Il giorno precedente, e la mattina stessa del volo avevamo visitato il Grand Canyon dalla sommità del bordo sud, lasciandoci stupefatti dallo spettacolo che si apriva sotto i nostri occhi. Il pomeriggio in volo è stato qualcosa di superlativo. Abbiamo visto scorci del Colorado e dei suoi affluenti, impossibili da vedere altrimenti. Esperienza, quella del sorvolo, che consiglio a tutti. La compagnia è affidabile, ed è la prima ad avere effettuato voli turistici. Il personale competente ed affabile. Abbiamo avuto un pilota oltremodo simpatico. Dimenticavo, durante il volo è possibile ascoltare le spiegazioni di ciò che state osservando in italiano. Grazie per la bellissima esperienza.

This was by far the most amazing excursion we have ever been on!  We did a flightseeing trip around Denali and then landed on the Ruth Glacier.  It didn’t hurt that Denali was showing all of her glory on the day we took this trip!  Our pilot was very professional, and the love he has for what he does came through resoundingly.  If you go to Talkeetna, make this a priority!

That plane ride is al lifetime experience!! 

Just do it!!

Great captain and most beautiful view, defiantly worth it.

Horrible experience when the third party booking company doesn't communicate with the actual servicing company. And the policies of the booking company don't apply with the servicing company. I had a hard time getting a hold of anyone after my booking was canceled due to inclimate weather but they were not understanding when I followed original booking cancelation policy. After finally communicating with a supervisor I was told I would get a refund but then weeks later I was told no. Horrible customer service.
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_text: We had something to celebrate on our trip to the US. In orde rto make it a memorable occasion, I booked the 45 min helicopter tour with Maverick. Tusayan is conveniently located just minutes from Grand Canyon NP. and the airport is well signposted. When we got to Maverick, we weer weighed in and then waited for the crowd to gather until the pilots called out the names of their passengers. The helicopters are pretty big (8-seaters). In the from there are 3 seats next tot he pilot, and 4 in the back. In our helicopter, there were only 4 passengers, 3 of whom sat in the front. I was one of them and I must say the views are amazing. The views from the rim are spectacular, but there is nothing like a bir's eye view of the Grand Canyon. Our pilot was very knowledgeable. Besides knowing how to fly the chopper he was also a very good tour guide. The whole setup at Maverick is very professional, from the moment you arrive until the moment you leave the airport, everything is well taken care of. A fabulous experience. Not the cheapest trip ever, but money wll spent.
Highly recommended - 5 islands, very informative, beautiful scenery, especially the Molokini crater!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: The plan was to make a glacier landing and hike on the glacier but unfortunately weather conditions would not permit.  We were offered our choice of a refund or a longer sightseeing flight to another set of glaciers.  We chose the sight seeing flight and enjoyed an 1,5 hour flight in an Otter viewing the spectacular mountains and glaciers!  Well worth doing!  The pilot was very informative and gave us a great flight!

We recently flew with Kim, a pilot with Redtail Aviation, and had a wonderful time.  We have spent a lot of time in the Moab, Utah area in our Jeep.  We visit every spring and are always amazed by the awesome landscape we find while 4-wheeling in the area.   This flight put a whole new perspective to the area!  We could look down and see some of our 4-wheeling trails but now could see on the 'other side' of the rocks.   There are arches in Canyonland that would be very difficult to see from the trails, but Kim pointed them out for us!    We highly recommend this flight!

review_title: Spectacular views and very professional and knowledgeable pilot!
review_text: We were blessed with a break in the weather and blue skies. Unfortunately the haze in the high elevation did not allow for us to see Denali but otherwise the views were breathtaking!  Our pilot, Will, was exceptional. We felt safe and and he gave us so much information about what we were seeing!  We absolutely would recommend this excursion!
There’s really no way to describe the trip, you just have to take it.  Worth every penny.  I’ve never had views like this before.  The bird’s eye view is unrivaled.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: It was safe and also informative. Pilot Brian was friendly and took good care of us. It is an understatement to call Kauai beautiful because it is much more than that. Thanks to air ventures for giving an aerial view of the place.

review_title: Can't get refund after they canceled last minute
review_text: I contacted them an hour before the flight to confirm before I rented a car to drive the hour. There was a light rain so I was concerned and they assured me the flight was going to take place. Then I learned the man I spoke to wasn't the decision-maker and a pilot called just before the flight and cancelled. The rain was mild and hadn't changed in that hour. I cannot seem to get a refund  It's been 2 months.

review_title: Totally different and amazing way to see Canyonlands
review_text: We went on the 50m Canyonlands/Arches flight on a pefect clear morning. Words cant describe the view. Gives you a whole new appreciation for the parks. Our pilots were great and gave a very thorough briefing and description of the flight, plus a very informative commentary throughout. We have done lots of hiking in the parks, but this flight really completed the visit. Perfect.
It was an amazing experience with a nice view over Miami. The pilot was great and we had a good time up there.

The pilot was amazing and made our trip so much better. He made sure everyone got a good view of the glaciers. The service was great. I forgot my coat at the hotel and they were kind enough to let me borrow one.

review_title: Flight to Denali with Glacier Landing
review_text: We took a flight to Denali wit a glacier landing and it was the best excursion of our trip. Clay was our pilot and due to the clouds around the mountain he worked his flying magic to get us a view of the peak. The glacier landing was unbelievable and an experience you should have on your bucket list. Also viewing the glacier rivers were exquisite. TAT was an excellent company and I highly suggest them for your flight-seeing excursion. Definitely worth the money.

review_title: Great Experience...Would Definitely Do It Again!
review_text:
We were considering doing a heli tour, but I came across Wings on here and saw how well-rated and how much cheaper it was.  Well, I'm soooo glad I went with Wings (flew on 8/19).  It's a small family-run operation and there's such a personal touch to it.  Bruce and Ellen are so nice and accommodating.  They even took our picture before we took off and used it for the cover of the CD they gave us (didn't check it out yet to see exactly what's on it yet).

They provide some water and ginger candies which are supposed to help with any air sickness.  During the taxi to the runway, Bruce goes over the checklist with the co-pilot (whichever passenger gets the lucky seat) which is a nice little lesson on the different buttons in the cockpit and how things work with the plane...my engineering mind was content.  We had a nice, rather smooth ride.  Bruce did a great bit of narration throughout the entire ride and engaged us as well...he knew all of our names right off the bat too.  There are some things you just can't see from a car or a hike which makes the plane right  all the more worthwhile.

I've never done a helicopter ride, but the family members I was with said that it was definitely better than a heli ride.  I'm sure having Bruce as the pilot surely helped with that assessment.  Go ahead and give Wings Over Kauai a try...you won't regret it!!

review_title: Views Above It All ~ Beautiful Kauai
review_text:
Wings Over Kauai is the BEST in every sense.  They were very easy to work with in setting up the flight well before we docked in Kauai.  They gave clear information on the "how to's" of pickup and drop off.  Since we arrived via cruise ship that information is very important.

The flight was wonderful....awesome....we could not have asked for more.  The pilot was great and very knowledgable about the island.  Everything was perfect.

Our thanks go out to everyone at Wings Over Kauai.  This was an exceptional tour and we were very happy to have discovered the true beauty of Kauai.....views from above.
There is so much that can only be seen and appriecated by air in Kauai. As a private pilot I can attest to their attention to safety and professionalism.

review_title: this is a must in Kauai
review_text: First I wanted to do this trip on a doors-off helicopter to be able to do better photos, but the two companies I found did not meet my requirements (Jack Harter Helicopters: there is a risk you get the middle seat from which you do not see properly and cannot really take photos, while Mauna Loa Helicopters unfortunately do not accept solo travellers) so I finally chose Air Ventures and it was a good choice, also much cheaper than any helicopter flights :) Our nice pilot, Desi, shared a lot of interesting info about the island and the views were truly amazing. If you are visiting several islands and want to do only one air trip, Kauai is the one. All in all, it was a fantastic experience that I would recommend to anyone. Warning: wear dark clothes, even your hands' reflection might be visible on the photos.

review_title: Mt. Denali National Park air tour
review_text: We had a very enjoyable 90-minute air tour of Mt. Denali National Park, seeing the peaks and glaciers up close. The pilot was informative and pleasant, making it a very enjoyable experience.

We did our Air Ventures tour of Kauai on December 17 with Harry as our Pilot. He was very professional and did a great job of making sure that we saw all of the beautiful sights of Kauai. My favorite place to see, of course, was the Napoli Coast. I was very glad we got a great look at it by air, as our Sunset Dinner Cruise down the Napoli Coast had to be rerouted to the Southern Coast due to the intense waves. I would definitely recommend this air tour to everyone that wants to see the sights of the entire Island in an hour. I would do it again in a heartbeat.

Must do!!! One of my most rememberable experiences while I was in Alaska. The staff was extremely flexible and understanding  due to rainy weather. We flew with Chris, who was very friendly and knowledgeable. The views were breathtaking!! Even though we were initially told we wouldn’t be able to take part in the glacier landing, the weather cleared up just in time and Chris was able to land the plane safely. I would definitely recommend this company and if I’ve ever back in Alaska I’ll be taking another flight myself!

It's hard to choose what the best part was. The flight over the coastlines were great, the stop in Hilo at Ken's pancakes was an awesome stop, and the waterfalls on the way back were amazing! Eric also let my kids take turns flying. All-around great experience.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: An amazing aerial tour of Kauai.  Eric was our pilot and he assured our safety and comfort and provided lots of information about the island.  Worth every penny.  Highly recommend this tour.  Thanks Eric and Kaycee.

There are so many reasons to go with WOK vs. a helicopter tour. But the top reasons are:

1. Personalized service!! We chose to do the small cessna tour for my husband and I, along with our 9 mo old daughter. We got a private tour with Capt. Bruce. If we had booked a helicopter tour, we would have been sitting on top of other strangers. We also received a FREE digital picture in front of the plane before the tour. Most companies would charge you for this type of thing. 

2. Price - for half the cost of a helicopter tour, WOK is really a great bang for your buck! We also appreciated the fact that we didn't have to pay for our daughter either.

I would without a doubt recommend this tour for anyone! Save your money and go with WOK. You won't regret it at all. 

Tip: Book this at the beginning of your time on Kauai just in case the weather is less than ideal to fly. We did this and I am glad we did because we had a lot of flexibility when the fog was really bad one day.

Assuming the cost is not an issue this is very well worth it.  Extremely smooth flight and landings.  Landing on the Glacier standing look around at the mountains towering above is incredible.  Sitting at a restaurant an hour later it all seemed just a dream. 
Great pilot.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Incredible experience, great way to see the whole Grand Canyon!
review_text:
The flight was incredible with great narration and awesome sights! Well worth it. 

What detracted from the experience was the lack of information up front, even when I called 1 day prior to the trip to confirm. I was staying at Bright Angel lodge (18 minute drive from the airport), no-one told me that there was no transportation to the airport, no bus, taxi, or Uber. I had to pay a private person $100 each way to get to the airport and back, the only option was not to do the flight after I paid for it.

My copilot and I were on a 35 hour layover in Anchorage and were looking for something fun for the day.  The weather was good, so we headed to Talkeetna.  We checked at K2 when we got into town and they had 2 seats on the 3:00pm flight. Check in was smooth and easy (thanks staff!)

All I can say is WOW!!  best experience ever!  Chad was our pilot and did a great job of making all the passengers feel at ease.  He flew the Otter like the expert he is.  

The views were the most spectacular I have ever seen.  I don't think there is a better way to see Denali.  Absolutely a fantastic experience and have already recommended it to all my family and friends.  Thanks K2, Chad, and staff!

The weather was iffy at best.  We were debating on whether to go or try on our ride back.  The owner was very honest with us and would give us our money back if we wanted.  The weather ended up clearing up enough so we went!  So glad we did.  Flying into the mountain/glacier was incredible!  The pilot was great!  She was very knowledgeable and nicely did the family pictures!   Highly recommend this company.  It's well worth the money!   A great tour!

I’d flown with K2 a few years ago on the Grand Denali flight and was looking for a repeat this year. Unfortunately we awoke to heavy rain and a low ceiling; an email from K2 offered options from canceling with a full refund, re-scheduling, or staying in touch to see how the day developed. We opted for the latter and got a call mid-morning telling us that the clouds had lifted enough to make shorter flights up to the lower glaciers. We decided to go for it and even this limited tour didn’t disappoint. We spent about an hour with excellent pilot and guide Mark, who gave everyone a good view of the glaciers and spectacular terrain of southern Denali. Even on a gray day there were amazing sights and great photo opportunities. I’d fly with K2 any time and look forward to doing it again!

From the minute we arrived at the terminal and were greeted by Sherry and Capt. Bruce it was a wonderful experience. We felt that we came to see our good, old friends whom we haven’t seen for a long time. The check in took only a few minutes and we were ready to board the plane.  Bruce is an expert pilot who has flown over 5,000 flights over Kauai so you may feel extremely safe, relax and enjoy the flight.  The flight experience was out of this world; with the cost being very reasonable we recommend everyone visiting Kauai to take a flight. In addition to being an expert pilot Capt. Bruce has a vast knowledge of the island history, flora, fauna, etc., which he shared with us during the flight.  We highly recommend taking a flight with the “Wings over Kauai”!!!

Chamil and Tatiana, Colorado, USA
Amazing views. Focus on the beautiful islands of Maui and the whales. Superior flight. Learned so much about Maui.

We flew over the Denali Mountains then landed on a glacier. So surreal.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable of our surroundings. Lots of information about the Denali mountains.  
We almost didn’t get to land because of clouds and wind. But everything worked out in the end we were all safe on a bright sunny day. With no clouds.

Great experience, the pilot was personable and very knowledgeable about the area.  He pointed out many areas of interest, and knew a lot of the history of the various areas.  Highly recommend this tour!.  Don't arrive too early though - there waiting area is unattended and minimal.  Wear shoes/clothes that can get wet, and if you have mobility issues let them know before booking the tour. The boarding facilities are minimal also, and it is a seaplane!
Absolument parfait malgré un prix un peu élevé, ça en vaut la peine et notre pilote, David, était très agréable.

Another Bucket list item and nature wonder . It’s a bit of a walk although with some effort there was 4 people who took a guy with a wheel chair to see this .  We loved this , its only 10 minutes from Antelope canyon . Easy to do both in one day .
Beautiful trip of Marin County and SF.  Super skilled and friendly pilot made the trip even more fun!

If you have a chance to go, definitely do it. I was able to do the glacier landing. Our weather that day was perfect. It is amazing to fly around the range and a great way to get a perspective of how big Denali actually is. We landed on the Ruth glacier. It was amazing to feel how warm it actually was up there. We were fine with just sweatshirts that day. We did here that it is always good to bring layers though. It is hard to describe what being on a glacier is like. It is just something that has to be experienced. The planes are small, so if you have claustrophobia that might be an issue. Also if you get motion sickness or can't stand turbulence, you might want to take something before your flight. When coming off the glacier and back to the airport, we encountered thermals which created a short period of turbulence. Still definitely worth every minute of it.

review_title: A wow eperience for my wife...
review_text: The intention to do it was 6 months ago, however the booking was made only a few days ahead. The previous few days of bad weather incorporated snow, and it appears that may have put on extra flights at 8 AM. There were 5 helicopters flying out at that time! The skies were blue without a cloud. Although I am quite light, I got the rear window seat, however my wife had the most amazing experience of her life being on the opposite side of the pilot, the best seat in the “house”, window in front and below. This was the 45-50 minute Spirit flight, with ample time to take in the canyon and photographs, avoiding the no-fly zone across the main part of the canyon, going east, then across to the north rim, and then crossing back to the south beyond Hermit’s rest. The commentary could have been better avoiding cheesy jokes.

Maverick is very professional. A truly amazing ride touring most of the Grand Canyon. The pilot answered questions in flight and gave us an insightful description of the sights before us. Great playlist too! A must do experience!

I wanted to do something special with my girl, and the truth is they had me at "Champagne".  Picture ice cold bubbly, my girl cuddled next to me, the Maui Sunset, her growing smile that became plastered permanently for the hour...WIN-WIN!  Highly recommended - DO IT!  Great pilot, amazing experience, worth it! We WILL remember this hour for the rest of our lives! Thanks so much MauiPlaneRides.com

A wonderful flightaround Kuaui, seeing many of the sights that you can see in no other way!

Very friendly and informative staff!

Highly recommended!

Super moment passé avec notre pilote Olsen, il nous a bien tout expliqué !
Super cool le mec  avec sa playlist oldschool dans l'hélico, j'ai vraiment apprécié !

review_title: Don’t Miss the Grand Denali tour!
review_text: If the sun is out, as it was for us, the Grand Denali flight is not to be missed. It was a memorable and very exciting experience. Don’t bother driving 3+ hours to Denali NP, you cannot see Denali from there, and can only travel into the Park 14 miles. The commentary from the pilot added greatly to the trip.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Better late than never! I did this 5.5 years ago and LOVED IT!
review_text:
It's Alyssa Jacey, the singer/songwriter you hosted on the private helicopter tour! I have been MEANING to review this and my only excuse is that I went on tour! I've opened for Bruno Mars, PEPPER, Andy Grammer, Lisa Loeb, Tavana and about 20 others! Anyway, enough about me. THIS TRIP WAS OUTSTANDING! I loved every second. It was so gorgeous, I felt very safe, they had a clean, comfortable heli...it was all wonderful. Not to mention their staff! LOVED them. So sweet, genuine...there was a lovely girl there at the time that hand drew me a map of the island...just to have! Anyway, I'll be coming back my next time to the island! I'll be on my 3rd tour in a year next month (June 7-19) to HNL. Visit Alyssa Jacey dot com for show details, maybe you can come to one of the nine?? 

To all considering Wings Over Kauai...stop hesitating and do it! You'll love it!

Sincerely,
~Alyssa Jacey
The vistas were lovely, but my 11 year old was underwhelmed and fell asleep on the ride back. In the future, I might do this trip with my husband and leave the kids on the ship.

review_title: Maybe not as thrilling as a helicopter ride, but cheaper and safer!
review_text:
We chose the GCA Visionary tour based primarily on safety (helicopter accidents @GC are much more common than fixed wing ones) and secondly on price (its a lot cheaper than a helicopter, and you can find a 2-1 voucher on the internet if you look, which works out slightly cheaper than the online discounted price per person).

Firstly I should say that everything ran smoothly. Pickup from hotel was on time, only a short wait at Boulder City Airport and we were off. From my seat I could see the cockpit and assessed (as a former pilot) the pilot and co-pilot (the latter was in charge of the aircraft whilst airborne) to be very professional.The return trip to LV was also prompt.

I very much enjoyed the tour. Alas my partner kept her eyes front for the whole duration because she was too scared to look out of the window! We chose the early morning set off, but I suspect that a later flight might give better lighting for photos and videos.

Okay, the flight could have gone further along the canyon. And whilst you get a good view, it is  perhaps not as great as with a helicopter. But if you are short on time and have a limited budget, but still want to experience the Grand Canyon, then this is a good option.

Flying with Wings Over Kauai was a wonderful experience.  The reservation process was easy and they were very flexible in order to accommodate our schedule. When we arrived everyone was extremely friendly and the checkin process was a breeze. Bruce informed us there was some haze and checked the weather to see if the next few days would offer better viewing.  Since there was some rain in the forecast we decided to go that day, and we were happy we did. We took the smaller Cessna plane.  Bruce was a wonderful pilot - it was an extremely smooth flight and Bruce was a great guide.  And the sights were awesome.  This is a great alternative for people who are nervous about helicopters (like me) or who have weight limits and cannot take a helicopter.

review_title: Delighted with our choice of plane over helicopter
review_text:
We debated helicopter vs plane  and eventually decided on the plane because we would see more and have more time in the air for less money.  I was also motivated by the fact that planes are safer than helicopters and use less gas. 

We were delighted with our choice. We were made feel so welcome by Bruce and his daughter - charming people. Our pilot was Marcus. I was nervous because he is young but he has great credentials and inspires confidence.  He did a great job telling us about Kauai. 

 The weather wasn't good so I was nervous about a bumpy ride but Marcus knew exactly where the smooth spots were while still showing us everything.  We each had a big window and could talk to each other over the headsets. My husband loved being in the co-pilot seat. We had a great time and highly recommend.
We got to see Denali on one of it's clearest days ever!  The tour was unforgettable, and Patrick, our pilot, was awesome!!

review_title: THE way to see San Francisco
review_text: THE way to see San Francisco!  Our shuttle picked us up from next to the Hard Rock cafe on Pier 39.  The seaplane ride was amazing.  We got great views of the coastline, Muir Woods, and the city of San Francisco.  Pilot was very informative and flight very smooth.  Thank you!

We took our 6 & 8 yr old boys on an evening flight with a glacier landing (Ruth Glacier). Flying between the mountains and taking in the various glaciers etc was great. 45 min flight to the landing, 15 mins on the ground and then a shorter ride back as your descending. I would highly recommend it for everyone including families with little ones! They loved the snowball fight on July 4th.

Taking a plane ride with air ventures in Kauai, hawaii was truly a memorable experience. Paul was our pilot and flew all over Kauai to show us the beauty of that island.Paul explained alot of "history" of the island and explained what we were seeing while flying.The Napali coastline and the canyon were unbelievable.I recommend this experience to everyone wanting to see an entire island while visiting for a short time.

Tour was a part of a Road Scholar trip. Felt safe and the scenery was awesome. You really get a perspective of the vastness of the Grand Canyon. Only complaint was lack of narration. Played a tape of the sights that repeated itself and was not very instructional. It would seem that the co-pilot could point out some interesting landmarks or if they are going to use a recording the quality could be improved.

review_title: Great way to see the Puget Sound and beyond
review_text:
We chose to fly to an escape to Vancouver island and were impressed by the efficiency, hospitality and safety of this airline. We loved the views on the outbound trip - in fact they did a flyover of northern Mercer Island so that a passenger could photograph his house from the air. The views were exceptional and the landings smooth as silk.  In the face of worsening weather on the return they demonstrated great judgement about getting us back home by aborting the initial route, turning around and taking a safer route with better visibility. 
Comfort was also a factor. I have been on other seaplanes on which we were squeezed against the wall of the plane because so many people were on one bench style seat. On these de haviland planes we each had our own window seat - and no aisle mates. How civilized is that!
Wow!  Just absolutely stunning views!  Amazing customer service!  Would go every day if I could!  Worth every cent!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: The whole experience with AirVentures Hawaii inKuaii was positive.  Pick-up near the cruise port, assistance in boarding for my husband.  A very smooth flight around an unbelievable island.  Next time will do the BiPlane!

This was the best tour we have ever taken. From the first moment we arrived we were looked after in a friendly and efficient way. However, the majesty of the Kauai scenery just blew us away as we took off and toured the island. The 1 hour flight, with a pilot that made everything interesting was superb. Even down to the soundtrack he played during the flight that fitted the occasion. It was worth every penny and at significantly cheaper than the helicopter tours, I would highly recommend this as the way to see the island and make lasting memories.
Great pilot, beautiful waterfalls and overall views. Would highly recommend this experience to a friend or anyone interested! Planes rule, helicopters suck!!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: Be very careful Do not book
review_text: Very frustrating! Horrible the Company canceled our tour in very short Notice and we had plans all arranged already,, Not sure if I will even get my money Back! Very upsetting and not recommended

review_title: Amazing Maui air tour experience, incredible photos, heart-pounding thrills, saved lots of $$$
review_text:
My fiance and I had a breathtaking experience here, a smooth flight with a super friendly and easy going pilot. 

We wanted to see the Sea Cliffs of Molokai island, as we had heard they're the tallest in the world, with waterfalls that fall 3000 feet from the top, straight down into the ocean! We looked around at some other options, the usual thing there everybody does, all were double the price for the both of us, and they couldn't guarantee window seats, it was shorter flight time, and we'd be flying with a group of strangers. 

The Maui plane ride was way less, a longer flight, a private experience, and we were the only ones. I even was able to fly the plane, which was thrilling, and easier and more fun than I ever thought it could be! 

We met at the airport, using the driving directions on the website and then we were taking off a few minutes later. We flew above the coast of Maui, which was rugged and looked beautiful from the air. The Maui plane rides was smooth, and flew at a slower pace which let us take in the views as I was coached by the pilot on how to keep the wings level- It was so much fun! The sensation of lifting up into the sky and then driving the plane was something I'll remember for the rest of my life! My fiance loved every minute of it, and it was a highlight of our time on Maui, without a doubt. 

If you're on Maui, and want something easy, fun, and comparably affordable among air activities, Maui plane rides is highly recommended. I think maybe they're a newer business, because I see this is the first review(?).    The pilots who fly  are professional pilots and flight instructors who make the flight and lesson so much fun, from start to finish. I really do wish them well and we want to support them, because they clearly love what they do, they do it well, and they do it for, honestly, a lot less than anyone else we saw. 

We were really impressed and totally thrilled by our Maui plane rides flight and lesson.
Had a tip from a local that this was the trip to take.  We will never forget the flight and amazing views.  This is definitely the company to take it with!

This flight was a highlight of our Alaskan adventure in many ways. As a retired pilot I enjoyed the flight in the Otter and envy our Pilot (Russ?) getting to fly around the fjords daily!. 
The scenery is spectacular and I would highly recommend taking the option of a landing on the fjord. Stepping out onto the float in the middle of the calm fjord, in near silence, was just amazing.

We originally planned the Summit tour although weather didn ´t allow us to. K2 aviation team offered to us shorter experience flight with was available. We are glad we decided to listen to them and accept shorter flight too. It was amazing, views were breathtaking and at the end we saw also the top of Denali and many rainbows around our plane. I would recommend this flight to everyone, it was worth every penny and our pilot Doug was perfect, talked during whole flight about all mountains we ha seen and many stories too. He made the tour special for us.

A must for those who have a Flight Over, around and across the spectacular Island of Kauai, Hawaii. Known as"The Garden Island" for its lush and densemfoolage and rugged backdrops, AirAdventures offers a great way to "get up-close and personal" with nature.

This little operation  at first glance appears a bit small & laid back to play with the big boys" of the "scenic flight operations" but don't let that fool you. They may appear laid back and easy going, but the entire team is 100% on their game and very professional.They just keep it  low key so as not to stress the fainthearted and they work their charm.

I've been in the tourism business for some 40 years and AirAdventures is certainly right up there with the best.
Thanks for a wonderful experience! We had a beautiful view of the island and great narration and music!

What else is there to say about TAT that hasn't been said before?  They are by far the premiere "flightseeing" attraction in Talkeetna, AK.  The entire staff could not have been more pleasant and helpful.  They pointed me in the direction of which tour I should take, as I was unsure/nervous about the trip ahead.  They eased any fear I had, and for that I could not be more thankful.  I bombarded them with questions, and they were able (and happy) to answer any and all of them. 
The flight itself was perfect.  Our pilot (shout out Clay) was professional and informational.  He knew when to point out attractions down below and when to just let the passengers enjoy the scenery.  The flight was smooth and the landing on the glacier even better.  He made sure everyone was comfortable at all times, leading to a truly once in a lifetime experience.  Cannot recommend this company enough.

review_title: BEST way to experience the Grand Canyon
review_text: This was my first time to the Grand Canyon and my first helicopter ride. It was a great way to experience the canyon from a birds eye view! The colors were beautiful! The pilot was extremely knowledgeable and I was able to get some great pictures! If you get car sick easily I would recommend taking some motion sickness medication before the ride...I happened to get very sick towards the end of the ride. You do not get to choose where you sit on the helicopter. Some people were forced to sit in the middle back row due to weight distribution. You may also not be seated by your family. Well worth the money if you want to experience the canyon.
I really enjoyed being able to fly as a pilot with an excellent instructor and tour guide. Would do it again in a heartbeat. Thanks

review_title: Flight Seeing Adventure - not to be missed
review_text:
Our family of 7 had an excellent time.  With our pilot (I believe his name was Mike) giving us a detailed description of everything we were flying over - his expert knowledge and skillful flying we had an awesome adventure seeing Denali and the surrounding mountains.   The views were breathtaking.    I recommend this company to everyone.    Everything was very professional - from the booking to the entire flight.    
An experience of a lifetime.
Steven was an excellent pilot. He was knowledgeable and polite. We had a great time in the air. He even took our pictures

We booked a Denali flightseeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi and had an excellent experience!  The pilot talked to us on our headsets about mountaineering on Denali, geology, the glaciers, and local climbing history.  We were lucky to have a clear day, so the photo opportunities and the galcier landing were spectacular.  The staff is very flexible and helpful.  This was one of the best travel experiences I've ever had, and I've had a few.  Highly recommended!

review_title: Best experience we've had in Alaska!
review_text: We come up every year just to hang out and relax.  Decided this year to take this flight.  We should have done it years ago.  Scheduling the flight was easy, the staff was professional and friendly, the facilities are top notch, Dan (our pilot), explained all things about the aircraft and the trip and did a great job telling us about the area over which we were flying.  All-in-all this was just awesome.  Of course it helped that we had an awesome look at Denali (thanks to the weather).  If you can only do one thing while you're here I'd highly recommend K2!!

review_title: What a great way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: We decided to take a helicopter tour over the grand canyon and decided to go with Maverick tours. We arrived at 1 for our 1:45 tour. We were weighed and checked in immediately. They have a nice little gift shop there to poke around in while you wait for your tour. Our pilot Matt came in and greeted us and another couple. So there were 4 plus of course the pilot. He was so nice. We were given a life "jacket" just went around your waist, and headphones. Instructed with the seat belt and we were on our way. Views are just spectacular and jaw dropping. It was worth every penny for that experience. Not for a minute was I scared or nervous. Just taken aback by the beauty. It was a 45 minute tour. Highly recommend it!
Steve was awesome. Flight was smooth and he was very informative. Highly recommend Maui Plane Rides and looking forward to coming back!

We would highly recommend going on an air excursion with Air Ventures.  My husband and I were picked up from our resort and brought to the airport and returned after the flight, at no additional cost.  All 6 members of the touring party arrived early so our pilot took us out ahead of schedule.  We went all around Kauai and also inland to see the Canyon and the beautiful waterfalls.  We were also fortunate enough to get a perfect shot of a humpback whale breaching right under us!  Loved it!  No vacation to Kauai is complete until you see it from the air and we are glad we went by Air Ventures!

review_title: One of the must do in Alaska. TAT is recommended highly.
review_text: We did grand denali tour and glacier landing. Denali, its northern face, its surroundings, glaciers and glacier landing are a sight to see. I have motion sickness issue but only faced minor discomfort. TAT is priced well compared to competitors.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Flying with K2 was the highlight of our trip.  We did the Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing, and it was worth every dollar.  Our original flight date had poor weather, so we rescheduled for two days later when we'd be back in Talkeetna.  When the weather was poor on our original date, K2 explained our options clearly and helped us reschedule.  The flight was incredible.  Once above the clouds, we had unobstructed views of Mt. Denali and surrounding peaks.  Our pilot did a wonderful job of pointing out prominent peaks, glaciers, and climbing routes within the Alaska Range.  It was all breathtaking and an amazing experience.

It was really a great flight. Itv covered a lot of area, and was a longer flight than the helicopters.  The cost was lower than the helicopters, and weight was not a concern.  Every seat is a window seat with a great view.  They do pick ups and drop you off, even at the cruise ship dock.  If you are on the Pride of America, the flight is a good way to fill the morning before the ship sails.  I would definatly recomend the flight.

This was a fantastic experience for our family! Such great views of the range from the air that will remain with us for a long time. Because of the weather we were not able to do the glacier landing but despite that it was breathtaking. The staff is professional and very friendly. Highly recommended.
Take of an landing were smooth and we had more than enough time to see everything this the Bay Area had to offer!

Amazing plane ride!  We were a bit cautious arriving at the small local airport.  When we met our pilot, Larry, all fears were put at ease.   He was amazing!   Great tour guide and even better pilot!   Loved every minute in the air!  Highly recommend this tour!

What an incredible day 
The Grand Tour by TAT was over the top beautiful stunning bucket list worthy
The people that work here are all awesome
Annie- what can I say but you are so terrific
Our pilot was great and took as to all sides of Denali
Landed us beautifully near their in Little Switzerland on a glacier
Gorgeous day fabulous 2 hour flight
Highly recommend this excellent company

You have to see kaui from the air. We tried this trip having taken the helicopter the last time we where on Kauai - 10 years ago. My wife like it better. Not so much quick movements as with a helicopter. Lots of room too with big windows. We were real lucky having an amazing clear day where even the top of the mountain was clear. Such amazing views with a very knowledgeable pilot. He always made sure to circle around the major sights so both sides of the plain can see. Smooth take off and landing...just like floating in a cloud. Go you will not regret it!

Westwind was recommended to me by the Four Seasons Scottsdale.  The hotel made all of our arrangements and they did not disappoint.  Lindsey at Westwind welcomed my party to the terminal bright and early on the morning of December 29th.  This was after being picked up by their shuttle at our hotel.  Every aspect of the trip was covered.  We never lifted a finger.  On top of this we were originally scheduled to travel to the South Rim; however, due to snow they changed our itinerary to the West Rim.  They wanted to ensure we had a wonderful day.  We did have a wonderful day.  In fact it was an amazing day.  Words cannot describe the views we saw of the Grand Canyon.  We covered all forms of transportation from plane, helicopter, boat and bus.  This tour cannot be recommended enough if you are staying in the Phoenix area.  Make sure to ask for Lindsey and she will take great care of you and your party!

Lieu d'activité de transport de voyageur et de fret par hydravion, accueil chaleur et lieux de décollage exception, la situation de Fish Lake permet de pouvoir accéder rapidement au différent Lac et rivière descendant des différents monts de la face Sud du Denali national park "Park du Mont McKinley".

The staff and pilot were so kind and attentive to us. We had the most amazing flight that words cannot express, simply stunning views. I had been working with one particular staff member who kept me updated with adjusted schedules due to COVID. We made this trip with friends and family and I was planning on a second flight with another son arriving the following day, working with the staff to make this trip as wonderful for him. Heavy rain prevented us from doing the trip but we will do it again. Thank you Talkeetna Air staff...you made a memory for our family and friends we will never forget.  Nor the kindness you extended to us!

My family and I flew with K2 out of Talkeetna in July 2016.  We originally signed up for the Grand Tour, but due to clouds on the far side of the mountain we had to shift to the Denali Flyer.  We were not disappointed in the least.  Mike, our pilot, gave us a fantastic tour or the mountains, and was able to find a break in the clouds to get us a great view of Denali.  We did a glacier landing at Denali basecamp which has always been on my bucket list.  My kids, ages 6 to 11, had a fantastic time through the whole trip.  I definitely recommend this flight for families with kids, and I highly recommend the glacier landing.  Thank you K2!  This was the crown jewel in our trip yo Alaska.

review_title: Best Value to See Kauai By Air
review_text:
My huband, daughter, brother, and sister-in-law toured with WOK on June 10.  The pre-flight check in was very informative - given by Bruce and Ellen's daughter, Mary.  And Bruce was just fantastic as the pilot and guide.  We've been to Kauai numerous times, but had not toured the island by air.  This really gave us the perspective we had been missing.  So much of the island isn't accessible by anything other than air and as such, we were able to see so many sights we had previously missed. 

As others have noted, Bruce manuevered the plane to allow all to get pictures of Na Pali and the waterfalls.  The scenery is just breathtaking!  Helicopter tours may get you closer, but in my opinion, it just isn't worth the significant increase in cost.  WOK is one of the best values we have found for exploring Kauai and highly recommend this company and its tour.

My float plane trip with Seawind Aviation was definitely an experience of a lifetime! I couldn't think of a better way to enjoy the beauty and grandeur of SE Alaska. I was visiting after the tourist season but Lesley and Steve were very accommodating to make sure I got out on a tour. Lesley was great about staying in touch with me to make sure we could find a time that worked with my travel dates. I would recommend this as a definite "bucket list" item for anyone visiting SE Alaska.  I was a bit nervous about going up in a small aircraft but this was one of the smoothest flights I've ever experienced. Steve is an amazing pilot and I'd recommend their tours to anyone!

The chopper is one of the most spectacular ways to discover the Grand Canyon. Very well organized tour with Check-out on time. We flew over much of the canyon with detailed explanations from our pilot. A unique experience.

My wife and I have taken more than 20 flights over Kauai.  The bi-plane flight was by far the very best.  The pilot (Kevin) provided us with tons of history and took us to all the places that we requested.  The bi-plane is awesome.  The altitude we flew at was perfect for incredible videos and photos.

Our pilot Garrett, provided a smooth and confident flight over parts of the Denali National Park pointing out various features of the landscape below.  The views from the plane were awe inspiring.  Landing on and walking the Kahiltna glacier allowed us a further unique perspective, otherwise only available to serious mountain climbers.   This was the top highlight our our Alaska vacation and highly recommended.

The crew were amazing, the flight outstanding.... I can not say enough about this crew/ company... Don't leave the island with out taking this flight!!!! 

They also pick you right up at the pier and return you...bonus!!! 
Thank you Josh, Bruse and Angel 

Paula and John Lawrence from NB Canada

Our 1 hour flightseeing tour of Denali was a spectacular highlight of our trip to Alaska. Our pilot Bill was competent and professional which put us all at ease. And as we approached the mountain the clouds lifted and I think I heard angels singing. Truly a vision. I highly recommend the tour and K2. My only caution is that the airspace gets very crowded on nice days, so don't expect lots of narration as your pilot will need to focus on talking to the traffic to keep everyone safe.

Thanks very much for the pilot for his services was perfect. Safe and fun. Thanks to Ed for his communication even though our family was late about 15-30minute from the time that we suppose to be in the plane

review_title: Great aerial tour, Great Narration, Great Value!
review_text:
Josh was our pilot and did a fantastic job with his enthusiastic and knowledgable narration of the awesome island of Kauai. (He is a great pilot too.)  Val made us feel welcome and was helpful in selecting a good time for the tour based on the day's weather.  Highly recommended - would do it again!

Charles & Lise Brown

If i can include more stars I would, my friend surprised me with this flight tour and it was the best surprise EVERRR 😊!The staff was friendly and kind.we had an incredible experience.Thank you so much 🙏

Forrest our pilot was a brilliant pilot and a wealth of knowledge.
I overcame my nerves and after 30 or 40 minutes we landed on a lake in the middle of the Ketchikan Misty Fjords.
Climbing onto the flotation thingies and photographing the surrounds was an unforgettable experience.
Ketchikan in springtime - Absolutely Fabulous.

We had a great scenic flight with AirVentures. As soon as we arrived, we were welcomed with a big smile as we ‘checked in’, and shortly after Jill gave us some info on what to expect. Then we met our pilot, Captain Ray, who is a very nice guy with loads of experience and just great fun to be around. A short safety demo and some pics later, we were on our way. We had perfect weather and had great views of the Na Pali coastline, the ‘Jurassic Park’ waterfall, Waimea Canyon and Tunnels Beach, just to name a few. It was simply stunning and a great experience. Ray was very informative, knew a lot about the island, it’s history and what we were looking at and made sure we were in the best spot to take photo’s. A great landing completed the trip and we couldn’t be happier with this activity. I would definitely recommend this flight and if you’re lucky enough to fly with Ray, you’ll enjoy it even more. Thank you Team AirVentures for making our visit to Kauai even better!
Amazing flight over the great gorge of Ruth glacier and the whole McKinley montain. Beatiful views, safe plane and kind and confidence pilt.
Everything was great! It was a great experience and I highly recommend this company. It really worths it.

review_title: Great views of the Island and excellent customer service
review_text:
Our experience with WOK was so personable and inviting that we felt like we were the only customers they had.  Of course they were booked and had plenty of customers but we felt very welcomed.  We lucked out with the weather and had excellent views of the coastline, valleys and the many water falls.  
The aircraft fit the 5 of us comfortably but it was difficult for the people on the left of the plane to see some of the sights on the right. 
Bruce was a great pilot and tour guide.  He had lots of info on the island and TV and Movie scene locations.  It made it all very interesting.  Although we were flying higher than the helicopters, we were still able to get a good look at the landscape of the island.  
WOK gave us some nice freebees such as a DVD with some video shots of the island that we just visited and a kukui seed necklace for my mom .  
This was our 3rd trip to Kauai but first time seeing it by air.  We would highly recommend this company and plan to use WOK again on our next trip.

review_title: Twenty Minute Tour of Friday Harbor
review_text: This is definitely something worth doing.  We had a great time and our pilot not only showed us interesting data points about the various islands we were viewing but circled around some orcas he spotted from the air.  We had seen the orcas the day before from our whale watching water boat tour, but it was a kick to see them from the air.
Bucket list experience! My wife and I truly enjoyed the flight. We had no issues getting our 50 something year old bodies in and out of the biplane.
Don't let your fear of flying stop you from taking a Glacier landing flight - smoothest flight I have ever been on!

review_title: 100% effort given by company and they WILL get you to your cruise ship in time 🙂
review_text:
Taquan Air created a highlight of our whole cruise.  My in-laws said "we didn't like it, we LOVED it!"  Booking was simple. Had a few questions so I called and were very helpful and professional.   The pilot was so friendly, talkative, and knowledgeable about the area.  The flight lasted the whole hour advertised and we flew over so much breathtaking scenery - my in-laws favorite was the high up mountain lakes.  The shuttle bus that took us back to our cruise ship was awesome..... our ship was at the end of the line of ships in Port that day and a decent walk from the pickup point but Taquan Air dropped us off right in front of our cruise ship.  We had been a bit stressed about it because we only had about a half hour from the end of the tour time until all aboard for our ship but, all stress was taken away when they said they could drop us right in front of our ship at the end. We were back on the ship well before our deadline time.
Thank you all so much and we will find you for another flight next time we're there!
I couldn’t believe how close they when to the mountain and it was beautiful and we really enjoyed it but not for the weak stomach people out there

We did the Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing. We had a picture perfect morning. Our pilot, Will, excecuted perfect take-offs and landings and the flight was so smooth I hardly felt I was in an airplane until I looked out the windows and saw the incredible mountains, glaciers, cliffs and snow-covered valleys and passes. I was a bit anxious because I can get dizzy at higher altitudes and get motion sickness, but this flight was so smooth I was completely comfortable. I am not talented enough to describe the views and exhilaration of this experience. It is an amazing experience that I cannot recommend highly enough. I want to thank Will (and Anjel, who greeted us upon our departure and also served us the night before at the Wildflower, lol) and all the people at TAT for this amazing experience.

Experience was great, we schedule the flight at 7:30 til 8:30 because we wanted to have the chance to watch the sunset, unfortunately the administration that is in charge of this did not make it at the time it was schedule for, we also arrived 30 min before to not have any issue and be in the sky before the sunset instead of that we waited for a hour in the lobby, the city was still beautiful during the night time and the person flying us was really nice and attentive.
An outstanding trip around Kaua’i.  Desi provided us with an experience that we won’t forget.  She was professional in her performance as a pilot and has a great personality.  Thanks!!

We did a scenic Seattle tour. The pilot, Brad, was excellent, both as a pilot and a tour leader. We tailored our flight to fly over our home. Of course the take off and landings were highlights, especially  for the two first timers aboard. Roger

This was an awesome experience! I had to convince my husband to do this and it ended up being his favorite excursion we did on our trip to Alaska. This is a family ran business that was so friendly, professional and just all around good people. Our pilot did a fantasic job. The views were amazing so if you are on the fence just book it. You will not be disappointed.
Great way to see entire island. We choose this on our first day then planed rest of stay after seeing from above.

This was a FABULOUS experience.  We lucked out and were seated in one of the 3 front passenger seats.  I have no idea what the views were like in the 4 back seats, but our views were spectacular!  Seating is assigned based on weight and balance.  This IS a pricey tour, but it was definitely worth it.  In the winter, there is no access to the North rim via car, so this is the ONLY way to see that portion of the canyon while the roads are closed.  Only 10% of all visitors see the north rim, so we feel privileged on multiple levels.

We left from our cruise ship and took a boat charter into the Misty Fjords with Taquan Air (pilot: Van) brining is back. Great tour. The boat captain and crew were friendly and informative. We saw a whale, Brown Bear, harbor seals, and eagles on our 3.5 hr tour. It is a long boat ride out from Ketchikan, but again, the boat crew kept us interested and even served snacks. The return flight was our first on a floatplane and as hoped, it was not exciting :). Overall a great way to see the Fjords.
Anybody visiting alaska, please do this trip. Completely worth it ! Fantastic views of mt mckinley and the sister mountains. Glacier landing was a surreal experience. Would do it again !

review_title: Awesome!  Best way to see and appreciate the grandeur of the Grand Canyon!
review_text: My family and I thoroughly enjoyed our aerial and jeep tour of the South Rim of the Grand Canyon.  This was our first time to the Grand Canyon, and this tour made it truly memorable.  It is a well-run and friendly organization.  We highly recommend this tour.
Everyone's pretty much said it.  I loved it too!  It was a fair bit of money but definately worth it.  One piece of advice, don't forget your sunglasses when you get out on the glacier.
Views were really cool! Eric knew a lot about the island and how to tell us what was up. Also super calming and a great experience overall.

Easily a 5-star experience!  If you are visiting Kauai, I highly recommend a Wings Over Kauai air tour.  I was really looking forward to this experience for months, and it didn't disappoint.  Why Wings Over Kauai?  First, sightseeing by air is the the best way to see the island.  You simply can't see the beauty of the island any other way.  Second, I like the idea of traveling via fixed-wing aircraft versus a helicopter.  The flight is smoother and quieter.  Third, when I saw Bruce's credentials, I was convinced the tour would be very educational (it was).  Fourth, it was approximately half the cost of a helicopter.  Who doesn't like saving a few bucks?  I found everyone associated with this company to be very friendly, informative, and professional.  We flew in the Cessna, and Bruce was our tour guide.  He was fantastic.  Bruce is highly educated and experienced.  He made my wife and I very comfortable, as though we were old friends.  He even shared some very personal experiences with us.  He's just that kind of guy.  Now, he did tell us that we were very lucky with the weather.  So I can't guarantee you'll have a great flying day weather-wise, but I am sure that you will be very pleased with how you are treated.  Please consider touring with Wings Over Kauai--you won't be disappointed.

We couldn't have asked for more....flight is life changing!!!  Weather was perfect for flight.  Our pilot, Ed, was so knowledgeable and friendly...if there were any doubts or nervousness about flying in a smaller plane, he erased all thoughts.  We flew  around Mt. McKinley and surrounding mountains; saw glaciers and all of Nature's mountain glories.  Company stored our packbacks etc. in a secure storage bin while we were on flight and also drove us to our hotel in Talkeetna.  Highly recommend this venture....this COMPANY.  Beatty Houston Texas

review_title: Mt McKinley Flight with glacier landing is worth it!!
review_text: A perfect day, flight and experience!!! Once in a lifetime!! Chris was our pilot and did a great job of getting us ready but nothing could prepare us for the landing or sight from the glacier. It is not cheap but how can you put a price on perfect?!

review_title: Great joy flight with awesome crew
review_text: Kevin was a wonderful pilot and guide made us feel very welcome and safe with a calm easygoing manner. Beautiful flight around Kauai luckily for us it was a good day. Only suggestion ginger tablets.... but other than that loved it. Highly recommend.

We are in Kauai for Valentine’s Day and took a one hour private flight tour of the island.  Couldn’t have been done better.  Well organized, kept in touch, reasonable priced for a private flight.  Even got to see a whale. Would recommend highly.Parker, our pilot and “guide” was excellent.

I would highly recommend this tour, especially for families! We are a family of 5 with kids from 7-17 years old. Everyone had a great time and was in awe in how beautiful Kauai is from the air. The ground staff were very friendly and helpful and our pilot was great. The plane ride was smooth from taking off to landing.  And even with our cell phones, we were able to take great pics!

Our family of 4 recently experienced this incredible flight around Mt. McKinley. It was a great experience to be so close to the ground and mountains where we could see the textures of the landscape, flow of water, and verdure in such detail. It’s as if you’re actually a bird flying through the air. My eldest son sat in the front seat next to the pilot. He had a big grin on his face the whole flight. We took many amazing pictures, and the small plane gave the ride a personal feeling much better than that of being on a large tour. Prior to the flight, we were allowed to canoe and paddleboat around Fish Lake while we waited for our flight which was quite fun. Jason was very friendly and knowledgeable. We would certainly recommend this tour to anyone wanting an intimate experience with Alaska’s most remote regions.

review_title: BEST way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: The BEST way to truly see the Grand Canyon!  Short flight from Phoenix, fly over Sedona and all around canyon.  Lands at small airport near Grand Canyon and hits all the best spots to view the canyon.  A remarkable and unforgettable experience.  Customer service was impeccable!  Flight out was smooth but a little bumpy on the way back due to warmer climate.  Best part was that we were back at our hotel by 3pm rather than making a 3 hr drive up, spending the day there then driving 3 hrs back.  THANK YOU to all the staff at Westwind for making this such an incredible experience!
Outstanding|  One of the coolest (no pun intended) things I've ever done.  Scenery was breathtaking.  Great pilot provided an excellent tour.  Well worth the cost.
Super dope… had so much fun … a wonderful experience definitely recommend when coming to miami awsome
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_title: New perspective for a local resident
review_text: I flew with some of my best friends over my childhood neighborhood in Waiehu and then we went to see massive Humpback whales and it was an incredible experience everyone should be a part of it.

We had perfect weather and a perfect flightseeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Our pilot, Jonathan, was very informative and checked with the passengers frequently to make sure we were all comfortable. The landing on Tokositna glacier was so smooth it was like landing on feathers. Linda, Margaret, and all the front desk people were extremely pleasant and helpful. What an amazing experience! Thank you.

review_title: Great Experience with Grand Canyon and pilot
review_text: Awesome way to experience the true size and beauty of the Grand Canyon. Our pilot James is an extremely experienced veteran with a great personality and sence of humor. Very knowledgeable about canyon details. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone...

The crew at Wings over Kauai (ground staff and the pilot) were so friendly and really invested in making sure we had a great time. They gave me a beautiful lei, took pictures before the flight and gave us a DVD of the tour. The tour itself was wonderful and the pilot gave us so much background info. about the island as we flew over it. 

I have a toddler and they were particularly attentive to her needs. This is what I call great customer service on top of a great service!! 

I will go back and would recommend anybody considering a flight option to pick Wings over Kauai.

review_title: Amazing Experience with an Amazing Company
review_text: This was one of the attractions i most wanted to do - i put a lot of research into this and spoke to a number of friends in my home town about going by helicopter to the canyon - each time Maverick was recommended.  I started to look into their website for the different tour options - i then had a live conversation with one of the staff who was very patient and helpful with me on the other side of the world.  I could not speak highly enough of the assistance given to me with the options that i wanted - it ended up being quite easy to choose once i was talked through the various tours.  The tour was more than what i expected - it was absolutely fantastic.  Connor was our pilot - one of the nicest tour guides i had during my 6 week holiday in US/Canada.  Do yourself a favour and look no further than Maverick Helicopters for an amazing experience in flying to the Grand Canyon - worth every US $$$$ that i paid.

Enjoyed a wonderful couple of hours flying all the way around Denali with family. Flew with 10 others. Every seat was by a window. Plane was cool but not uncomfortably cold. Headphones made it easy to hear pilot's directions and flight-seeing explanations. Took lots of photos. Glad we took our sunglasses but noticed that pairs were available to borrow if need be. Didn't get to make glacier landing due to newly fallen snow but flight was excellent. Pilot made sure to make at least two passes for most points of interest so that both sides of the plane had front row seats. Would fly with these folks again.
We took the Mountain Voyager with glacier landing tour. It was absolutely fabulous. ATA is very organized and employees were very friendly. This tour was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.

What an awesome experience with an awesome pilot that knew his stuff and answered questions throughout.  I never felt nervous or uneasy about the flight.  Landing and takeoff were smooth.  Can't wait to do it again!!!

review_title: Flight around the island of Kauai
review_text:
My husband & I took the 1 hour flight around the island of Kauai & had some spectacular views especially on the right side of the plane.  Flight was nice & smooth.  Was much better than the helicopter flight we took years ago.  Would recommend this & plan to do it again.
Thank you.
K2 is so professional from their check in  ground crew to their flight staff! We experienced an awesome glacier landing. Thanks, Stan for making this trip unforgettable!
Beautiful views and gentle ride. Steve was an excellent pilot and we’ll definitely book again next time we’re in Maui!

What a great experience the people were just wonderful Eric and Jill run a top notch program not to mention the Cessna 182 had all the bells and whistles very up to date I will be going again before the trip is over.

This tour was amazing! our tour guide Henry was spectacular and provided us with great history of the island and answered all of our questions! we got to see a lot of different sites and experience different climates all on the same island! will differently visit again
tour_name: 15-Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Experience Departing from Oahu32_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: If you can do this trip. Flying over and through the canyon really helped us gain more perspective on the vastness of the Canyon. And we got to see more of the Kaibab forest so that was neat. The pilot was nice and explained about the area and geology.

Four of us took the Wings over Kauai Air Tour around the Island last month.   I am a Commercial  Helicopter / Fixed Wing Pilot from Ohio but still chose the Wings over Kauai  Airplane over a helicopter for our tour.  The Wings over Kauai AirVan was the perfect airplane for the Island tour.  Bruce was great.

review_title: Highly recommended- do not miss this!
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed our scenic flight with Wings over Kauai and we were lucky enough to have Bruce as our very informative and personable pilot! We picked the 9am flight and were very lucky with the sunny, clear day(rain was forecasted on every other day of the week!). Check in with Val was smooth and friendly.  We decided to do the private flight for our honeymoon and were so glad we picked the Cessna! I sat in the back and the views were incredible. Take off and landing were so smooth. We enjoyed the breathtaking sights. So glad we chose Wings over Kauai- we would definitely fly with then again & loved this experience (just take motion sickness pills if you are susceptible to being queasy!).

This was our 2nd time flying with K2 Aviation.  Same flight both times.  Mike the pilot from 2008 is still there.  We flew with Chris the chief pilot this time.  Both pilots were fantastic, extremely informative and very professional.  There is no way to describe the feeling of landing on a glacier.  The word "awesome" doesn't come close.  This is definitely one for the ole bucket list!!  The only suggestion I could make would be to add more chairs in the shade while you wait for your turn to go.
great flight.great service!! Would definitely fly again with them. Smooth safe and romantic sunset flight.
Touring the Grand Canyon from the Cessna was amazing.  We’d all do it again in a heart beat.   After that the pink Jeep paled to the plane.  Everyone should see the amazing Grand Canyon from the air.

My daughter and I chose Air Ventures because it cost less than the helicopter tours.  We were very glad we did.  It was a wonderful tour, the pilot, Paul, pointed out all the sights and was very knowledgeable about the island and the geography and geology, and even restaurants! My daughter thought it might be scary at first, but it wasn't, and she loved it too.

Our Talkeetna flightseeing trip was incredible! The staff worked us in one day when our appointment time was rained out. They had not been able to go up once in two days they said due to weather delays. But they thought there was a chance for the weather to clear slightly. Sure enough, we made it in time to catch the flight at the end of the day. Amazing! The skies cleared and the scenery was stunning for the time it took us to tour Mt. McKinley and the base camp. What an awesome sight! My husband and I agreed this was the highlight of our trip. We took so many pictures... the mountains are so up close. Landing on the glacier we could see the freshly fallen powder snow. Amazing memories! The staff here is so professional and our pilot was fabulous in naming many of the peaks and glaciers throughout the Alaskan range.

review_title: K2 Sightseeing Flight to McKinley awesome and well worth it...a light-light of three month stay in Alaska!
review_text:
It was a bluebird day and we booked an afternoon flight to see Mt. McKinley from the air. We had pilot, Gary, who was a terrific guide and a fun trip. We went in a Beaver DeHaviland aircraft along with 7 other people. Could not have had a more spectacular view or trip.
Highy recommend K2 as this is our 3rd time flying with them and excellent each trip!

review_title: Simply spectacular -- our best tour ever
review_text:
From our first contact with Wings Over Kauai, through to their “thank you” email and photos, everything was simply first class.
Friendly, personalized and professional are the three adjectives that best describe their service.
Captain Bruce, as well as being a considerate pilot (comfortable, smooth flight) is a wealth of information about the island.
The flight was spectacular and we enjoyed aerial views of inaccessible terrain as well as features (Wailua Falls, for example) we had seen on our road trips.
We had a rewarding and memorable experience and thoroughly recommend the team to all visitors who wish to see Kauai from the air. Thank you Bruce, Ellen and Maren.

review_title: Absolutely worth every penny...I will do it again!!
review_text:
I went up on April 6th, 2011.
I was a little concerned that the ride might be a little bumpy, but as a person with severe vertigo, I was wondering if the ride would be OK for me. It was smooth as glass. The pilot said that because we were over water, there wasn't any thermals (uplifts in air/turbulence). I had an absolute blast. We circled South Beach, and then circled Key Biscayne. We saw some dolphins, a Manta Ray, and som Manatee. I have to mention that the pilot was VERY FRIENDLY.  He was like giung up with a friend. I mentioned to him that he was friendly, and that it made the experience more fun. I told him that if the pilot was a grump it wouldn't be as fun.

The plane looked new, inside and out. When I got there, I waited for him to arrive with the plane. He said they keep it hangared at a local airport. You can tell they take very good care of it.

On a side note, this is the same plane that the Kardashian sisters went up in on their TV show.

I thought this would be a one time deal, but I will go up again, and again.....
It surpassed what I expected......

review_title: the ONLY way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: Flying over the rim into the canyon is like nothing else: our pilot was very knowledgeable and informative and there seemed to be very good safety checks etc before we took off, which was reassuring. Quite expensive but definitely one of the highlights of a fantastic trip.
It was amazing the guys was really friendly even helping me with my fear of heights will definitely come back !!!
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: Had an awesome experience! Breathtaking views! JT was a great pilot even on a windy day! Definitely a must do!
Plenty of sites and a fantastic journey!!! Make sure you bring your camera, because you will definetly beig using it!

review_title: Not the best use of time
review_text: We had a great time at the Canyon, but only wish, that out of a 9-hour tour, we could have had more than 1.5 hours at the Canyon itself. We were told to be ready at 4:40 for our hotel pick-up, and finally arrived at the air terminal around an hour later, after numerous hotel stops and one shuttle bus change. If we had driven our own rental car, we could have shaved about 35 minutes off that portion and gained another half-hour of much-needed sleep, LOL! The flight was beautiful, and we both got window seats. Note: the views and light in the morning are much nicer on the left side of the aircraft. Once at Grand Canyon airport, we were efficiently shuttled into a huge bus (very roomy, but about 3x bigger than our group of 15 actually needed). The driver was friendly and personable, and even went back to pick up stragglers from our first stop after delivering us to the second one. But, at 45 minutes for each of 2 stops, it was nowhere near enough time at the park. If we had flown back right away after driving back to the airport it would have been one thing, but we were made to wait about an hour and a half before our flight back -- which is time I would rather have spent at the park itself. To top it all off, we found it was the same tour we could have booked through Scenic for about a hundred dollars less; the only reason we booked through this company instead is that they actually explained the plane configuration and guaranteed one of us would get a window seat (Scenic told us it would be totally random whether we would get one or not).
What a way to see the beautiful island of Kauai. The view from the open cockpit is amazing. Kevin is a great tour guide and pilot. Don't miss the chance to enjoy Kauai in this unique, fun way.

We went on this flight as an optional Riviera trip. It was amazing and I would recommend it to everyone. We were on a small 4 seater aircraft. Our pilot was James who was very sympathetic towards nervous passengers and explained everything. We were in touch with each other during the whole trip. He was very friendly and informative about Canyonlands and the views were unsurpassable. A truly unforgettable experience.
BEAUTIFUL. Amazing job by the pilot and great views. Loved the crater and saw the beautiful cliffs. Jurassic world is something I love and I witnessed it. DONT MISS IT

Viewing the Grand Canyon from helicopter is the best way to see this marvel of nature. Our pilot was awesome. Our group of 5 had the trip to ourselves. I’d definitely do this trip again. I’d read reviews about Maverick having helicopters with larger windows for viewing and I’m happy we booked with them.

Our planned trip of the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing was canceled due to cloud cover but we were able to go on a shorter flight on the southern side of the range and still got to land on the glacier. Awesome experience to see the mountains so close, walk on a glacier and have Mike, our pilot, give us such great info about the terrain! The southern peak of Denali was above the clouds so we got to see her up close and the beautiful blue waters in the glaciers that we flew over. If you have the means and opportunity to do this, K2 is the way to go. Great staff, safe stable planes and excellent itineraries.

review_title: great experience. They even offered whale watching.
review_text: In general, this is a great deal. It is cheaper than the helicopters, but has a comparable view. The right side has better view than the left. The captain will watch for whales and point them out for you. Their big window offers great view, but the wings are sometimes an obstacle for taking pictures.

Fantastic flight! Everyone from start to finish was great. Beautiful views and amazing flight. Pilot adjusted the flight so it was as smooth as possible while still getting close to the summit, seeing everything, and landing on the glacier. Great experience and great team!

This was my first seaplane ride.  Im not fond of small planes, but it was actually a very enjoyable experience.  The pilot was great.  The scenery from above was fabulous.  And it was a far better option for me than the ferry.  Would absolutely travel with this company again on my next trip!

The weather was cloudy at best for the week that we visited Kauai.  After a couple of cancelled flights due to poor weather our pilot Kevin was able to read the weather for an appropriate take off time.  I have done a number of scenic flights but can easily say that doing it in an open cockpit of a biplane complete with cloth helmets and headset was easily the most enjoyable.  Kevin has lived in Kauai for years so not only was his commentary excellent but also restaurant tips!!  Thanks Kevin!

I went on this adventure with my girlfriend a little over a week and a half ago.  We both kind of have the jitters about flying, especially with this being the first time in a small plane for both of us.  Captain Bruce and his crew, Ellen and Maren who were awesome at getting us situated, made the flight very easy and comfortable.  We learned a little about flying from Captain Bruce who is also a flight instructor which was a very cool part of this adventure.  The flight was about an hour and we circled the whole island while Captain Bruce, who I think is a genius, pointed out all kinds of land marks and told us facts and neat things about the area.  The views of the Na'Pali Coast and the Waimea Canyon are spectacular.  One of the best things about this tour was when he showed us where they shot different clips from shows like Fantasy Island, Jurassic Park, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Six Days Seven Nights, and he even would help us so that we could get a nice photos.   I got a really good shot of The Fantasy Island Falls from the opening scene when Tattoo was yelling "The plane, the plane."  You see a lot of stuff that you normally would not see because you can not get to it by car.   Hands down, this was one of the best things we did our whole trip.  I would highly recommend it to anyone, especially if you can't afford the helicopter ride.  I am so happy we did this.  Thanks again Captain Bruce, Ellen, and Maren for this incredible adventure!

Mahalo,
Rob

The customer service is exceptional! We received a call about and hour and a half before our flight letting us know that weather wasn’t permitting the Grand Denali tour we had booked and options to either fly a shortened one, or postpone. We ended up postponing twice and then our last day in Talkeetna opted for a shorter flight without the landing so that we could at least get up there before leaving. SO worth it!
