We got an hour 15 of flight time, amazing views, and they refunded us fully for the portion of the trip we didn’t get from our original booking. 

I would recommend not locking yourself into one time slot when booking…give yourself at least a day for flexibility! There was a couple in line behind us banking on the 8:30am flight and had left anchorage at 7am only to be disappointed that their flight was shifted. Alaska weather is always unpredictable…plan ahead to make it worth it!

It was amazing in every way possible!! We booked at a kiosk in town with an employee that was very knowledgeable and super friendly. When we arrived at the airport the team was ready for us. Every seat in the plane was a window seat. The views were amazing. The pilot was super friendly and informative. Loved every minute!

We went on a flight with them on 2nd July. We wanted to do the summit tour but were unable to as the minimum was 6 and we were just two. So we agreed on Grand denali trip. As it was very cloudy they were not sure if we would be able to land on a glacier but our pilot ( Paul - turns out he was the owner of the company) did his very best to make sure we landed on the glacier safely! He waited for an opening in the clouds and landed at the right moment so that we could get our best experience! This company is the best to fly with for the once in a life time experince!

review_title: A beautiful way to see Kauai!
review_text:
We were not able to appreciate the land excursion we took the day before to the Waimea Canyon because of a downpour, so was really looking forward to this. Our pilot, Mark, was fantastic. There was still cloud cover over the canyon so we had to go in a different direction, then another rain cloud snuck up on us, prompting Mark to turn back and cancel for the day. Despite that it was beautiful and we saw a rainbow
  Diane and Richard O'Boyle, Lansing, Mi
  .

Air Ventures provided a fantastic experience for our family to see all aspects of Kauai!  We saw so many landforms and natural beauty that we would not have been able to see on our own!!  Harry provided great information about all that we were seeing along the way.  From the canyon to the beautiful beaches and the NaPali coastline all were spectacular.  Air Ventures provides the best way to see it all on Kauai!  Thanks Harry and staff for providing a favorite part of our 2013 trip!

What a great experience!  Not only is the island incredibly beautiful and unique from above but Wings Over Kauai really go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and safe.  Our pilot told us interesting facts about the island during the flight and Mary packed us a cooler full of cold beverages and towels.  I love that it is a small family ran company that makes you feel right at home from the beginning.  I would highly recommend this amazing experience!
The pilot is very informative. Flight was very smooth and pilot show us some of the beautiful spots in maui. So amazing experience!! Will recoomend

review_title: A Surreal Trip with K2 Aviation!
review_text: This is a must adventure.  My husband and sister and sisters friend and I went on this great adventure around the Denali with an excellent pilot at K2.  I know it wasn't Barry but it was another totally professional pilot that flew us smoothly by the mountains and landed us on a glacier. I am serious when I say it was totally surreal to be in the middle of all those mountains standing on a glacier. We had a clear day with lots of sunshine so it felt about 70 when we were there. It was just AWESOME!
See the beautiful aqua marine colors of the ocean from a Birdseye view and seeing the sheer cliffs. Very nice flight.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: We highly recommend Air Ventures. The flight was just amazing with incredible views. Worth every $!!

review_title: The GREAT ONE... Was Definitely GREAT!
review_text: HAPPILY checked off an item on my Bucket List!  I have been blessed to get to fly to many areas in Alaska in small airplanes and to enjoy the float plane we have in Seward.  BUT, to get to fly near to Denali and do a glacier landing was outstanding!  Definitely, in my top 5 best Alaskan and International flights!  I’ve known for years that when time permits in the summer and the weather looked good.... it would be a go for me!  All good things came together (except for the COVID-19 giving all Alaskan’s time to explore our state .... ) made it work for us to do my dream flight.  Would be tough to be more PERFECT!

review_title: Great experience with 30 min private flight over Miami.
review_text: Excellent experience! I recommend taking a 30 min flight over Miami. We took it on our first day of visiting the city and it was amazing.
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: This was a great tour start to my quick trip to Kauai! Desi our pilot and tour guide made this an exceptional and memorable experience. The above views of Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coastline are worth every penny of this air tour guide! I highly recommend this tour to everyone.

We booked the private tour at 5:30. We got there at 4:45. (Booking says to get there 30 mins earlier.) When you get to the destination they have no office. They just get fuel from the major companies there. (I think) we waited for about 50 minutes. The pilot wasn’t there I think he was home when I called the company at around 5:25 to know what time he was going to be there. But once he got there he took us out pretty quick. Take off was good. Bit scary/ sketchy because the plane is pretty old. But the overall experience was great! The tour was so much fun, the young man was very informative. I enjoyed the time being in the air. (Was probably like 25-30 minutes.)  Would do again! Just hopefully their timing is better.

My family of 5 recently took an AirVan ride touring the island of Kauai. We got there early, and were offered books to peruse while we waited. Josh was our pilot. He was very knowledgeable, educating/entertaining us the entire way, and we each had our own window seats! The ride was rocky, but that was not Josh's fault - It was a windy day. Besides, there are water and juices available onboard, as well as "bags" at each seat.  (At one point, I thought I would lose it, but it didn't happen! Thank goodness!) We got to see places we would not otherwise see by land -- the NaPali Coast, where our boat tour was cancelled because of rough seas -- and beautiful waterfalls everywhere! Seeing the island by air was fantastic! It gives you a whole new perspective. I highly recommend the owners and Wings Over Kauai. (Give Billie the dog a pat on the head from us! What a low-key, nice dog!)

Took a "round the mountain" flightseeing tour of Denali (formerly Mt McKinley) with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Excellent, well maintained aircraft, flown by experienced, knowledgable pilot who described in detail what we were viewing on the hour and a half flight.  Planes were equipped with photo friendly windows to record much of the scenery.  The hanging glaciers, glacier moraines, and rugged geology of this highest North American Mountain and its sister peaks is awesome.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND! We decided at 3:15pm to join the 3:30pm flight to the glacier. It was the highlight of our entire trip! We put on the provided boots and boarded the airplane with Mike for a breathtaking flight, landing and overall experience. Mt McKinley was clear and we could see it. Landing on the glacier was smooth and soft. We got out of the plane and made snowballs, yelled to listen to the echo and Mike made a snow angel for us! Such an amazing trip! DO IT ... YOU WILL LOVE IT!
At least once in a lifetime you need to do a helicopter flight over the Grand Canyon! Stunning views and a lot of fun!

On August 25, 2012 we did an AirAdventure Tour over Kauai. It was a fabulous day for weather...meaning the skies were clear with very few clouds. We were able to see many things that are otherwise not visible because of the weather. The amount of hills and valleys on this small Island are amazing. It didn't appear to be all that small. There are many waterfalls that we were able to see. The coastline and Napali Coast are absolutely beautiful. Everyone gets a window seat and can take many pictures. I took over 200 pictures during the hour which will provide lasting memories of our air tour. The staff at Air Adventures were all very nice and the pilot was constantly pointing out points of interest as we were flying. This was a great tour and was a great value in comparison to other tours.

review_title: One of the top three events of a phenomenal vacation!
review_text: Few of the many wonderful things my wife and I did on our recent vacation to Kauai could top the experience of our Wings Over Kauai tour, and I can't imagine having had the vacation without it.  Bruce & Ellen are friendly, enjoyable, personal and professional, and know how to create an unforgettable time.  Don't visit Kauai without seeing it from the air, and try seeing it from the air with Bruce as your pilot.  You'll love it!

review_title: Seaplane Tour + Alcatraz Tour in afternoon
review_text:
We booked this trip because it also provided us with two tickets to Alcatraz once the Seaplane Tour had ended.  We were picked up in front of the Hard Rock Cafe at 9:00 am. The van was on time. 
We then drove to the Seaplane base in Sausalito, signed the necessary forms and boarded with two other couples. Each person has a window seat. We flew over the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz prison, AT&T stadium, Muir Woods and SanFrancisco city itself. Our pilot, John , has been flying for over 50 years. He was great and all of us felt comfortable with him at the controls.  I only have one suggestion that the company write a two or three sentence description of each place John points out.  Otherwise he really does not have the time to elaborate on each point of interest we were flying over. 
      Each person wears earphones to keep engine noise to a minimum and provide a communication link between the pilot and passengers.  If you ask a question speak loudly into the microphone provided. It’s voice activated and needs a strong voice to activate it . 
     Management worked very hard with the Hotel Zoe Concierge, Aiyaz Ali, to confirm our flight and the two Alcatraz tickets.  Everything worked out fine. The flight lasted a half hour and John flew us over most areas twice so passengers on both sides of the plane had the same quality view and the ability to take photos with their cameras or smart phones. Once the trip was over , the pilot borrowed our cameras and took pictures of each couple standing on one of the pontoons. We were then driven back across the Golden Gate Bridge again and dropped off at the Hard Rock Cafe. We then walked down to the Alcatraz pier and exchanged our vouchers for afternoon tickets to The Alcatraz prison. You will need to show a photo ID to pick up the Alcatraz tickets and show that ID again twice when you board the afternoon ferry.

We took the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing. The views we saw were stunning the experience itself was speechless. It was very calm the day we flew to Denali and the sky was crystal clear. It may look a bit expensive but with the experience we got, it well worth the money spent. Definitely go for it esp if it is a great day for flying! Comparing the pics that our friends took(who went for their Southside Explorer tour), our trip took us to the snow capped peaks. So I would say spend the extra hundred of dollar and did the Grand Denali tour, worth it! The glacier landing was so cool, we ran jumped and even lied on the glaciet with Denali at our back. It was incredible!

Unbelievable day thanks to our pilot. The smooth flight was punctuated with an informative dialog and majestic views he delivered during the entire tour. The ground crew was accommodating, friendly and most helpful. The entire team made this the best flight of this type we have taken.
If you doing only one thing while in Talkeetna it should be a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi.
Bert England & Chanawan Khantanod
Trip was excellent.  Pilot was a great tour guide and made sure we saw everything as he guided the helicopter.

The booking process was extremely easy and made the check in day of even easier. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and provided tons of fun facts throughout the flight. Even though Denali was in the clouds, it was still insane views!

Bruce the owner and pilot is a great guy.  Very safety focused and really takes care of you during the whole trip.  Typically his flights are much smoother than a helicopter and relaxing.  Bruce has lived on the island a long time and is a great historian and really gives you the low down on the island.  My kids loved it.
Absolute highlight of an amazing week spent traveling from Fairbanks to Seward.The guides are great.

review_title: Superb flight by very experienced pilot
review_text: My wife and I did the Denali Experience Flightseeing Tour on May 29, 2018. There were some clouds to contend with but K2 will not fly if it is not safe. So they delayed our flight about 30 minutes. I was very pleased to see that we were going in a turbine powered Otter aircraft; much safer than a piston as I just retired after 45 years of flying military and corporate. Chip our pilot gave us a good safety briefing before we got airborne. My wife sat in the copilot's seat as I wanted to just take photos. Chip gave us a nonstop tour and history of the area; it was like being in a college classroom as he really knows what he is talking about. Overall this was the highlight of the Alaska land tour that we did with Princess Cruises. If you want to see Mt Denali up close and personal and the surrounding area, don't miss this flight. K2 is an impressive company; check out their article on landing on glaciers in AOPA magazine, June or July 2018 issue if I remember correctly. This tour should not be missed....(skip the river rafting, boring; use that money to fly!!!). You won't be sorry you did. Don't forget your camera either.
Eric was absolutely awesome!!!! Very once in a lifetime experience! 12/10 out of ten stars! Loved it!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: Awesome way to see Grand Canyon
review_text: We did the 45 minute tour around the Canyon and it was amazing. Chris was our Pilot and he was ver knowledgeable, pointed out specific landmarks and gave us wonderful historical and scientific background. My kids loved it and will be something we all remember! We had the 10:00 tour in the morning and it was perfect timing.
Beautiful day,pilot was very helpful,landed on Ruth glacier, scenery was awesome!! Two weeks later and I still picture it in mind daily.
We had a great time!  Beautiful scenery and nice pilot to guide us!  Would definitely go again, one of the longer trips next time!

Very nice flight around the wilderness, see 10 bears 3 mooses and caribous
flying out of the heavy crowded of talkeetna is very charming! no stress, very nice approach
over a small lake!

What an awesome joy it was for us to fly with Jason. I have never ridden in that small of a plane and was not sure of what to expect. I was amazed at how smooth and comfortable a ride it was. I noticed with Jason, besides his experience of the terrain that safety was an up-most priority of his. The views of Denali and Mount McKinley were spectacular! I can't use enough words or had taken enough pictures  to describe what we saw in the air. I never thought that this plane ride would be on the top of my list of things that I have experienced.

review_title: W O R T H     IT
review_text:
The captain was great and the tour was awesome .. totally worth it.
The information about the city provided by the tour guid (the captain) was interesting and he was funny, be careful it get little bumpy because of the air.
Anyone planning to visit San Francisco I highly recommend this activity (ask to be a Co-pilot).
I've really enjoyed many flights with the pilots! Very friendly, very curtious. Highly recommend flying with these guys!

review_title: Next level once in a lifetime experience!
review_text:
Epic experience which we will never forget. Efficient and good fin. Caden is an excellent pilot which knows his island. He will tell you all about the islands beautiful nature and use of the lands, but also highlight locations where famous Hollywood movie scenes are shot.

5 out of 5 easily.

Everything went smoothly on this trip!  I was very impressed with the Antelope Canyon.  Our Tour Guide, Niko, really was knowledgeable and presented this magical place so well! The flight & rafting was equally nice.

review_title: Great way to start your holiday
review_text: Flying to San Juan with Friday Harbor Seaplanes is the best start to an island trip. From the booking, shuttle, reception and pilots, everyone is friendly efficient and helpful. Special thanks to Jen in the office for all her patience with a South African credit card! We flew both ways and loved every moment.

Helt enkelt et must. Denne tur med et mindre fly er noget billigere end helikopter og jeg skal ikke udtale mig om hvordan de turer er. Men dette var helt fantastisk og absolut pengene værd. Ca. 40 min i luften og det var helt fantastisk.
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_text: Our pilot, Mokoa, is very competent. People at first were concerned because he is very young but he maneuvered the plane quite well...took off and landed well.

What an incredible experience.  The entire tour looked like things you only see in magazines.  Matt was our pilot- he was super knowledgeable, friendly and safe.  It was breathtakingly beautiful to see those huge mountains up close.  Hard to imagine people rock climb and hike those mountains.
Loved it. Gorgeous scenery and felt totally safe.  Best to have a “plan B” as plane ( due to weather) was unable to pick us up for our return a few days later. Still, would do it again.
This is next level plane ride to explore west of Maui and Molakai. Laura was an amazing person. An excellent guide and awesome flight instructor! Highly recommend this experience.

My boyfriend and I experienced more of Kaua'i during our hour with Bruce than in our four days on the island.  We took the Wings Over Kaua'i flight on our first day, so the overview gave us a good idea of how we wanted to spend our remaining time.

Pros follow:

*Private tour in a four-seater propeller plane (Bruce, the boyfriend, me)
*Boyfriend (as "co-pilot") ticked off pre-take-off checklist as we watched an American Airlines plane depart before us
*Bruce smoothly handled the plane, so we didn't experience any motion sickness
*As we circled the island, Bruce listed the places we could explore during our time on Kaua'i (e.g. Anini Beach, a lagoon like spot), which was materially more efficient than reading a travel guide 
*Views of waterfall after waterfall that are unaccessible except by air

This tour was really good value, and I appreciated the funds go to a mom-and-pop business operated by people passionate about Kaua'i.  Frankly, $125 per person is a steal, and I'd recommend this tour without reservation to any of my friends heading to the "Garden Island."

Wow what a ride! Not only do we get to see the beautiful waterfalls and waterfalls and pools of water among the mountains and the snow, we landed on a tiny Little Rock formation where the pilot let us get out and take pictures. The views were amazing and  the tour was so fun! Talk about photo opportunities!
Amazing! Highlight of the trip landing on a glacier! Allow a weather date in case of rain or fog for rescheduling. Staff is very helpful in working around your schedule.
The views were incredible and Russell made sure that we felt safe and comfortable the entire time. It was an incredible experience and I can’t wait to go up again!

review_title: If you like flying close to the ground, this flight is for you!
review_text: We customized our Alaska Railroad package so we could stop in Talkeetna and take a plane ride to Denali. Well worth it! Above 10,000 feet, sky was clear. Our pilot got very close to the mountain several times, went all the way around it, and showed us many glaciers around Denali. Staff was very helpful and pilot outstanding. We flew on a Cessna Caravan, about 10 pax.
We had a great experience, the views were amazing.  At time during the flight, I felt that I could reach out and touch the mountain.  Our pilot was excellent.

Our seaplane adventure was amazing and had Spectacular and breath taking views! The pilot was amazing and had a lot of experience including military flight training; that’s a plus! Check in was so easy. Nice and friendly staff. It was my children's first flight and they loved it. I think they are inspired to be pilots, especially my 12 year old daughter. She wants to be a fighter pilot now! We are definitely going again!
Excellent pilot, great views, personal treatment, knowledgeable explanations about the area, would recommend to friends

I enjoy the trip it was really fun.
We were able to seee lot of views through the plane.
The pilot was really trained.

Westwind flew us from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon in a single-engine cessna, where we spent 30 minutes flying back and forth across the canyon before setting down at the local airport. From there, a van brought us to the canyon (10 minute ride), where we hiked down into the canyon with our guide. Finally, we had a provided box lunch on the canyon rim before flying back. In all, it was a magical experience. The plane was comfortable (noise-cancelling headphones provided), and offered a great view for everyone. Our guide was super friendly and extremely well qualified (how often do you get a geology grad student to give you a tour of the canyon).

Other tips: You can't hike from the top to the bottom of the canyon- I recall you get about 2 hours of hiking, and a full down/up hike would take over a day for an experienced hiker. Just hike until you're either tired or the guide suggests it's time to head back. The path itself serpentines down along the wall of the canyon, and has incredible views at every point. It has some steep drop-offs at the edges, but general it's around 10 feet wide and very safe. It might not be the best option for people afraid of heights, although my wife falls into that category, and while she was nervous she still made it down. We saw lots of people with kids, hikers with toddlers strapped into backpacks, and even some joggers! You should be in reasonably good physical shape though, and remember to save some stamina for the hike back up.

review_title: La meilleure façon de voir la grandeur du grand canyon
review_text:
Nous avons fait le tour de 45min depuis le South Rim, dans un avion qui peut accueillir jusqu'à 18 personnes: 6 rangées de 3 donc on peut se trouver au milieu mais on voit quand même tout très bien. On est placé en fonction de son poids sur un des 3 sièges.
Nous en gardons des magnifiques photos comme souvenir.
Et pourtant nous avons eu partiellement de la pluie et le ciel était en grand parti couvert de nuages. Le vol à failli être annulé pour risque d'orages.
Nous avions le vol de 14h et a 11h le ciel était tout bleu. Cela montre avec quelle rapidité le temps peut changer ici!
La prestation vaut largement son prix et on vient ici une fois dans sa vie, donc il faut en profiter.

review_title: Air Ventures flight tour over Kuaui
review_text: My wife and I flew over Kuaui with Air Ventures today and absolutely loved it.  It was very beautiful and the pilot was great.  Seeing the island from above was more than we expected, the landscape so diverse and wonderful.  We would highly recommend seeing Kuaui this way.

Wir sind mit Tony für einen Tagesauflug nach Bimini geflogen. Er und auch alle anderen Mitarbeiter waren supernett, Tony hat uns persönlich die Insel gezeigt und alles erklärt. Auch ein Besuch des Dolphin Hauses war dabei und ist unbedingt zu empfehlen. Die Flugzeuge sind in sehr gutem Zustand und er ist ein sehr guter Pilot. Tolle Firma, jederzeit gerne wieder!
We had a great tour. The pilots were fabulous and Allie was a phenomenal bear guide. Thanks for a great tour and I would recommend to others.

We stopped into the downtown store and the store representative was fantastic!!   She helped us with merchandise and helped get us a ride to where we were going.  They have unique gifts and quality merchandise.  Would highly recommend!

First of all, wow.  Just wow.  In the past, my husband and I had taken a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon, and we'd both flown in a Cessna.  After a few days into our vacation, however, we had fallen in love with Kauai and knew we wanted to tour it from the air in something special.  Enter "Snoopy 2", the vintage open-air bi-plane (all-modern construction) flown by the wonderful Eric.  We were so lucky to get Eric as a guide.  He had a great sense of humor on top of mounds of professionalism, flight hours (8000+!), enthusiasm, and knowledge of Kauai.  Apparently there had been quite the overnight downpours on the highest points of the island, because he was able to point out gushing waterfall after gushing waterfall as we were flying over the LUSH green center of the island (I am embarrassingly bad at remembering Hawaiian names).  It's quite the chunk of change, but it is so worth it, especially if you've gone the helicopter/Cessna route already.  A special shout-out to lovely Jill who checked us in (and took a very flattering photo of us in our canvas helmets and goggles).  Thank you for a memorable, marquee-level adventure.

Truly an awesome experience (such an overused word but, for once, the appropriate one.) Ben was our pilot and was great, very pleasant and informative. The moment we flew over the rim of the Canyon was unforgettable, as was the whole flight. Forty five minutes just whizzed by. Awesome!

review_title: Best of the Best Island Tours
review_text: I've never done a small plane tour of any area; it's always been helicopter tours. Glad I stepped up and out of my comfort zone and decided to give Eric's Maui Plane Rides company a chance. Our in air host, pilot and tour guide (Eric) made the experience an epic sightseeing adventure not possible by helicopter, land or sea (the 3 latter which would all have access and tour length issues that a small plane flying slowly does not). The very Personable, Knowledgeable and Accommodatingly Lovable Eric makes this one experience you DO NOT WANT TO MISS while visiting Maui.

We had a fantastic flight today, 45mins was a great amount of time to see a big chunk of the canyon & Colorado river. We even saw some rafters. Booked through trip advisor (very easy, although I received 4 emails confirming & asking for the same details I had given). Check in was easy, our pilot was friendly & informative & made us feel at ease. Would do it again with Maverick 😁

review_title: Helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon is safe, fun yet breath taking.
review_text:
We started with an excellent safety briefing, our helicopter seemed to be new and in top condition and we had a personable, safe and knowledgeable pilot who made our trip over the Grand Canyon really engaging, fun and most memorable.

We were lucky enough to sit in the front and I sat by the window which consistently had a great view.  

Even though the windows were perfectly clean, which was really helpful, it is extremely difficult to get great pictures.  Most notably as you go from the airport, over the forest and to the Grand Canyon the view is breathtaking (see attached picture).  I used a wide angle lens with a polarizing filter which helped but there is still a lot of reflection on the windows.  Additionally the wide angle lens allowed me to get a few nice pictures of my family inside the helicopter.

We decided to go with K2 and drive ourselves to Talkeetna from Anchorage--it saved us money and in the end they were great! We enjoyed the amazing views. Our pilot talked and informed us all along the way in local history, geology facts, etc. Would recommend to anyone. I even tend to get a little sick on small planes and I did okay. Pilot was kind to me and made gentle turns :).

This was an awesome experience! JT was our pilot and he was great. I suggest doing this at the beginning of your trip so then you can see what beaches or hikes you might want to do at the rest of your trip!

Our pilot was simply brilliant.  The weather was ideal for taking in the splendour of the snow capped mountains, the bright blue water and the many islands.  Hubby snagged the co-pilot's seat and I had the rear seat to myself which was ideal for taking pictures from either side.  At times we flew between mountain peaks which seemed almost close enough to touch.  It was a great experience landing on the water and walking along the float before heading back.

A wonderful tour which I would highly recommend.

I recommend this tour to anyone going to Kauai.  The flight takes you to places you would never experience except by air, viewing the beauty of the heart of Kauai.  Just remember don't eat before your flight, you will feel the air turbulents in this small plane.  Definitely worth every penny!!!

review_title: After several weather delays, fabulous flight!
review_text: We were supposed to do a flight over Denali, but due to weather issues had to cancel that.  The next day we instead flew over another nearby glacier and it was fabulous.  The pilot was terrific, the plane was comfortable (a 10-seater) and the weather was magnificent so the sights were just glorious.

This is my second time flying with Bruce.  First time back in 2012.   Both Bruce and Ellen are extremely friendly and are always helpful in providing you with any information you need on the islands.  Very good weather for today's flight.  Got some awesome photos of Waimea Canyon and the Napali Coast.  Would definately fly with them again.

review_title: Late season, Pilot was burned out, just a job for him
review_text: Nice flight, Richard is a very experienced safe pilot. We also had perfect sunny weather, not a cloud in the sky and very smooth. You could just tell Richard has flown all summer. He was tired of tourists and the same route around the mountain. He had no enthusiasm left for his ten passengers that day. I guess he doesn't care for tips or reviews. It was very informative narration though out the flight but had a very board monotone. The ladies in the office were pleasant and friendly. Someone even helped us with the boots after the flight. The Turbine Otter we flew in had a lot of power but had a nauseating jet fuel and jet exhaust smell the whole flight. It may have some leaks that need attention. Overall, I think it's the best way to see Denali. Getting out and walking on the Glacier was the best part.

I took the flight that landed on a glacier. The trip was everything I had hoped it would be and more. Both the office staff and pilot were helpful, kind and fun. The views were absolutely amazing. I would do it again in a heartbeat!!

review_title: Flight from Lake Powell to Moab after Rafting
review_text: After a fun-filled, tiring day on the Colorado through Cataract Canyon, the flight back to the Moab airport with Chip was the icing on the cake! Chip was very professional, providing preflight details and setting expectations our group, to include two teens. Once safely in the air, he was very informative regarding the local terrain as we passed over many of the sights we rafted by earlier in the day. Highly recommend the flight back to Moab from Lake Powell!

I went on a flight tour of the Canyonlands Park  with some friends for my birthday. James was an amazing pilot and very knowledgeable about the the area. The flight was very smooth despite it being a windy day. James was great at pointing out  the geological features and landmarks. I would definitely recommend this tour for friends and families.

review_title: Highlight of the trip - A MUST DO!
review_text:
We took the flight seeing tour on June 9th.  They had to give us the lesser tour because of the weather, but the glacier landing was still a go.

Mike was our pilot- very informative, friendly.

It was the most amazing part of our trip to Alaska.  Words just do not describe the beauty of Denali by air.

The Pika Glacier landing was ultra cool.
Booked a late afternoon flight and glacier landing.  Great staff to work with and pilot.  The scale of the area is only appreciated when you are in the air and seeing it.

My husband, two teenage daughters, and I had a very pleasant trip with JT. We have done both helicopter and Air Van tours while in the islands. The Air Van is more comfortable in terms of spacing and leg room despite the fact it does not go as deep into valleys as a helicopter would go. JT’s descriptions were both informative and entertaining for our family. The service prior to and post flight were professional and efficient.

As one might imagine, flightseeing in  Denali National Park is always breathtaking but what made our experience unique with K2 Aviation was their responsiveness.  It was a cold, clear, sunny morning on November 1.  We knew it was last minute but we took a chance anyway and called K2 to see if they could take our party of 3 out that same afternoon.  Sarah was most pleasant, helpful and accommodating on the phone. When we arrived in Talkeetna, we discovered a new, clean and welcoming facility.  Our pilot, Chad, was friendly, safe and very informative.  We were safely back on the ground within 5 hours of making our initial call.  This is a very safe and efficient operation offering spectacular flightseeing tours of Denali.

Fantastic tour and highly recommended! Our pilot (Chip) did an awesome job of flying us around the mountain, landing us on a glacier, and getting us back safe and sound...all while educating us on Denali Park!! Don’t forget you camera!

review_title: WOW --What views on our guided flight over beautiful Maui!
review_text:
We were so lucky to find this newish company in This Week Maui, among the free booklets from the airport.
 Excellent value and exactly what we'd hoped for as we prefer a plane over a noisy helicopter which we'd taken on the Big Island.
 This was perfect for the 3 of us (including 2 seniors citizens) and is smaller and more comfortable with easier access than planes we'd taken with a Seattle company around Puget Sound --we had very personalized and clear communication with the experienced pilot, Eric, who explained what we were seeing and answered all our questions.
 It was so interesting to listen in on the frequent conversations with ground control as the competent and careful Eric checked in with each one.
We were only about 1000 feet up so had great views everything, including Humped Backed Whale families, the Road to Hana, kite-boarders, details of various beaches, Haleakala, W. Maui Mountain, resorts N of Lahaina, and also the island Kahoolawe, which is inaccessible since it still contains unexploded bombs used for practice during WW 2 and afterward.
It was so much fun for our son --and amazing for us to see details of the many places he'd bicycled to.
A bonus was that Eric had taken some photos of us and the views during and before the flight and promptly emailed them. Our photos turned out great and are a wonderful memory of fun visiting our son.
 Just can't recommend this highly enough and we plan to repeat this experience when we visit again!

We had a great flight. It was a beautiful sunny day and Harry, our pilot and a very knowledgeable person, gave us lots of information about Kauai and pointed out so many highlights of the island. He even pointed out a couple of whales off the coast of Lihue. The plane was comfortable and everyone had a window. When necessary, Harry circled around special areas so all could see from a different advantage. The ground staff were also very knowledgeable and helpful as we prepared for the flight. I realize that helicopters can get closer to see some things but this plane ride was amazing and I would highly recommend Air Ventures if you want to see beautiful Kauai!

We had the best time viewing the spectacular sea cliffs of backside molokai! Eric was awesome, nice and fun. I absolutely recommend Maui Plane Rides for anyone seeking a beautiful adventure you won't regret.

I loved this seaplane experience.  Discounted to $200... We took off and flew over beautiful mountains before landing on a secluded lake.  After getting out and snapping a few pictures from the floats we climbed back in to take off and fly over a waterfall for a breathtaking photo opportunity and then glided over mountain peaks to see a flock of mountain goats before landing in Ketchikan.  Our pilot Adam was a great guide... Although he waited until the last ten minutes to tell us we were riding in a 62 year old plane.  It must be reliable if it is still being used for tours and to transport mail for the postal service which we learned during the flight.
I had no idea how beautiful Kauai was until we went on this tour. The staff was very friendly and helpful.

The views were spectacular! Truly a once in a lifetime experience to see Maui and the islands from the sky! The pilot was super friendly and kind and knew wonderful and interesting facts about the island. My husband and I had such an exciting time and think this was the highlight of our trip!!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Owners Jill and Ray went out of their way to make my friend and I feel very welcome. We arrived early and on a Sunday. We took the bi plane ride. What an experience !  I highly recommend both Air Ventures and the bi plane on your trip to Kauai.     Stephen, Canada

review_title: Flight over canyons, volcanoes, waterfalls, gorges, valleys and coastline of Kauai
review_text: The flight was absolutely superb. Very awe inspiring to say the least.. Couldn't fault the attitude and helpfulness of the staff. High;y recommended. It would be such a shame to leave Kauai without doing this trip. Other than an expensive helicopter trip, it's the only way to see the sheer dramatic beauty of this wonderful island.

review_title: Fantastic views of Kauai and great staff
review_text:
The pleasantness of the staff and the pilot made the experience even more memorable. And of course no questions about the aerial views. 

Tip: eat nothing/ very lightly before the flight to avoid nausea.

Great time, flight was informative and landing on the glacier was quite exciting. At first I was hesitant about the price, but thought "you only live once" and threw caution to the wind.  So glad I did.  Truly breathtaking views and scenery.

Approximately one hour.  Can choose either Cessna (seats 2 passengers) or AirVan (total of 4 passengers on our tour).  We toured all around the island including the Napali Coast, and by air is probably the best view of that area.  Breathtakingly beautiful.  The pilot was friendly and well-informed, answering many of our questions.  Noise canceling headphones were helpful.  

Some mild turbulence during our floor but the operators did their breast to plan ahead:  there was a cooler full of ice and cold water.  If you're prone to motion sickness it's a good idea to take Dramamine in advance to be safe. But many photo opportunities and highly recommended.
The weather kept us from doing the flight we wanted but they were able to give us an alternate or refund.  We chose the alternate and it was amazing.

Excellent experience with the helicopter tour. Information before the trip was very good. All info we needed we had on time. Once there the pilot was very knowledgeable and let us know all we were flying over. It was absolutely so impressive the whole experience. We were 5 plus the pilot meaning all of us had a top view.
Had we been 2 more they would have been sitting in the middle in the back not seeing as much as we did. Very expensive since our currency for the moment is vey week but the trip was worth every cent!

My wife and I had a fantastic time on our flight and it was one of the highlights of our trip to Hawaii. I booked this flight as an instructional flight because I have my license and wanted the experience of flying in Hawaii. Ellen helped me with the reservation and was extremely friendly and helpful. Bruce was our tour guide and flight instructor and allowed me to handle the controls on 99% of the flight. He made the flight relaxing and easy for me and provided some great information about flying in general and flying in the local environment. At the same time he provided my wife, who was riding in the back, with some great information about Kauai as we circumnavigated the island. We both had an outstanding time and would do it again in a heartbeat. I highly recommend this company as it is a family business and they provide excellent service and are very knowledgable. Thank you to Bruce, Ellen, and Allison for a great time!

We were on a cruise and chose to book on our own.  We were very happy with the communication ahead of time, the shuttle to and from the port, and the floatplane ride itself.   All of the staff were great and the view was amazing.  We were glad we had booked an early trip out as the day was sunny and warm and the plane heats up.
I will never forget this experience! The flight and the pilot was amazing and glacier landing was definately something that cant be put in to words!!! Thank you so much!!!!!!

review_title: If you can't climb Mt. McKinley, let Talkeetna Air Taxi take you there!
review_text:
Safety was my primary concern when scheduling a 2 1/2 hour flight around McKinley with glacier landing.  Talkeetna Air Taxi's record was good, but talking to the staff reconfirmed that safety is their main concern as well.  I would rank the experience among the top ten of my lifetime.  It was breathtaking.  I felt comfortable at all times including when we took off from the glacier, 7000 feet up.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was very accomodating by rescheduling the flight when weather would cut our flight short.  They also picked us up at an in town location and returned us.

Wear warm socks and a light jacket.  I was overdressed for the trip.  They provide boots which were needed as we stepped into knee-deep fresh snow on the glacier.  Also take chewing gum to keep your ears from popping.

We did the Denali Flyer trip which got us into the face of the mountain range and the sight is impressive!. It was a smooth ride and visibility of the scenic landscape was gorgeous. 
Our pilot was very informative about Denali and the surrounding landscape and was continuously pointing out things of interest.
A must thing to do if in the area.
Highly recommended

review_title: Highly recommend utilizing Westwind for an unparalleled Grand Canyon experience!
review_text: Our experience with Westwind was fantastic. Our pilot Brandon was courteous, knowledgeable and made sure we stuck to our schedule. From the flight to the viewpoint stops to the helicopter and boat rides, everything was smooth sailing!

What a great experience – from the first call to schedule – to walking away from the airport after the flight. Bruce and Ellen were fantastic. I would truly recommend this aerial tour to everyone. What a great value and the personalized tour over Kauai could not have been better. We will do this again the next time we are in Kauai. Bruce is a great pilot and knows so much info about the island. You’ll be happy you did this tour and you will not be disappointed. Annette and Royce

We had a group of 5 in Talkeetna/Denali for just a few days. We pre-booked the 2 hour flight with glacier landing via Talkeetna Air Taxi and then anxiously watched the weather. Talkeetna Air Taxi was so awesome in letting us move our flight around & wait for a good time to fly. We ended up being the first flight our day (at 1:30pm) to be able to land on a glacier, and that was spectacular! We actually landed at Denali base camp & talked to climbers who had just made the descent. So cool. We loved our pilot Paul! 

I would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. They go out of their way to ensure everyone has an exceptional experience. This was a highlight of our trip. Do it!!

There is no way to see Alaska as well as by air.  This was one of the highlights of our trip and we would recommend it to everyone.  This is a family owned business, maybe that is why the service was so nice.  Our pilot was awesome, he made sure to circle and let us all see from different angles.. The scenery was breathtaking and the flight was smooth and you could tell the pilot was excellent at his job.  We would recommend them to everyone.
This was amazing and it was a ride that my family will cherish for our Christmas Day ! The views were awe inspiring and we saw it all!
Only way you are able to see all of the island. Marcus was a great pilot who was very educational about the island. Worth every penny!!!

Our experience started with the super cool sales guy in their Talkeetna Main Street office who gave us a very accurate non-pushy picture of what we would be getting during our flight.  He was knowledgeable about the routes and conditions.  Super friendly.  Gave us a discount for same day booking and arranged for their shuttle guy to stop by the train depot with us to pick up our luggage that was being held there for us since we would get back after they closed.  Seth picked us up in the shuttle, helped us pick up our luggage at the train station and then offered to drive our luggage to our lodge for us 5 Miles out of town, while we flew.  The ladies at the front desk were super friendly.  And then came our pilot, Matt.  He gave us the ride of our lives.  I grew up in a small plane with my dad and this guy could fly!  Very safe and competent.  We got up close and personal with Denali and the surrounding cliffs.  We only did the 1 hr basic flight and it was amazing.  It helped that we got the one clear day in 10!  But what a ride!!!  So impressed with this company and it’s top service!  Seth drove us back to town.  He had delivered all our luggage as promised and filled the inn keeper in on our plans and schedule.  And he refused our tip!  Said he was just doing his job.  But please don’t let that stop you from trying.  Absolutely go with this company!
Our flight from Thorne Bay was very pleasant. Pilot was professional and friendly. Staff in Ketchikan were very accommodating and friendly.

Initially I considered booking a helicopter tour of the island, but after reading some reviews of heli vs plane tours it seemed like plane was the way to go. Less possibility of motion sickness and better overall aerial views. 

We were not disappointed. The approximately one hour tour was full of amazing views and vistas, combined with informative tidbits from our captain/pilot Marcus. 

Definitely recommend!

We booked after we got off the ship and saved a bunch of money!!! The ship price was 280 and we got the trip for 230... Naomi took us to the plane and Mike took us flying. It was wonderful even on a rainy day. We saw a whale and felt very safe....family run business that makes you feel welcome.  If you want to be sure you get them I would call ahead. From the time we left the boat to in the air was 15 mins....

Hatten heute Morgen einen Flug mit Bruce von Wings Over Kauai in der kleinen Cessna. Viel dazu brauche ich nicht zu sagen, da schon fast alles gesagt wurde. Eindrückliche Landschaften mit einem super Sympathischen Team. Würde ohne zu zögern sofort wieder mit Wings Over Kauai fliegen!

Talkeetna Air Taxi was more like a Limo.  Great service, very experienced pilot and overall concern for the guests.  We were scheduled to go up and weather forced us to reschedule for the following morning.  The next day we actually were the first to go up and thus we went up not knowing if we were going to be able to see Mt. McKinley or land on the glacier.  Therefore, they were not going to charge us until we got back from our flight and they knew we landed or not.  Our pilot Richard was very professional, friendly and safe.  As we cut through the clouds the great Mt. McKinley appeared and he immediately began surveying the surroundings and relaying it back to headquarters for the next groupings that were flying out.  We flew all around the mountains and he told us about each one and then we swooped down and landed smoothly on Ruth Glacier.   Richard's landing was so incredibly smooth it felt as if we floated on to the Glacier. First ones to land on the glacier that day and had the whole place to ourselves.  It was fabulous!   Overall, this once in a lifetime opportunity was definitely worth every penny and one that you should definitely do if your are considering.  Enjoy and make it a great day!
Very bad company and service. Do not recommend anyone to book with them. Over charged us and  the fight tour was less than promised with no champagne.

We had a wonderful experience with K2 and our pilot, Justin.  It was a little pricey, but we figured being on a once-in-a-lifetime trip like we were, we should go all out. 

We did!  And I am so glad.  Being eye-to-eye with the summit of The Great One was incredible!

Thank you K2 and Justin!!!

review_title: This is not a flightseeing review....
review_text:
We didn't charter Seawind for a flightseeing tour, nor were we cruise ship passengers.   We had something much more challenging for Seawind and the service and support we received was exceptional.  

My wife and I are wilderness campers - Alaska is our favorite place for this but we had never been to southeast Alaska or the Ketchikan area.   Planning a trip like this begins 9-12 months ahead, which is when Seawind first helped.   Once we decided on the general area we wanted to go to - I contacted several air charter companies in Ketchikan asking for advice and recommendations.  Steve and Lesley at Seawind were by far the most helpful and responsive.   I talked to both during the winter and with their recommendations reserved National Forest Service cabins in two different locations for a week each.   One in Misty Fjords National Monument and the other on Prince of Wales Island.   

Seawind's communication was excellent during the planning phase.  They recommended an outfitter, a satellite phone rental company, and even a saltwater fishing guide for the few days we had in Ketchikan between camping trips.   All worked out excellently.   

Once we arrived in Ketchikan, I hesitate to write how much Lesley and Steve helped us out, because they went so far above the expected I don't want to create the impression that everyone should expect the service we received.  Suffice it to say - they treated us more like family guests than customers.   

The actual trips went very well.  They loaded all of our gear in the plane, we left promptly when planned and the flight was smooth and enjoyable.  Steve explained scenic highlights along the way, helped us unload our gear and even provided fishing tips for our destination.   Pickup a week later was exactly as scheduled, although this time Rolf was our pilot.   Due to weather we had to take a different route than our trip in, but this was nice because we got to see different scenery, and Rolf took his time to explain highlights along the way.   Rolf even took the time to tell us about some of the wildlife to expect at our second cabin ;)  .  My wife especially appreciated this information.   

Our second trip out started as planned with the same great flight out, also with Rolf, to Prince of Wales Island.    Arrival and unloading was smooth and efficient.   On our day to leave the weather turned bad, with low fog and lots of rain.   We were in contact with Seawind via our rented satellite phone, and they tried to make it in to land but had to turn back.  Rolf waited in a nearby bay for three hours waiting hoping the weather would clear, but it didn't.  We heard him try to get in several times, but the fog and clouds were just too thick to make it into our lake.   We had a 9 am flight the next morning to Seattle.   In a last attempt to get us to our flight on time Rolf tried again - at 5:30 a.m. to once again make it in - but the weather hadn't improved so he had to turn back.   Finally in the middle of the afternoon, the weather cleared some, I called Seawind and Steve was on his way to get us.   He made it in OK, we packed up and left, and caught our rescheduled airline flight the next day.    I'm sure it was expensive to make three attempts for one pick up - but Seawind did not hesitate at all to try.    

We have traveled to wilderness Alaska lakes with several other air charter companies - I have to say Seawind is the best.  Their dedication to customers and safety is exemplary.   The planes are equipped with modern avionics, very clean and appear to be well maintained.  Both Steve and Rolf are excellent pilots, and know the area well.   Lesley is fantastic - she runs the office, is available day and night, and can help with any local support you may need.   

The next time we need a charter service in the Ketchikan area - Seawind will be our only choice.

On our recent Pride of America cruise, we moored at Kauai overnight.  We are Australians, and our travelling friend had privately booked a trip with Wings Over Kauai.  It was a fantastic trip, and our pilot, Marcus, was a delight.  He provided a very knowledgeable commentary throughout the flight; wonderful Hawaiian background music throughout the trip, and stirring music as we approached the Na Pali Coast.  To see the Na Pali Coast and Kauai parks and countryside by small plane was an amazing experience.  We have flown by helicopter in Maui on other trips, and this small plane trip  was just as exciting, with great visibility. We are all in our sixties and felt very safe with Marcus. We would highly recommend this trip.
We enjoyed our flight so much.  At no time did we feel fear.  Our son, visiting from Chicago, joined us!
The pilot was great at showing a good perspective on the islands. The views were just amazing. I would highly recommend!
We loved this trip.  Safe, fun and the glacier landing was awesome.  You are really going to want this experience.
Un moment génial passé au dessus de Miami. Un pilote adorable et des vues incroyables sur Miami. L'hydravion est une activité incontournable lors d'un séjour à Miami.

I will highly recommend Air Ventures to my children, grandchildren, and relatives next time they visit Kauai. It is amazing to see the heart of Kauai, the Jurassic Park falls, the undescribable cathedral cliffs of Na Pali coast and of course the incomparable beaches of the island!
Mar S.
Awesome!!!  Great, personable, friendly and knowledgeable guides.  Extremely long day but the best way to see a lot in one day

When we were heading for the Mt McKinley area, a friend who used to live there suggested that we book a flight with K2 Aviation in Talketena. We did so and were really pleased. We hit the clear skies of September 2010. We got to the airport earlier than our booking in case the weather changed. K2 staff were very accomodating and set us up for a trip (complete with boots that they supplied for a glacier landing).  The only concer was that their minimum number of passengers for a Beaver flight was 3 and we were only a couple. We would have had to pay for the third person but a couple who had lived in the area for 11 years decided that they would take advantage of the beautiful day and fly with us. So the four of us wwnt up with a very experienced pilot, had a great flight around Mt McKinley, landed on a glacier and then returned to Talketna, with lots of  photos.  
The K2 staff were extremely helpful, accomodating and any passenger would feel very confident with their operation (e.g. only landing on a glacier that they knew was safe to land on).
We highly recommend you consider K2 if you get to fly to see Mt MKinley. Located in Talketena, they are much closer to Mt McKinley than if you fly from Denali and also closer to Anchorage.
Super flexible service and amazing views. We were able to see five islands and changed our itinerary in the sky’s!

What an amazing trip! I lived in Alaska for three years and didn't take this trip until I went back to visit almost 20 years later.  The glacier landing was the icing on the cake! I would urge anyone who is considering this option to spend the extra money to enjoy this awesome experience.  The weather on the day of our flight posed some challenges due to aircraft restrictions but the folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with our group to ensure we all got on a flight.  Once we got above the clouds the views were incredible! Truly a first class operation and something that all visitors to Alaska should put on their "must do" list!

After  a rainy week in Alaska, we ended up in Talkeetna on a sunny and relatively clear day and decided to do a flight tour to take advantage of the weather.  We inquired about tours around 4 pm and they were able to get us on a flight at 6:30.  You simply cannot appreciate the scale of the Alaskan range from the viewpoints in Talkeetna or along the highway heading up to Denali NP. It's a whole new perspective from above and the views really are amazing.  We happened to get a clear view of Denali but even if you don't, you'll see many glaciers and peaks and the pilot was well informed and shared a lot of information about the park and what we were seeing.  After a week of rain and overcast skies, we finally felt like we saw Alaska on this tour.

The best and the most memorable experience I have ever had! Thank you so much! Seeing the garden isle from the air was just stunning. We also managed to spot some whales during our flight. Weather was perfect, Josh, our pilot, was very responsive and friendly.

review_title: Fantastic Air Tour of Kauai Island!
review_text: Our air tour of Kauai Island “The Garden Isle” gave us spectacular views of iconic Hawaii and its dramatic beauty! Seeing its lush landscape, spectacular Waimea Canyon "Grand Canyon of the Pacific", Opaekaa Falls, and Na Pali Coast from the air was the highlight of our visit to Hawaii! During our 70 minute flight, our fantastic pilot Bub made his six passengers feel comfortable and ensured both sides of the plane enjoyed all the views. We appreciated his informative narration on the sights below and knowledge of the landscape. Our Air Ventures experience was truly an amazing adventure!

I was nervous about flying in a small plane, but the pilot was really capable, and the entire trip was delightful.  I could see the homes and fields and then the mountains, Mt. Hood, Lost Lake, the Bridge of the Gods -- awesome!  It was really something to see where the big fire from a couple of years ago burnt.  However, it was pointed out that it has come back a lot, even since spring, so that was good to hear.  The entire trip seemed like it was a second instead of an hour!

I have been to Hawaii approx 40-50 times and flying with Wings Over Kauai rates in my top 5 of fun things I have ever done in Hawaii.Flying with Bruce was a blast and dealing with Ellen was painless.When I called Ellen for information, you could tell she had the true "Aloha Spirit". When I informed her that I was a private pilot and asked if I could do the flying she said that would not be a problem, as Bruce is a FAA certified flight instructor. Bruce was extremely safety oriented and has a wealth of knowlege about Kauai. His aircraft is in great shape, has Bose noise cancelling headsets, and is a pleasure to fly.
 I have previously taken 3 helicopter tours on Kauai. Flying with Wings Over Kauai takes you basically everywhere the helicopters go at half the cost. I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. Thanks Bruce and Ellen, it was really fun.We will be back.
Al and Eric

review_title: Great tour of the Misty Fjords
review_text: This was my second time taking a seaplane tour in Ketchikan. Being a pilot myself, I love getting a ride in a DeHavilland Beaver, great airplane! Our pilots name was Ryan, very personable, great knowledge of the area, and made the experience very pleasant. Be prepared to take alot of pictures, the plane flys snow enough to capture great shots of the monument. It is the cheapest cost in the area for aerial tours and they have a great fleet of aircraft. Make sure to go on a day when the weather is not too windy if you're not used to flying in a small plane.

review_title: 100% worth it. Highlight of our Alaskan holiday
review_text:
We were tossing up between this, an ATV tour and a rafting tour. We were traveling on a pretty tight budget but I am so glad that we did the Denali experience. It was honestly one of the best things I have done in my entire life!!!! Not exaggerating. 

Our pilot Billy was great, our plane had 9 people in it and everyone got a window seat, and we saw some once in a lifetime breathtaking views. 

I would highly recommend to anyone and everyone regardless of your budget you will not regret it.

review_title: Great way to take in the Grand Canyon.
review_text: Great way to see the entire canyon. If you are staying at or near the south rim it’s a short trip to the airport. Excellent value. Our pilot had many years of experience and lots of interesting facts to share
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_text: We booked the Traitor's Cove Bear view tour. The lady for pickup is super nice and friendly. The view from the flight is fantastic, but the pilot is silent throughout the flight, not a single word of introduction, which is quite different from my other tour experience.As of the bear view, it really depends on timing and luck. I heard from the guide that sometimes there are 5 bears at the creek eating salmon. But I only saw a bear for 1 minute during the hour we stay on the platform.

The flight over the Grand Canyon was amazing, something we will remember forever.  Seeing the canyon from that perspective was so worth it.  A little turbulent with the winds but our pilot Chris was excellent, even helping us and others with pictures after landing. We were really impressed!

Makoa was our pilot and showed us all the highlights of Kauai. He encouraged us to let him know if we wanted to see anything again. We did and he circled back over so we're could get a better look.. The staff is very warm and made us feel like Ohana or family!! Such a great group of people we would do this again in a heartbeat...

review_title: Great alternative to the helicopter tours
review_text: We did this partially for cost, we had our 2 year old son with us and per FAA regs he was considered an adult so we picked this option.  We were not disappointed.  JT was an excellent pilot. Our son loved the ride and JT was very knowledgeable and informative about what we were seeing as he went around the island.  I loved the entire view of the area we got as you cant get this on the ground and some parts were restricted historical sites.  Everyone had their own window view and he circled it for those both on the right hand side and left hand side. The only thing I wish is that we got a little closer but i understand something is lost between being in a helicopter versus a plane.
The flight was great! Definitely less bumpy than helicopter flight for sure. Our pilot Brooke was very nice and considerate throughout the flight. Highly recommend!
Had a wonderful experience. Eric was very accommodating, experienced & knowledgeable.  Total pleasure from beginning to end!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: We were blessed with a clear day for our flight.  Alex was our pilot and I was able to sit in the co-pilot seat.  The views we had were amazing because it was so sunny and clear.  Alex described what we were seeing as we flew over the rivers and by Mt Denali.  We circled the mountain but he took care to make sure both side of the plane were able to see by circling back several times.  We had a very smooth flight and our landing on Ruth Glacier was very smooth.  I was in awe of the beauty we had from the air.  I would highly recommend flying to Denali and the glacier landing.

Amazing tour over Misty Fjords. You get a bird’s eye view (literally!) of the fjords. The plane takes you close enough where you can make out some details from ground below. We had a sunny, clear day which helped. Well worth it!

Amazing tour with lots of information about Maui. Eric was an attentive pilot, very kind. The view over Maui is astonishing, truly a unique experience. We were so overwhelmed and impressed after the flight, full of feelings, that we completely forgot to tip! So sorry Eric!

Regula & Michael

review_title: Wow, Great flight and well worth the price!
review_text:
Booked Wings over Kaui flight for 2 in their 6 passenger air van. A little apprehensive since it was not through Carnival and it was a small company. Not only a great 65 min  flight, but we were treated like family, received pics of us by the plane and got a cd from them. Marcus did a great job flying the plane. Kaui is a truly beautiful island. This was the highlight of our 4 island trip. Thanks to Ellen and Captain Marcus for a memorable experience at an insanely low price.

Jeff & Maryann Kay

We were in Kauai just one day and I’ve read before the most worth is traveling island by the plane! That was totally truth! First of all I need to mention our pilot Bruce! That was amazing guy who was very open minded and great guide! I’ve learned everything by this hour. Honestly I was bit stressed because it was my first time in such small plane but that it was unnecessary because everything was great! So if u are couple take Cessna it’s great and unforgettable feelings and scenic views!

review_title: Fantastic company to take you to the spectacular Misty Fjords
review_text:
Support the people who live in Alaska - fly local with Steve and Leslie. This is a one plane family operation with a spotless record and exceptional service. They are delightful people who take pride in their business and love what they do. I give it my highest recommendation.
 
We found SeaWind on the internet when we were looking for an excursion off the Holland America Zaandam when we docked in Ketchikan. Flightseeing is the best way to see the Misty Fjords. Everything was as described, and was provided with a smile and sincere friendliness.

Our pilots name was Samuel. He did a great job describing where we where and answering any questions we had . 
 I had never been up in a small plane and I was nervous but we had a smooth take off and landing.
And we enjoyed every minute of the flight .

We had booked the Molokai sea cliffs tour but the wrath did not look good that way so the pilot proposed to go to the volcano crater . He was able to fly around the clouds to fly us over the crater twice. Amazing view from there. 
He was also very attentive to our comfort. 
Great experience with great pilot.
Our pilot and host was Clay, a delightful young man. We had the time of our lives--we had never flown in a small plane and Clay gave us a grand tour of the Columbia River Gorge. Highly recommended!!

I wanted to see ALL of Kauai as there are places you can only go to by boat and then you cannot see the interior of the island.  The Air Venture plane was very comfortable and I was able to see everything very clearly.  The pilot was knowledgeable  and we were able to ask him any question we had during the flight. It is a worthwhile adventure to take.

review_title: Amazing!! Amazing!! Amazing!! Oh, and it was amazing!!
review_text: Terrific experience all the way through. Corey was so friendly when guiding us through the options and the booking process, and he even gave us an extra discount because “we were patient”! Lol How cool is that? The flight was amazing, and we only paid $23 per person. That’s insane! We flew over Portland and loved every minute of it. Wish it was longer and will definitely be back for other flights. Compared to the other air tours we looked at in Portland, I don’t know why anyone would choose more expensive options for less of an experience.

I have always been afraid of small planes, but, after reading so many raving reviews, I decided this was worth it.  And, i never felt any fear during the flight.  The scenery is beyond anything I can describe -- total awesomeness of G-d.  Unfortunately, our glacier landing was cancelled due to weather, but the flight still exceeded my expectations.

The experience of a lifetime!!! Recomended to everybody, got to see amazing views of the volcano and many more things, will definitely come back the price is completely worth it!! Spencer was a great pilot and gave great information!
We did the tour with Ruth glacier landing. Landing experience was outstanding ! Our Captain (sorry forgot his name) was great and very informative.
I’m feeling amazingly amazing right now !! This entire experience was BEAUTIFUL Safe and very enjoyable along with BEAUTIFUL 🌈🌈🌈 rainbows that must be seen flying Maui Plane Rides !!!
Super trip with pilot, Josh. Very impressive, rugged environment with climbers on the mountain. Glaciers galore up to 12,000 ft altitude.

We booked the C172 for a training flight on our first day in Kauai. My husband and I are both learning to fly so what’s cooler than logging some time in Kauai? It’s definitely a different experience flying in mountains. It was a slightly windy day with intermittent clouds/rain. Definitely different from what we typically fly in but the CFI was great and gave us a great tour along with more technical information about flying in the area. Even for a tour only, I’d highly recommend because they’re noting like seeing the countryside from the air.

Amazing tour! The price is nothing compare to what you get! The crew is very friendly and very profesional. I had a smile on my face the whole 60 minutes of the flight. Once you're up in the air you just wish that the tour never ends!

Our pilot (Chad) was very informative and friendly, learned a lot on the flight and we were very excited to see all three peaks! Flight was very smooth and the pilot took the time to talk about the airplane specifications with us after we landed.

The views from this air tour were amazing!!! The pilot was very knowledgeable about the history of the Napali Coast and he even checked on me (a couple of times) to make sure I was comfortable (I think he could sense that I'm not a good flyer). The tour was so smooth and comfortable that I was able to take a lot of beautiful pictures. I would definitely recommend this tour to all of my friends!
what an amazing experience! the views were breath taking, the plane was comfortable,Eric the pilot was just a pleasure to be around.

Our family of 6 took the tour to Grand Canyon West. Bruce was our pilot and tour guide and he was terrific. Very friendly and extremely patient with us as we kept stopping for more photos (he is also a good photographer).  We were blown away by the cruise on the Colorado River and the jaw dropping helicopter ride to the base of the canyon.  This was our second trip with Westwind and I would highly recommend them!
War eine super Erfahrung und ist jeden Euro wert! Und fliegt über Miami und hat ein super Blick auf die Stadt!
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text:
We saw whales, gorgeous colors, dormant volcano, 5 islands, & more.
Pilot, Eric, was super kind & took lots of videos & photos.
Just the 2 of us & pilot
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text:
We had booked for a flight earlier in the week and when we turned up they said that with cloud cover we'd miss 1/3 of what they normally can see so they gave us a full refund and we booked for another morning.  Today we were luckier and despite it raining at our hotel and us thinking the flight would be cancelled, we were thrilled to find that it was on and our visibility was great.  

The team that work for the company are all so friendly and helpful.  Given all the different options of companies that you can go up in the air with, we think we definitely made the right choice.  You have Bose earphones so you can hear the pilot and hear/speak to each other.  They had very cleverly timed the background music to movie themes of the sites we were seeing, such as Jurrasic Park, Indiana Jones, the Descendents etc.  I started to not feel too good, as I do suffer from travel sickness (even when I drove the car up to Waimea Canyon I started to feel sick, so I am a lightweight) but they had ginger candy onboard and that helped, plus they had a micro cloth that had been soaked in water and then frozen and that really helped.  

I have done a helicopter ride before and was terrified, but I felt much safer in the plane and would recommend for those who know they don't like helicopters. 

Definitely worth every penny...or cent I should say in US.
Great flight.  Fantastic scenery.  Our pilot Kim was very informative. This flight gives you a totally different perspective of the park. This is a flight that you do not want to miss.

review_title: Great tour!  Professional, knowledgeable, and informative!
review_text: Bruce, Ellen, and staff provide a fun and entertaining tour of the beautiful island of Kauai. Bruce previously was an academic and provided detailed and very interesting information (including scientific detail) about the island. I highly recommend Wings OVer Kauai Tours!

What a great way to view the entire island of Kauai in an hour.  James, our pilot, took us on a safe ride and gave exceptional guides on the island.  As a native, he is well familiar with all the key spots and items of interests along the flight.  We were rather worried about the weather but that’s how Kauai is…unpredictable.  But James was able to maneuver for better views which included great views of Napali Coastline, Waimea Canyon, Kauai Coffee Plantation and sites where they filmed Jurassic Park and Fantasy Island.  The checkin process was rather simple and hassle free as the staff organized it well.  We had some flexibility on the dates of flight as our original day was rather rainy.  All in all, it was well worth the experience!

This was truly the flight of a lifetime. The staff was friendly & helpful. Andy was our pilot and he gave us the Grand Tour. We felt safe, he gave warning if there were going to be "bumps", changed course a bit if needed for a smooth ride with the best views. This was a glacier landing flight & so glad we did...amazing! Andy was knowledgeable and encouraged questions about area history, mountains, climbers, etc. You will not be disappointed!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: My family enjoyed the flight over the Grand Canyon and we were all able to go since the price was about half that of the helicopter tour. I have been on many small planes and this was definitely the best, smooth and great take-off/landing. It was a great way to get the most out of a short trip to the Grand Canyon.

When you travel from Europe you plan and dream about your trip. This is one of the arrangement I absolutely did not want to miss. With all the storms that have hit California beginning of January 2023, after a few cancellations because of the weather, we were able to have an amazing experience taking a tour with sea plane adventures for an our over San Francisco and the coast.
Strongly recommend !

What a great experience from beginning to end.  We were 3 couples (2 went in the Airvan & 1 in the Cessna.)  We took off within minutes of each other and spent the next hour flying over spectacular scenery; our pilots, Marcus and Doug, shared a lot of interesting history & information about the island while soothing Hawaiian music played in the background.  The flights were smooth and the planes are clean and comfortable.  Everyone we dealt with was professional and very accommodating.  This definitely was one of the highlights of our 2 week Hawaiian vacation.  Highly recommended.

review_title: Second trip with SeaWind Aviation was even better!
review_text: This was the second time in three years that we have taken the flight to the Misty Fjords National Monument with SeaWind..  SeaWind is a family-owned business with outstanding service.  They picked us promptly at the pier and took us to their business site.  After a safety video we boarded the plane for a Great tour of Misty Fjords National Monument.  Our grandson was able to sit up front with the pilot (owner).  The take off & landing was super smooth, and we enjoyed terrific views of all the sights.  We were able to land in a fjord & enjoy the great sights & tranquility.  Slightly less expensive than purchasing the tour through the cruise company, but we'll-worth the money.
Seaplane Adventures is simply amazing.  Our family enjoyed our trip and it is such a unique San Francisco experience.  I think it is a must for anyone visiting the bay.  Brian

Flight 11.00 on 23 January. The whole experience couldn't have been better. Bruce owns the company and was our pilot. He is a very interesting,  personable man with an outstanding knowledge of his, obviously,  dearly beloved island. He was also great at interacting with his four passengers. The 65 minutes flight was terrific.  We went everywhere and gained an appreciation of Kauai which can only be achieved from the air. We were so glad we made this choice of company and that we did not opt for the helicopter option. Taking everything into account, including collection from the port which we specifically requested, it was very good value. If you are thinking about booking with Wings over Kauai, do it. You will be glad you did. Thanks Bruce.

My husband and I and two other friends flew with Air Ventures Hawaii in late January while visiting the island of Kauai. The flight was very informative and we were able to view the NaPali coast line from the air and see things that we could not have seen by boat or on land.
 Our pilot provided great background information about the island and interesting facts about the area.

I was a little apprehensive about flying in a small plane--but it was great and I felt comfortable the entire time while I was in the air. A great trip to do while visiting Kauai.

I would recommend this to anyone visiting the island.

Joyce R

Family of 8 travel to Alaska in August 2021.  K2 was able to accommodate us all on the same flight.
Weather was perfect, clear and sunny.  We had the most amazing experience. 
As the pilot took us around, giving us information and making sure we all had a perfect view every time!  We came to see Denali and we were so lucky to see it very clearly and different viewpoints, only thing that made it even more fantastic was that  we were the lucky few to see all 3 peaks!!  Thank you for a memorable experience.

Great experience from beginning to end.  They were all professionals from the email responses to the office personnel st the airstrip to the pilot!  The airplane was great and we loved all of the Mountain View’s but the glacier landing was the pinnacle of the trip.  We all loved it and would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.
Excellent flight with airventure, save (thanks to Eric), with a lot of information on all aspects of kauai.
