Our original booking got cancelled twice due to the thunderstorm and heavy cloud at the Grand Canyon (safety first). Their front desk staff was very helpful to reschedule for us to two days later when the weather was sunny. We had a smooth check in and everything was great. Our pilot, BJ, a very funny guy and yet very professional. He answered my questions about how often they service the helicopters and safety precautions. It was a great experience to fly with Maverick and I highly recommend them to everyone.

This is definitely the way to see the canyons. What an awesome journey flying into the canyons. The pilot tells you a bit of history and explains what you are flying over. Hoover dam was quite a sight from the skies. We were quite lucky to be seated next to the pilot as we has almost a 180 degree view. As we enter the Grand Canyons, an air-wolf type of music was played and it really jives with the flight path. Upon landing in the middle of the Canyons, snacks and champange was served. Though it was about 40 degrees when we went, we were too blown by the beauty to feel the heat. Definitely a must try!!

This is a stunning way to see Grand Canyon.  Our 45 minute flight went too quickly and we appreciated the way our Pilot (Alex), put us at ease and guided us through the trip, with his informative, interesting and entertaining commentary.  The views from the helicopter were truly awe inspiring.  The whole operation was very efficient, slick and professional and they certainly went out of their way to make the experience special for us. We would very highly recommend this experience.

The experience seeing the Bay from a Dehavilland Beaver floatplane was exceptional. Our pilot Fred was supremely knowledgeable in everything we saw and gave us the best day ever. I highly recommend this experience for locals and visitors.

review_title: Thrilling way to end the vacation
review_text: Amazing views and a thrilling experience flying the plane! The pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. Definitely a great time.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: Best tour of my whole trip.
review_text: Paul was our pilot and he showed us a great time he circled around so both sides of the plane got great views and pictures. He was full of interesting facts about the island. The boat trip afterwards was great as well the ladies singing and dancing for us at the fern grotto was very cool.I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting the island. Great value for the money.

Wow it was a great experience. First the service is magnificent, the pilot was great, funny,explained all the security procedures, was very good at explaining us everything during the excursion. The ride was smooth and you could see the pilot know what he was doing very profesional. The views of the Grand Canyon were amazing and unforgettable. Don't miss this ride!

Had the opportunity to see Kauii by plane, with Desi as our pilot. She was awesome, and we were lucky that visibility was excellent the day we flew. We were off the Pride of America for the day and thoroughly enjoyed this excursion with our knowledgeable pilot, which we booked through Discount Hawaii. fantastic views of the canyons and coastlines.

Awesome experience of flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi. All the representatives were very helpful, warm and welcoming. Pilot was very friendly, explained everything about the trip, Denali mountains etc., also, patiently answered all the questions that we had. They picked us from our hotel and also dropped us to the area of our choice, hence it was very convenient for us as we didn't have any car and quite a bit of luggage. Overall, we feel that we made the right choice to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi, would love to visit again.
Great experience. Awesome views. Highly recommend going on this tour. Safe flight and knowledgeable pilot.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: We just finished our 1 hour float plane tour. We paid extra for a glacier lake landing and thought it was worth the extra cost. We had a cloudy day so Denali wasn't seen, but we were able to see moose, and many glaciers and of course lakes and rivers. This float plane is such an amazing experience,  to take off and land only on water surface. Our pilot was very good.

review_title: Bird’s Eye View of the World
review_text:
The entire experience was great!  From the greeting at the front desk to the fond “goodbyes” it was all perfect.  We arrived early to surprise our birthday-friend.  The Fred and Daniel (pilot and dockhand) could not have been more gracious and arranged for us to board the plane 30 minutes before the birthday girl.  The surprise was huge but the views were even bigger.  Fred knows the territory and shares his knowledge in a friendly way.  Best of all there’s no test at the end.

I grew up in the Bay Area and thought I knew all there is to know but I was sorely wrong.  Fred’s an interesting guy with a happy and energetic view of the world, his job and his life.  Just do it!  You’ll be glad you did.  I promise.
A fantastic flight with our pilot JT who had so much knowledge of the island and who made our flight feel very safe and smooth.

review_title: Ohne den Flug ist der NP nur die Hälfte wert
review_text: Wir haben mit Maverick diese Tour gemacht und es war das viele Geld wert. Das Unternehmen ist 100% professionell. Wir zehren jetzt noch von der Erinnerung, wenn der Heli über den Bäumen in den Canyon reinschwebt. Beim Ticket Kauf mal bei Viator vorbeischauen. Erste Buchung gab 10% Rabatt. Lohnt sich bei den Preisen

review_title: Wonderful start to vacation on Kauai!
review_text:
We booked our flight with Wings Over Kauai for our first morning on the island.  I'm glad we arrived early enough to be able to chat with Ellen a bit.  She is a wealth of information about the variety of ecosystems on Kauai, all of which we were about to see from the air!  Our pilot, Josh, was a great tour guide, giving us all kinds of information about the history, geography and culture of Kauai.  I struggle with motion sickness (in spite of aids to keep it under control).  Josh's steady and calm demeanor definitely helped, and I was amazed with the photos I managed to get as Josh pointed out features.  This introduction to Kauai was a great start to our exploration of the island!  We are very happy that we choose Wings Over Kauai!  Thanks Ellen and Josh!!
Connie and Jan, BC, Canada

review_title: Amazing way to experience the island
review_text: Wonderful views, and amazing service from start to finish! Since you can only see 20% of Kauai by car, taking this tour will ensure you get to see all of its beauty!

Vol inoubliable en compagnie de Captain Bruce. Si vous ne devez faire qu'une seule activité à Kauaï, allez sans hésiter chez wings over Kauaï. C'est une entreprise familiale, où l'on est accueilli chaleureusement, nous avons choisi de faire le tour privatisé en Cessna et franchement nous ne l'avons pas regretté!!! des paysages à couper le souffle et un super pilote qui aime son boulot et ça se sent!!! le rapport qualité/prix en comparaison avec les tours en hélice est sans appel, le tour en avion dure réellement 1H et on en prend plein les yeux!! sans aucun doute le meilleur moment de notre séjour! merci encore à la famille Coulombe.
Felt like a roller coaster at times but it was do to high winds but Stephen assured us it was normal. Great flight! Keep it up

My husband and I loved our private plane tour with Caden as our pilot! We saw all of the highlights of the island and learned a lot of interesting information about what we were seeing and about the island in general. When we returned, we found that there had been an issue with our GoPro and it didn’t capture much footage. Jill graciously offered to put our GoPro on another flight later that day. We really appreciated that!! Also, the private plane has A/C, which helps reduce motion sickness. Such great people and an incredible experience!
Une magnifique visite de San Francisco. Voir les différents sites déjà visités depuis les airs a enchantés tant les parents que nos 3 ados. Les explications de Paul étaient parfaites. A conseiller.

review_title: Fantastic trip and great customer service
review_text: We did the airplane tour over the west rim. We had heard that the south rim was better but the views from the plane were spectacular. An incredible experience! Our pilot Chris was funny and knowledgeable, we felt in very safe hands. We did have a bit of a mix up with the pickup location and missed our transfer but Kevin dealt with this very professionally when we got there and didn't make us feel stupid (when perhaps we had been a little stupid!) Brilliant customer service and meant that the miscommunication didn't ruin our experience in the slightest. Thank you!

It was our last day in Talkeetna and we were surprised to see clear weather. When we checked out Denali Overlook Inn, the owner suggested we check out flightseeing as it was a good day for flying. He gave us $25 discount vouchers to Talkeetna Air. We called around 930am and they booked us for a 1 pm flight. Check in was easy and fast. Pilot gave us a brief instruction on safety and expectations and off we went. Flight was smooth going to the Alaskan range. Pilot gave us info while we went around the vast range of snow, glaciers and rock. It was a sight to behold! My sister actually said that it's overwhelmingly beautiful that no amount of photos can capture the grandeur of the mountain ranges. We were able to see Mt Denali's peak; the pilot did turns so both sides of the plane can take in the sight. Overall it took about an hour of flying. We felt safe and enjoyed it immensely. Many times, people we met tell us only a percentage of tourists see Denali's peak when they visit because of the weather; so if you have chance to see it, grab that opportunity!

Absolutely Amazing Experience. Stunning views and Perspectives. Captain Eric was the best. Highlight of our vacation and super worth the cost. Lifetime Memories. 

Grateful and filled w Aloha

My mom and I took the seaplane to Bimini for a quick two day getaway.  It was an amazing experience!  Tony was great and took us and another couple that was on the plane around the island to a few interesting spots.  I highly recommend!

We thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Viewing the Maui northern coast and rainforest from above is out of this world. Very happy with Mavericks Helicopters. Their operation is very professional and we felt totally safe flying with them.

review_title: Must Do!  The best part of our 14-day trip!
review_text: Our trip was filled with highlights including a 7-day cruise of the inland passage. Consensus is that our K-2 flight to Denali out of Talkeetna with a glacier landing was the boldest and best thing we experienced.  It was not scary at all.  No motion sickness among us who often have it.  K-2 provides over boots so you don't have to worry about getting your feet wet.  We were blessed with super clear weather.   I wore my newly acquired K-2 tee shirt on the glacier and needed no sweater in the land of the midnight sun.  Bring sun glasses as the snow and sun are blinding without.  The flight and landing were super smooth and exhilarating.   Do not come to Alaska and not do this.  All the K-2 staff are great.  Worth every penny.   These memories will last a lifetime!

review_title: Fun Viewing Kauai from the air
review_text:
We enjoyed our air tour of Kauai flying Wings Over Kauai in their six seater fixed-wing aircraft.  Wings Over guarantees a window seat on the right side of the plane for every customer.  This is crucial to getting a great view of the island from the air and getting your money's worth.  

Bruce Coulombe, the owner/pilot, is a retired scientist and very knowledgeable.  We thoroughly enjoyed his commentary and insights as we flew.  Bruce is a veteran pilot with more than 5,000 flights over Kauai.

One drawback of the fixed wing aircraft is that it cannot get up close to many of the waterfalls and ridges that a helicopter can.  For us, this was for the best because one of our party members tends to get motion sickness.  Bruce and Ellen also made sure that the person with the tendency for motion sickness got to sit in the co-pilot seat to minimize the effects of the motion of the plane.
Amazing tour we got to fly around miami and southbeach this was for my girlfriends birthday! Pilot was very friendly. Thanks!
Very fun and got some great views. The pilot was cool and professional. Definitely would do again with one of the other tours they offer

review_title: Beautiful way to see the island.
review_text: The whole crew was super friendly and the flight was wonderful. I highly recommend this a a must do. The views and the narration of the flight were unbeatable. Thanks for a great adventure.

review_title: My Amazing Birthday Present to Me!
review_text: I had a BIG birthday on a weekday, and knew I needed a special experience on the actual day. Arranging a ride with Seaplane Adventures was the best decision I could have made. As local who's lived nearby for decades, I'm glad I finally did it. I chose the one-hour Pt. Reyes + Marin Coast trip, which includes flying by San Francisco. The trip took us over the familiar towns and landscapes of beautiful Marin County, then to the dramatic cliffs and beaches of the coast, where we saw several pods of whales out at sea, and finally over the Golden Gate, past downtown SF, over Alcatraz, with a landing in Richardson Bay offering amazing views of Sausalito, Tiburon and Belvedere. The weather was clear as a bell with unlimited visibility. The pilot and staff at Seaplane Adventures were totally professional, knowledgeable and friendly. It's clearly a very well run operation. I highly recommend them for anyone -- visitor or local -- who wants to enjoy our beautiful area from a whole new perspective. I fully intend to fly with them again.

We did the 1 hour south facing tour and it was amazing! Dave was our tour guide and he was so great. We even brought our 14 month old on the flight. This was definitely the highlight of our trip. If you are coming to Alaska for vacation, this is the trip you don't want to miss out on. Well worth the cost.

Four of us took this sightseeing flight in April 2018. Ellen, Bruce and Doug (our pilot) were all so nice. Our flight over Kauai was awesome! The sights, falls, and canyons left us amazed! Doug was very informative and professional. We highly recommend this excursion.

The Denali Grand flight tour was incredible.  To be able to see this amazing mountain up close at 12000 feet was such an inspiring experience.  Our pilot Will was very informative.  My husband took wonderful photos that are just not obtainable any other way!

Seven years and 14 trips into the Alaska Range later, and I've flown with every air service in Talkeetna. But the one I keep coming back to is TAT. Whether you're looking to go into an unexplored zone, or just want a reliable flight to your base camp, these are the folks to trust. There's a reason they're used by the serious climbers of the Alaska Range time after time.

This flight was a revelation and even if one visits all the overlooks along both rims of the canyon  you cannot comprehend the immense magnificence before you but on this flight this wonder unfolds as one is taken on the flight and we took the 45 min option (pre -booked ) . There is before the flight procedures to go through which  involve waiting and might irritate some people but this is to do with safety especially on weight distribution within the helicopter. As for the flight itself it was as one would expect carried out in a very professional manner with a commentary by our great pilot Jake (no sudden moves,very smooth ride). We as part of the M/bike group could talk to each other and Jake during the trip.I also felt the same sense of exhilaration within the "copter as riding my motorcycle.All praise to Maverick Helicopters.

Overall we had a great experience. They covered a lot of the interior parts of denali national park which is otherwise not accessible by road. The plane ride was very smooth, and they really care about their customers and accommodate all requests within their reach.

review_title: Over looking Miami Beach is one of kind!
review_text:
Thank you so much for an amazing tour!! The plane ride was smooth, plenty of room & the views were amazing! We had a blast! 
10/10! Thank you!
1h de survol du Grand canyon. Magnifique expérience avec un personnel sympathique et  très professionnel. Parfait !

What an awe-inspiring, gorgeous experience -- truly once in a lifetime.  And K2 is extremely professional and polished. The company declined to take us out when the weather was uncertain or when the conditions made it hard to see the mountain and very politely rescheduled the flight to match everyone's preferences. The customer experience is truly the main priority. Moreover, I never once felt unsafe. My pilot Nick led us on a perfectly smooth ride, while being informative, thoughtful, and polite throughout. His passion and knowledge shone through, alongside his utmost concern for the passengers' experience. We couldn't have been in better hands! If you're in Talkeetna (or anywhere near Denali), please treat yourself to this unique encounter with the mountain. 

Best way to see Denali / one of the best experiences PERIOD!

review_title: Exclusive flight and crab fest George Inlet Inn
review_text: The best excursion my husband and I have ever done!! Totally cool. Smooth take off and landing. Beautiful sight seeing. I would do it again and again.

Would thoroughly recommend this tour of the island of Kauai. Our pilot J.T was excellent, very accommodating ensuring everyone in our party was able to see everything, the highlights were many, including breathtaking waterfalls, the Napali coastline, and 2 graceful and beautiful whales. J.T put everyone at their ease and the landing and take off were very smooth.

A warm welcome and personnal pilot who knew about the island; what a treat.
From welcome to send off Bruce and Ellen made us feel special the entire trip. 
They reschedule us twice due to cloudy weather,  the choppers went up any way. 
A nice video to take home. Fond memories.
Go for it!
Smooth ride with great amount of views. Enjoyed the views of Maui shore. Cliffs were amazing. Great adventure!

Wings Over Kauai made our honeymoon complete! We had been contemplating a helicopter ride which can be pricey.  We found Wings Over Kauai and this was a perfect solution! Bruce, our pilot, was well educated on island info.  He was able to point out so many fun facts about the island. The plan itself was a nice slow smooth ride.  We felt like we were floating.  I thought a helicopter would be better to see all the landscape, but this plane did a great job and flying slow and allowing us to see all the views/sites we wanted to see. This was an affordable solution to seeing beautiful Kauai by air!! I would definitely recommend!!

K2 is the best flying company in Alaska, hands down. They have so many options you can, fly and hike in the mountains or land on a glacier. They are located in my favorite town of Talkeetna. They are located just a small walk from town and are not hard to find. The staff is excellent. They are all very knowledgeable with any questions you have about your trip and any concerns you might have. The pilots are super friendly and highly trained. They know so much about the area and Denali it is mind blowing. This company is about everyone's safety, which is my number one concern.  As a Tour Director I only want the best for my best and K2 aviation is just that, the best!

Ne passez pas à côté de cette expérience : dès  la prise en charge par la navette à San Fransisco jusqu'au retour du vol, grande gentillesse et disponibilité des employés Seaplane. Avion et pilote exceptionnels et superbe point de vue sur la baie, le pont et la ville.

We had a wonderful time. Maka was our pilot and he was very kind and informative.

I was concerned at first that I wouldn’t be able to see well and I was very happy that I could see everything I wanted to

Went with Talkeetna Air for the South Side Explorer flight and wow! All the staff was super friendly and great. Our pilot was so informative and I felt safe with him in control. The flight itself was unreal. I'm a nervous flier and scared of heights, so it was a little nerve wrecking for me. But all of that was 100% worth it. We were able to see the summit and the pilot flew around several times to give us amazing views. We also did the glacier landing which was incredible. It was a once in a lifetime experience!
The views were breathtaking. I loved seeing the colorado river and hearing Craig, our pilot, tell us of the geography and specifications of the canyon. A must do for anyone visiting the grand canyon.
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_text: Erik was absolutely amazing. The weather was not optimal for our volcano tour so we went to the sea wall. Excellent commentary, nice & engaging experience, gorgeous views. Highly recommended, will tour again! ;)
Amazing experience.  Crew and Captain jack are incredible! Better than helicopter,  more time in are, for less $
Trip Advisor guided us to this great family run business.  Booking was easy and all aspects of the trip were wonderful.   I would highly recommend Wings and would gladly go on this trip again!

Had an opportunity to take some first-time visitors on a tour of the Island of Kauai with Air Ventures and couldn't have been happier with everything about the flight. You get to see parts of the Island that you would never see from the ground, and of course, you get to really appreciate the special beauty of Kauai. Not to miss!

The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi exceeded our expectations.  This is a professionally run operation that really knows Denali.  We landed on base camp and were able to talk with mountain climbers who had been there for five weeks. This is by far the most thrilling way to experience the big mountain.  Do it!

review_title: A High Point of Our Visit to Moab
review_text: We flew with Larry who is extremely knowledgeable about the areas surrounding Moab.  Our flight went over Canyonlands and Arches National Parks, but we could see far beyond those areas.  A great way to gain perspective and to take in many of the highlights of touring Moab and the areas around Moab, especially if you are trying to take as much in as possible in a short period of time.  It was an outstanding experience - one that we will long remember.

We decided at the last minute to add a flightseeing trip around Mt McKinley and surrounding peaks. We were not disappointed. Had a fantastic weather day. There is no way to explain the immense beauty we saw on our flight. Talkeetna Air staff are great and, especially our pilot. He made sure everyone on the plane got an opportunity to see all the amazing sites and take photos. His narration throughout the flight was spot-on. Definitely the highlight of our Alaska trip. Take the glacier landing tour, if you can. It is a one-in-a-lifetime experience.

My wife and I wanted to do something special on our trip to Alaska, and this was perfect.  The flight around Denali with glacier landing was thrilling yet comfortable, adventurous yet safe, filled with gorgeous, jaw dropping sights, and worth every dollar.  Staff were very friendly, too.  Highly recommended!

This experience was one of the most meaningful and beautiful things we have ever done!  The views were remarkable!  Our pilot, Harry, was personable, engaging, and informative.  The plane was clean, well-maintained, and offered excellent views for every passenger.  Our drivers to and from the airport were delightful to visit with.  Well worth EVERY penny!  We will highly recommend this to others!

review_title: Fantastic once or twice in a lifetime experience everyone should do!
review_text: I did a GC flight 26 years ago (can't remember who with) & it was amazing & 2nd time round with my wife, still amazing. The colours, light, shade, shadows, contours etc. change every second. The aeroplane was very good value & cheaper than a much shorter helicopter flight & we must have been in the air, excluding take off & landing for a good half an hour - well it seemed like it anyway. Fantastic experience & would definitely recommend.

review_title: Excellent intro to the Garden Isle with excellent service!
review_text: Ellen, Bruce and their daughter Mary are very professional and know how to make their guests feel welcomed and at ease. Bruce is a great captain and the sites around the beautiful island of Kauai are just added bonus!

Tour cancelled at the last minute apparently due to rain in the area - we were not informed and had to call (at £1.40 a minute) in panic, especially as our NCL ship had docked in a different port to where Seawind has advised us it would dock - we had to call them to say we would be a few minutes late but they said it was cancelled anyway. We saw other sea planes flying that morning and could not understand why we could not be offered an alternative such flying later, or to another area where bears were. We were refunded but that doesn’t make up for a trip we had been planning for 3 years being a 50th trip, and booked over a year in advance. It’s not as if we can get back to Alaska any time soon living in the UK. We have not been offered any good will gesture such as a future discount. We feel very let down by Seawind Aviation.

In September of this year my wife and I traveled to Hawaii where we spent 2 weeks on the Big Island, 1 week on Oahu, and our last week on Kauai.  While in Kauai we too the Air Ventures flight and it was worth every penny we paid and compared to the helicopter tours it was much cheaper and we were able to spend more time near the various points that we flew over. Great for taking photos and video.  
Gary and Dian

This was the highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska. We were fortunate to fly on a crystal clear day and our pilot was able to give us amazing views of Denali and surrounding mountains. Felt like you could reach out and touch them. Absolutely spectacular. Landing on the glacier was a great experience. Always felt safe and learned a lot.. This is a not to be missed experience.

Clay was our guide and did a fantastic job of maneuvering through the mountains to get the best views of Denali.  As we took off in the clouds that morning we didn't think we would see much but Clay took us to the north side of Denali where the sun happened to be shining and it was just exhilarating!  We landed on a glacier which was a highlight of our trip!

We were a group of four people and all four enjoyed the Papillon helicopter tour.  We took off at 10am and did the 45min Imperial route.  We were in the front right and back right of the helicopter and everyone was very impressed.  It was literally our first views of the canyon, absolutely spectacular, and the entire trip very enjoyable.  I would recommend for a very unique perspective!
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_title: A Birdseye view of Maui & Molokai
review_text:
Our pilot guide had prepared an unforgettable journey for us adding history narrative to give our experience depth and texture.  We watched as he revealed features, landmarks and wondrous beauty about our tour.
I’m lining up friends and neighbors to experience this highly affordable tour.

review_title: Great tour but are at the mercy of the weather.
review_text:
They were very accommodating of our changing plans and I emailed them with a request to change the time and they did that immediately.

We were booked on the mountain voyager with glacier landing (which is a must in my opinion). Due to the weather, they offered other options on the day of travel including canceling at no charge.

We went ahead anyways and our pilot Paul was fantastic with tons of travel and flying experience. The views are spectacular and the glacier landing was special. We got to meet mountaineers at their base camp as well when we landed on the glacier.

Must do in my opinion. I hope you have better luck with weather when you do.

My family, including two small kids, just had the most amazing experience of our lives. 

Thanks to Chip, an amazing pilot/scientist/tour guide/naturalist/comedian/expert glacier navigator! 

Whatever your hesitation is about this tour, give it up and go. We saw Denali, landed on a glacier and had a snowball fight, and then spotted wildlife on the return trip. We learned so much, and we felt totally and completely safe, even with a 2nd and 5th grade passenger along. 

We can't thank Chip and the folks at K enough. Truly a life changing moment.

Heads up for people booking with K2.  They are eager to book (W/ Glacier Landing) any one of 4 Denali flightseeing trips.  The problem is when you get there (in our case after a 2 1/2 hour drive from Anchorage) they tell you that the weather won't allow us to do the flight you scheduled but they can fit us on one we didn't schedule and, there will be no Glacier landing.  Upon further inspection we find out the real issue was.   1) our flight was not full and there were miraculously 2 seats left on the flight we were offered.  2) the pilot said it has been "over 2 weeks" since they did a Glacier landing.  I would have rated this a 4 if they would have told us at any point before arrival of the change.  I would have rated a 5 if they would have been truthful about Glacier landing.  Felt like bait and switch.
Perfect way to see the whole island.  Pilot knew alot of information. We felt very safe.  Would definitely do it again.!!!

What an amazing experience! James was our pilot. He was a fantastic host and guide. I was concerned that a plane would have to travel too fast and keep too great of a distance. That was not the case. The plane traveled at a seemly slow speed and was close enough to see details in the landscaping. The flight lasted for over an hour, which in much longer than a more expensive helicopter tour. James was knowledgable and provided a lot of great historical, as well as current, information. Our family of five enjoyed the tour and found that it exceeded our expecations. We highly rcommend it.

review_title: Truely a Highlight of da Garden Island...
review_text:
I highly Recommend doing the private tour to see all the hidden & fabulous views of Kauai. Our pilot's name was Harry & he was the the greatest, full of information,sense of humor & felt like we known him for years. The ride was very comfortable & smooth from take off to the return landing. Flying with Air Ventures is truely a remarkable lifetime memory you won't forget. 
I also wanted to thank you Harry for this lifetime memory & we will see U again soon. 
Mahalo,  
Greg & Lisa M

Surprised my husband got his bier throat and he loved it!  It was so fun! Clear weather and the views were beautiful!  Flew over SF, Mt Tam, Stinson Beach, Golden Gate Bridge, even saw some whales breaching.  Highly recommend this adventure.

My girlfriend and I were amazed by this experience and would recommend it to anyone, especially with this company!
You get to see amazing & breathtaking views of the island from the air, the captain (Cameron) was very friendly and gave us interesting explanations while we were flying over the island.
Everyone from this company was friendly, smiling and happy to help! Maloha and see you soon!

The pilot was a very skilled and knowledgeable pilot and made the experience relaxed and a lot of fun. We flew in a Beaver airplane which has a lot of history in Alaska and is considered the “Bentley of the Alaskan Bush” 
The view of Denali and her summit were unbelievable! I’ve never been around mountains so flying in between the mountain passes with the glaciers beneath us and Denali above us was a once in a lifetime experience. There are a lot of fun things to do in Alaska, but after this flight I’m convinced there’s no better way to experience Alaska than through the cockpit of a Beaver!

review_title: The only way to see Kauai.
review_text: This was an awesome trip.  This is the only way to see the whole island, my whole family loved it.  Harry is a great pilot  and travel guide.
Staff i friendly. They helped us move our appointment as per our convenience when the weather conditions were not in our favor. Flying exp was amazing. Had a great time.
We booked this tour for our anniversary,it was money well spent! Jill was very helpful with booking and at check in. This tour offers great views if the island and waterfalls.

review_title: wonderful views for an affordable price.
review_text: There were 4 in our group. Everyone had a window seat. The pilot  gave information and pointed out landmarks. He circled over the waterfalls so eveyone could see.It was very comfortable in the plane , small but not cramped. Highlight of our trip!

After reviewing many tour companies, we decided to go with Air Ventures and couldn't have been happier.  The pilot was wonderful explaining what we were seeing.  The seating was great, as everyone had a large window to view out.  They only take six customers.  I would absolutely recommend Air Ventures, as they are the best priced air tour with great customer service!

Words can't describe the experience of a flight seeing trip and glacier landing with K2 Aviation!  The views are something that can only be experienced from the air.  The time spent walking around on the glacier was awe-inspiring.  When you get off the plane, you can't help but be struck by the absolute quiet.  We were lucky enough to hear an avalanche happening somewhere in the mountains while we were on the glacier.  Our pilot, Chris, was great and the entire experience from start to finish was unforgettable.  Terminal is very convenient to everything in Talkeetna.  We wondered if the trip would be worth the money....the answer is a resounding ABSOLUTELY!!

this was our no 1 attraction while visit hawaii island!
the service was great,the view is anazing,bruce is wonderfull pilot&guide.
afterthe flight we did the waimea vally by car-and u cant compare it to the view we saw from above.
we flew in the secna aircraft &it much mor  better then fly in the helicopter.
the flight was a hour long &for our poi t of view-must do while visit beautiful kawaii.
thanks a lot for the lovely couple.
udu&tal

My daughter and I went flying for my annual birthday flight. I went to school for aviation and haven't flown in years so we took an instructor with us. Kim was fantastic. He has a great personality and showed us around the Maze and Needles districts of Canyonlands National Park as well as Arches National park. It was incredible to see all the sights from above. Thanks Kim and Redtail Aviation for a great birthday flight!
Eric was a fantastic pilot, host, & guide! The views were beautiful - flying over Lahaina was incredible. Will certainly be back to fly with MPR!

I will definitely recommend to all my friends and readers here not to hesitate even for a second and book a flight with Air Ventures! 
All the team was extremely nice and professional especially Jill, one of the owners who also recommended us a nice restaurant after the flight! 
Thank you guys and continue to be so awesome !
Our trip was in May 2022. We had a blast. The pilot was knowledgeable and fun. My husband hates flying, especially small planes, but he'd do it again. We plan to book with K2 again.

This was an amazing experience, we all loved it!  Our 10 year old son, Roman, got to be the "Co-Pilot" and he has told everyone that since our return to PA.  The sites were amazing including Ruth Glacier, the Great Gorge, Denali, Moose's Tooth, etc. etc.  The views were breathtaking and we lucked out with a beautiful day.  Dave, the pilot, was great!  So knowledgable and nice!  Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi and Dave for a great family experience!
This was just a wonderful experience and in our opinion this is an absolutely must do for a few reasons: the private cabin and the longer time.
The experience was incredible! We got excited and had fun and Pilot Erik was helpful, adorable and very professional!!The best of the best! Absolutely Recommended :) :)

OMG what amazing scenery. We chose this tour over a helicopter trip, mainly on price. The flight far exceeded our expectations, right from the time you arrive at the airport. Pilot Josh was very professional and informative, The plane had large windows and everyone had a window seat on our trip. We loved the takeoff. This is a great way to see the island, we would recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone.

review_title: The highlight of our trip!  I will never forget this experience!
review_text: Never having flown in a helicopter, I was apprehensive but determined to take this tour!  The pilot was amazing, couldn't have asked for better.  Once we took off, I never felt any fear at all, It was a thrilling experience to fly over the canyon, to see views up close that you cannot see anywhere else.  That moment when you leave the trees below, and fly out over the edge!  Incredible!  Once in a lifetime experience - worth every penny!  What was the best part of our whole Arizona trip?  This helicopter ride!

We absolutely loved the entire experience. We have one child who was VERY concerned with being on a small plane, and the pilot took the time to set her mind at ease by explaining how the flight would work. The visuals were STUNNING and landing on the glacier for an on-the-ground appreciation of the scale of the mountains and glaciers made livelong memories for our entire family.

review_title: Well worth the drive and the price!
review_text: We had a beautiful drive from Anchorage (could see Denali on the drive!) and were so NOT disappointed with the flight!....it was just my husband and me and the very knowlagable pilot (owner of the company) in a tiny single engine plane....we felt we were up close and personal with that beautiful Alaska mountain range!

Un survol inoubliable. Départ de la banlieue de Portland, direction le Mount Hood. Vue sur le Mount St Helens, Le Mount Baker, la Columbia River Georges, les cascades.
Tout simplement magnifique et inoubliable.

review_title: Very pleasant aerial tour of Kauai
review_text: We couldn't decide between a helicopter or fixed wing tour of Kauai ... since we have done chopper tours elsewhere, we decided to try Air Ventures Kauai.  We had a wonderful flight and were able to see well out the windows.  When we were walking out to the aircraft, several navy fighter jets were in the pattern doing "touch and go"s" so we were able to watch them for a few minutes ... very cool!  Although I do prefer helicopter flight, especially in Hawaii, I would recommend Air Ventures for a less expensive, positive alternative.
The air tour is a must do in Kauai.  Using Air Adventures was a great experiance.  The pilot went our of his way to explain and answer our questions, offering a very colorful tour.
Friendly and courteous staff and pilot, breath-taking views, awesome experience!  Bucket list worthy!  Highly recommend!

It was an amazing experience and our pilot was so informative and friendly!
It was a little scary but the pilot made us aware of the turbulence before it happened so that helped!

We took the Grand Canyon landing tour for our anniversary and it was a fantastic experience. They are a quality company using modern helicopters. This tour takes you over the Hoover Dam en route to the Canyon before working its way back. There are 3 legs in total but the first leg is the hero of the tour and if you can be up front for this segment you will be well rewarded.

review_title: An Awesome Grand Canyon Day Trip
review_text: Great trip, great pilot, awesome views.  Westwind handled everything for us.  The guide they hired to take us on our Grand Canyon hike really knew his stuff and was easy to talk to.  He packed in a lunch for us and took us down into the canyon all while giving us history and answering our questions.

review_title: The BEST way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: Maverick Helicopter Tours were top notch all the way! It was a magnificent way to see the Grand Canyon and all its glory! Our pilot BJ was fantastic and had a great song playlist! Our kids enjoyed the experience and it will be something I won't soon forget. Definitely in the top ten experiences of my life! Ground staff was friendly and accomodating to our large group. Thank you Maverick Helicopter Tours!

Absolutely brilliant.  This was a special treat for our Silver Wedding anniversary.  Very informative, comfortable, very expert pilot "B J" was the best. Highly recommended if you want a better perspective of the Grand Canyon.  Thanks again B J.
Steve & Lynda

Aloha!! Gosh, I only have wonderful things to say about this experience! My brother and I were looking for something adventurous to do and, boy, this was it!! If you want to try something new, different, and adventurous, this is for you! Our pilot, Douglas was super sweet and informed us of so many interesting insights to Kauai's history and rich culture. I learned so much! His wife, Ellen was super sweet and chill as well. We even saw whales!! Yes, whales! And if photography is your thing, this is a great opportunity to get some great shots! Thanks again, Doug, Ellen, and Bruce! You guys are great! This was without a doubt the highlight of my trip! Thank you! Be well.
We took their tour on 2/1/18.  What a great flight. The pilot that we had was excellent.   All the seats have good views and pix taking opportunities.  .

The smoothest plane ride you’ll ever take! Beautiful sights and a wonderful experience! We flew over the ocean and saw an abundance of whales! Eric is super accommodating and really goes out of his way to make sure you are comfortable and having a good time! You won’t be disappointed!

We initially booked this activity because we didn’t want to pay the expensive helicopter prices but this ended up being more than we could have every hoped for! They were extremely personal and professional and our 70 minute tour was stunning and informative. We really enjoyed the entire flight experience and we highly recommend it to anyone going to Kauai!

My wife and I did a plane tour on our honeymoon and had a great experience.  We actually did the introduction to flight package (where I got to fly the plane part of the time) because it was the same price as a regular flight. Our pilot/instructor/tour guide was Jacob and he did a great job! Really cool way to get to see the whole island as well as parts you wouldn’t otherwise see and a little nicer price than the helicopter tours. Highly recommend!
Michael, our pilot, was awesome!  The scenery was out of this world amazing and landing on a glacier was smooth as silk. This was the highlight of our Alaskan trip.  Thanks so much!

The pilot, Michael,was fantastic. Very skilled and informative and made you feel very safe. The view of the glaciers and Mt McKinley were unbelievable. It really gave you a feeling of seeing Alaska. Landing on and taking off from the glacier was such a thrill. Well worth the cost and time.
I highly recommend this excursion.Bring your camera!

The price might turn some away, but it is worth it and more the views of mountain range and almost neon blue water and ice if you are in the season fir glacier landings add that you won't be disappointed

review_title: Get the seats on the left side
review_text: We took this tour as part of a package from our hotel and loved it. At least 50 minutes in the air with constant incredible views. My seat on the left side “as you look forward” was the best side only because as we flew over the Grand Canyon and Colorado river most of the views were out my large window. My wife was seated to my right and had nice views but nothing like mine. If they could alter their flight pattern then everyone could get a greater view. We both loved it and highly recommend this tour. Some have commented it was pricey, $400 each for the flight, antelope canyon tour, river cruise, and bus ride back, but for a 13 hour day it was priceless. We would seriously do all this again. They stop flying at the end of October as does the river cruise and we got the last tour in this format. Staff and pilots were great, both tiny airports were very clean and nice. Our flight was super smooth and relaxing. Highly recommend this especially if time is limited. You will see the Grand Canyon in a totally different and comprehensive way.

review_title: It was a very memorable one hour trip.
review_text:
The full 60 minutes trip was awesome. We saw the whole island from the air , hovered over the canyon, saw the waterfalls filmed in the JP and the best moment was seeing WHALES . 
The ride was very comfortable and we thoroughly enjoyed it. 
I would recommend this trip to all.

Mountains are king of Alaska scenery, and Denali is the king of the mountains. This was a bucket list trip for us, and Talkeetna Air Taxi did not disappoint us. We traveled by the Alaska Railroad from Fairbanks on a Sunday, flew to Denali on a Monday and took the train back to Fairbanks on a Tuesday. From the earliest planning stages through the actual flight, the people at Talkeetna Air Taxi were superb. Without exception, their only interest was to see that we enjoyed our flight. They do it many times each day, but know that their passengers will likely have the opportunity to do it only once. Our deepest gratitude goes to Talkeetna Air Taxi for an experience beyond words.

review_title: A true highlight of our trip!
review_text:
I wanted to take an air tour of Kauai but wasn't sure if I wanted a helicopter or airplane.  Being a bit of a history buff, when the google search brought up "Tropical Biplanes", I knew this was what I was looking for!

It starts with you boarding a  cherry red, double cockpit biplane.  My wife and I sat in the front cockpit, the pilot in the back cockpit.  We were supplied with cloth helmets, goggles, and radio set (reminding me of the old Battle of Midway movie).  These were needed as the cockpit was open air (you do have a windscreen to protect you)!

The flight was awesome!  Being an open cockpit, you had an almost unobstructed view in every direction.  I loved sticking my head over the side and looking straight down at the ocean.  One disadvantage of the plane versus a helicopter, was that we were not able to get close to many of the falls or anything.

Our pilot was great.  He was very professional and friendly.  He provided us plenty of information about the sites without being overbearing or cheesy.  When he found out what beach we were married on, he banked the plane so we could get some great pictures from the air!

If you are looking for a flight a bit more adventurous than the usual airplane/helicopter tour (and want to feel the wind in your face!), I would highly recommend Tropical Biplanes.

July 12, 2024, took a "Misty Fjords Flighseeing". Pilot, Clark, did not have a welcome word when we took off and either a  thank you for us when we left.  Very little talk about what we were flying over.  Clark should have a better personality when dealing with that type of work.   I don't recommend a tour with him.

Geweldig om het watervliegtuig te nemen. Prachtige uitzicht op Miami, de eilanden, stiltville, de vuurtoren en de stranden. Grote, echt grote nurse sharks gezien! Superaardige piloot die de geboekte Ultimate tour helemaal waarmaakte! Ben je in de gelegenheid, doe deze. Bij mij kan deze van de bucketlist😀

お天気に恵まれ素晴らしい体験でした。1日目、2日目とレンタカーてドライブしていましたが、空からしか見えないところが沢山ありました。島の中央には雲がかかっていたので、沢山虹も見ることができました。ホントに感動です。
スタッフの方もとても感じが良くて、フレンドリーでした。英語があまり理解できなかったので片言の日本語で話しかけてくれました。
ヘリコプターを最初は申し込みしたのですが、満席でエアーバンにしたのですが、料金も約半額という事もあり、こちらを選択してよかったです。
No better way to get a feel for the whole island.  The family run business is an outstanding value with a personal touch. A great value - especially compared to the helicopter.
The views and experience were  awesome. The plane ride was smooth, comfortable and informative. A quick way to grasp all that Kauaii has to offer. So glad we took the tour.

Westwind had all the bases covered.  They took care of our needs, all the details are ironed out.  The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, qualified, made you feel safe, and were very personable.  We enjoyed our excursion very much and it definitely felt like the best way to see the Grand Canyon!
We took the path of the waterfalls and it was breathtaking! Phenomenal experience! I would highly recommend taking a ride!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Spending time on the glacier is truly a breathtaking experience. I now understand why there are so many 5-star reviews here. The reason I'm giving Talkeetna Air Taxi 4-stars is because the Otter plane we were assigned for our flightseeing tour was an older model with small windows, as opposed to the group that went up just before us in a newer plane with wide 'HDTV' size windows, just like the plane on the company's website--so it was a frustrating to go up in a different plane with no mention made of why. Also, we paid for the Base Camp tour, but never saw a base camp, nor heard our pilot mention a base camp or why we weren't seeing it. Overall, the communication wasn't as clear as it was with other companies we used throughout Alaska on our trip. Besides all that, the pilot flew a flawless, safe flight, and Talkeetna is definitely a cool little town.

We went on the flyer with glacier landing on Jul 1 - our 1pm flight was one of the firsts to be able to land on the glacier as the cloud cover cleared in time. We got the flyer deal with the TourAlaska coupon booklet so worked out reasonable (still expensive :)) The plane is a 10 seater cessna - a bit loud so they give you noise cancelling headphones. The views are incredible as the plane goes very close the mountains and the glaciers. The immensity of the glaciers cannot be fathomed until you go this close to them. The landing itself was awesome and it was unreal that we were sitting on a mile of ice on the Ruth Glacier. Overall about an hour and half for the trip - the glacier views and landing were increible. The flight was a bit bumpy on the return but nothing too bad. My kid was complaining of a headache from the flight (probably altitude) but otherwise enjoyed it. Dont forget to take the complementary goggles on the way in - the glacier is too blinding without extra pair of sunglasses (you will go snow blind if you dont use them). Highly recommend this tour!
Flying near Denali and glacier landing.  Very informative and beautiful views of Denali.  Would highly recommend

Memorable flightseeing trip around Denali with landing on Ruth glacier. We took the grande denali tour. The views were breathtaking. Best part was the feeling when we were standing on the glacier. We were lucky to have a clear day and a clear view of the peak.

This tour was fab from start to finish!!! 
The breakfast and lunch they provided were absolutely lovely along with water all throughout the day. 
The airplane ride was fantastic and the pilot was sooooooo lovely!!
Antelope canyon felt rushed but it was still nice to see
The highlight of the day for us was the tour down the Colorado river which was simply stunning and Lauren our guide was amazing!!! 
Brilliant day would absolutely book this again and highly recommend the company - all staff from start to finish were SO nice and helpful too
It was amazing the view was amazing! Our pilot was great, really funny and a good pilot. The pictures were clear and very pretty. I can’t explain how amazing it was.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Something far and above the typical crowds of Fisherman’s Wharf and Pier 39.  A must do to give friends that once in a lifetime experience or just being an aweome host to family and friends.

Views were amazing. We didn’t opt for glacier landing but our pilot, Joe, took us very close to the mountains and floor and showed us all the lovely formations. He gave us great information. We took a lot of pictures.  We really enjoyed it a lot!

We did the one hour biplane tour with Kevin and it was amazing!!! He showed us the entire island and his knowledge about the island was phenomenal! Would recommend for anyone who loves to fly and want a more private experience. Would definitely do again!
Es war großartig Miami von oben zu sehen. Empfehlenswert. Der Pilot hat uns viele Informationen gegeben.
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_title: If you only do one tour - This is it
review_text:
We booked online. Ellen emailed back a confirm within 24hrs (actually more like 2).  Tor from Wings picked us up right outside the cruise terminal and took us to the airport. He gave us so much info on what it is like to live in Hawaii in just the few short minutes of the drive to the airport.  Really a tour within a tour!   We signed our life away, stepped on the scale - really a formality.  Bruce arrived with the last couple he took up, and they were beaming.  Tor got us into the plane.  Let me tell you, if you have any mobility problems, or if you are a large person, you will be just fine.  The plane was easy to get into and we were well taken care of.   Probably due to decades as a pilot, Bruce's natural confidence set us at ease right away.  He told us what to expect as far as the way the plane moves ahead of time. 

It was neat feeling like part of the flight crew.  We were able to listen in on the chatter with the tower.  And although I did not expect it, both my husband and I felt afterward that there was something really special about taking our tour in an airplane.  It's an extra feeling to the tour that is hard to explain, but you will understand it once you go up.  Most of our pictures have a bit of the window or the wing in there. And for us, that is just so perfect.  We have a remembrance of the phenomenal beauty of Kauai and a reminder of that incredible nostalgic and peaceful feeling of slowly flying over pristine beauty. 

Bruce was great at pointing things out - an interactive tour. Really more like a personal conversation between Bruce who knows the Island, it's history, it's ecology and people -  and the people lucky enough to get a seat on his plane.  We just can't say enough about that - this is a personal tour. Not a prepackaged production.  This is one of the few things I'd gladly spend money on again if we are lucky enough to see Hawaii again.
A fantastic and unique view of the island. Our tour guide Eric informed us of the island’s natural beauty and made the experience memorable.

Came to Ketchikan as stop on Royal  Caribbean cruise and booked float plane excursion to Misty Fjords.  Felt very safe with our excellent pilot (John).  My added bonus was getting to sit in the front seat.  Gorgeous views from the air, and loved the  take-offs and landings on water!!  Totally awesome excursion!!
Our pilot was fabulous: young, energetic and very knowledgeable  Her enthusiasm was contagious and put you at ease if you had an fear of flying.

review_title: Amazing views of Maui & Islands around
review_text: Eric was amazing in explaining all about Maui and the Islands around! Views were beautiful and the plane ride was super fun! Highly recommended when visiting Maui!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: We had a really great experience on this tour. We showed up early and enjoyed the water view filled with beautiful boats and yachts. Our pilot was super nice and very professional. We took the 30 tour and got to see South Beach, Key Biscayne and all of the mega cruise ships. I would recommend this to anyone.

We booked the Canyon Spirit 45 minute trip with Maverick direct in advance, they were very helpful.
We were supposed to check in at the South Rim terminal 45 minutes prior to departure. I got delayed slightly on the drive, so we called them on route and they were again very helpful.
The experience was awesome – well worth the cost. The pilot was very competent and provided a really good commentary. The flight was a bit bumpy but once in the Canyon all of the focus was on the amazing scenery. 
My wife and I got seat in the front of the helicopter and whilst my wife was nervous of being in a helicopter she absolutely loved the trip.

I am so please d that we made the effort to get to the South Rim rather than settling for a visit to the West Rim.

review_title: An experience we will never forget
review_text: Our flight was wonderful.  Beautiful Sunny day!  Magnificent scenery. Great music.  I can't put into words how inspiring being up there above the majestic mountains and beautiful blue waters made me feel.  Our pilot, Chuck, made us all feel at ease, answered all our questions and really made us feel at home.  When we landed on the water in the quiet little bay it was like slicing through butter.  No bumps at all.  Take off was just as smooth.  We will think of this day and Chuck fondly for the rest of our lives.

review_title: Flight we will think of for the rest of our life!
review_text: When we arrived we were informed how we would fly over the island.  We were given the instructions of our seat belts and the other safety items you would experience before taking off.  We scheduled this flight on our second full day on Kauai so if we had to be rescheduled we would have options left while we were on the island.  Luckily we were blessed with a great flying day.  The two of us were with a very nice couple along with their young daughter.  Everyone on the plane had their own window seat.  Josh narrated so well during the flight and made the flight personalized to everyone on the flight.  The views over the Waimea Canyon we will never forget.  We saw so many waterfalls and a couple of whales.  When Josh spotted a whale he was able to maneuver so that all of us got the view.  We were all lucky to have a rare view of the tallest mountain on Kauai from the ground to the peak.  We did not expect that flying over the rainiest spot on Earth.  The take off and landing was smooth.  We purchased the video of our flight so we could remember this flight for the rest of our life.  All of us on the plane had smiles on our face!  Very impressed with the professionalism with this business.  If you book with them you will be in good hands.

Fabulous day trip to the Grand Canyon
So recommend this charter flight service out of Phoenix. We had the best day. Including the pink jeep tour at the canyon.

Our pilot was fantastic, very couteous. The flight was fun and beyond beautiful! Then the crab feast, so very delicious! Our hostess/waitress at the crab feast was a total delight, the crab is wonderful, as is the cheesecake, so save some room for it! Just a wonderful excursion, I can't say enough!

This was a beautiful, memorable experience.  Our pilot, Cameron, was very informative, knowledgeable, and took us to see some awesome sights of the island.  He circled back a few times, because we couldn’t quite see the waterfalls ( they were under us) or we wanted to get a better look.  There is no better way to see the whole island, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, and especially the NaPali coast than from the air.
Best experience while on the island!  Unforgettable!  Mahalo Cameron!

The service, from being picked up downtown to our pilot, was first class!

The booking process with Leslie was easy and she was a pleasure to email back and forth with, answering all questions and accommodating us!

Checking in once we arrived was easy and everyone was extremely friendly.

Steve, our pilot, was great and explained what we were looking out at. The playlist on the headphones was spot on! The landing was much smoother than I thought it would be. The plane seemed to be in good shape and I'd assume they take good care of it.

Thanks for a great trip!

Great airplane ride over the south rim and north rim of the grand Canyon. 
The plane is about a 8 seater

review_text: The employees were all so nice. The pilot was super. He told us about the Island and pointed out many points of interest. I only regret that we couldn't get down lower in places to see better.

we felt very safe on our flight and the company takes safety very seriously. Our pilot was nice and knowledgeable. Unfortunately it was too cloudy to see Mt McKinley on the day of our flight but the other sights were amazing.

Our Denali glacier landing flight was spectacular!!  We had a reservation for Friday which was cloudy and rainy.  TAT allowed us to reschedule for a Saturday flight  The day was perfect  The most memorable day of our Alaska 2 month trip!!

Der gesamte Ausflug war hervorragend. Der Shuttleservice zum Pier 39 hin sowie zurück funktionierte tadellos und ersparte uns eine Menge Mühen. Der Flug war eine super Erfahrung. Das Starten wie Landen mit einem Wasserflugzeug ist schon was Besonderes. Der Pilot machte einen super Job und als Pilot sowie als Guide und die Eindrücke von „oben“ sind total toll. Jederzeit wieder! Danke für den tollen Service 👍

Yes you might hesitate to take a moment or more when considering the cost since it can be around the same as a domestic flight in the "lower 49" but PLEASE don't let that get in the way of you having one of the MOST incredible experiences during your visit to Alaska. The flights and proximity to the glaciers is unspeakably beautiful and worth every cent. We were unable to make a glacier landing that day because of weather but we were not disappointed as it was a spectacular experience. Joe was our pilot and incredibly professional and pleasant to talk with. Don't worry about the $$$ it is truly worth the cost.

review_title: A new, beautiful view of my home...
review_text: I have lived in SF and Marin since 1998 and have always noticed Seaplane Adventures on my 101N drive.  I finally had the opportunity to take a tour with Seaplane Adventures a couple of weeks ago and it blew my mind.  Seeing my home from this bird's eye view was really amazing.  Everyone, locals and visitors, should do this at least once.  It gives you a new perspective to Marin and San Franicsco.  The crew at Seaplane Adventures are incredibly friendly.  They did everything they could to ensure that I had a great flight.  Thank you Seaplane Adventures!  I will be back!

review_title: Take this tour if you can!
review_text: Took the tour during the last week of May with my two adult sons.  Excellent operation from reservations to landing. Felt very safe and enjoyed spectacular views. Fantastic memory for the rest of my life.
Really a great time, very unique view of the island and surrounding area. Would recommend to friends.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: This was an incredible way to see the parts of Kauai only accessible by air. Our party of four had the plane to ourselves and it was a terrific flight. The weather was perfectly clear, which we were told was uncommon, making the scenery that much prettier!  Our pilot, Marcus, was so knowledgeable about the island. I have done the same trip by helicopter but this was far more enjoyable. Do yourself a favor and book this trip!

TAS was a great experience. The girls at the desk were very nice and informative. While waiting for the flight several exchanged pleasant conservation. The pilot was like one of your friends. Felt very welcome from everyone at TAS. Great service!!

review_title: The best part of our trip to AK
review_text: The day was crystal clear, which is unusual for this part of Alaska, and the air taxi trip around Mt McKinley was wonderful.  The pilot was our tour guide and did an excellent job.  We landed on a glacier and spent about 30 minutes there.  It was an amazing sight and one I don't think the view would ever become boring.  I felt that the professionalism of the personel was outstanding and again, this was the highlight of our trip.

It was a very memorable experience. You can’t go wrong with a smooth flight and a breathtaking view. It was the perfect thing to do on a date with my husband. The pilot was did an awesome job at explaining and making sure we were comfortable. We are like ok’ing forward to the other rides and places they offer! Definitely will be back . Thank you envi adventures!!!

We booked the air and sea combo tour with Blue Dolphin Charters and Wings over Kauai -- both were a great value. Unfortunately, the morning we were supposed to take our flight it was cancelled due to conditions. However, Bruce and his team were very accommodating about the short amount of time we had on the island and were able to reschedule for us. We ended up rebooking for the day we also had our boat tour -- not the best idea since you're driving from one part of the island to the other, but still doable.  We caught Bruce's last flight of the day at 4PM and were lucky to have the whole flight to ourselves. Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island and we were able to see incredible views. Part of the perks of doing the plane over the helicopter would definitely be the pricing  -- it's almost half as much. Though a helicopter is better able to get you down into those tighter areas, such as Waimea Canyon, we still had plenty of great views and picture ops. They were also quite alright with me using my gopro to record a chunk of the flight. Bruce provided complimentary drinks while we were up in the air and a nice, added bonus -- they took our picture in front of the plane and printed the pic out on the jacket of a DVD highlighting the views we saw during the flight (at no extra cost). It's a nice little touch to have a pic of us before our flight and a little highlight video. Thanks, Bruce and your team. Would definitely recommend!

review_title: The best decision we made was to use K2 Aviation. Very organized incredibly friendly .
review_text: I think the best part of our flight was our pilot Leon! So incredibly knowledgeable and entertaining. I truly had the best time. When we landed on the glacier he never rushed us we got to spend some time taking some incredible photos. I would highly highly highly recommend this organization for sightseeing and if you can request Leon you'll be golden! The whole experience was incredible!

We had a short trip to southern Florida, and this excursion was truly the best way to experience both Miami and the Everglades in a matter of hours. 

Our pilot, Adriel, was a super cool guy, and the type of guide that you'd remember as equally as the experience itself. He was friendly, easy-going, and very knowledgeable about the region, the aircraft, and low-altitude flights. 

Our take-offs and landings were seamless on both ends of tour. The flight along the Miami skyline and beaches was super fun, and the airboat portion of the trip was equally as educational and entertaining as everything else. 

One note worth throwing in.... This excursion was literally the last thing we were doing before heading to the airport to catch our flights home, so we arrived at our "meeting spot" (random parking lot near the water), via an UBER with our luggage in hand. There was not a company office available to store our luggage in while we were on the tour. Thankfully, our pilot was able to accommodate our two carry-on suitcases and two backpacks in the very small space behind our seats on the plane, otherwise I don't know where we would have left it for the duration of the tour.

review_title: Excellent customer service when Mother Nature disrupts your plans.
review_text: I just have to say how impressed we were with the customer service. Our flightseeing tour got cancelled due to weather, and the folks here were so wonderful rebooking us three days in a row. Ultimately, Mother Nature had other plans, and we didn’t get to do the tour. That’s okay. The rule in Alaska is to be flexible since the weather is always changing. :) I just wanted to mention their customer service. Maybe next time TAT! Cheers from Tennessee!
5 Star experience with Eric. Incredible views and a very knowledgeable pilot. Highly recommend! Mahalo

review_text: Today I flew with my friends, We had such a good time! The pilot was very friendly and a good tour guide especially if you’re  not familiar with the area. The pilot was super patient when taking our photo as well 10/10 would recommend to anyone for a fun unique experience! The company also is very communicative and was a very easy process to enjoy!
