review_title: One of the best tours of our cruise
review_text: This tour is much cheaper if you walk into town and book it yourself. We saved $150 over the price on the cruise ship.  We flew out to the Misty Fiords Monument.  Breathtaking scenery and it was exciting to land out there on a lake.   A must do if you are on a cruise!

Phantastischer Blick auf San Francisco und das Umland. Der Pilot ist ein lustiger cooler Typ, der einiges zu erzählen weiß. Ebenso der Shuttleservice-Fahrer. Alles perfekt organisiert. Und wann fliegt man schon einmal mit einem Wasserflugzeug? Vielen Dank

This was the biggest thing on my bucket list while in Talkeetna!  Our weather was unbelievable as confirmed by every local we encountered on our Alaskan vacation!!  Our pilot Greg did a great job telling us facts and pointing out hikers, glaciers, and which peaks and summits we were looking at!  My Hero GoPro video camera was suction cup mounted to the side window for most of our tour! Can't wait to get home and watch it again!  The glacier landing was the icing on the cake!  Make your reservation early in your stay and they'll work hard to get you up when the weather is not cooperating, however, we hit a perfectly clear day!!  Not a cloud in the sky!!  Our B&B had a coupon for $25 off.  Every little bit helps!!  Take the tour!  Be wowed the marvel of God's creation!!
Loved this flight! I can’t stress enough how majestic these sights were. It was an amazing experience!

review_title: Amazing way to see the whales !!
review_text:
Fantastic experience!!
This was a highlight of our trip! Perfect for our whole family! The staff was kind and so helpful with getting my Pop in and out of the plane. The pilot did more than one pass to see things so everyone could get pics! This was an amazing way to see the whales and not nearly as loud as the helicopter, so no disturbing them ( if they even noticed us:)  Beautiful views of the island and the coastal cliffs hard to get to by foot.
Met the owners while checking in and they were a hoot:)

I had never flown in a helicopter so was a bit nervous, but the pilot came over as being in charge and professional. As soon as we took off I was totally comfortable with the feeling. It was awesome. I had been picked up at my hotel at the precise time agreed and driven to the helicopter base to be matched with a group of others, with everyone being weighed to ensure the flight was not overloaded and the weight was spread evenly. There was a total wait of about 30 minutes before we were called to our helicopter. First we headed toward Hoover Dam and the pilot gave us some background details  before heading off to Grand Canyon, pointing out various points of interest along the way. There was a refuelling strop halfway and then we swopped seats to give everyone a chance of a good view. on the way back the pilot went a slightly different route back to Vegas so we saw as much of the area as possible, again what we were seeing and how the landscape was changing due to the low water level. We had a chance to buy a video of the flight and they presented us with a photo taken with the pilot just prior to take off as a memento. Not that I am likely to forget the experience in a hurry

Booked with maverick on the recommendation of the concierge at out hotel and having heard mixed reviews about Sundance!

What an experience! Our pilot was great and made the trip and the Grand Canyon is unmissable!

If I had one criticism it was the cost. The cost for my wife and I worked out at about £680 which I thought was a tad steep.

That aside the company are very professional and the trip really is a once in a lifetime experience!

We landed at Lihue and called asking if they could fit us in, and they did.  Sabrina checked us in.  They are absolutely the nicest hosts.  Bruce, the owner and pilot, was of course very knowledgeable of the islands and pointed out all the amazing views and stories behind them.  Soaring over the Napali coast and Waimea Canyon were especially spectacular.  Later in the day we drove to Waimea canyon overlook and quite frankly we had much more incredible views in the plane.   We also saw whales, water falls, and even did a fly over of the other couple's hotel.  Bruce is a very safe and gentle pilot with literally thousands of hours flying around Kauai.   As a private pilot myself, I can attest to his skills.  We did this as soon as we landed which gave us a great overview of the island.  Bruce also gave us a sheet of his recommended places to go and things to see.  Real local knowledge that's gold.  I'm not going to tell you everything because I don't want to over hype it (any more than I already have).  It's a super value at half the price of the helicopter tours and a much more personable experience.  I don't normally write reviews but felt compelled to do so this time.  Highly recommended.

Selbst wenn man die Na Pali Küste schon vom Boot oder per Trail gesehen hat, dann lohnt es trotzdem es noch einmal aus dieser Perspektive zu versuchen. Wir hatten lange überlegt ob wir einen Helikopter buchen sollte, der zwar etwas teurer ist dafür aber an die Wasserfälle dichter ranfliegen kann und auch in den Waimea Canyon hinein fliegt. Wir haben uns für die Tour mit dem Airvan entschieden, da man hier die beste Sicht hat und es keine Mittelplätze wie im Helikopter gibt. Letztendlich haben wir unsere Entscheidung nicht bereut. Ellen & Bruce sowie Ihr Team sind sehr professionell und man sieht für das gleiche Geld mehr. Besonders beeindruckend waren die unzähligen Wasserfälle im Hanalai Valley  (Awesome!). Ganz hinten war auch Klasse, da ich so auch zwischen linker und rechter Seite hin- und her springen konnte. Aufgrund der Route liegen die meisten Highlights auf der rechten Seite. Etwas störend waren die reflektierenden und vibrierenden Plexiglasscheiben, aber das ist ein kleines Detail am Rande. Insgesamt wirklich lohnenswert. Beim nächsten Besuch machen wir die Hubschrauber Tour zum Vergleich.
What can I say except great things. Ray, Jill, and Nate were an absolute delight to be around. The tour itself was breath taking and it was the best part of our entire trip. Highly recommend!

review_title: Hands down best part of our Hawaiian vacation
review_text: From the moment I first emailed Ellen to the minute we stepped on the plane two months later in Kauai, my entire experience with Wings over Kauai was nothing short of fantastic. This is a class act, family-owned business with stellar customer service, attention to detail and a real bargain for the once in a lifetime experience of flying over Kauai. Our fantastic pilot, Josh, gave us so much history as we soared above beautiful sights. I would do this all over again in a heartbeat and recommend to anyone. Also, tip your pilots!! They deserve it!

Capitalized on a brief window of good weather on August 1st. We flew for about an hour and got to see the Great Gorge and the peak of Denali (from below). Absolutely MUST DO when visiting the Denali area. Our pilot and the ground staff were great.

This was the best of a two week trip packed full of activities in 5 different areas of Alaska.  This was the best, top of the tours! We were luck to get a clear day and a great pilot guide!  Will was our pilot. He told us what we were looking at along the way and flew that little plane like a well seasoned pro.  The views from the plane were amazing!  We felt like we were right next to these high peaks. I don't usually leave 5 stars because face it there is always room for improvement.  I was amazed and very happy with the service!

I really wanted to give a better review because the view was incredible. I was surprised we were offered a full refund because of cloud cover but they convinced us that we would see the mountains once we broke through. Indeed the scenery was outstanding and the pilot did a great job of making sure all passengers could see the mountain. However we were the first to arrive and the last to be placed on a plane. In addition to the usual 30-45 wait we stood in the cold for another hour. They changed our placement three times including once that when they did not inform us. My feet were cold prior to departure and only got worse on the flight which was freezing. The pilot admitted he was too hot so did not put the heat on. This company could communicate better and actually care about the customer and not just the money.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: We had a fantastic day and very much enjoyed our Wings Over Kauai Air Tour.  Our pilot was Josh whom we rate an A+.  He was knowledgeable, personable, engaging, used the names of those on the plane making the trip much more personal.  Despite the fact he does this trip all the time, you did not feel that he was making a speech - he was super interesting.  They take pictures of each couple before you leave and when you land you are handed a CD with your picture on the cover and a generic review of your trip over Kauai.  However, a CD of your trip is also available; there are two cameras on the wings so when you watch the CD back when you get home, you can easily reminisce about your day.  You see the scenes you actually saw and here the conversations that went on in the plane - very nice!  We are super glad we purchased the CD; we will share with family and watch next May upon the anniversary of the trip.  And then there's the flight itself and the awesome scenery.  Kauai is downright beautiful and seeing parts that can only be seen from above was fantastic.  If you are in Kauai, please, please, please visit Wings Over Kauai; they will not let you down.  The weather might but we were super lucky and had a great day.

We booked a trip before we headed to Vegas with Maverick Tours and it turned out to be one of the highlights. We choose an early tour (5:20am hotel pickup) but it was well worth it because we were back in Vegas for 11:30am. From the hotel pick up to the drop off the staff were great but a special mention to Chris our pilot. He was very informative, laid back and good laugh. He gave a good running commentary on the way out and told us what to see and do. And being so early we had the Skywalk to ourselves which was a real bonus. Overall a great day out and would highly recommend
The Pilot Felix was amazing.  He took the time to really tell us some history and some great info about the island.

review_title: Really genuniely nice outfit and great experience
review_text: Tony the pilot was just great .... loads of bits of knowledge and trivia ... but most importantly warm and friendly.  The trip itself (I did the 1 hour one) was awesome and so much fun taking off from and landing on water.
Outstanding 18th birthday, very professional and personable. Very great air experience for first timers

I had Envi Adventures help me with an amazing proposal. The owner got the plane set up in a perfect spot, and worked with my photographer to set up this special day. The tour was great as we went and checked out all the falls going up the gorge. I highly recommend taking an aerial tour over the gorge or Mt. Hood in the summer.

Very windy day we scheduled.  Pilot, Parker, said we could go, but we'd have a better time next day.  He checked NOAA site.  They could have lost money, but valued our experience.
Parker sick the next day, so owner, Bruce, took us up in Cessna 172, (two maybe 3 small people max).  Best tour flight I've ever been on.  Bruce knew everything about the island.  Circled back so we could see a whale.  Lots of stories.   Answered all our questions.  Can't say enough good things about the company and the experience.  Would do it again.  Super friendly and safe.

review_title: La mejor experiencia de mi vida
review_text: Increíble vuelo por kauai. El 80% de esta isla solo se puede observar desde el aire, la parte de la isla que se puede acceder en coche es, para mi, lo menos bonito de hawai, pero el 80% restante es simplemente impresionante. Experiencia que le recomendaría hacer a todo el mundo, el trato proporcionado es exquisito, Bruce fue nuestro piloto y es un auténtico crack, explicaciones detalladas acompañadas de la música adecuada, cuando empezamos a sobrevolar la costa de napali se me saltaban las lágrimas de la emoción por lo increible del paisaje que estaba viendo. Lo mejor de unas vacaciones en hawai increíbles.

It was truly a bucket list experience...the pilot was great and so helpful when I was a little fearful of getting out on the float.  The views were magnificent and everyone we dealt with at the office and in the transport to and from the meeting point were very friendly and courteous...highly recommend
Beautiful view) amazing experience) Our pilot Erick professional) great service and light flight! We will be right back next time)

I rented 2 helicopters for my family of 5. This is the only helicopter touring company in Kauai that I know offers window/door seat for every passengers. Most helicopter tours offer a back row that seats 4 and are assigned by weight distribution.

Mauna Loa allows for doors on or doors off experience. We chose doors off and loved it. I thought my wife, who is less daring than the children or I would opt to keep her door on, but she went doors off also. I highly recommend doors off. Pilots were great constantly checking to make sure everyone was doing well and we always were,  

They provide straps for phones and cameras in order to have them secured for doors off flights. Doors off allows for amazing views and picture opportunities. With doors off it can become chilly. A sweater or light jacket is needed.

The helicopters are modern and inspire confidence. The whole operation looks very professional. Our pilot was Irish and his commentary was very informative and interesting. The flight was smooth and showed us a totally different perspective, especially when the helicopter banks to turn. Almost as interesting was travelling over the forest to get to the canyon rim. 
If you are visiting Grand Canyon this is an essential trip and worth every penny.

Lived in Marin all my life. Always loved seeing the Dehavilland Beaver flying overhead. I finally snapped out of it and scheduled a ride for my wife and me for our 17 year anniversary. WOW, what a blast. Our pilot Will, was very experienced and really interesting.  You haven't seen Marin and the Bay Area unless you've seen it from 2,000 feet above on one of these aircraft. Magnificent! This will be an annual event for us in the future...
Well worth the money and time! The best way to see the mountains and glaciers. Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable of the geography and history.

We emailed back and forth to Ellen before our trip to Kauai, and she was always prompt to answer any of our questions. We decided to wait till  we arrived in Kauai before booking our flight to see what the weather was. That was no problem getting a flight for the following day at 1pm. We ended up flying in their smaller plane with just my wife and I and Bruce the pilot. A private flight tour was great. We wanted to do the flight early in our trip to Kauai, so we had an idea what the island looked like and places we wanted to visit while there.
Their daughter checked us in, Extremely friendly. She gave my wife a nut Lei and a flower for her hair and lots of helpful information about the flight and sightseeing ideas on the island
Bruce was great- very friendly and informative in showing us points of interest while flying over Kauai. It was a A-plus experience and the highlight of our Kauai vacation.
We had perfect weather with hardly a cloud in the sky.
My wife sometimes has issues with motion sickness. She had none on this flight-very smooth.
She sat in front seat next to Bruce and even helped with pre-flight checklist.
We saw many beautiful things during our flight. The flight lasted almost 90 minutes.
We picked the airplane over Helicopter and were completely satisfied with our decision.
We highly recommend taking a flight with Wings over Kauai. It is a great family run business.
They also include a CD of flying over Kauai with their flights. We took lots of great photos.

review_title: Bucket List on the Garden Island
review_text:
This was our 4th trip to the island and we had thought we had seen all its wonders.  We had, just not from between 1000-4000 feet from an open cockpit! No helicopter, boat or ATV will ever afford the perspective of a nip
Plane.   My non pilot travel companions reservations concerning air sickness evaporated as soon as we lifted off.  

Ground crew and the pilot were exceptional!

Want a truely memorable experience?  
This is it!

What a amazing flight, thank you so much!! Bruce was wonderful, he was first of all a lot of fun to have as our pilot, but he didn't talk to much so we could enjoy the scenery, but mentioned all of the important info that we'd want to learn and know about. Lets just say this....there is a reason why this has a 5 rating for most of the people.....I would highly recommend, thank you for such an enjoyable flight!!!!
Adds a whole new perspective to the island that you can’t get on land or a boat which makes it even more beautiful.

review_title: It's like nothing I've seen before!
review_text:
My family of four ages 52 to 15 booked a maverick helicopter journey over the Grand Canyon.  

Martin our pilot took us out on their weather route as the heavens had opened over the north rim.  That moment when we hovered above the trees and then glided slowly over the canyon will stay with all of us for the rest of our lives.

Martin was extremely knowledgeable and you knew he loved his job due to the passion of the commentary.  

This isn't an expensive experience and I know we will do this again.

review_title: You will never forget this experience!
review_text: The only downside to this experience is its cost.  If you can fit it into your budget, it is a beautiful and memorable journey through some of the most beautiful and unspoiled scenery on the planet.

Shout out to Rick Rickauscus, our Maverick helicopter pilot! This trip was amazing, in fact it was probably our favorite thing in Maui. I have a fear of flying but normally it’s a necessary evil to getting places, however I did not share this before our flight. From the tone of his voice to his playlist of music he was able to soothe any nerves. He explained all the places of interest below and would explain anything he did beforehand..such as turning us around to provide additional photo ops, and this was truly the smoothest ride you could possibly imagine. The landing In the rainforest was again incredible and if he had been balancing a cup of coffee on the dash it would not have splashed or spilled a drop. On landing he proceeded to pour everyone a glass of champagne and lead us on a tour with names and descriptions of all the plants and fruits we were seeing in the area. He was happy to be the photographer for us as well and you could tell everyone’s comfort was paramount on this tour. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone….even those who might be a little apprehensive about a helicopter ride…this was so the highlight of our trip!  
~Barbara

review_title: How to Experience Kauai via Air
review_text:
When you pick an aerial solution to fly over Kauai, you have basically two choices - helicopters or fixed wing aircraft.

Air ventures represents the best solution on Kauai for the fixed wing option.  

We chose to take the 8:30 AM tour, on our first day after we arrived on Kauai.  While it would seem somewhat early in the AM to rally the troops after getting to the island, the 8:30 AM flight worked well, from the time adjustment perspective.  Winds in the early AM are somewhat calmer, and temperatures cooler than later flights.

We were able to grab a light breakfast prior to heading to the airport @ 8AM for our flight. 

This aerial solution offers a great overview perspective of Kauai from a 1000-3000 ft perspective, permitting great photographs, a more stable platform, with more visibility for each person, with oversized window seats, at a reasonable price structure.

Everyone has a full window seat in an “air van” like setting, with noise cancelling headphones to communicate with the others, or the pilot. We chose the 6 passenger option, however, smaller two - three seat aircraft options are available.

Make no mistake, we saw a lot of helicopters flying at lower altitudes, however, the fixed wing perspective offers fuller vistas, and covers similar territory over a longer flight experience.  For our group, this worked best...as weight restrictions are more lenient in a fixed wing aircraft, and air sickness concerns were a consideration in our choice.

We saw a lot of the island from Napali Coast, many of the interior canyons; the vibrant blues of the ocean, sea turtles, and dolphins; several waterfalls, Hanalei and Princeville areas.  From our group, this provided the overall perspective and island layout we were looking for.  

By going with Air Ventures, we saved several hundred dollars from a comparable flight alternative via helicopter.

We highly recommend this alternative to see Kauai by air.  This was our second tour with Air Ventures Hawaii.

Pilot, Erik, was very knowledgeable, professional, experienced in a relaxing manner that permitted  the others he travelled with to also feel more comfortable.

Esse embora caro, é o melhor passeio da cidade, com duração de aproximadamente 1 hora, sobrevoando os fyords, com pouso em um lago e 10 minutos para fotos. Experiencia única para voar em um hidroavião.

Surprised my wife with a Seaplane Tour on our anniversary and it was one of the most memorable experiences ever! The views are breathtaking and our pilot was so amazing, he made sure we felt safe and shared so many tidbits of the places we were flying over. Highly recommend!

We had a great flight with Wings over Kauai.  Weather was fantastic, not a cloud in the sky.   Everyone is so friendly, and very personable.   Bruce the pilot gives you a narrative of the island as you fly by all the points of interest.   I found this to be a better value than a helicopter ride, and in my view felt safer.   You were not as close to the points, but I think this gave you a better panoramic view of the island.   This was definitely the best excursion we have been on.   If you do this trip, do it early in your stay, and you can plan the things that looked interesting from the flight.

The area of the trip was limited (due to cloud cover) but we were told that in adavnce and we elected to take a revised flight plan. The pilot was knowledgeable, friendly, humorous, and respectful. I could not have asked for anything more. 
The equipment was all in great condition and the light snow cover made the colors "pop".
The value was outstanding, and I would do it again!
Amazing experience. Amazing staff. What an adventure. Pilot was knowledgable and fun. Scenery could not have been better.

Eric was awesome, easy going and fun, full of interesting information about Maui.  Fun flight with beautiful views from the air.  Would recommend Maui plane rides to everyone for a personal experience away from the crowds and large group activities.

We missed this tour on our previous trip and were so glad to take it this time.  Beautiful views of the mountains and glaciers!  Our pilot did a great job with narration and keeping us informed of distances and other planes.  We even got a look at Denali which we missed the previous day in the park.  This was the highlight of our trip!!!

The weather was beautiful and the views were amazing.  Connor, our pilot, made us feel very at ease and was knowledgeable about the island.  Overall a fantastic experience and great value compared to a doors off helicopter tour.

We had a blast flying with Envi Adventures! The sights were amazing! KJ and Ethan were awesome pilots. They ensured both me and my dad got to view all the amazing sights. Seeing the sun set over the river was breathtaking. If we are ever back in the area, I would love to take another flight with Envi!!!
Een geweldige vlucht rond het eiland Alle highlights vlieg je langs De piloot verteld alle bijzonderheden die langs komen Super vriendelijk ontvangst

Open air cockpit so there's nothing between you and Kauai. So no locked tinbox in the sky feeling, no air sickness, no other tour people.  Hands down the better option to see kauai from above. And u can set ur holiday itinerary from the sky.

BEST ATTRACTION on Kauai.. I highly recommend this flight service if you are really looking to see Kauai. The staff are awesome and the view is unbelievable. If you only take one excursion while on Kauai, I would highly suggest AIR VENTURES. As a pilot for over 40 years, I can say, It may be the BEST hour long trip you will ever find, and will always remember. THANKS guys..

review_title: WOW, what an amazing ride w/ Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: As first time small airplane flyers, my girlfriend & I were in the best of hands with Caden. He made sure to call out any rough patches of air & was constantly calling out specific places from above to look at. The tour was by far the scariest thing we signed up for while on the island, but was by far the best experience we had & may ever have. Highly recommend this tour to all first time visitors of Kauai.

review_title: It doesn't get any better then this!!!!!
review_text: This is a first class family operation. We were picked up and taken to the flight site, given beads and a beautiful flower from Carter 's backyard. Carter is the handsome son that helped make our visit a memorable occasion. My husband got to sit in the copilot seat as we overlooked the amazing topography. The dad was our excellent pilot and narrarator. When we returned to land we were given a CD to remember our trip. We just watched it and enjoyed agin the wonderful trip and family that we met in Kauai. After the trip the mom returned us to a beach that she knew we would enjoy. They treated us like family and did everything possible to make our stay with them a pleasant one. Hats off to WINGS OVER KAUAI!!!!!!

This was such an extraordinary flight! Flying over the volcanoes was so surreal and seeing the many waterfalls and the beautiful scenery was such an awesome experience! Eric was a great host and excellent pilot.  I would highly recommend!!

Great trip out to the everglades where i proposed to my girlfriend the guys where fantastic can't thank them enough for the fantastic day they gave us. Highly recommended one for the bucket list especially if you like vintage aircraft amazing how they keep them flying.
 Oh and she said yes by the way :-).

A true fabulous experience!
Well operated by an excellent staff.
The pilot Mike made the adventure unique.
Can’t wait to go back.
Thanks the opportunity of a lifetime.
See you next year...

review_title: Fantastic and the pilot's narrative added to the whole experience!
review_text: Seeing the island from the air is something I am so glad we did not miss. I was surprized that some of the island looked like the Grand Canyon. The pilot told us about the areas we were looking at. Besides the beauty, knowing what we were looking at made the whole experience much more memorable. I will definately take air tours again when I travel and will be back to Air Adventures if I should be so fortunate to return to Kauai.

Este é um passeio imperdível, vale a pena fazer o voo completo, são 25min saindo de Renton até o Friday Harbor, com direito aos sobrevoos da cidade de Seattle, Friday Harbor é um lugar lindo, vc terá 90min para conhecer o lugar, antes da volta de mais 25min. Verifique a condição climática, dias com Sol são a melhor opção.

review_title: A unique experience not to be missed.
review_text:
The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi did a great job!  In addition to being a great pilot, she also was an excellent 'tour guide' and really taught us a lot about what we were flying around.

The folks on the ground took great care of us and had everything extremely organized.  It was quite interesting watching them flex their plans throughout the day as weather conditions in Denali changed.

Getting to land on & walk around the glacier was quite an experience - got some of our best pictures the entire trip from there!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Spectacular Way to See the Island!
review_text: We booked a trip with Wings Over Kauai very last minute after deciding we really wanted to see the island from the sky. We were able to do a same day flight for cheaper than any of the helicopter tours. We did the Grand Deluxe Tour and basically got to see the entire island. We were fortunate enough that the sky was fairly clear and we could see all the way to the top of the Mount Waialeale which we were told happens about 3 times a year so that was a truly amazing experience with several 2000-3000ft waterfalls. The staff was really great. Mary greeted us and gave me a Kukui Nut Lei and fresh flower. Captain Josh took us out and he was really engaged and fun. At the end you get a souvenir video with your photo on the cover that they take before your flight. Overall, it was a great experience and I would recommend Wings Over to Kauai to others looking to see the island's breathtaking beauty from the sky.
Highly recommend seeing Kauai from the air with this awesome company. Best part of our trip and they even went the extra mile by offering us a list of recommendations of thing to do on the island!
Pilot was wonderful and explained everything we saw. Went above and beyond to make it a memorable experience.

Late March has often very good weather in the Talkeetna area and we were fortunate to have a perfect day for our flight with Ruth Gorge landing. TAT people are very competent and the business has been around awhile. Their planes are well kept and pilots are excellent. For a great flight without pressure, go before the climbers arrive in mid-April.

review_title: Best photos we got on our trip to Kauai. Truly wonderful experience.
review_text: We wanted to see Kauai by air and Air Ventures was a reasonable price. The lady who came to the Wyndham  Balj Hai gave a very good description of what the flight would be like.The plane was very comfortable.The pilot inspired confidence and had a great spiel. We learned a lot about the island, its history and geology. I even got some pictures of a whale with its calf off the Napali coast from 1000 feet up. I took over 100 photos with a 200 mm lens. They came out great. We got a very good overall education about Kauai that helped us the rest of the week to find the best snorkling beaches, coffee plantation, tunnel road, waterfalls, canyon road and rivers. Thanks.

review_title: A really great way to experience Kauai in the air and at a good price
review_text:
When on Kauai you must absolutely take a helicoptor tour or an airplane tour.  It is a must.  It should be a law.  Helicoptor tours are more expensive and Air Adventures was a good deal cheaper.  You see the whole island and the Helicopter Pilott Harry was great.   Be warned however if you get motion sickness, you may get sick on this tour becuase the plane ride can get choppy.

You will not regret this tour.

review_title: Boring. Not as advertised. Pilot did. It narrate and we had no idea what we were looking at. Not as advertised.
review_text:
Very disappointing trip. I read all the reviews and was excited about the commentary. Our pilot maybe said 3 total sentences to us. We could not talk to each other via headphones. It was like flying through a forest with no commentary it was beautiful but very boring. I did reach out to Leslie and she said he was in the quiet side but very safe pilot. She offered a 200
Discount but I denied and would rather leave an honest review. I was disappointed how she handled this. We spend 1600 dollars to fly around with no talking or information. My mother actually fell asleep. They advertise that the pilot will narrate the entire trip. Our pilot Hardly said hello or goodbye. I was so looking forward to this trip and it was a splurge to be disappointed with the flight and customer service. There is another company another shipmate went on called wings she said the pilot narrated the entire time and it was wonderful. I am so disappointed. I would not recommend

This was a chance of a lifetime.  Being able to see different islands from the sky was beautiful and Eric's great knowledge enhanced the flight making it a once in a lifetime experience.  Eric made the flight very comfortable and ensured we were having a good time.  This is a must do adventure.  Best way to explore the waters and islands is in the sky with Eric as your guide.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Awesome Airvan tour.  The owners, Ray and Jill were a delight to work with.  Our original morning tour with another operator was cancelled yesterday and we hastily booked for an afternoon tour for today with Air Ventures.  Early this morning, I called to  see if we could change our tour time and Jill was very accommodating.  Despite being very busy due to a cruise ship coming into port, she called me back when a couple seats opened up on an earlier flight.  She even picked us up near our hotel along with another family from the cruise ship.  Ray piloted our tour and was delightful for the entire trip.  He has spent a career flying airplanes, and he obviously loves flying every chance he gets! He made sure everyone was comfortable....even a reluctant father who didn’t like to fly, but went along with the family.  He explained everything and told us a lot of first hand information about the coastline and waterfalls we were seeing.....he has hiked most of the trails we were flying over.   When we returned, Jill was kind enough to drop us off to pickup our rental car.  Truly a pleasure working with small business owners that enjoy what they are doing and understand good customer service.  Thanks to Ray and Jill for a great Kaua’i memory!

review_title: Magnificent mini tour of SF Bay via SeaPlane
review_text: I was really impressed with the excitement of flying in a small plane while receiving loads of interesting information about the San Francisc Bay and environs. I am looking forward to taking another longer tour with SeaPlane Adventures

This was a great way to see Kauai. The views of the remote canyons were magnificent.  The pilot was informative and gave a great tour. Loved the fact that we saw places from the air that you cannot readily get to by land.  Would definitely recommend Air Adventures.
Amazing way to see Miami! Our pilot was funny, knowledgeable and ensured we had a great experience. You have to do this 1 hour flight when you visit Miami!
Amazing views,fun experience would definitely recommend to friends and family would try again but for a longer experience

First of all, I have a huge fear of flying so this was not something I was excited about. However, as I did not plan the trip, I was forced to go. 
O M G, it was so amazing. One of the best experiences of my life. If you have a fear of flying I suggest sitting up front with the pilot as I did. It helped me relax and was also the best seat for photos. Our pilot (Chip?) was so great. He was polite, calm and very knowledgeable.

review_title: Denali Tour with a Glacier landing
review_text:
Definitely the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Talkeetna Air Taxi staff were excellent.  Helpful and professional.  They were so relaxed and friendly.

Loved the Glacier landing.  We weren't going to do this tour at all, as it seemed expensive, but we managed to get a good deal and was even picked up from our campsite!  

Lovely experience.  Recommend doing this if you have the funds... because, even with a deal, it's not cheap.

PLEASE PLEASE Schedule a flight with Bruce and his team the first day you are on Kauai!
His air tour and commentary are the perfect introduction to the Garden Island and you will spend the rest of your vacation thanking yourself (and Bruce) for the experience.
Lastly, be sure to buy the Blue Ray DVD of your flight!
A very lovely experience!  Our pilot was awesome and showed us all of the Miami area highlights. We would highly recommend!!
Easy flight , nice pilots, great views, good value wonderful smooth take off and landing I highly recommend this group
Best experience ever, cheap, friendly with a good quality tour. Pilots are friendly and responsible.

What an awesome experience!  Eric calmed the fears of my daughter and sister; so they could really enjoy the experience.  My son had a blast learning to maneuver the plane in high winds over the mountains.  We can't wait to do it, again!

I grew up here in Portland and went to the gorge every weekend basically. I’m as Oregonian as you can get, my blood is green, stumptown coffee infused and mixed with rain. I thought I knew my Gorge, but now seeing it from above, in a slight drizzle, cloudy, afternoon day, seeing the Gorge, I was speechless. It was all green, the water was blue, everything was perfect. I highly recommend taking a flight from Envi. It was perfect. Absolutely beautiful. Take the flight. Bring your friends, make some awesome memories and take some beautiful photos. Absolutely worth every penny I worked for to fly!

review_title: Top Rating for a Helicopter Tour We Never Went On
review_text:
We booked a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon for our family.  Making the reservation was easy and painless.  We arrived in the Grand Canyon Village the day before our scheduled 50 minute helicopter tour.

I had chosen Maverick Helicopter Tours because of their safety rating and because of the type of helicopters they use that have maximum visibility for all passengers.  

We awoke to heavy snow on the day of our helicopter tour.  Although our tour was not scheduled to begin until 3 PM, Maverick Helicopters called us around 9:30 AM to inform that the tour was cancelled due to the heavy snow and the forecast for more snow to come during the afternoon.  They said that even if they had elected to fly, we would be unable to see the canyon below us due to the very limited visibility.  

They offered to reschedule us for another day or provide a full refund.  We would have liked to fly with them another day but we had a full schedule of other plans and bookings that we could not cancel without loss of our deposits.  

Whenever we have another opportunity, we will surely book with Maverick Helicopter Tours and, with a little luck, we won’t have a snowstorm on the day of our helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon.

review_title: GREAT WAY TO GET OVERVIEW OF THE DIFFERENT TERRAINS
review_text: We were a group flying from Denali to Anchorage to board a cruise ship.  We divided into 3 aircraft.  All were overhead wing Dehavilland bush planes.   We flew over the green valleys and rivers, up to the high mountain glaciers, where the pilots made sure we saw everything up close.   The ride was fairly smooth and nobody go airsick.  Not many people get to see Alaska this way.  The attached pictures say it all.

review_title: A must do when in Talkeetna!
review_text: Amazing experience with K2! The staff and pilot were all fantastic and genuinely want you to have a great time. I felt safe and amazed the entire time! Absolutely recommend K2 when you are looking to check off this experience off your bucket list!

Our Pilate was great.  Very fun and knowledgeable.  My husband even got to ride in the co Pilate seat, and they were nice enough to take a picture of him on his phone!  All the staff was super nice and helpful.

An amazing way to experience all the sights of the island. It was breathtaking! Especially the Na Paali coast line! It's a great way to make sure you see all the sights and the views are spectacular. The pilot Mark did a great job, explained everything so well and the ride was very smooth. The customer service was also great!

We had a wonderful family flightseeing trip with K2. Much to our and our kids' disappointment, our morning flight was initially cancelled because of smoke from forest fires. But K2 managed to squeeze us in on a flightseeing tour with a glacier landing a few hours later, and it was the highlight of our trip for my teen and tween daughters! Our pilot patiently answered my nine-year-old's questions on the flight and took terrific pictures of us on the glacier. Great trip and great staff!

review_title: Can't wait to take another flight!
review_text: My husband and I, along with our 17-mo old daughter, took the waterfalls tour yesterday with Ryan as our pilot and I can't say enough good things! He was incredibly accommodating from start to finish. We set off for the short (20-min) tour b/c we weren't sure how our daughter would handle it. Since she fell asleep 10 minutes in, he asked if we wanted to stay up longer and we definitely did! We got to see amazing views of waterfalls, the gorge and all the area has to offer. Ryan was a wealth of knowledge on where we should head next, where we should eat, etc. The flight was incredibly smooth and Ryan communicated even the smallest details just to make sure we felt comfortable. Really, it was amazing! I highly recommend Envi Adventures as a way of seeing the Gorge. Next time we visit we hope to do the Mt Hood tour but weather didn't allow that today. I guess we'll save it for next time! Thanks Ryan!
No favourite part - the whole trip was fascinating.  Ray's knowledge of the island and it's weather (he avoided the rain) is quite amazing.  Check in was a breeze!

We flew from Phoenix to Sedona and, then, Sedona to the Grand Canyon and back.  Westwind Air was great.  From the people in the office to the pilot, everything was top notch.  At the Grand Canyon we transferred to a Pink Jeep Tour.  The Tour took us to many amazing viewing points.  The whole trip went smoothly and was run professionally.  Even a fearful flyer would enjoy this trip!!!  It is a must do!

Thanks to Shahd for finding us good rooms for staying. There were 5 of us (one little child) and it was very important to stay far away from the pools and two rooms close to each other. Shahd was very polite and attentive and made everything to organize it.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Couldn't have asked for a better birthday flight around Miami Beach. Tony was wonderful and really made it a great experience. Highly recommended.

I can't even express into words to explain how amazing this flight was! Open air bi-plane flying over Jurassic Park sites in a rainstorm was so fantastic, I stopped taking pictures because they cannot convey the enormous rush we got from this trip. So glad we did it. A little scared at takeoff, but decided if it was it time this was the way to go!  Still can't stop smiling! Our pilot  Harry was so chill and handled some serious downpours and headwinds expertly. Because of the rain there were twice as many waterfalls. I highly recommend this adventure!!!
Wow we just stepped off the plane and the experience was jaw dropping.  As someone who has traveled to Maui many times we truly thought we had seen it all.... THIS blew our minds!!! Great experience.

If you only read the first sentence - This is a must adventure!  From the booking to the flight and afterwards, top notch service.  Josh not only kept us safe and gave us a wonderful flight, but also taught us much about the island's history.  This will be an excursion that we will never forget - for me it was the highlight of our trip (we visited Kauai and the Big Island on this vacation).  The views are spectacular and the ride was smooth.  A big Thank You to the entire crew at Wings over Kauai

I have to share my experience this morning. I took my Very First Flight Ever a couple of hours ago and did it through RedTail Aviation in a 6 person plane. I was so nervous before I got on the plane and then I met the pilot (who is very young) which made me a bit more nervous. We board the plane and before long I was having the time of my life. I'm giving a very high compliment to the pilot Neil! He was so calm through turbulence and made me feel very comfortable. He controlled the plane with expertise, confidence and precision and is a great narrator for the trip. I had an amazing first flight and it's all thanks to Neil and RedTail Aviation. I will be seeing you again in the future and will recommend you to everyone I can!

Bruce and Ellen are warm and welcoming!  Bruce begins the plane ride with an interesting check-off list for the plane which simply educates the passengers about the plane and sets the stage for an amazing ride over the island of Kauai.  My 10 year old daughter and I had a fabulous experience and felt very safe, and Bruce's commentary on the island was enlightening.  The plane ride was quiet (Bruce has top-of-the-line headsets which we used to communicate with) and the plane ride was very smooth.  Mahalo to Wings over Kauai for adding to our love of this island!  Gina and Sophia, Aloha from the Garden State to the Garden Island!

A must do in Alaska! The weather was not in our favor, but our pilot did a wonderful job of really maximizing our experience and giving us spectacular views! The pilot, Kris, was awesome - really knowledgable of the area and definitely made the tour entertaining. The entire staff was extremely kind and welcoming. One of the highlights of our trip!

First time at Grand Canyon and we wanted to see it all. Well this tour didn't disappoint. Booking agent was very cordial and professional as was every one involved. Took the longer tour to see the north rim, 45-50 minutes, the 8am flight. Clear skies, minimal turbulence thanks to the pilots skill I'm sure. Marc was a wonderful guide and very reassuring to first time helicopter riders. The views were breath taking and worth the cost. All seats face the front unlike other tours. Highly recommend this company .

review_title: Mountain and glacier viewing from a de Havilland Otter
review_text: We took a family trip with a broad age range (8-84) and took a flight tour with this company. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about the region and we had a fantastic tour of the mountains and several glaciers. The plane was very comfortable for our group and I have to say the landing at the end of the tour was the smoothest I have ever experienced. Highly recommend a tour with this company.

Today was the most amazing day! We traveled to the West Rim of the Grand Canyon from the Deer Valley Airport in Scottsdale. Carla was our pilot/tour guide for the day. She was knowledgeable, caring & a great pilot! She had everything ready for us & we never really had to wait in line. She was also really great with the kids! I would recommend this trip to anyone who loves adventure!

As part of our Best of Kauai tour we took a small and ride over Kauai. JT, our pilot, was fantastic.  Knowledgeable and a good pilot. We had such a marvelous flight and seeing Kauai from air was the best.
what an amazing adventure Chris was informative, could not have asked for more.   Will definitely spread the word

review_title: A fantastic day in the alpine!
review_text: The trip was great in every facet, but our guide was especially knowledgeable, warm, funny, and led us through an educational, open-ended path on the tundra.  Never-ending panoramas and impressive hills and landscapes.  One was a glowing red mushroom, and all kinds of intricate flora and fauna.  No bears.   Thank you,K2!

Piolit was great, he was calm, cool,knowledgeable,  great guy named Jon or John. 
My teenage son was scared to get on at first but everything worked out.

We took the tour when staying in Moab because we were interested in seeing Canyonlands, which is not easily accessible by car (and certainly not easily traversable). We were very please we did it because the views were superb. We took the extended tour, which included Arches and although we had explored this at ground level in some detail it was nevertheless interesting to experience the aerial views as well. The pilot was knowledgeable and added interesting stories and was very good at pointing things out. A couple of points though: the planes are small (ours was a five seater) so expect a bumpy ride - there are sick bags to hand; there is very limited leg room - if you are tall it could be uncomfortable; and the headphones are a bit crackly and need adjustment - so best to do this before the commentary starts. In terms of taking pictures, some seats are better than others because of obstruction by the wings. MY wife was OK, despite the turbulence but I was feeling a little queasy - but would not have missed the experience. I would have put this down as a must do when in Moab. The airport is around 16 miles north of Moab so one needs to allow time to get there - some of the flights start fairly early e.g. 08:30. We had a slight wait for a passenger who failed to turn up - just as well as we are not sure where he would have sat! As space is very limited it is best to leave all that you can in the car - camera and water only for the plane!

We booked the flight over Kauai for my husband, myself and my mother (79 years)
This was a wonderful experience. The island is very pretty with waterfalls, mountains, beaches & the Na Pali coast. The flight lasts about 50 mins and covers a large part of the island including Waimea Canyon. We listened to music and a commentary from our pilot as we flew which added to the experience. He also pointed out specific locations from movies including Jurassic Park.

As we flew along the coast he was great at spotting whales and we even watched a breaching whale for a few minutes.

I cannot compare to the helicopter flight as we have not done this on Kauai but I found the fixed wing flight to be affordable and very enjoyable.

We were not able to do a landing due to weather but had a fantastic trip to see several glaciers and the summit for just a short while. 
It was an amazing tour with a terrific pilot.

Rather than do the standard helicopter tour, I wanted to do something that would allow me (as a private pilot) to do the flying.   We booked the 172 with Marcus along as CFI.  Marcus handled the radio and suggested the route, but I was allowed to do all of the flying.   

It was a great experience, and probably the highlight of our trip.  I would highly recommend this as an alternative to a helicopter tour.

My husband and I loved this flight over Kauai with our pilot Harry. We spent two weeks on the island and had been told to take a helicopter ride, but since we had experience a biplane ride in Key West, we went with the biplane ride on Kauai. It was spectacular and would highly recommend this way to see the island.

review_title: Beautiful air tour over the gorge

GREAT Float Plan excurision into the Misty Fiords.
Small Mom&Pop operation well worth the experience.

review_title: A Perfect flight despite imperfect weather

The pilot was top notch and the airplane and equipment in perfect working order and very well suited for this type of operation. The pilot was so accommodating to my wife.  She made sure she had a great view when we landed  on the glacier.   This flight was the highlight of our Alaskan trip!!

review_title: Wow!  That is what you'll be saying when your flying right up next to the mountain.
review_text: This is a once in a lifetime experience.  My wife and I were in awe and it was worth every penny.  Our pilot was great and made the flight very smooth.  Loved it!!!

review_title: Highlight of our visit to Kaua'i
review_text:
I found Wings Over Kaua'i through a Tripadvisor thread debating heli tours vs fixed wing. I am prone to motion sickness, plus we were treating my in-laws, so four tickets would be a little pricy. I was glad to see the good reviews of the plane tours and thought it would be easier on my stomach and wallet. I booked through their website just a few days before our tour. 

We took the early morning flight at 9am and it was a good thing because it was calm and clear but rainy later in the day. Everyone from Ellen picking us up, to Bruce and Angel taking care our prep, to Josh as pilot- just wonderfully nice and friendly people. Josh did the best job of keeping the flight as smooth as possible. The crew even  sent along a small cooler with ginger chews and sprite in case of motion sickness, something I really appreciated. The narration, music, and of course the views made this an absolutely wonderful experience. I recommend them highly.

We had an amazing time with Talkeetna Air Taxi. All 10 of us fit on one plane, and our wonderful pilot Chris even let someone sit in the co-pilot’s seat. We were in the air for about half an hour until we landed on Ruth Glacier. We were up close and personal with Mount McKinley. It was the most incredible experience, and while it was very expensive, I do believe it to be worth the money. Chris was a wonderful captain and made us feel very safe.

Very professional

Peaceful flight over the awesome GC
Landed at GC airport
Jumped into Humvee for ground tour of some of the top view spots, with Stoney our tour guide. He had some great stories of the GC pioneers 
Lunch at the Lodge
Then return flight , arriving back by 2pm
Preston our pilot for the day was great company
Wonderful day
John

review_text:
After several rainy ports we finally arrived in sunny Kethcikan.  Our flight the previous day in Skgway had been cancelled and they referred us to Taquan Air.  I was able to book an online web special and for the 6 of us it was a great savings.  
It was very easy to get the shuttle from the cruise ship, and then everything was very efficient upon arrival at Taquan air.  Our pilot, Brentwood, was experienced, and friendly and made the trip wonderful for us.  It was a beautiful late afternoon flight and the scenic views did not disappoint.  We were able to land and get out mid way.  It was one of the hightlights of our whole trip!

review_title: Saved the best for the last day
review_text: Our plane didn't leave until 9:30P.M., so we decided to do something really fun on our last full day in Kauai. Boy, was it ever fun!  I really liked that everyone had a window seat and we all were able to see so well. The views were so beautiful, it was breath taking. Josh, our pilot explained all the maneuvers and what to look for as we passed over so many beautiful sites we would never had seen if we hadn't taken the flight. I would definitely recommend this trip and will take it again if we get the chance to come back to Kauai!

If you had one day in Alaska and had to pick one thing to do, flying with K2 Aviation to Denali National Park for a 3 hour hike (guided by Alaska Alpine Adventures) surrounded by glaciers would fit the bill very nicely. 

Upon early arrival at the K2 Aviation office we were greeted with smiles, filled out a simple form, "weighed in", and relaxed on their sunny deck. The facility and grounds were very nice; clean and well kept. A short time later we boarded a van that took us to the float plane dock a few miles away. The driver was pleasant and made sure we were comfortable. Once there we took a few pictures of the surrounding beauty while passengers deplaned and the aircraft was being topped off with fuel. Our pilot Jeff then introduced himself to us, gave us an easy to understand pre-flight safety briefing and made us feel very safe and welcome. 

We boarded the aircraft and were airborne in short order. Lift off from the water was imperceptible. I know many factors can contribute to the way an airplane performs in flight, weather, aircraft design, pilot's skills, etc. The de Havilland Beaver was solid and smooth flying. What a great comfortable ride from a great Alaskan bush plane classic. The views were nothing short of phenomenal. This is what those Alaskan nature shows dream of capturing on film. Nothing beats the experience of seeing Alaska from the air with your own two eyes. Our richly experienced and confident pilot kept us engaged by pointing out interesting geography and landmarks. The views of colossal glaciers and majestic Denali (Mt. McKinley) were magnificently surreal. Take plenty of memory for your digital cameras. 

We landed on Moraine Lake and touchdown was equally imperceptible. Our hiking guide Elliot greeted us, stored our day bag and gave us trekking poles to begin our three hour hike. He even stuffed our water bottles and our sweaters into his back pack so that our hands could be free to enjoy the hike and take pictures. Elliott was very knowledgeable about the terrain and surrounding beauty of the mountains. It's great to be educated while having fun. His pace matched our abilities and desires. Elliot delivered an enthusiastic and fun adventure.

Upon return to base camp, Elliot set out some chairs for my wife and I and we relaxing at water's edge while he catered crackers, cheese, smoked salmon, and red wine! We had pleasant conversations amid one of the most beautiful and secluded sub-arctic locations known to mankind. We were a bit saddened to leave so soon as the sound of Jeff's plane returned to fly us back to Talkeetna. The flight back was just as breathtaking. Once again we saw incredible glacier features, moose, and a some of the same sights as before but from a different angle...equally impressive.

A huge thanks to all involved in making our tour, safe, enjoyable, and the unforgettable highlight of our summer!

AK residents: get out and enjoy our state with K2 Aviation, (ask for pilot Jeff), and Alaska Alpine Adventures...don't let the tourists have all the fun!

review_title: Hassle free way to fly over the Grand Canyon
review_text: Easy to book, efficient process at Tussayan airport and professional flight even though local climatic conditions meant we had quite a bumpy ride. Very smooth landing.

We communicated via email with Ellen concerning our reservations. She provided detailed information promptly to our queries. Our 60-minute trip was set to depart on a Thursday afternoon, but was moved back on our request due to the weather several times. Josh was our wonderful pilot. All 4 of us had window seats with a large bubble window that hardly had any reflections. Large headphones with 2-way communication with the pilot and others in the plane. Views were fantastic, of course.  Overall, a great flight!

review_title: Battesimo del volo in Alaska! / First flight in a small private plane in Alaska!
review_text:
Nel nostro soggiorno a Talkeetna abbiamo voluto prendere il K2AVIATION nonostante il tempo non permetteva di avvicinarsi alla montagna Mt McKinley e non avendo più giorni per aspettare le condizioni meteo favorevoli siamo saltati a bordo per un volo di battesimo sui piccoli aerei turistici in attesa del volo previsto ad Homer per il bear adventure... Abbiamo sorvolato la foresta ed una miriade di fiumi ad un prezzo ridotto ($90). Ci hanno fatto pesare prima per questioni di sicurezza e ci hanno dato tutte le informazioni sul volo che mi ha tranquillizzato. Esperienza positiva grazie al personale competente ed efficiente. Ma vale la pena solo se si è così fortunati da poter volare sulla montagna che sembra accada solo al 30% dei visitatori!....
----
During our stay in Talkeetna we decide to take a flight with K2AVIATION, even if it was too cloudy to see the famous Mt. McKinley; it seems that only 30% of visitors get to see the mountain!!!…. They emphasized safety, made us weigh in for the plane loading and explained everything necessary for a safe flight. So we felt pretty secure and got our first flight in a small private plane, for a special low price, over the town and the surrounding rivers and forest. It was a great adventure, the pilot talked about the area we were seeing but I still feel sorry about missing the great mountain… Next time!

Simply the best day in my trip to Vegas - by far!
The Canyon is utterly awesome and the whole Maverick helicopter experience to the South rim truly professional A day to remember for a lifetime

Not cheap, but what a great experience. We went for the 45 minute flight over the canyon, which felt just about right. The whole set up from arrival onwards was very professional, whilst our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable.
This tour was our highlight of our trip.  The sights are spectacular.  The pilot was so informative.  Loved, loved it. use this company if you can.

We saw that the weather was going to be clear for the several days that we were in Talkeetna (late August '16) and booked a flight-seeing tour with this company.  The weather was probably as good as could be hoped for-- blue skies, few clouds, little to no wind, temperatures in the upper 60's.  We departed at noon, with the sun overhead. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the experience.  The flight path took us thru some of the most spectacular vistas that we've ever seen.  We opted for the lake landing, and were not disappointed.  The aircraft had a smooth landing, and when it came to a stop the aircraft was pointed directly at Mt. Denali.  The pilot asked us if we wanted to get out of the aircraft and stand on the landing pontoons (which I did).  Took some video and photos from this location.  The pilot took a photo of me standing on the pontoon and holding onto the wing strut, with Denali in the background.  My wife and I both agree that this was the highlight of our Alaska trip.  The cost was a bit pricey, but we thought it was worth it (most likely a once in a lifetime experience).

Ficamos em dúvida se fazíamos o passeio de helicóptero ou avião. Decidimos avião e não nos arrependemos. Valeu muito a pena!

Como muito da paisagem de Kauai não é vista por terra, nada melhor que sobrevoar essa ilha muito bonita.

O voo foi muito bom, piloto muito divertido e dava informação da ilha toda com explicações muito detalhadas.

Fomos muito bem atendidos e a paisagem de Kauai vista pelo alto é indescritível.

Valeu cada centavo que pagamos no passeio.

Somos muito agradecidos a Air Ventures pelo passeio inesquecível.

The staff is pleasant and professional.  Our pilot Stan was great with a ton of information about Denali and the surrounding area!  Weren’t sure if we would get to do the glacier landing but the clouds parted and Stan made it happen!  What an amazing flight!  Treat yourself to this activity and you won’t regret it!

We had a great time going up with our pilot, Eric. The island is beautiful from the air. The weather had cancelled our snorkel excursion the day before and Air Ventures was able ro give us the chance to see the Napali coast before our flight out of Kauai that evening.

Our flight with Harry and Air Ventures Hawaii was spectacular!  The views were unbelievable and Harry had lots of interesting facts to share with us.  My husband is a commercial pilot and was a little unsure about flying with another pilot but he quickly became comfortable.  Everyone was very helpful and friendly and we totally enjoyed the whole experience!
Had an incredible time and the pilot was very professional and informative. This was a once in a lifetime experience and we are very happy we were able to ride in this airplane.

Spectacular Flight in a small ski plane up close to Denali and through the surrounding Alaska Range.  Our Pilot Wilbur was experienced, calm and capable.  This was a highlight among many great Alaska experiences.  Highly recommend!

Real professionals.  Felt safe all the time.  Staff and pilot knowledgeable and friendly.They rescheduled us due to weather and got us the flight of a lifetime over Denali.Highly recommend.  Best part of our Alaska tour.

We took the South Face McKinley Tour with glacier landing and it was an unforgettable experience. The views of the mountains, including Mount McKinley (peeping out above the clouds), and several glaciers are amazing. The glacier landing was fun, especially being able to take photos with the plane on the snow. The company is very professional: the booking process was smooth, they answered all of our questions in no time, and also in explaining the safety issues they gave us the impression they clearly knew what they were doing.

Super équipe, très bon accueil et super pilote, très agréable.A faire les yeux fermés.De très bonnes sensations, nous n'étions jamais monté dans un hydravion, ce fût une première.El la vue de San Francisco tout simplement magnifique.

This review is long overdue as we did this back in January 2012.
This was one of the best experiences of my life so far. I got to sit in the front and be co-pilot which was so much fun. The views were amazing. There's so much of this island that you can only see by air or by water. My husband and I decided to do the aerial experience by plane as opposed to helicopter because it is quite a bit cheaper. The two of us could go for same price as one in a helicopter. The family that runs this tour are so nice and you get a souvenir photo and DVD to take home and share with friends and family.

I'd recommend doing the tour as one of your first experiences on the island. The pilot was incredibly informative and personable and gives you a range of ideas/areas to explore during your time on the island. The views are amazing and you will love the experience.

This was a spectacular and unique experience!  The flight and clear view of Denali and the surrounding peaks was beyond awe inspiring. The pilot was informative and skilled. Landing on the glacier was a riot ( and NOT scary).

The ground crew was very responsive and helpful. The flight was expensive but the experience priceless. We were speechless. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi for making our introduction to the grand mountain of Denali so fun and memorable.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Well worth your time, Amazing Views
review_text: My father and I took the one hour Canyonlands flight. WE ABSOLUTLY LOVED IT!! If you are ever in Moab, I HIGHLY RECCOMMEND you splurge on a scenic flight from Redtail Avation. Our pilot today was Jim, Arch Enemy #1. Jim took the time to learn everyone's name and made appoint of using our names throughout the flight to draw our attention to the amazing rock features. he made us feel like it was a personal tour of the park. The flight was bumpy due to high winds but Jim had great control of the plane. spectacular views! He took us all over the park, including the parts nor assessable by car which are rarely seen. Jim shared great stories about flying a tiny plane through some of the larger rock arches in the area and knew the names of everything. I will definitely do this again!!!!

review_title: A must do in Kauai.  Half the price of a helicopter tour!
review_text: What a cool experience!  If you are like me and have sticker shock on the helicopter tour price tag,  then you'll love this.   Very professional operation but fun at the same time.  The tour was the perfect length and the pilot was a wealth of knowledge.  Would highly recommend.  To quote a guide book I was reading,  not doing an air tour "is like visiting the Sistine Chapel and never looking up".

We had to reschedule due to weather but it was so much better on the day we did it. It was clear and beautiful you could see the mountains the views were incredible everything about this experience was amazing. I was a bit nervous about the tiny plane but it was great. my friend and I had a great time. Are pilot was very nice and helpful. I would recommend this to anyone even if you’re a little scared it’s completely worth it, you won’t see views like this in any other way.
This was the highlight of our tour of Kauai. TJ and Harry were great pilots!  Gave all the passengers in the plane the best views for pictures. Great value. Easy to make arrangements over the phone.

My husband and I have lived in Moab, UT most of our lives and have never experienced such an awesome scenic flight of our area, actually it was our first ever  scenic tour. It was so beautiful and we would love to go again! Our amazing pilot, Kim Ruble was so knowledgeable and entertaining! We flew over Canyonlands, Moab, Castle Valley and Arches. He even made sure we got a picture of our home from the sky! We also saw some arches and ruins we didn't even know existed. Thank you so much Kim for this amazing opportunity! We highly recommend a flight with Kim Ruble!!!!
Our pilot, BJ made the flight over the Grand Canyon fun and exciting.  He seemed extremely capable and confident while very upbeat and even humorous.  Highly recommended.

That was the best and beautiful thing I’ve ever seen in my life. So many different landscapes 😍😍. Our pilot Marcus was also a real air guide, he knows a lot of things and he tried his best to made this tour unforgettable.

An amazing flying view of the canyon which provides a totally unique way of viewing from above. Our pilot was incredibly informative and friendly and took care of us the whole time. The helicopter was comfy and the ride smooth, and took us around and over the best parts of the canyon and landscape.
This trip is totally worth the money and I highly recommend if you're in the area. Do not miss it.

The highlight of our two week vacation to Alaska was the Talkeetna flight to Denali, and to land on the glacier.  We were lucky to spend three cloudless days in Denali. Sobering to see the rapidly receding glaciers.  Smooth flight; very informative pilot.  I couldn't stop taking pictures.  Make sure you have plenty of camera memory before taking off.

It was a beautiful informative flight .  The pilot was great and the flight fun .
I'd do it again!!!the sky's were clear  We did get to fly through some Hawaiian air plane wash, as the mist cleaned the plane.  Kauai from the air is s
Spectacular

review_title: Fly first to see what to visit later
review_text: Excellent flight.  Comfortable. Good narration by the pilot.  In my view fixed wing is safer than helicopter because of the more complicated maintenance requirements of a helicopter.

My wife and I visited Kauai for our 40th anniversary.  Prior to going one of my friends had shared with me that he had flown with Bruce and Wings Over Kauai while visiting Kauai. During his visit he took several flights with Bruce and raved about the experience.   As a long time pilot I wanted to have the opportunity to fly in Kauai.  We arrived about 30 minutes prior to the flight and had a chance to chat with the staff who were great.  The flight was wonderful- Bruce is a super experienced flight instructor and guide.  We had a blast and would highly recommend Wings over Kauai to all that visit Kauai!

review_title: An extraordinary ride through the mountains
review_text: definitely take the flight and do a glacier landing -- it was incredible.  our pilot was great and we felt quite safe in her capable hands.

Our party of four booked this excursion after reading glowing reports on tripadvisor.  It was easy to arrange and we met our shuttle at the ABC store at Anchor Cove Shopping mall which took us to the airport.  We then were weighed in and waited a short time for our plane to arrive.  When it was time to board we were given safety instructions and shown how to use the head phones.  Our pilot was "Brian".  We then took off into a beautiful clear blue sky.  The views were magnificent. He took us all over the island (Waimea Canyon, Waita Reservoir, Napali Coast, beautiful coastal golf courses Lumahai Beach, waterfalls, whales in the ocean etc.  It was endless beauty. Brian gave us interesting comentary throughout.  Honestly, I had the best time.  The small aircraft was smooth and quiet and I felt very safe at all times.  I would highly recommend this excursion to everyone. All the people involved were so friendly and welcoming.

review_title: This is the way to see Kauai!
review_text: Our Pilot-Harry was wonderful. The entire day rained and stopped just when it was time for our flight. It was perfect! We saw so many rainbows. It is a must do. My father got to sit up front in the co-pilot's seat and got such great pictures. It was an experience that our entire family will never forget. Thanks for the great memories!
It was a very nice experience. A must try aerial view of the city. It took 45 mins including the take off and the pilot was very friendly.

Air Ventures' tour of Kauai was spectacular and well worth the price.  The staff was courteous and friendly, which made the tour even more enjoyable.  Kauai really is the "Garden Isle" on the ground and in the air.  Enjoy!!

Incredible views and very entertaining pilot.  Small plane gave intimate feel to flight. Absolutely stunning tour. Plus for only $25 we attached our go pro to the wing of the plane for additional incredible footage.

review_title: Amazing Seaplane ride and breathtaking views of Misty Fjords
review_text: My wife and I  booked our tour to Misty Fjords through Princess Cruise. I had mixed feeling about the tour because we could only get space on the first flight out of the day and I was not sure if we would be able to see much in Misty Fjords. There is a reason it is called MISTY Fjords. Ketchikan is surrounded by rain forest and it rains there all the time. We were told that if there are clouds our flight might not happen. When our cruise ship reached Ketchikan it was party cloudy. The forecast had slight chance of showers. Well by the time we boarded the small 6 seater seaplane sun had come out. It was our first time in a  seaplane. Taking off from  water was an interesting experience. Our pilot was experienced and knowledgeable about the area and shared interesting information through the whole flight. However, there were no microphones in our headset. so we could only hear our pilot but could not ask him questions. The headset were old also and at times there were lot of noise. The experience would have been much better if we had better (newer) headphones with microphones.  By the time we reached the fjords, the clouds and mist had cleared and the views were breathtaking. Our pilot flew the plane low enough through the fjords to really enjoy the spectacular scenery. We landed at a remote spot in the fjords and stepped out of the seaplane for about 5 to 10 mins. On the way back, our flight path was different than the one we took flying in to the Misty Fjords. We saw many bald eagles. Overall an enjoyable experience in a seaplane.

Unforgettable mind blowing experience.  I only see those view from YouTube videos but today in raw eyes!  Eric is a wonderful coach and tour guide, super helpful and caring. He explained the details, so I flew a plane over Maui and I’m a PILOT!🙈 you don’t want to miss this once in life experience!! Highly recommended!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: The staff was accommodating with our last-minute booking.  It was a spur of the moment trip n a beautiful Alaskan day. ,
review_text: Our pilot, Chris, was not only a great pilot, but an excellent tour guide. He was a wealth of knowledge about the Denali Park, the mountain range, the glaciers and even the geology and formation of the land that we’ve come to love; Alaska. I’ve flown as a helicopter crewman for many years and found this service, plane, and pilot to be the best!
It was amazing. See the Grand Canyon from above is something else. I've never experienced anything like it.

Had a fantastic time on this private plane tour of Maui County. Particularly loved the pilot’s description of Maui’s history and the view of the tallest sea cliffs in the world! Fun and exciting for anyone with a love of nature or adventure.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: There are two reasons why we cannot rate this 5 stars.  First, one person in our party had a headset with a nonworking mic so they could not ask any questions during the flight.  Second, we thought the flight would be limited to six people (according to the website description).  There were 10 people  in our plane not counting the pilot.  Not sure why there was a difference.  The views on the right side were better than the left, but the views for all were incredible. Takeoff and landing were very smooth.   It's worth the trip, but be sure to check your mic and ask how many people will be in the plane before going.
I loved the amazing views that you can only see from above.  The pilot was confident and professional and knowledgeable of the area.

I was supposed to do the flying tour with a glacier landing but was told when I arrived that they couldn't land on the glacier due to bad conditions. However they easily swapped ne onto a new tour, just flying, leaving at the same time. 

I can say it is the best thing I've done, I wasnt expecting to get so up close to the mountains but if felt we were within touching distance we were so close. 

Our pilot was fabulous, giving each side if the plane equal views and really good commentary.

We were in the air for a good hour and a half and it was well worth it. We were lucky with the weather I think and had amazing views but you could see how quickly the clouds come in. 

I would highly recommend K2, an incredibly professional operation.

This was probably the best thing we did in our week long trip in Alaska. We had a wonderful and personable pilot who was obviously well trained. The views were breath-taking. I have never seen something so awe-inspiring. Well worth your money.

review_title: Amazing way to view Kauai from the air
review_text: Totally excellent experience.  The pilot was also an excellent guide.  My wife gets motion sick and we saw reviews for this trip that mentioned it was much better than the helicopter rides for someone prone to motion sickness.  I very much agree as she had no problems with the flight.  The island is breathtaking from the view above it.  Seeing it from the plane was amazing.
Awesome experience. The sea cliffs were beautiful, and the pilot was very friendly. Definitely recommend!
Awesome views.  Everyone must see the island from an air view.  The staff at Air Ventures were awesome, very friendly. Would definetly use them again.

review_title: Best part of our 3 week road trip
review_text: Superb trip...well worth digging deep and paying for it.  Our family of 5 all thought it was by far the best part of our 3 week road trip of the USA.  Staff really helpful and great pilot.  Felt very safe yet exhilarated.

JT was our pilot and we had a GREAT flight - amazing views and Sooo smooth ! A few of us were a little nervous of motion sickness but we had None of that !! We Saw whales - beautiful waterfalls- amazing coastline and terrain that was spectacular. Wonderful landing - the whole ride was worth every penny — thanks JT !

review_title: Best view of San Francisco by far
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed our seaplane adventure flight this week.Our pilot was full of fun and made us all feel at ease. His commentary during the flight was excellent.We flew down the coastline with stunning vistas then back up to the bay passing over the Golden Gate Bridge with everyone getting a chance to take plenty of photos. We flew over Alcatraz and the city getting some amazing views. He didn’t rush back and after landing took some photos of us next to the plane. Certainly a wow experience!
Our pilot Larry id an awesome job with the flight, narration, and landing in an isolated bay.  Getting out and standing on the pontoons in the bay was the best!

review_title: Fantastic views of the Grand Canyon
