review_text: All people very friendly - We spent all day visiting also Antelope canyon and rafting on Colorado River

We were booked for the following day but were worried the trip would be cancelled for weather so we hoped on a flight in the morning the day before.  Was a great experience and they were very professional

während unseres Aufenthaltes auf Kauai haben wir uns spontan zu einem Rundflug mit "Wings over Kauai" entschieden. Es war einfach unbeschreiblich schön. Schon beim Einchecken mit Ellen fühlten wir uns richtig wohl. Es war noch unbeschreiblicher als wir uns mit Bruce und seiner Maschine in die Lüfte erhoben. Er beschrieb sehr informativ während des Fluges alle Details, Film-Locations und Landschaften unter uns.  Der Flug war sehr ruhig, seine Konversation mit uns (mit den 1000 USD teueren High-Tech Bose-Kopfhörern) sehr informativ! Während des Fluges mussten wir keine Knöpfe drücken um Ihm zu antworten. Die Sicht war vom Flugzeug aus ebenfalls toll, dank der großen Panorama-Fenster (vor jedem Flug liebevoll von Ellen gesäuberten Fenster). So konnten wir herrliche Luftaufnahmen von dieser einzigartigen Insel machen. Zum Abschied gab es sogar noch eine kostenlose Flug-CD von Wings over Kaui.
Meine Frau, ich und unser Sohn waren noch Tage danach tief beeindruckt von diesem Erlebnis! Von uns eine klare(für einen Kauai-Rundflug preiswerte!) Empfehlung für "Wings over Kauai"

You can see the whole Canyon from the helicopter tour.  The guide does a great job giving details.  It is unbelievable to get to see the canyon from this viewpoint.

We highly  recommend  taking this helicopter tour it's an experience you and your family will not forget although it is pricey. 

Took a 45 minute one,

We almost never take a chosen itinerary path on world travel "things to do" and "must see events". We usually wing it, and finding Wings Over Kauai was another notch in our belts in this department. This 70 minute flight adventure on board a Cessna 172 was incredible. Captain Bruce was personel and the sights of Kauai were beautiful and awesome. We considered the cost very reasonable. This flight truely made our trip complete - buzzing around in his aircraft and witnessing all of the islands wonderful sights.

Everything is very well organized at Maverick's. Be sure to arrive 1/2 hour in advance !
The pilots are really professional. The music list on the craft is perfect and the overview over the canyon is breathtaking despite the rainy weather (August 25, 2015) we had during the flight).
It's a great experience you should not miss even it's a bit expensive. You can join two great pleasures : flying on a helicopter and discovering one of the most exceptional natural place in the world. For sure, enjoy this experience!

review_title: Fantastic Kauai Island View by Air
review_text: To see Kauai island by air was not an activity my sister and I had planned to go on but we were given an opportunity and we took advantage of it!Our pilot Desi was fantastic at explaining the island terrain and some history while flying a very smooth course, with an occasional “bump” as we approached the clouds although Desi warned us in advance. It was awesome to see the Nepali Coast by air.Thank you, Desi and Air Ventures Hawaii staff!Cheers! Janice & CarolynVancouver Canada

Though our experience didn't start out well, (if you read my first review), it ended wonderfully! 
Our situation was handled by their GD Isaac and he did an incredible job of getting it fixed. We went that following Sunday night and had a great time.
The views are incredible! if you're worried about getting photos, do not. We were able to get our best photos from here. The pilot even turned the plane so that Everyone could see and snap pictures. 

Allergen Alert: 1
They did an incredible job of placing me in front so the cologne of other passengers did not play an issue, and they were so kind about it. There is, as expected, a little pre-flight exhaust to cause some concern, but was very minimal. Pilot wore no obvious cologne.

Wonderful to see the island from above and MUCH better than lining up on the ground with millions of tourists all trying to get the best shot.
My stay on Kauai couldn't have started better than with this flight.
From the first contact via mail until the last good-bye: just great!
Highly recommended!!!

Weather was great, which provided a smooth ride. Loved the majestic views around every corner from our 6 seater seaplane, piloted by Harry, who was very personable and knowledgeable. We had never been in a small plane like this. It was a bit confining, so may not be a comfortable ride for a very tall or large person. We did have to disclose our weight and our party of 6 was split up between 2 planes to even out the load between planes, although they did keep couples together. Taquan Air was very accommodating, bringing a ramp to board the plane for my husband who wears a prosthetic leg. They also provided a golf cart ride for him back and forth to the plane, as it is a bit of a walk on inclined ramps, etc. Halfway through, we landed in the middle of the water and travelers could step out onto the pontoon!  We thought it was worth the money and was a once in a lifetime type of excursion!!

Fantastic experience! The staff was so friendly, welcoming and professional. We always felt at ease and very safe throughout. Captain Josh was a wealth of information. Even having been to Kauai 4 times, I learned things I didn't know before. Bring a camera and make sure it's charged and with plenty of space on the memory card - I had to delete about 100 old photos while flying over the Na Pali Coast... not my best move! 

Highly recommend!

A great ride.  Eric the pilot is 100% dedicated to safety and comfort.  His enthusiasm for the beauty of the island is genuine and a pleasure to share.  Flew with my wife and daughter and we cannot stop smiling.  A joy if a ride.  NOTE: follow the signs to get there (we turned too early by the tower)

The flight was one of the most amazing events in my life. The pilot was outstanding and educational. The office staff were not well versed in customer service, it was like we were wasting their time asking basic questions but the flight was incredible.

We drove past Alaska Bush Plane on our way down to Talkeetna so came across them purely by chance as opposed to researching them first which is what we usually do but what a find they turned out to be! The weather was really changeable but we could be a bit flexible with our plans and Molly in the office was brilliant at keep us updated on the weather and what flight we could do. In the end, we did a 1 hour wildlife tour because it was too cloudy for Mount McKinley but the 1 hour was awesome despite the mountain staying hidden. Our pilot Jason was really knowledgable and an excellent spotter of wildlife! Black bears and a whole heap of moose on top of the mountains were the highlight. Great experience!
Took a tour down to the keys for lunch then back.  Captain Tony is the real deal!  We will be back and highly recommend this to anyone looking for a little adventure in their lives.
The experience was definitely worth it, Joel is the best, he made the trip fun and informative. Will do again

The facility was super clean and the the team was so friendly and pilot Sergio is well experienced and the views were amazinggggg
Highly recommended

Steve and Lesly are great. We flew with them on two different days. Once to see the bears, where we were about 15ft from a mom and two cubs, and again for the Misty Fjords. Both times we flew with Steve and he can be pretty funny. He spotted a bear in the Misty Fjords and circle a couple times so everyone could see it. He even pointed out the mountain goats! I will fly with them again!

review_title: A Highlight of Any Alaska Trip
review_text:
This will be one of the most unique experiences you will have anywhere.  The flight though the Alaska range cannot be adequately described with words. TAT takes you trough the passes and along the paths of glaciers that provide a sense of the size and uniqueness of the landscape leaving you in awe.  The glacier landing is really exciting and puts you on the snow in the middle of multiple jagged ridges and peaks - including Denali.

Our pilot Leighan was great.  She not only piloted the plane through very beautiful areas of the Alaska range, she provided great information about the area and the geology - and made the whole experience a lot of fun.

The people at TAT were very friendly and made every aspect of the trip easy. Don't hesitate in making a flight with TAT part of your Alaska adventure!
An absolutely fantastic experience. The views were breathtaking, the knowledge of the local islands/landscape was second to none and I couldn’t recommend Maui Plane Rides any more highly! 10/10

review_title: If the clouds are to low for Denali, reserve a floatplane ride.
review_text: Truly and amazing flight! We loved it, The tundra landscape with its 100 shades of green. We were looking for wildlife but did not see any but it was still well worth it. The 30min was a perfect time for us.
Ray was our pilot and did an outstanding job showing us the island, whales, key landmarks. I feel I saw everything there was to see on the island which made for a complete island vacation.

review_title: Best Way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We had one day to visit the Grand Canyon with our young children (ages 4, 6, and 8).  The Adventure tour was well worth the money and was better than expected.  The plane ride, helicopter ride, boat ride, lunch and SkyBridge were all perfect.  Things moved quickly enough that the children never got bored, but slow enough that everyone could keep up and not be completely worn out.  We were back to Deer Valley Airport by 3pm, which gave us plenty of time to take our tired kids back to the hotel, get them fed and in bed at a decent hour.  My husband and I are both professional pilots and can say the aviation portions were very safe and well done.  Good job Westwind!  The employees of Westwind were very informative, kind, and helpful.  Great customer service all around.

Weather didn’t permit us to get at all close to the waterfall we wanted to see but the flight was cool and seeing whales from above was neat. We enjoyed getting to see the Island from above and it was well worth the money!
Our pilot Billy was excellent. We had perfect weather and landed on the glacier. Without a doubt, the most spectacular flight of my life.

review_title: Just Wow. You won’t Be Disappointed!
review_text:
We booked this tour very last minute after stumbling upon a discounted brochure in the back of a taxi that offered an airplane ride over the GrandCanyon, Hoover dam and the Colorado river. This tour appealed to us as it only lasted approximately 4 hours where as bus tours to the Grand Canyon that we had previously quoted would last 12 hours +. We were not disappointed with this tour!!

What an experience and excellent value for money. This is not something that you are going to forget! 

Easy and smooth hotel pick up drop off service. Quick to board the plane within around 25 minutes of arrival which meant time for a restroom stop, a quick drink and photo opportunity.

The views are absolutely breathtaking and the Audio tour/music played is an added bonus. You will have many picture opportunities from the plane fitted with large windows so that you are able to see on both sides.

I would highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to experience one of the 7 natural wonders of the world in a way you simply won’t forget.

review_title: Best thing to do in Alaska
review_text: I had a great time. Dorothy our pilot was wonderful. She was informative. There was very little turbulence,which I was nervous about. I would go again

Wings Over Kauai was my husband's favorite part of our trip to Kauai! If you are looking for an air tour of the island that is reasonably priced and informative, this is your tour. Many of the helicopter tours are expensive (over priced), whereas Wings Over Kauai is reasonably priced and offers beautiful views of the island - Waimea Canyon, Hanalei Bay, Na Pali Coast and our pilot, Josh was very knowledgeable about the island. It was obvious by talking to Josh he wasn't trained as a tour guide, but instead shared his own passion about the island and answered any questions we had. Very authentic experience - didn't feel "touristy" at all!

I had been emailing back and forth with Ellen for a couple months prior to our visit to get times figured out - we were on a cruise ship and had limited time. She was so helpful and accommodating. When we actually got there, it was like meeting a long lost friend!  

The flight itself was wonderful. I'd never been in a small plane and Bruce mentioned there was some turbulence - I sure didn't notice it. The views were spectacular, Bruce was full of information and we got to see the breathtaking NaPali coast without doing a lengthy and strenuous hike!

Yeah, you get closer with a helicopter, but knowing my luck, I would have been the one squished in the middle of the back seat. Here I had my very own window - yay!

I was apprehensive but it wasn't long before I was taken in the the breathtaking views. Open air cockpit, the sights and a knowledgeable guide, this makes for a memorable trip. We did a complete loop of the island and the interior too. Thanks Harry!
Amazing views!  This tour helped deepen my understanding of the island with firsthand views of the topography.  Pilot Eric was very welcoming and friendly.  Wonderful experience!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Everything was as advertised or better.  Took my daughter for a tour and was the highlight of our trip.  I suggest a tour with a landing, if you are able.  We landed in the rainforest, drank champagne, walked along streams and beautiful plants, the took off again and finished the tour.  Tone was an excellent pilot and tour guide; very knowledgable.  Highly recommend!

It was a stunning flight. Our captain Caden, a cool and young guy did a great job. He made sure, that the passengers on the right as well as the passengers on the left side could take pictures of the must sees. despite the quickli changing weather conditions the flight was stable and comfortable. I had the chance to sit in the front row, next to the captain. Thank you!

What a great trip.  We did have the best weather ever and the smoothest ride of the year so I suspect we were spoiled.  Clear day, no wind and a great pilot.  Definitely do the glacier landing as that is a highlight in nice weather.  Also book a little ahead of the weather is looking fine.  They can get a flurry of guests in nice weather.  This is a must do and TAT pilot guides are great.

On Wednesday, August 7th, we arrived at TAT at 4:00 pm for a 4:30 reservation for our party of four. As soon as we got to the desk we were shown a relief map of the area surrounding Mt. McKinley (Denali) and we were told that the cloud cover would prevent us from seeing the peaks. However, they had been making glacier landings all day. I discussed it with my party and told the staff that we'd go ahead as long as they were making landings. They again said they've been making landings all day. 
We put on the supplied over boots and boarded the plane. Just before we taxied away someone spoke to our pilot and I'm pretty sure he said something to the effect that the air had become choppy and a landing would not be possible but that he should fly around a little more. 
The flight was amazing but when we approached the glacier where he would have landed he told us the air was too choppy for a landing. When we returned to the hangar the pilot said that if we had paid for a glacier landing there would be an adjustment made.
I went back to the counter where another party was just instructed to put on their over boots.
I informed the staff at the counter that we didn't land on the glacier and that I was annoyed that they let us fly knowing that we had discussed it at the beginning and that we were going ahead with the flight with limited visibility because they had been making landings all day. 
One of the women said that they never guarantee a glacier landing because the weather is so changeable. I said but the pilot was told before we taxied away that there wouldn't be a landing and that we could have just as easily waited for the next day. She said, "We'll, you can try again tomorrow if you like." I'm not sure, but I don't think she was offering us a free flight, so, yeah for another $1100.00 we could try agin tomorrow. Thanks.
They refunded us $85.00 per person plus the $10.00 per person Denali park fee. 
Here's the thing. The flight was incredible. Not the issue. The people are really nice. Not the issue. The pilot was incredibly knowledgeable and gave us fantastic views. Not the issue. 
The issue is we were only going ahead because of the landing and before we left they knew we wouldn't be able to. Not only that, as far as I know, they didn't inform he people after us either.
We rented a car and drove from Anchorage, booked a bed and breakfast, spent a day in Talkeetna after a cruise from Vancouver and the highlight of our time in Alaska was going to be landing on a glacier. Yes, there was no guarantee that if we waited until Thursday we would have made a landing. No guarantee. But, it was a sure bet that before we took off they knew we weren't making a landing. Guaranteed.

We did a glacier air tour and glacier landing with Talkeetna air taxi! It was amazing ! Our pilot was very nice and explained what we were seeing while flying. The views are breathtaking and totally worth the price ! 

The glacier landing is AMAZING! We only got to spend 15 mins on the glacier, wish that could have been a bit longer. But if you have to choose one activity to do while at Alaska I would definitely recommend doing this glacier landing tour!

Our Scenic Canyon River Adventure began at the Grand Canyon Airport with a flight to Page, AZ, flying along the southern and eastern rim of the GC. We arrived to the area late the previous night and I loved watching my husband's face as he saw the GC for the first time during this early morning flight. :) We then toured Antelope Canyon, another wonderful example of God's amazing creation. Next we boarded a motorized raft for a smooth water float trip from the base of the Lake Powell Dam to Lee's Ferry, about 15 miles. Brad was our captain and he provided much historical and geographical knowledge of the area and even serenaded us on his guitar. The ancient Indian petroglyphs were amazing, also.  We were blessed with cloudy skies and uncharacteristically mild temperatures, a nice surprise. I highly recommend this all-day trip as it was extremely enjoyable and informative!
Unbelievably terrific experience. Staff is so great, facility is nice with restrooms. Sol was our pilot. He's THE BEST! Alaska is beautiful and this the way to see it.

Loved flying over Kauai and seeing all of the valleys we would not have seen otherwise. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and made sure to point out important scenic views.  Very smooth ride and loved riding in a Cessna for the first time!

review_title: My husband recently took a flight lesson...
review_text: My husband recently took a flight lesson with Bruce and I was able to join them for the flight around the island. We followed the normal tour flight path and were able to see the entire island. Bruce, Ellen and Maren were so kind, so friendly and helpful. Talk about the true meaning of aloha! Bruce knows a lot about the island, especially the agriculture. He shared a lot of interesting information during our flight. I disagree with the review that said a fixed-wing tour is not a good as a helicopter tour. I have done both on Kauai and I think the two experiences are more similar than different.
Great flight and glacier landing around Denali. Very professional and welcoming. Had a wonderful time
Great tour.    Eric explained everything about the flight.    Then while in flight he pointed out sites to note.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: We absolutely loved this experience! Upon arrival the staff were all friendly and good chat. The flying experience was amazing, it was great to see the Bay Area from a different angle. The plane journey was fun and much smoother than I was expecting. We are so glad we made the decision to book this!!

review_title: This should be on your bucket list
review_text: Seaplane Adventures was awesome! We took the champagne sunset tour but it was already midsummer so we didn’t see the sunset but it was still well worth it. We got very close to some sites like Mt. Tam, ATT Park, The Golden Gate Bridge and even our home! We hit a little turbulence over the Marin Headlands but it made the trip even more fun. It was like an amusement ride. Word of advise, don’t drink the champagne on an empty stomach, you may get sick during the ride. This trip just made us love our city even more. Thank you Seaplane Adventures!

I've been to Arches before, but I really SAW it for the first time today. Chris, our pilot, was informative, comfortable to be with, and made Arches and Canyonlands a whole new, incredible experience. Almost didn't do it. But it will be the story I tell for years about this trip.

review_title: Excellent experience from Scottsdale to GC however
review_text:
Really my only complaint was watching no one tip the pilot of WW, who is essentially your tour guide all day.  At least our guy offered a LOT of information and background along the way, was able to get us in an out of lines faster etc.  I understand that some countries are non tipping countries but I think that spelling it out at the desk at WW would be helpful.  If you feel like it wasn't worth it then by all means let them know but a gratuity line item wouldn't be at all out of line IMO.  You have the opportunity to buy your photo in front of the plane as the last thing you do at WW, perhaps when you are paying there could be a "would you like to add an additional gratuity to the pilot of your plane?" type question?  

Actual Tour - I don't like cessnas but this was a larger one.  Flight there was fine and very little turbulence.  Flight back was very bumpy and while I wasn't nauseous, I was uneasy!   The canned audio on the way in was slow but informative.  A little too long IMO but I"m sure others found it very informational.  I preferred the pilot's own views and sight information.  The best thing is that the headphones drown out the plane's noise.

GC - Hopped out of plane, got in line for helicopter.  Heli ride is very organized and professional and feels "safe."  Short drop into the canyon.  Steep rocky hike down (5 minutes) to the base where you hop on the pontoon boat.  If you have knee or mobility problems then that little walk down will pose a bit of a problem.  Plenty of older people being assisted as it's steeper grade and not even footing.  Reasonably fit people should just watch their step and ankles!  Great photo ops though if you turn around because the GC forms the base wall going up and the helicopters are flying back up to pick up more people.

Pontoon - short ride but fun.  it was warmer here at the bottom than the windy top so it was nice to get out of the wind and have a short ride and relax.  Beautiful and makes you want it to last a lot longer.  No you do not get wet so no worries there...although we heard that occasionally people will jump in for no apparent reason!   Out of the boat back at the dock and back up the rocky steps.  Time to take some photos till you wait for your helicopter to pick you back up.

Back to the top where you get in line for Skywalk.  If you don't know what this is, google it.  I have a fear of heights and was cautiously fine.  I also did not look down right away and did a lot of deep breathing.  it's pretty scary!   You can't take cell phones or cameras there but they have photogs of course so you can buy the pics after.  Those range from 30 bucks i think to 120 maybe?  that gets you your pics on a flash drive to do with what you please when you get home although they print off 4 for your right there, which i think is smart just in case your drive doesn't work later!!  at least you have those 4 prints!   You end up in the gift shop there until you leave.

Time for picnic style lunch - bbq chicken, cole slaw, brownies, corn, mashed potato and gravy.  That type food.  Looked fine to me...not sure what people complain about.  It's included in the price.  I have dietary restrictions so I didn't eat it but it looked fresh and tasty and everyone in my group finished their plates.  Watch out for those pesky oversized ravens!!  OH and plenty of opportunities for bathroom stops all day so in hindsight I would have drank a lot more water!   There is time for a short hike after lunch and then some pics near the edge.   Back on plane and back to phoenix.

All in all a very enjoyable trip and very well organized.  Would do another trip with WW in a heartbeat and i faced my dislikes of small planes, helicopters and heights, all in one shot!  if i can do it, so can you!

review_title: Awesome sights in the sky!  Must do!
review_text: We had a wonderful flight seeing experience today on the Denali Flyer tour.  Kevin was our pilot and he made our time in the air worthwhile.  He was extremely knowledgeable about the area and pointed out noteworthy sights along the way.  We are so thankful to have had this chance to see the Alaska mountains from a different view!  Do not leave this out of your trip, if possible.  It was AMAZING!
Absolut atemberaubend und toll, der Rundflug zum Denali! Unser Pilot Kevin war super, hat uns viel erzählt und uns auf dem Flug alles genau gezeigt, besser geht es nicht!

We weren’t able to land or see Denali like we planned, because the weather wasn’t cooperating, but the tour we took was amazing!  Our pilot, Randy, was very informed on the glaciers, the topography, the climbers and the history.  The ride was smooth and the views stunning.  We saw a couple base camps, many of the climbers were in town waiting to get out...like the tours, problems to safely land.  The K2 staff was great to deal with, gave us the option of full refund if we didn’t want to go, or of course a reduced rate for trip we were able to take.  I’m glad we did!  Their office and airport is walking distance from Talkteeba town, where we stayed, but I also noticed K2 vans brining their customers back and forth too.

Our experience with SeaWind was amazing!  We took the flight to the Misty Fjords and landed on a lake at very high elevation in the mountains.  We had a beautiful sunny day.  The pilot, Saul (sp?), was great and provided a lot of information on what we were seeing.  The area in Alaska is so remote and beautiful.  It was great to have this opportunity to see it from high up.  I would recommend taking a flight if you can afford it.  Kind of a once in a lifetime opportunity.

We were a family of three so were placed with another couple.  The plane held six total.  Scheduling was easy and they were in contact when we arrived in Ketchikan on our cruise.  It is noisy so we were given headsets and were able to talk through these.  We did not see any bears but one mountain goat made an appearance.  Overall, awesome time.

I booked a flight through Instagram to feature on my travel/adventure blog. I loved seeing Oregon from the air! The Envi plane took me back to my childhood, flying in my grandpas plane! Overall great experience and loved how knowledable the pilot was of all he showed us! Thanks Envi!

review_title: Plane Hummer Canyon wow wow wow
review_text:
My husband I thoroughly enjoyed our plane ride to the Canyon with the pilot making sure we saw the beautiful canyon from above . Could not stop taking photos. When we arrived at the Canyon we took a prearranged hummer tour of the Canyon from the ground which was excellent! 
What a fantastic experience from beginning to end . Strongly recommend this bundled tour
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_text: The flight over the islands was fantastic.  Having a birds eye view have great perspective.  Thanks Eric!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: Fantastic trip, if you have a free day well worth going!
review_text:
Travelled with Westwind early February as part of 60th birthday treat whilst staying at Four Seasons, Scottsdale. 
Early pick up from hotel, travelled to airport picking p 2 more passengers so just 4 of s on trip.
Pilot Jeff flew  90 minutes in Cessna to Grand Canyon, spectacular views as you near the Grand Canyon.  Into helicopter on landing to be taken down to river for boat trip. We were really lucky as just the 4 of us on big boat with 'skipper' Nate who was very informative about the surrounding area. 
Back up onto rim in helicopter and then onto Skywalk which was truly amazing! Just the 4 of us on as the coaches had not yet arrived, although I understand that it can get very busy in the high season. 
Lunch on the rim of the canyon and then flight back to Phoenix. 
Lots of opportunity for photos and Jeff took plenty for us to savour when we got home. 
Cannot praise this company more, very professional and the tour was a delight, please try if you ave a free day, you will not be disappointed!

review_title: Best part of our Cruise Trip
review_text: We are so glad that we took this flight with Wings Over Kauai.  By air is the only way to see the whole island and the Na Pali Coast and by plane is the most affordable.  This was truly the best part of our 7 day Hawaiian cruise.

I surprised my girlfriend with a tour for her birthday. Amazing views and a incredibly knowledgeable pilot.

The flight was great, but sadly both of us had serious nausea. We don’t usually get motion sick. So if that sounds like you, just make sure to take some Dramamine.

The plane ride was absolutely amazing! We got to see beautiful views of the oceans, the valleys of Maui, Molokini, and Molokei. Getting a chance to fly the plane was so exciting! One of my favorite parts of our trip to Maui

We chose to do a Wings Over Kauai tour over a helicopter tour because it was quite a bit cheaper, and we have no regrets.  Yes, the helicopters can get a bit closer and can hover, but I felt we still saw everything they did.  It was absolutely amazing and we were below the clouds the whole time so you could see everything.  A great option for seeing the Napali coast during be rough winter months.  Our pilot Marcus was great and recited facts about the island as we flew over it which really brought the experience to life.  This was my husbands favourite part of the whole trip.  Highly recommend.

Super Vol 30mn de Grand Plaisir
Décollage à l’heure Plein les yeux au dessus du Grand Canyon
Hélicoptère Très stable
Grand Moment avec dans le casque de la bonne musique qui accompagne notre vol (Sting Christopher Cross John Williams...)

Ski plane trip around Denali mountain was fabulous then landed on Ruth Glacier. Scenery of mountains and multiple glaciers is vast, surreal & indescribable from above & close up. Took many photos. An experience of a lifetime that was pricey but worth every penny.  Quite awesome.
The flight was calm and view was beautiful.   The pilot gave us information about what we were seeing.  Free parking in a lot that is fenced in at night.

While in Kauai, we took the Air Ventures tour in order to see the interior of the island. The views were spectacular and the pilot did a great job of narrating the locations. You are able to see the island from a perspective different from land tours. We would recommend this tour to all travelers.

My husband and I took our 1 year-old daughter to Kauai. We booked the Best of Kauai land and boat tour at first thinking our daughter wouldn't be able to fly. When we changed our mind just an hour before flight time, Steve (of Northshore Limousine who led our tour) called and made arrangement. Not only we got our own private plane, we got Ray, the owner of Air Adventures, to be our captain. He was very knowledgeable about Kauai and was very considerate of our comfort during flight especially our little one. There was also wet cool towels for our use during flight to remain cool even though we didn't need them. And we used headsets to communicate with captain as well as for him to explain the scenery to us. Our girl fell asleep throughout the entire flight. There was a little turbulence here and there whenever we approached the mountains but felt the same compared to the turbulence in a big passenger plane. Ray always warned us about upcoming turbulence and got our input in fly direction such as when we wanted to see the Na'Pali coast from a different view. Overall, our experience was very enjoyable. I can't say enough about the scenery. The best way to see Kauai is by small plane like this. By land alone you can only see 10% of the island. I'm so glad we could do it.

review_title: Maverick Helicopters is a great grand canyon experience - must do in Las Vegas
review_text: We got there, checked in, they were very polite and the Helicopters were very comfortable. Please be punctual, otherwise your transfer will leave without you. 5 stars for Maverick

The view going over the crater is nothing short of spectacular. Takes a bit to get up to 10K feet but so worth the time. Our pilot, Steve, is excellent. Will book him for our next trip to see the cliffs of molakai!!

review_title: Great view, great pilot, and great experience
review_text: We were visited from out of town, and decided  to try something new. Best decision. We got Spencer as a pilot, and he was awesome. During the ride, he explained every super well, and made sure we were comfortable. The view was incredible. After the ride, he took some great pictures. Who knew he was also a photographer haha. This exceeded our expectations. Will definitely do this again when visiting. 10/10 would recommend to everyone.
Check one off of my bucket list!  It was spectacular - the flight, the landing, and walking around on the glacier.  Definitely a must-do!

This was incredible, amazing views of the mountain. It was raining during our original scheduled time, but we were fortunate that we were going to be in town for a couple of days so we’re able to reschedule, and they were great about that. It was windy the day we went, so there were some concerns about turbulence causing motion sickness (I’m really susceptible), but the pilot was great about staying out of super bumpy pockets of air. He also talked us through everything we were seeing, we learned a lot. Highly recommended.

review_title: Phenomenal experience with a truly professional company
review_text:
The sunset champagne seaplane tour is by far the best thing I have ever done!
This is a brilliant company to do it with, we arrived 30 minutes early but that was no bother for them, and we were soon up in the air.  We also had the plane to ourselves which was a real treat!
Our pilot was very knowledgeable and great at telling us about the scenery below.  The views were simply stunning, check out my pics!  
P.s. this was my first seaplane ride so i was a little apprehensive, to any first timers, there is absolutely nothing to be worried about, we had the smoothest ride ever, I can't wait to do it again.

The piolet was a very outgoing friendly man in a Hawaiian shirt!  He was a great piolet and super knowledge about the area, the topography and geology.  He answered all our groups questions with a clear, concise answers.  He was also personable and fun.  As a local he gave us a lot of information about the area as we flew.  This really was a great time.  

My husband was able to ride co-piolet and had an amazing one of a kind experience.  

The reason we did not give this a 5 is because we called ahead to see if the green route was flying.  They said yes and booked us but by the time we got there 3 hours later they were not flying this route and hadnt been all day.  While I understand it was because of weather I wished they had been a bit more upfront so I was able to make a fully informed decision.

Although expensive the experience is worth it.  If you go with K2 or another company it was amazing to see the park and mountains from the vantage point.  

Tips:
*Co-Piolet seat is AWESOME
*Ask a lot of questions 
*Be flexible as the weather determines flying. They may go up when you think they will not and vice versa.

I booked the the Alaska Bear Adventure on a Holland America cruise ship. They used this company. Everything was excellent. I do believe that the company is very safety conscious, the pilot was outstanding. The aircraft was an older plane: however, it appeared to be well maintained. It did have updated electronic displays on the dashboard, etc. The plane seats 7 counting the pilot, it had a 2-2-2-1 seat arrangement. FWIW, the lighter weight people were assigned the 3 seats in the rear.  Pickup from dock, safety orientation, flight to the "bear site", bear viewing, etc. were all excellent. I was a little worried at first, for the first 10 minutes or so we didn't see any bears; however, then they started coming down to feed. There was usually one or two at a time; however, one time there were three. They would continuously come, feed, and go. Sometimes a larger one would chase a smaller one away. Overall there were plenty of bears and lots of salmon in the water. Our guide (AJ) at the "bear site" was excellent too. In case you wondered, I didn't see any restroom facilities at the "bear viewing site".

The  flight was more then anticipated, you don't experience Alaska unless you fly and they are a great company to fly with. Saw lots of wildlife, glaciers and much more.  Everyone was great to work with, you can tell when someone truly enjoys what they do.
There location is beautiful, like out of a picture book.

During our vacation to Alaska one of our stop overs was the town of Talkeetna.  It is just below Denali National Park and is the home of K2 Aviation which is renown for its tour flights around Denali (Mt. McKinley) and glacier landings.  We went up on a Grand Tour of Denali along with the surrounding glaciers and lower peaks.  
It was, without any reservations, the most enjoyable and memorable part of the 1st. week we spent in Alaska.  The views were absolutely incredible.  We obtained over 50 beautiful photos that our friends continuously marvel over.  The flight was absolutely smooth.  A lot of the credit must go to our pilot Brian, however all the pilots are exceptionally experienced in negotiating mountainous terrain.
One of these flights is a must do if you plan on visiting Alaska.

The staff at Taquan air were nice and our pilot was very skilled (a flight instructor from Florida). 

The let down was the lack of interactive information during the flight. During the flight all information provided came from a recorded audio track, which provided general information about the area and some of its history. There was no information provided directly by the pilot about what we were flying over or what specific things we saw under the plane. 

Although the scenery was pretty, it was not spectacular. 

If you're going to book a flight while cruising in Alaska, I'd recommend a helicopter flight over a glacier, rather than a fixed wing flight over the fjords.

review_title: Pilot was great, the way the seating was handled not so great
review_text: We booked this nearly a year in advance for 5 of us.  The pilot was top notch and the views were amazing.  My little one (very use to flying) had some ear issues and he tried his best to alleviate them on our decent.  I was a bit disappointed because we weren't able to land; however being safe is most important.  The one thing that I didn't like is that we rode with another family who made sure they got right in the front and when the pilot announced that someone could sit in the co-pilot seat, I spoke up stating that my husband would really love to do that, yet the man in the other family went straight up there and sat down- HOW RUDE!  Their child also kept looking back at my daughter who was having ear issues.  I don't know when they booked, but perhaps they should have some sort of policy based on when you book as to who gets to do something special like that, or, if it is safe, let one person do it going up and another going back down.  I felt really bad for my husband and wanted to tell the other people off, but of course, would never do so in front of my daughter.
This trip was once in a lifetime. If we could give more than 5 stars I would. The views incredible!!

The best possible views over the beautiful Grand Canyon. 
Maverick were great throughout. Easy booking, efficient communications and great service.
Plenty of helpful commentary on the 50 minute South Rim tour.
A must-do experience.

review_title: In the Air Review of Kauai
review_text: Had a great time with Brian as the pilot.  This is the best way to see the island because so much is inaccessible from the road.  The company really goes out of the way to make your trip special.  The cruise boat was late in docking so they asked if we would mind waiting for 20 minutes to allow the "cruisers" to make it.  Well, they made it & we got more then an hour of air time to make up for being delayed.  Good employees & get event.

Although a premium price, the service was beyond anything you could imagine.  Booking was simple and easy.
On arrival, we were welcomed personally by Lindsay and offered coffee and treats.  Homemade brownies were excellent.  She introduced our pilot Brandon and he went to ready the plane.
We were escorted to the plane, given safety instructions and on our way.  The flight over Sedona and then over the canyon was amazing and Brandon was great with telling us a few things about what we were seeing.
After returning in the allotted 3 hours Lindsay asked questions about us and our stay.  It came out that I have stage 4 kidney cancer in my bones and she hugged me and my wife and shared her victory over cancer over 30 years ago.  Then in the parking lot, Brandon came to us.  We thought we forgot something, but he said Lindsay had shared our story and he had just lost his mom and previously his dad to cancer.  He is now working limited hours to care for his brother battling stage 4 cancer.  We all cried a little and Brandon commented he was meant to take us up today.
The people at this company truly cared.  They were not just kind and doing their job.  I know I have two more people praying for me in my battle.  I could not say more about these people.
Please know this is a business with a quality product that you should support.  You will not regret it.
Thank you Westwind.

We did the Canyon Dream airplane and helicopter tour in May. A truly fabulous experience with the most professional and friendly staff from start to end.  Collection from our hotel and a full day of pure enjoyment (Seven hours).   No photographs can project the beauty and sheer grandness of the canyon.  

My sister is an extremely nervous flyer but what a supberb flying experience this was.  The pilots taking us out to meet the helicopter were charming, enthusiastic and had a great sense of humour which all  made for an extremely positive  exerpience.    The pilot invited us up to the cockpit and took photographs for us.  Nothing was too much trouble and lots of interesting facts relayed throughout the plane trip. 

The helicopter trip itself over the south rim of the canyon was just breathtaking.   Again a great pilot, lots of chat and tremendous knowledge of the canyon.

There is also a driven tour through thre National Park taking you to scenic viewpoints to enjoy the  packed lunch provided.  We had a fabulous guide called Mike who was extremely knowledgeable and had a great sense of humour.  It is apparent that lots of care and thought is put into Mike’s tour.

We also did the evening flight down the Las Vegas strip, breathtaking! 

Can’t recommend this company highly enough. Each and every one of the people we met came across as enthusiastic, with an absolute passion to provide an unforgettable experience.

We came for a flight seeing tour of Denali but due to weather weren’t able to fly that day. I wish I had known to check my email on the morning of the trip, it would have saved me a long drive as they had sent a message telling us of the less than desirable weather. It was overcast and so we wouldn’t have been able to see Denali. We were rescheduled for the next day but the same occurred and they offered a flight seeing excursion around the Talkeetna valley area (sheep mountain). Although it was a bummer that we didn’t get the full Denali viewing tour (not their fault) the Talkeetna valley tour was fun. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable about the area. He took his time explaining the safety features and helped quell some other people’s fears of flying. We felt safe and comfortable the whole time. It’s a little awkward getting into the planes but there were was an older lady on our trip with a bad knee that the pilots and rampers were only too willing to help out. I would fly with this company again.

Our flight couldn't go to Denali and have any glacier landing due to weather. We were offered a full refund, a reschedule (not alot of availability) or to take a flight in different direction over Talkeetna area and have a partial refund. 
We tried to ask the day before about the status of flights and weather but they wouldn't commit to anything. We drove two hours from Anchorage to get there so we agreed to the alternative flight. We did see glaciers. 
They followed covid protocols with everyone in office wearing masks, needing masks to enter office area and required on the plane. They sent an email 1-2 days before  asking health screening questions.

review_title: great flight  with a great pilot
review_text: Talkeetna air provided a wonderful scenic flight around Denali. If you have the time to do the glacier landing it is well worth it. The entire operation was professional, the pilot very skillful. It is a different angle on the mountain.

Plane, pilot, ground crew were all amazing! Wanted to do a glacier landing but was unable to due to drought. We never regret doing the summit tour in place of that as it is an amazing view!  Highly recommend!!

If you are in the front you get a panoramic view of the canyon but in the back you get a panoramic view of the front passengers. Its very unfair that Maverick charge the same price whether you are in the front or the back of this helicopter. Very frustrating when three of the passengers are whooping with joy as they board..... As several reviewers have pointed out, if you are an average male you should expect to be in the rear seat and if you are in the middle dont expect to capture any decent photos. Sorry Maverick, but this is grossly unfair.
Es war ein absolutes Erlebnis! Unser Pilot hat uns während des Flugs viel erklärt und dann gab es Bilder mit dem Heli. Tipp - Lasst nach dem Flug Bilder mit dem Piloten von Mitreisenden machen.

It was fantastic we had a beautiful clear day.  The pilot was amazing, I was some what freaked out flying in a small plane but he flew with grace!   Landing on the glacier was the most amazing experience I have had.

What can I say - we booked the trip through the travel agent at home and can only say that you get superb value for your money. The flight was amazing - the pilot was so full of amazing information about the locality, culture and was really fun and friendly. The flight lasted 45 minutes but felt like longer. Have no doubt about booking with this company, the experience was brilliant. And the views you get of the Grand Canyon were to die for!!!! The chopper was well heated so we didn't need the thick coats we we took.
The flight around Denali with the glacier landing was spectacular! The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable. A must do in Alaska!!!

It was an incredible view of the island.  Gave us an overview of everything.  Really put things in perspective.  Especially enjoyed flying over the ridges and seeing the inaccessible parts of the island.
We saw all the grandeur of the cliffs, forests, mountains and the coastline.
The pilot was excellent.  Enjoyed his narrative, especially the historic parts.
I took a lot of video as well as some still pictures.  The ride is quite smooth except for a few mild wind turbulance which makes picture taking easy.
We feel like we have seen the whole island now.  Those views over the mountain tops will remain most vivid for a long time in my mind.
Mahalo for a great trip!
Denis & Terry Chicoine

Fantastic views of all 5 islands! Private with focused attention. Cannot recommend this enough, we have done helicopter tours of most Hawaiian islands and this plane ride was the best by far (no getting stuck in the middle seat or with strangers!!)
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: By far one of the most amazing things I’ve experienced! 100% recommend. Steve was super nice and guided us through the ride. Never gonna forget this moment.

The tour was amazing! Absolutely beautiful! Unfortunately, our 8 and 5 year olds both got sick. Our pilot, Eric was great. He was experienced and very knowledgeable about the island. Eric also was very sensitive to our kids and prepared with cold towels and water. Overall, we would do the tour again. Air Ventures and Eric were awesome.

Our pilot "JT" (22 years old) was amazing.  Gave us a lot of facts on Kauai and shown us some gorgeous views of the beaches.  The canyon, waterfalls and we got to see a whale breaching and playing in the ocean!

We were reluctant to take this trip over the glaciers, but collectively the three of us decided that this might be a once in a lifetime opportunity. With marginalized enthusiasm we met Dan and away we went. I hasten to tell you that Dan was informative, enthusiastic, interested in what we were most interested in seeing and was the difference maker in a "should do" to advocates as a "must do" for everyone we meet, Dan was awesome; personable and professional, and the trip overlooking the glaciers was phenomenal. We even chose a pathway back through what we called the green passage...Just breathtaking. We are hoping to receive a video of our own trip. Just do it, you will have no regrets!!! Tip: You will not need to be bundled with lots of clothing.

The views you get on this tour are breath taking. There are places on the islands you would never be able to see except by small plane or boat which makes the entire experience exceptional. 
This  is a small business so changes are possible but not cancelations. In their fine print it clearly explains that any refunds are at their discretion so be mindful of that.
The only thing I really didn't like and the reason I deducted 1 star is because when the trip was over and the operator had been paid we were held up until everyone completed their review and he stood over everyone in the group to ensure he only received 5 star reviews and even coached what he thought you should write. I didn't like that. If people feel pressured to write you a 5 star review, how honest is it? Let the tour speak for itself. 
Also, the ad says you do as much or as little as you want, that it's a flying lesson but really its just a photo op. You really only take the controls for a few minutes. Long enough for him to take a picture of you with your hands on the controls, and he held the pictures he took for us until he got all of his 5 star reviews from each of us. 
It was a worthwhile experience. Total expenses out the door including tip it was just under a $1000 for 3 people for about an hour of actual flying.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: An amazing experience that's more than worth the money.  Experienced pilots in a comfortable plane show you sights only God could create.  Beautiful doesn't begin to describe the trip!  Have your camera ready...and spring for the glacier landing!  It was awesome!!
This was an amazing excursion.  Our pilot was J.T. and he was very friendly and provided us with a great experience.  I would highly recommend this to others.  It is well worth the time and money!!

Highly recommend seeing the Grand Canyon from the air.  There are a couple of helicopter tours that leave out of the Tusayan airport.  Maverick is on the back side, or the second entrance coming from the town.  We took a 45 minute tour which was a good amount of time for us.  During check in you, and anything you will be carrying on the helicopter, are weighed.  The scale reading is displayed on the computer screen, behind the counter.  The company uses this information to distribute the weight on the helicopter.  The helicopter seating arrangement is the pilot plus three people in the front; and four people across the back.  We only had the pilot plus 5 passengers, so the two center backseat chairs were empty.  Maverick says all seats have a view, but not really.  Those two seats don't have an unobstructed view in any direction. However, if you're feeling anxious about it, maybe those are the seats for you.  But, in my opinion, looking down is the reason seeing the Grand Canyon from the air is so amazing. You wear a 4 point harness.  The helicopter rotors were stopped before we got on and off.  Our pilot was okay.  My impression is that he was newer to the area and didn't have much additional information outside the script. But I guess we all start somewhere.  He was professional and our flight was smooth.  The only stomach dip was when we flew over the rim going into the canyon for the first time.  The tour we took didn't go very deeply into the canyon.  It was an incredible view.  After the flight we were able to take lots of pictures, and weren't rushed at all.  They also sell a video of your flight.

Very wonderful experience, to see whales from the air is amazing
非常精彩的经历，从空中可以看到很多鲸鱼，而且还不晒，eric非常友好，对茂宜岛的介绍也很嗲，还可以自己驾驶一下飞机，很特别的体验，赞一个

My husband and I (and our three year old) had a fantastic tour of the island with Wings Over Kauai.  At half the cost of a helicopter tour and much longer, we thought it was a great value.  But more important than the cost was the personal experience we got from Mary and Bruce.  Bruce (our pilot) gave us a great tour of the island, including a short side trip to find whales (which we did).  The Napali is simply breathtaking.  Words can't express just how beautiful this side of the island is.  If you're in Kauai, you must take an air tour and definitely consider taking one with Wings Over Kauai.  You won't be disappointed.

review_title: Awesome views of Kauai from the air!
review_text:
Very nice tour of the whole island,
My suggestion:before you take flight here, tour the island by car;you will be in awe when you see the sights from a different perspective!
We were sitting on opposite sides of the plane,both taking pictures,even at that the pilot Paul even banked back so we both got some awesome shots.

The clouds parted as we approached Denali and my jaw dropped. The glorious twin peaks came into view veiled with misty clouds and the sun drenched snow covered shear walls of granite blew my mind. We circle heaven for 30 minutes and then dropped down to follow Ruth glacier all the way back home. 

This was my second trip to Talkeetna. The first time it rained and I never saw the mountain so this time I allowed three days to stay flexible with flying times. Sure enough it rained on our scheduled flight time but K2 was very good about rescheduling for the next day and even suggested I call before my flight time to see if there was and opening for our group to land on the glacier. Unfortunately the rain made the glacier to soft for landing so K2 offered a one hour flight only tour. We all agreed it was an amazing experience anyway. 

My father was very afraid to fly on such a small plane. Our pilot took off and landed the Otter plane so quickly we could not even feel it. He gave us safety instructions before taking off and a good verbal tour of the mountain during the flight. 

Do it!
It was amazing and well worth the $160 which took just over 1 hour. The pilot made sure everyone in the aircraft could see all the scenery.

My wife and I been to this Island numerous amout of times, this is our new favorite activity ! Eric teached us how to take off the runway and helped us fly the plane to hana and back . We felt very safe and comfortable at all time! 
We already planning to do it again next time with friends :)
Great flight, it was a wonderful time! We saw some amazing sights. The waterfalls and volcanos were great!

review_title: Awesome sites in a very smooth ride...
review_text: Awesome sites in a very smooth ride!  Extremely friendly service!  Breathtaking views, especially, the na poli coast!!!  Highly recommend this tour!!!!

Our family of four including two young children did the Misty fjords seaplane sightseeing tour.  Everything went perfectly well. From the bus pick up to the drop off at the Seaport to meeting with the pilot and getting on board, it was a fantastic experience.  Our pilot was Louis who is a fourth-generation pilot.  We flew in the Haviland Beaver.  The plane sat six passengers plus pilot.  My husband got to sit up front with the pilot and had a wonderful time.  The flight was perfect from take off and travel over the mountains to the fjord where we landed and were able to get off the plane at a floating dock.  The Misty fjords lake was beautiful and we were able to get out and take pictures of the family and look for wildlife.  After 10 to 15 minutes we re-boarded and took off for the return flight back to the Seaport. Louis was a great pilot and narrated during the entire flight.   If you are looking for a fun adventure for the family, I would highly recommend The flight tours..

review_title: Excellent customer service at 1/2 cost of other air tours!
review_text: We were hesitant about booking an airplane tour since my husband really wanted a helicopter tour, but I experience some motion sickness. After reading some of the "Wings over Kauai" reviews, we heard others proclaim this tour was just as good as a helicopter tour. Although we have nothing to compare it to, this company knows how to treat their customers & were extremely friendly. The tour was excellent and the pilot had a great landing. We both got a little motion sickness at the very end of the flight, but we would do it again. It is an awesome way to see the sights at less than 1/2 the price of a helicopter tour.

The biplane was incredible. The pilot Harry was great, professional and extremely informative. The middle of the island leaves you speechless. Highly recommend to anyone wether you are local or visiting. Seeing everything from that perspective is beyond words.

Incredible staff and procedures at all points: booking, reception, explanations, pilot. We had high expectations and were still blown away. 100% worth it to land o the glacier. Great views from every window - and it doesn't matter which side of the plane you sit on.Thanks TAT!

review_title: If you do Not need a car on the Island, take the plane, you will love it
review_text: Friday Harbor sea planes  located in  Renton.  20 min from SeaTac.  Great pilots   If you can afford it will save 5-6 hours by going by ferry.  They are Friendly, knowledgeable and good pilots.   Plane is old but we felt safe.   the pilot will give everyone headsets so he can point out interesting properties or if spots some Orca.  It is definitely the way to go to the San Juan Islands.
The pilot was amazing, very smooth take off and landing is perfect. Great views and great comments from the pilots on locations.
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: We took a flight seeing excursion with K2 as part of a tour so all the arrangements were made for us except for the weather, of course.  Poor weather conditions around Denali made it impossible for us to see "the great one" but K2 came up with a flight plan that included extensive aerial views of the fascinating forest growth patterns interspersed with glacial river routes, moose, bear and homestead habitat, and we still got to see amazing glaciers in the Alaska range.  It was a smooth flight from start to finish and our pilot, Chip, was very knowledgeable about the flora, fauna, glaciers and the importance of aviation in Alaska history.  If we ever have the chance and the weather is right, we'll be flying with K2 to see Denali someday.

We ended up in Talkeetna on a clear day so we booked our flight as soon as we arrived to take advantage of the weather. The plane was awesome and so was the flightseeing. It was so much fun that I would do it again. If the cost seems high, please know that it's 100% worth it.
Weather made landing on glacier be cancelled.  However, flight and pilot were great, and just as we got near, the clouds cleared, and we saw Mount Denali.  Got amazing photos.  Thank you.
Seeing all of the different views and the pilots knowledge of the island. Perfect time if day to do an air tour of Maui.
My favorite part was seeing the immensity of the landscape.  The pilot was great at explaining what we were seeing and covering a lot of territory.  Everyone was so nice.
Simply flying above the areas that were breath taking. Steve is an awesome pilot and very professional.

review_title: One of the best days of our holiday!
review_text: We booked our flight from the UK the whole process was easy. We arrived at the heliport on a fantastic blue sky morning. The check in process was seamless, the staff friendly and informative. We were lucky enough to sit at the front of the helicopter with the pilot and had the best views ever. The trip was amazing, interesting and everything that we had hoped it would be. My husband is not the best traveller but he was put at ease and thoroughly enjoyed his flight. It was very expensive but worth every penny and we would not have missed it and would recommend it to everyone.

It was our second visit in Kauai. The first one, our boat ride to Na Pali was cancelled du to weather. This time, again! We looked for another way to see that wonder of Nature.

Chopper rides seemed interesting, but were pretty expensive. We came about Wings over Kauai.

What a wonderful tour of the island. Bruce, our pilot (and owner) was a great host and very knowledgeable. The tour lasted a bit over an hour. The views are simply breathtaking. We went all around the island and got a chance to see the Canyion as well as the Na Pali coast plus a multitude of other sites (Wailua falls). The ride was very smooth, we couldn't asked for more! 
We ended our tour with a very thoughtful gift (a surprise). 

Thanks again Bruce for communicating your love for this land.
Gilbert and Valerie 

P.S. If you get the chance we strongly recommend you get the hole tour in HD quality. It's only 50$ but well worth seeing it all again.

Steve and Leslie have a family owned and operated float plane operation.  They called promptly after the cruise ship disembarked and made arrangements to meet us. Steve explained a lot about the area that we flew over and set us down gently on a beautiful mountain lake. He pointed out a bear! 

Highly recommend. Please know those with mobility issues may have trouble getting in and out of the plane due to stepping on the pontoon then up into the plane. Also it’s a tight fit inside. If we are ever there again will look them up!
It was a wonderful experience. Thank you! Super great. Yay. Would do again. Beautiful. Nice guy. Good company.

Steve was our pilot and it was a smooth ride all the way. We didn’t have to worry about window seat because this plane only has window seats. So, great view from all angles. Definitely recommend this tour.

review_text: Great service and fantastic views. Well worth the price. Weather was great and aircraft comfortable.

Excellent excursion the trip was super nice, good customer service, 100% recommended.
recommended to all couples to have a good time.

The flight was absolutely great, it was my anniversary.
and everything was stunning.
the pilot made our flight so much fun and gave us a lot of information about Miami.
100/100 recommended.

review_title: Scenic Rollercoaster Ride Above the Bay!
review_text: What an experience that was! The flight was an incredible adventure. Seaplane tours are the perfect way to celebrate the birthday of a loved one. We had such a great time. Thank you!

We did the Grand Tour of Denali with the glacier landing through K2 Aviation.  We were very fortunate to have a perfectly clear day.  Our pilot, Mike, was excellent, telling us all about what we were seeing, providing a perfect landing on the glacier, taking pictures for us and even finding us some bears to check out on the flight back!  We felt like we could reach out and touch the mountain.  There are no words to truly capture this experience.  If you have the opportunity to do this excursion do not pass it up!

We booked the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing flight and it was fantastic! The folks at Talkeetna Air provided a pick-up transfer for our morning departure and check-in was smooth. I highly recommend wearing the overboots, even if you have waterproof shoes as the snow may be deep and the overboots will protect your pants legs from getting wet. We were fortunate that the weather was amazingly clear and we saw Mt. McKinley. We landed on Ruth Glacier and had an amazing time.

review_title: Safety conscious, enjoyable and eye opening flight
review_text: Although this was a fair chunk of money, we decided to do this flight and also paid for a glacier landing. We did the  Mountain Voyage with Glacier landing. The pilot was very upfront and said for our safety they were not doing glacier landings, so that part was refunded to us.  It was really awesome to see Denali from this perspective as well as the surrounding areas.  We were very lucky as the previous few days they could not go up or they could not see the full mountain (I forgot which).  We all got to take photos from all angles.  Well worth doing.

review_title: Amazing!!! A must do while in Alaska
review_text: This was an amazing experience. The pilot was really great. The views were breathtaking. Highly recommend this to anyone.

review_title: Must do experience while in Moab!!
review_text:
I can without a doubt say this was the highlight of our Moab trip! 
Checking in at the airport was a breeze, and our captain was so friendly. He gave us a ton of informational narration during our flight and made us feel so safe the whole time. Moab is definitely something that needs to be seen from above, as it's unique landscape made for amazing photographs and memories that I will cherish for the rest of my life. If you are in the area, I can not recommend a scenic flight with Redtail Air Adventures enough.

We enjoyed Seaplane Adventures to celebrate a milestone birthday and what a treat it was! The pilot, who must have done this tour a multitude of times, did not seem one bit jaded and told us interesting information about everything we were seeing with ease and genuine enjoyment in his voice. We have lived in this area for 40 years and this was a very different and pleasurable way to experience it!

Amazing experience. Professional & courteous staff. Pilot was excellent. If you like to make lasting memories land on a glacier & make a snow angel........This is the company to go with. I will certainly be back.....

Talkeetna Air Taxi took us to the summit of Denali and it was awesome! Thorough, safe, and most informative! We couldn't see Denali from inside the park so we really enjoyed seeing it from the air. We couldn't land on it because of clouds but the views were enough. Ask for Chris, he knew so much about Denali and was really great to listen to. Felt safe in his hands.

review_text: We paid to get a ride on a 30 seater and were taken on the tarmac to a beater silver plane in the back. The plane had clank noises when turning on the runway. If you ever felt nervous about turbulence on a big commerical plane you will contemplate your existence bouncing around in turbulence in a 8 seater, especially over the canyon.

review_text: Kevin, the pilot, did a very good job of giving us a great tour of the Island. He and his staff were very good at making us feel welcome and accomodating our needs.

We took off in light rain. The rain cleared and we were able to see the beautiful island. Rain moved in heavier and we were forced to land for a short time at Port Allen. Safety was priority. After a short period, we were able to return. Thanks Paul for a wonderful trip.

Bird's eye view of Moolakai island was amazing.
Eric's story telling gave a unique perspective to island.
I will do this again
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text:
We chose Wings Over Kauai as my boyfriend had never been on a small plane, and it was MUCH cheaper than the helicopter tours (our tour was $300). This company had the best customer service ever! On our scheduled day, we arrived early and Mary got us checked in, weighed, etc. The wind was really picking up and it looked like a big rainstorm was moving in. Mary checked with Marcus (the pilot) to see how conditions were elsewhere on the island. Marcus replied that conditions were not very good for sightseeing and getting worse. He and Mary suggested that we should cancel for the day and try again the next morning, in the hopes of a much better trip. Note: we had booked an afternoon trip but Marcus and Mary said that morning trips are usually a better bet for good weather and visibility. We got booked onto a tour the next morning with no problem and at no charge.
Meanwhile, we asked Mary for recommendations on what to do since it looked like a thunderstorm was moving in. She suggested going to the west or south side of the island which she said was usually sunny. Since we had a Jeep, she recommended we go to Polihale Beach. This turned out to be breathtaking, and we were so glad she recommended it!
The next morning we went on our tour. There were two other people with us, and we all had window seats. Also provided in the plane were waters, cool wet towels, ginger candies, and ginger ale for motion sickness. My boyfriend got motion sick, and the pilot and other passengers were most helpful in helping me get him the towels, ginger, etc. to feel better.
Marcus was an excellent guide, and had personal stories about some of the sights we saw, as well as general information, which helped make the flight tour that much better.
We had our picture taken with the plane before flight, and when we returned, we got a CD with our picture and some of the music that was played during the flight. Unlike some other companies, there was no charge for this great souvenir.
We thought the plane tour was better than doing a helicopter tour as we were able to fly higher and get better views and pictures of sights such as the Na Pali coast. We saw helicopters that were flying lower and closer to the cliffs, but we preferred to have our views of the entire cliff from top to bottom, instead of just a small portion of the cliffs.
This was our favorite thing we did on Kauai, this is a must-do!

review_title: 3 trips to Alaska, 3 generations of family, K2 Aviation flightseeing, 1st Class experience!
review_text: K2 and our pilot, Chris, were great about accommodating same-day booking and trip through the Denali range. After 3 visits to Alaska in 5 years, Denali finally opened up to us and K2 provided an outstanding experience! Our party represented 3 generations of family and we all walked away amazed by the beauty of the area.

review_title: Awesome way to see the island.
review_text: Great way to see the beauty of Kauai!!   The picture they took in front of the plane and emailed had us with the pilot.  That's all well and good but for the money, I should have asked to have one of just us only.

We use Tripadvisor as our  personal travel guide, and that is how we found Wings Over Kauai. Not comfortable with helicopters, we chose this method of seeing the Napali coast.  Wow! It was so nice to have such a personal touch. Bruce and Ellen made us feel comfortable from the minute we arrived.  The flight was excellent, Bruce was a terrific pilot and very knowledgable about the island. We were able to see the entire island, and it was a thrill all the way. We were surprised with a kukui lei for me, and at the end of the flight a 10 minute DVD with highlights of the tour taken by Bruce's videographer-son, plus a photo of us on the DVD case.  Booking online was easy.  I highly recommend this company!

The folks at K-2 were awesome.  Garret was super and Adam the pilot was extremely knowledgeable.  Flightseeing may seem pricey, but it is worth ever penny!!  We wanted to see Denali, but the weather on the mountain was bad.  K-2 came up with a great alternative.
Estuvo muy genial la experiencia, yo puedo recomendar para cualquier persona ya que es algo que no se puede realizar con facilidad.
