review_title: Fantastic Experience - Denali Sightseeing and Glacier landing - Professional and seamless
review_text:
We flew up on a fixed wing plane to Mt. Denali on the glacier and had a fantastic time. The glacier landing went vey smoothly The views were incredible and the organisation of the whole experience was just easy. We were in a group of six and some that were a bit hesitant on flying. Steve is a young Pilot and took it all in his stride and explained the process and was very informative being a local. 
We asked him all kinds of questions and he was very helpful
We took coats and gloves but didn't really need them.Cameras are a must.
K2 provides over shoe covers and that made it easy walk on the glacier

The best days to go when there are no cloud cover

Thanks Katherine and Barry for a wonderful trip!  You guys made it happen and we had a spectacular time!!

Chuck and Cheryl

My husband and I totally agree with the other positive ratings that are given to Bruce with his Wings  over Kauai.  We had to deal with rain, clouds and WIND - but Bruce still was able to pull off an incredible flight for us, flying around clouds to give us the best views.  The wind was blowing us around a bit, and it was very comforting to know that Bruce was at the wheel.  He provided a very safe trip and was very concerned how we were feeling, quick to see to our comfort and to calm any fears.  We'll only fly with him when we are in Kauai!  Thank you Bruce.

Our flight to the Grand Canyon was a great experience for my daughter and myself. It was a beautiful flight with fantastic views of the Canyon. My daughter is a student pilot and was able to sit in the right
seat and converse with our pilot throughout the flight. This made it even more special for her since our pilot was a women and they seemed to hit it off from the get go. I would highly recommend Westwind Air Service for anyone interested in viewing the Grand Canyon by air.
The whole experience was amazing! It was the best, breathtaking - have to see to believe it…and the pilot was great! Highly recommend!!
The flight was so fun! I highly recommend this experience. I would do this again in a heart beat. You will not find these views anywhere else.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: Amazing bear viewing tour of Tongass National Forest
review_text: We had an amazing bear watching tour of the Tongass National Forest with our guide, Mark.  It was on September 4th, 2017, the weather was beautiful, the pilot was great and narrated our trip.  The departure/arrival area was very clean and everyone was very professional.  Mark greeted us at the dock at Tongass, we took a short drive to the trail where he gave us a safety briefing.  We walked down the trail to the viewing platform where there was already 1 bear fishing and along came several others.  One bear came up on the platform where we were standing, Mark did a great job quietly directing us to the corner, asked everyone to be quiet and he stood in front of us.  It was thrilling, yet I felt safe.  He also told us that the noise we heard was a cub crying for its mother and pretty soon a cub climbed down a tree!  It was wonderful.  I highly recommend this tour, Mark and Taquan Air.   Plan your trip to take this tour!

review_title: Yes, you can ride in an open cockpit biplane.
review_text: This was something I always wanted to do but never thought possible. A beautiful ride with my wife.  Quite smooth with good views of the island.

It was a amazing flight,
K2 aviation, have a fantastic staff, and the pilot, that flew was very nice with the explanation, about the the rivers, mountains glaciers, etc..
Also the landing in the galcier was espectacular.

Thanks for the ride K2 Aviation.

Greetings.

Alejandro Ferrara Quintanilla (mexico).

One thing to do before you leave Alaska, land on the Denali ice field.  At 7,000 ft, the mountain is another 13,000 ft above you, sky is bright blue and air is SO fresh.  Go on a sunny day, when a High Pressure system is present and bring a bottle of Champagne!

took a great flight to Denali!  Could not do the glacier landing as it had just snowed 5 feet, but it was a great flight.  Everyone has a window seat, the pilot flies so that both sides get to see everything.  Really beautiful!

As a part of our wedding my beautiful wife booked us a whale watching flight. It was a great experience we saw many whales and a lot of other great sites too and we learned a lot too. It was an unforgettable day.

review_title: Best way to see Grand Canyon
review_text:
The Grand Canyon is SO Vast, it's the fastest, best way to see the whole thing.  It was hard to take it all in... so much to look at.  We saw Bison grazing in field, saw many formations that Vern told us about, and their names & he answered any questions we had while in flight with our mic/headsets on each person. (we had 3 women, 3 men w pilot Vern)  This was always on my bucket list, I loved it, a great investment in a great experience.  The only time I was a bit scared was coming up to the crest of a butte, the wind was strong in Nov. and pushed us around a bit, but we were fine.  
There were wild horses at the airport too!

We had taken a helicopter trip the last time we were in Kauai, but we were both pleasantly surprised that this plane trip was much more enjoyable. Josh, the captain, gave a great narration of all the beautiful sights we were seeing. We were able to see more of the island; the service and quality of the flight was excellent! Would highly recommend this company to travelers!

review_title: Eco Star Helicopter Grand Canyon 45 minute tour
review_text: Very disappointed, my husband & I were both seated in back. Viewing back of people’s head and their seats

review_title: "A Must" for seeing the Kaua'i you can't see by car
review_text:
We had a most wonderful experience today with the "Wings over Kauai"  (WOK) tour.  We have opted in the past to take helicopter tours, but this peaked our interest after reading reviews on Trip Advisor.  

We were not disappointed.  Ellen took our reservation and Captain Bruce, our pilot, was friendly, knowledgeable and engaging as he took us around the island in his Cesna airplane and showed us sights on Kaua'i that one ONLY gets to see by plane or by boat.  He had a lot of information about the island, its history, its flora and fauna.  We got to ask questions of the captain, as we wore the Bose noise canceling headphones with microphones, provided to each person on the trip..  

The flight lasted a whole hour.  When we returned, we were given a gift - a CD of the journey that was produced by the son of Bruce and Ellen.   It was a lovely parting gift that will provide memories of the trip whenever we watch.  What a nice surprise that was after such a beautiful experience.  

Thanks again to WOK, We HIGHLY recommend this tour if you are traveling to Kaua'i.

In a float plane which carried 5 passengers, 4 of us had a smooth flight viewing snow-capped mountains, we saw lakes sitting on different levels in gullies, landed on a lake midway of our flight, in beautiful clear weather.  I had booked this excursion before we left Australia and was pleased that I had.

review_title: Great Tour of Kauai - Great Staff - Excellent Experience
review_text:
From the moment we called Wings over Kauai we were immediately greeted with a warm/friendly voice.  Maren was wonderful and provided us with great information.  They were very accomodating and she relieved any anxiety I had regarding flying (I'm 5 1/2 mos pregnant).  It was a very simple reservation process and in less than 10 minutes we were booked.  We arrived the morning of our flight (we took the 9:30am) and found that we had the plane all to ourselves! bonus! We met with Ellen and Capt'n Bruce (owners) who were extremely friendly that provided a warm welcome.  Ellen reviewed the tour map with us (which covers the entire island) and as we boarded Bruce made us feel extremely comfortable. Ellen also provided refreshments for the flight.  The tour was awesome and the views were absolutely gorgeous (it was approx 65-70 mins long).  Bruce made sure to point out all of the "must see" areas and was very well-versed in the island's history. (He also has a great sense of humor!) Overall this tour is a must.  They provide a very personal experience and their rates are extremely reasonable (compared to the other pricey companies).  
Thank you Bruce, Ellen and Maren!

Our review is being posted a bit late, but I wanted to make sure I added our review.  We did the Wings Over Kauai tour the last week of October.  As many of the other reviews have mentioned, Bruce and Ellen were wonderful, courteous, genuine and professional.  

We were afforded a wonderful and educational view of Kauai - we were able to take some fantastic photos, but most of all, we were able to view a large portion of Kauai - most of which is not accessible to most travelers on the ground.  

We highly recommend this tour.  it was half the price of a helicopter tour and we felt we got our money's worth and more.  Bruce and Ellen were wonderful to work with.

review_title: very old not romatic at all!!
review_text: Experience is not worth it AT ALL The plane is very old and not clean. It is embarrassing for a date. They did not give us champagne

Great experience. One of the best activities on our trip to Kauai, There was a sudden rain shower before our flight which only lasted minutes but left beautiful rainbows for us to enjoy from the air. The pilot was excellent and provided commentary on all the sites we were seeing. Beautiful views of the beaches and waterfalls. Waimea canyon was awesome. Highly recommend seeing Kauai from the air with Air Ventures Hawaii. Reasonably priced.

There no way to see all beauty of Kauai except from the air. We're so glad we decided fly with Air Ventures, the pilot did a great job showing us the Island and sharing his knowledge. Everyone who takes this trip will be glad they did. Thank you to the staff for an enjoyable trip, the memories are priceless.

The flight it’s self though cut short was fabulous and I would have loved to have received what I paid for. Unfortunately due to smoke in the canyon the company was only able to fly the shorter route missing about 65% of the canyon.

My husband and I loved the tour. Our pilot Paul was great; sharing lots of interesting things about movies filmed nearby, as well as history of each area as we passed over.  I was lucky enough to get to sit up front with him! 
It was a great chance to see the island from a different perspective. The island is so beautiful and rugged. A view from the air is a must to really see it all!
Entiendo sus políticas, pero no dan soluciones  ni son considerados cuando uno no puede llegar al tour por problemas que se salen de nuestras manos, más si es primera vez que uno visita Miami.

review_title: Awesome Hike but NOT at Denali National Park
review_text: This is a bit of a mixed experience for us.  The floatplane ride to Caribou lodge was wonderful - the guided hike from Caribou Lodge at Boomerang Lake was really awesome - Zack showed us amazing tundra plant life - his family at Caribou lodge opened our eyes with their lifestyle and their hospitality.  So full points to them for our delightful hiking experience.  But due to cloudy conditions  the flight service to view Denali National Park from the air was canceled (the float plane service reimbursed us very promptly for the missed portion of the trip).  Here's my issue - the blurb states "Experience Denali National Park from the air and at ground level"  The clouds made us miss the "from the air portion" and we accept with gratitude what Mother Nature grants us, but there was *never* a chance of experiencing Denali NP "at ground level."  So by following this ad, we missed out on visiting Denali National Park on a once in a lifetime trip to Alaska, and that was disappointing indeed.  The ad needs to be clear that there is NEVER a chance to experience Denali National Park *at ground level* with this service. If the weather permits, you see DNP from the air, but you never get to DNP at ground level, no matter what.
A truly brilliant experience. Flew with my wife and two teenage childten. Our pilot BJ provided a great tour which was a real highlight of our family's roadtrip. Definitely recommend.

Several friends from England recommended that we take this helicopter tour if we were going to visit the Grand Canyon, and we are sure glad we did.  It is fairly pricey, but we can't imagine there's any other way to get an overview of the vastness and beauty of the Grand Canyon.  We did a 3pm tour, so the sun was not directly overhead but the shadows were not so long as to hide parts of the canyon.  Make sure you do the 50 minute/1 hour tour and not a shorter one -- it's hardly enough time to take it all in.

Super schöne Skyline Tour über Miami!
Freundliche Begrüßung und Erklärungen. Es wird sich Zeit genommen für Fotos und Informationen. Der Pilot erklärt worüber er fliegt und was sich wo befindet. Er geht auf deine Fragen und Wünsche ein. Rundum ein super Preis Leistungs Verhältnis! Ein unvergessliches Erlebnis!

7 of us went flight seeing with this company. We explained that our Florida grandchildren had never seen snow. We landed on a glacier and had a snowball fight! The pilot said the weather was beginning to look ominous and he cut the trip short. No one could tell. They refunded $700. If you want to flight see pick this company. No second choice

review_title: Smooth flying, fantastic view of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Fantastic service - Leslie in the office is an absolute treasure and our pilot was very professional and obliging. Superb views of the canyon - felt very safe & comfortable. Other passengers also very friendly. One very pleased 'aussie'!
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_title: Excellent air tour around Kauai island
review_text:
I was interested in doing the first flight of the day but it was full so I booked for the second one of the day.
Anyway, as I took the rental car at the airport passed by to the company and they told me that there was a place in the first flight of the day. So I could do the tour immediately and then going to visit the island.
I was also lucky with the weather because little by little the cloud disapper and we had some sunshine.
Good explications from the pilot and excellent service provided.
And of course seeing the island for the airplane is amazing.

review_title: Terrific views of Canyon but not much explanation of what we saw
review_text:
We had a 35-40 minute flight in a small plane around parts of the canyon, which is spectacular.  Looking down from a small plane into the canyon provides incredible views.

It was a little hazy the day we visited because of forest fires.  We understand the airline can't control nature.

However, there was very little explanation of what we were seeing.  This would have been much better with more narration.

Great tour! Covered the whole island and saw views of Waimea canyon and the Nepali coast that can not be duplicated by land or sea (we did both). The expanse of coffee crops was way larger than I expected and of course, the beaches were endless strips of gorgeous. 
HIGHLY recommended.

We treated ourselves to the Denali Flyover with a glacier landing and we are so glad we did. Spectacular views of Denali! Incredible to actually be standing on a glacier. Everyone was so polite and professional throughout our whole experience. Our pilot was so knowledgable and went out of his way to make sure everyone was enjoying themselves.  He even made a slight detour in order to show us moose as we were returning to the airstrip. We felt safe and secure throughout the flight. Highly, highly recommend it.

review_title: The tip top of our trip (pun intended)
review_text:
My mother lives in Talkeetna and she has always raved about her trip to the glacier on the top of Denali.  When I brought my adult sons to visit, she encouraged me to go.  We booked through the Alaskan Lodge we were staying in and they chose TAT although I have heard that K2 aviation was also very good.
The airplane held 12 passengers and we all wore headsets to hear the pilot.  Our pilot gave us lots of interesting information about the mountain, glaciers, the climbers we saw on the mountain, climbing the mountain facts, etc. and kept us entertained during the flight.
One lucky passenger was able to ride in the front seat next to the pilot. The windows in the back were adequate to take short video clips from my phone that showed how close the steep mountain sides were to us.  A still photo did not give enough scale because these rocks and ice walls are immense. 
Landing on the glacier on a sunny summer day was exciting.  The snow was slushy and luckily they provided waterproof booties to cover our shoes and pants.
This is a must-see experience for anyone who wants to get up close and personal with Denali.

wiew from there is something else not from this world tour gay pilot is really nice. much better sight than from the boat  tours pilot explain sights so you got the picture right from the very start .tell us about not just the place hi tell us about history off kauie.really amasing tour

We did the bi plane flight with Kevin and it was so wonderful.  The sights and the experience were terrific.  Cannot say how much we enjoyed learning more about the island from Kevin.  And seeing such amazing things.  Flew through a rainbow!

Supper happy with this trip! From our arrival to the airport, the staff was friendly and welcoming. Our pilot was incredibly knowledgeable and went out of his way to make sure we had a good experience. I would recommend this to anyone!

Bus was clean n comfortable.  Driver was knowledgeable and friendly. The guided tour information on the bus was nice n interesting. The ride was smooth and we had plenty of time to see all of the canyon.  Heat was super depressing but there are plenty of accessibly for everyone. Lunch was include n was good. Take plenty of water n extra snacks! Dry heat can be difficult to beat.

Friends of ours had taken a trip with Seawind before so we were quite happy to go with their recommendation. We were on a cruise but booked this excursion privately. They picked us up and took us to their nearby office. I asked if we would need binoculars and they said it wouldn’t be much of a trip if you needed them. Whilst they do not guarantee bears they were pretty sure we would see some. The 20 minute flight is very smooth and we are met at Traitor Cove by our guide Drew and his very large gun. It is a quick drive to the sighting area and short walk in to a secluded “hide” to watch for bears. We knew they were around as there was some evidence. After a very short wait we saw bears coming down to the water to hunt for salmon, without much luck. However just watching the bears was a fantastic experience. Drew was an excellent guide, although the jokes he tells need some work. The flight back was great as well and the pilot even responded to a request to fly over a lodge owned by some friends. On arrival back at Ketchikan they were going to take us back to the ship but when we asked for a good place to eat they went out of their way to take us to a local restaurant. This was an epic journey. Seawind are a first class operation. Thanks guys.

review_title: Great ride with only one problem
review_text: For 3 of us in our party of 4, it was great. However for my wife, it was certainly disappointing. Three of us sat on the right side of the plane and had great looks of the sites. The wife was seated on the left side of the aircraft, and since the flight itinerary took us mostly in a clockwise direction around the island, the wife's view was primarily of the ocean on her left, or an attempt to look through 3 heads that covered the windows on the right. If you are assigned a seat on the right side of the plane, by all means, it is well worth the ride. If you get assigned a seat on the left side of the aircraft, I'd recommend you refuse to take that flight and ride on the next flight.
Had a very good time. Employees were friendly, The scene was outstanding and would definately recommend this journey. This way if seeing the scenery is much more expanding than from the ground.

Had a blast and saw lots of waterfalls, pilot was friendly and informative.
Flying plane was great!!

review_title: See Arches and Canyonlands National Parks in 90 minutes
review_text: How clearly we "got the picture" of both Parks in a 90 minute flight piloted by Larry, of Red Tail Aviation.  He explained the various parts of the Parks in a most engaging way with a sense of humor in the Kodiak aircraft.  From this flight we had more of a concept of what we wanted to visit during our stay at Moab, Utah.  Larry worked for the Bureau of Land Management and the National Park Service over 30 years, so he knew the area well  from several viewpoints.  He was a skilled pilot who, with co-pilot Bronson, handled the flight smoothly and safely while sharing his love and knowledge of the area.  The flight with Larry was a very worthwhile experience.

The flight was an excellent way to see all parts of the island, especially the NaPali coast. Our pilot (Paul) made sure everyone could see the sites regardless on which side of the plane you were on.  He was funny and seemed very knowledgeable about the island. The flight was smooth and fun. We liked that it's an eco-friendly way to see the island as well! Would definitely recommend this tour.

review_title: Great sight seeing flight at K2 Aviation
review_text: Our pilot Morrie was a highly experienced professional and gave us a thorough safety and aircraft familiarization briefing, provided a very interesting and appropriate narration of the incredible terrain we were seeing, and made every effort to ensure we had great photo opportunities.   We were on a very tight schedule  to leave Talkeetna and at the conclusion of the tour  the helpful front desk people at K2 immediately whisked us back to our hotel to meet our bus.   You really don't want to miss this sight seeing experience!!

Tour of Misty Fjord by float plane (arranged through the cruise ship). Arrived at facility, received a safety briefing from the pilot. Recorded commentary provided on the flight as well as information from the pilot. Landed on a “lake” in the fjord. We were able to step out on the floats for a brief time (10 minutes) for pictures. Then we headed back to Ketchikan. Felt quite safe all of the time. Flight stayed at about 800 feet, good enough to see a flying eagle.
Such an incredible experience! The only way to see Kauai, gorgeous views! Carter welcomed us & made us feel at ease. Bruce was a wonderful pilot, smooth flight, unforgettable time! Mahalo.

Used these folks for climbing support with friends and then again for a scenic flight on my honeymoon and couldn’t be happier.  Such a friendly and welcoming staff, very accommodating, and smiles all around. No other way to see the true vastness of the incomparable Alaska Range!
Experience you can’t miss if you are here at Alaska. Great pilot and breathtaking views of Mt Denali and other peaks. Glacier landing and experience the fresh snow are to be remembered for long time

This was our favorite thing we did on Kauai! Marcus was a great captain and really cares about the island and its wildlife. We saw several humpback whales from the sky and I almost cried I was so excited. This is hands down the best way to see the island and appreciate how unspoiled it still is. Thank you!

I've flown with Talkeetna Air Taxi several times and their service is absolutely exceptional.  Incredibly friendly staff to work with and great pilots to fly with.  If you want to fly with the best, go with Talkeetna Air Taxi.
Excellent Pilot!  Little windy and a little bumpy, but he explained exactly where and when we would experience turbulence.  Beautiful views up the Columbia River Gorge.

review_title: Glacier Landing! Engaged on Mt. Denali!
review_text: Yes! (For more than just one reason!) My boyfriend and I were planning our trip to Alaska and this came up as one of the top rated attractions - for good reason. We knew we wanted to do the plane tour but the glacier landing was one we were debating on. Although it's not that much more money, Alaska is already expensive and we didn't know that it would be worth it. Well, it was! Little did I know that my boyfriend had called TAT ahead of time to mention that he was going to propose on the glacier. Upon arrival, I had no idea! The entire crew knew and treated us just like everyone else, which was kind and helpful. The takeoff and plane tour itself was great. There was never a concern for safety. The pilot kept us informed throughout the trip on where we were flying over and facts about the mountain. Landing on the glacier was really cool, as was walking around in a couple of feet of snow on the most quiet and serene place I've ever been. Nothing compares. The pilot took a

Picture perfect day to take a flight around Mt. Denali and experience a glacier landing and takeoff. The experience is tremendous and the mountains phenomenal. Our guide, Leanne, was awesome and a really skillful aviator. You’ll remember this excursion forevermore.

review_title: The best hour we spent in Kauai
review_text:
WoK was super nice and professional, and the tour itself is our best memory in Kauai.

I was concerned that my 28 week pregnant wife might have motion sick for the flight, WoK was happy to rescheduled for me a morning flight with a bigger plane. It turns out to be only my family was there so we actually get a private tour.  Our pilot speaks Chinese which is a big plus as my wife & kids doesn't speaks much English, and the pilot introduced so many attractions in the flight. They gave my wife and daughter beautiful flowers which is the first surprise. 

The weather was very good for flight and we were lucky to see the Mount Waialeale, the wall of tears. Needless to say we go to the Na Pali coast, the waimea canyon, we even saw some dorphins. 

I would definitely do this again in next visit.

TAT has the ability/instruments to fly safely through clouds for a safe  Denali Summit flight/Ruth glacier landing. We even got to see a summiting team right at the summit. Our pilot was highly experienced and provided a grand tour of the myriad glaciers and peaks surrounding the grand Denali. Once in a life-time experience!

Our scenic flight was the highlight of our Alaska trip. Our pilot Leighann was knowledgeable, safe, and fun to be around- she clearly knew her way around the mountains and was able to transfer her passion for the Alaska Range to her guests. The entire process—booking, check in, pre flight briefing, and being airborne—was a breeze. Our flight included a glacier landing, and I’d highly recommend the same to anyone. It’s great to see the peaks from the air, but to be immersed in them for a little while and admire the enormity of them from the glacier was breathtaking. Both of the takeoffs and landings were smooth, and we were safely escorted back across the runway in Talkeetna at the end. I’d suggest this trip to anyone traveling through the area, families too!

A must do when you are on Kauai! Most people make a flight in a helicopter, but we had never been in a biplane, and we wanted to experience it once. And it was so nice! We had a very good view over the island, and the fight took long, it was great. Our captain told us a lot of interesting things. We would recommend this!

Molly, Elbert and Jason made the flight service of our Alaskan fly in hunt a wonderful experience, in and of itself! I'm from the southern part of the lower 48 and these folks at Alaska Bush Float Plane Service know good customer service, just like good ole southern hospitality!! From the very first phone call to Molly, my son commented that she was the only person he'd talked to that provided these types of services, that was willing to answer his questions and assist with a 1st time group of men going into the Alaskan bush to hunt caribou and bear. It was a successful trip to say the least and we are already planning another hunt in 2015. We will use their services again, without hesitation and recommend them 100%! Thanks again Molly, Elbert and Jason! You folks are awesome!!

We were very lucky to have pretty good weather, but the company does not go up if you won't have a great experience. It is best to book when you get to Talkeetna in order to have a little leeway for the weather. The staff will work with you. It is expensive, but wotprth it. There is a coupon in the Northern Lights coupon book for 25% off for 4 people.

Josh was an excellent tour guide! Very knowledgeable and informative, as well as funny, which is most important. I have been on this tour before, but it was my daughter’s first time. She 17, took a LOT of unforgettable pictures! Thanks Josh, crew, and everyone who helped get us on this amazing experience!

From the initial contact and reservation through every detail of the preflight briefing and flight, the entire Maverick team was professional and friendly. My initial contact was via chat, where the operator suggested the type of flight that would best meet our needs and price. No pressure, totally knowledgeable and courteous from start to finish.

Their facility at the Grand Canyon Airport is recently renovated and spotless. The staff there is friendly and efficient. The flight was perfect, with great narration and the helicopter is designed so that everyone has a great view. The interior of the helicopter is heated and air conditioned, and each person has a comfortable headset, so the narration and conversation is clear.

Don't bother with lesser providers - this is the company to book with, you won't be sorry.
Absolute amazing, circle island tour was so incredible. My photo library is full of incredible photos and I spent most of the trip just soaking everything in.

Booked an aerial tour as a surprise for my daughter and I (she just turned 21) while my husband played golf.  We could not have asked for a more perfect day!   It was absolutely gorgeous!   Our pilot, Nate was terrific.  I was fortunate enough to sit in the co-pilot seat during the trip and got some amazing shots with my wide angle lens.  Those haven’t been downloaded and edited yet though so those I’m sharing are from my daughter’s phone.  Very cool experience.  Highly recommend!  Oh, and Nate’s landing…… perfection!!!

Our trip was excellent! We saw so much of the island, and the flight was so smooth. That was partly due to the wonderful weather but also our awesome pilot Bubs. Highly recommend this tour company. The very best way to see the Island in my opinion.

There isn't much to say here, except the experience was fantastic. Seeing the landscape from the air was breathtaking, and landing and taking off from the glacier was a hoot. Our pilot, Melissa was superbly qualified and a real pleasure to fly with.  We were fortunate to have exquisite weather. Do this!

review_title: Perfect experience with eric and my family
review_text:
it was such an AMAZING EXPERIENCE with beautiful sight and amazing weather

100000000percent recommend

Eric provides detailed explanations and enough time to take beautiful photos

review_title: Amazing experience of Denali land flying onto a glacier!
review_text: It was an incredible day and an amazing experience. The weather was perfect, plane ride and landing on the glacier was smooth and calm. The pilot was charming and made sure there were plenty of opportunities for both sides of the plane to have amazing views of Denali and glaciers.
Excellent tour! We had a wonderful once in a lifetime adventure and Maui Plane Rides made everything perfect!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: My wife and I had never flown in a single engine light plane, but we felt extremely comfortable with Bruce.  He is an excellent pilot and great narrator of the magnificent island of Kauai.  This experience is not to be missed!  Thank you to Bruce and his wife who made sure we found the airport and didn’t miss our flight.

We we treated to a exciting , beautiful trip on a plane ride around Mt Mckinley and glacier landing. Pilot was extremely friendly and skillful. Company did everything in their power to help change reservations for us and make our adventure successful. Highly recommend this company for your vacation.

I took my son, who is 8 years old, on an afternoon tour of Miami with Miami Seaplane Tours and we can not say enough great things about it.  My son wanted to seat in the front seat next to the pilot and they could not be more accommodating.  The pilot was very informative on the sights and we had a smooth take off,  flight and landing.  Our favorite part was being very close to the water by Stilsville and being so close to Miami Beach.  I have lived in the area for over 30 years, been in sailboats around Key Biscayne, but this has to be the best view of Miami that I have experienced!

What a wonderful way to get another view of Kauai.  Our pilot was very professional and so informative about Kauai. It was also so neat to see the part of Kauai where there aren't any roads!  The only thing we didn't see was the pot of gold at the end of the rainbow!!!!    Rating:  10.5 out of 10. Thank you!  J&L Malcolm, Sk. Canada
Simply an awesome experience! The pilot was nice, attentive, and very knowledgeable of the surrounding area.  We’ll be coming back for another flight!

review_title: Floatplane from Ketchikan to Neets Bay Bearwatching
review_text:
Professional warm friendly set-up in a beautiful 1960 Classic De Havilland Otter aircraft. 
A friend didnt join us because of a fear of small aircraft. This aircraft was super smooth with an expert pilot Ron. Smoother than Commercial aircraft!
Video briefing on the coach so when you arrive at the Floatplane no time is wasted. Plenty of room in plane and a seat for everyone with a window! Great music by Steve Millar Band and Dire Straits and beautiful scenery. 

Then getting close up to plenty of brown bears feasting on salmon! What a trip..

review_title: Highlight of our trip! Worth every penny!
review_text: This was an awesome way to see the whole island of Kauai!  Our Pilot, Eric, was awesome.  Great info about the island as we flew.  Beautiful waterfalls, canyons, beaches.  A great way to get a unique view of it all.  Combine this with some hikes and a water excursion and you'll get to experience Kauai from many viewpoints.  Much recommended.

review_title: Great Ride with Wings Over Kauai
review_text: Kauai is such a magical place, and a great way to see it is with Wings Over Kauai. Customer service was great, and they have a perfect safety rating. I have some issues with motion sickness so I took one dramamine 30 min. before we went up and had no problems at all. Bruce (the pilot) gave me some great tips on helping avoid motion sickness. It was a very smooth ride and we were lucky enough to have perfect weather. The views were unbelievable and we would recommend doing this to see the island. Also, the noise cancelling headphones made for such a peaceful ride, they were worth every penny!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai, Up Close and Personal
review_text:
What a trip! What a welcome from Ellen and Bruce. There was just Paul and I on board as passengers that 9am on 2nd January 2010. (Julia Roberts was boarding the private jet next door.) The weather was perfect and we saw EVERYTHING you could hope for. We flew over the south side of the island spotting 2 whales surfacing and glinting in the sun. Then up the west side to the grand canyon of the Pacific and then on to the Na Pali coast. Then along the northern beaches with the celebrity homes and then inland to the waterfalls. 
Bruce was knowledgable about the flora, fauna and topography. The operation was slick and half the price of the helicopter tours. It was just us, no sharing with others, so we felt it was very personal. What a great trip.

The flight was very fun. Our pilot was friendly and pointed out more than just the waterfalls as we toured the gorge. They were super flexible when we needed to make adjustments and it was a very great experience.

I have travelled to many parts of the world but this 2 hour flight with TAT is THEE BEST experience I can ever recall. They are seasoned professionals that will greatly exceed your expectations. Make sure you have a clear day when you visit "the great one,"  McKinley! There are no words that describe the experience of walking on the glaciers our pilot landed on or seeing/touching the awesome peaks of this range of mountains. The photo opportunity is unbelievable. 

It cannot be improved on!!!!!!!!!!!

Worth every penny. Alaska is fortunate to have these wonderful folks with such a great mission - to share the beauty of Mt McKinley!!

This was hands down one of the most humbling experiences I’ve had of my many adventures.  Landing on the Kahiltna Glacier at Base Camp on the south west slopes of Denali makes you feel very small in the grand scheme of things.  Patrick, our pilot, was stellar.  What an awe inspiring scenery.  It was a blessing to experience it.  We originally intended to do the summit flight with glacier landing, however due to storms the attempt was too dangerous.  K2 happily quickly and happily offered to get us on the Grand Tour with the glacier landing with the promise of better views flying amongst the towering walls as opposed to above them.  They were beyond correct.  I would highly recommend this experience!!  Well done K2 Aviation, well done.

We flew with Jake who provided a very informative flight to see the waterfalls along the Hana coastline.  Flights are currently limited, so a trip over the volcano was not available.  The chopper makes a 20 minute stop at their own private spot in the jungle to view the local flora and cultural artifacts (taro gardens).  Beautiful scenery.

review_title: Fly to Monument Valley from Moab
review_text:
We arranged a scenic air tour from Canyonland Air Field, Moab, to Monument Valley. The round trip flight took two hours, the flight and panorama were awesome.   We flew over Canyonlands on our way to Monument Valley, we saw the junction of the Colorado and Green River.  The colours and sheer size of this place is incredible. The topography slowly changes as you fly south from canyons to buttes.  The colour changes are also incredible.  We flew at about 1000 - 1200 feet between the buttes when we got to Monument Valley.  We did not land at Gouldings Trading Post as we thought we would,  we were advised by the Pilot that our schedule would not allow for this to happen.  We booked and paid for our air fares through one of the companies in Moab that arranges a lot of different tours.  The reason we booked through a third party company was because their website stated that their trip to Monument Valley included a landing at Goulding's Trading Post. I was a little put out when we found out that we would not be landing at Gouldings from the Redtail Pilot.  I do not blame Redail Aviation for this, however I do blame the tour company who advertises that a landing a Gouldings Trading Post forms part of the scenic air tour.  If you are thinking or flying to Monument  Valley I would deal  direct with Retail Aviation.  

Make sure you take  an early flight say 9am, as it is a smoother flight in the morning than the afternoon.

If you have time, this is one of the best experience you’ve have in Alaska. It’s already amazing to be able to fly around and see Mt Denali. It’s out of this world to be able to land on a glacier, enjoy the magnificent beauty and landscape, with Mt Denali in the background. Wow! The staff there is simply great and very sincere. Our family had an amazing time!

review_title: Breathtaking views of Alaska's majestic mountains, glaciers, and more
review_text: It wasn't just the views that were amazing on our flight with K2 Aviation in Talkeetna, Alaska.  Our pilot, Will, was as well.  He was actually a flight instructor with 40 years of experience and was very knowledgeable about Alaska.  He provided an ongoing commentary during our flight to let us know exactly what we were seeing.  So glad the sun came out that day and we were able to see Denali (the big one)!
Enjoyed this flight to McKinley and Denali. The pilot was an artist, he was so smooth. Everything about this flight-seeing trip was outstanding.
Eric loves his work and is a great pilot. Definitely one of the most exciting holiday experiences ever. Everything was easy and straightforward but spectacular!
Hearing the history behind the land! It was really amazing— loved it!! I would recommend to everyone it was a lot of fun and a unique experience.

The K2 flight was the highlight of our Alaska visit.  We may have gotten lucky with the weather, but the sights and experience were amazing; the flight couldn't have been smoother and our pilot was great!

review_title: Awesome - a MUST when you visit Grand Canyon.
review_text:
The Maverick Helicopter Tours is a very smoothly and professionally run business. Great staff in the reception building. You have restrooms here, a gift shop and a cafeteria.
The helicopters look brand new. They are specifically designed for sightseeing tours and offer excellent views for the three passengers in the front row and the two passengers in the back row seated by the windows. The two passengers in the middle seats of the back row have somewhat less good views.
I went on the 45 minute Weather Route, which gives you the longest time over the Canyon. Our pilot Justin was very nice, knowledgable and a really professional pilot.
This is really the best way to truly appreciate the grandness and beauty of the Grand Canyon. I highly recommend this tour. It is a bit pricey, but that goes for all helicopter sightseeing tours around the world.
Highly recommended.  Very impressed with the staff. And word is that this is the safer of the two flight companies operating in Talkeetna.

review_title: Great Flight, Great Staff and Great Fun!!!!
review_text:
The tour was outstanding!  Amazing immense views that cannot be captured by a camera.
The staff made our trip extra special from the first call I made to Lesley to make arrangements, to our van driver, to the pilot, and office staff.  They were all so incredibly professional and kind.

Whatever you do, don't miss this experience when visiting Kauai.  Our family of four were the only ones on the plane as we booked a private charter, so it was very personal and we got the best seats on the plane (right hand side).  Our pilot Josh was great, pointing out all sorts of things on the ground, telling some of the history of the island, even where some actors have bought holiday homes.  Flying over Waimea Canyon and along the Na Pali coast - words can't really describe how amazing the scenery is - you have to see it to get a feel of how amazing this island is.  The plane has several video cameras located on the wing etc, so at the end of the flight you have the option of buying a DVD of your full flight, which means you can enjoy the whole flight without worrying about getting the perfect shot or video.  The Kukui nut necklace gift before we boarded was a pleasant suprise as well.

I absolutely loved my helicopter trip over the Grand Canyon! Our pilot was really nice and gave us loads of interesting facts about the canyon.

We had booked the 50 minute flight, check in was quick and pleasant, all the staff were friendly, he shop was good but a little expensive but I wouldn't expect anything different.

The flight was amazing, we flew over the canyon for at least 40 mins (rest of the time was getting to the canyon and back) after the flight the pilot was happy to let us take photos with him and our group.

review_title: Great way to see Denali and surroundings
review_text: Excellent experience! (K2 Grand Tour, without glacier landing) The views were totally amazing + our pilot was skilled, knowledgeable, and provided just the right amount of narration/explanation during the flight. We were very lucky with particularly clear weather, but the terrain, and the altitudes at which you see it, are very varied, so I'd guess that it will be remarkable even in less-than-perfect conditions . The pilots have discretion about the exact route they fly, so they can take best advantage of whatever is happening on the day you fly. We recommend leaving an empty day the day after your scheduled flight, if that's possible, so that in the rare event that no flights can go out on your day, you can stay over and try again the next day. In any case, the train trip to Talkeetna is very pleasant and scenic, and the town itself is...cute. A highlight of our Alaska trip (tied with the Kenai fjords boat tour).

review_title: Really great experience, incredible views of the island
review_text: Wow!  We loved Bruce, the pilot, and his family.  His wife, Ellen, and daughter were all a part of the operation.  They were very easygoing, and accommodating when the date of our flight didn't have great weather.  We rescheduled for the following day, on Bruce's advice, which was the right choice.  As we floated off into the sky, Bruce narrated the trip to us in a lovely, soothing voice to soft Hawaiian music in the background, and if we were nervous, all of our fears went away.  It is hard to believe there can be so much beauty on one island, and I feel like we got to see most of it from our plane window.  What we weren't expecting, however, is to get so motion sick.  It really took me and my daughter by surprise.  It was such a smooth and relaxing ride that I never would have expected to feel so badly.  Bruce had bottled waters, which helped the two of us, along with peppermints and ginger candy.  It didn't ruin the experience at all, but we were not prepared, since we don't normally get motion sick.  We still highly recommend this adventure.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi Grand Denali Tour
review_text: My wife and I took a twelve day Alaskan vacation this summer.  All the attractions we saw by land or sea were superb.  With that being said the highlight of our vacation by far was the plane ride around Mount McKinley .  We took the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing.  It was simply wonderful.  The aerial photos that I took don't do it justice.  The scenery was so incredibly beautiful it would make an atheist believe in God.

The aerial tour of Denali was beautiful and quite exciting.  The ability to maneuver the Otter aircraft close to the mountain and circle it at 12 thousand feet made for majestic scenery.  Our pilot, Mike, was very knowledgeable and gave very interesting commentary throughout the flight.

K2's equipment, staff, and processes looked excellent, making this a very comfortable experience.

A must experience for visitors to Alaska.
The flight was smooth and felt safe. It was very interesting and fun to see the island in a bird’s eye view. Our pilot answered our questions well.
Booked this for my husbands birthday. The staff was very friendly and the pilots were great. The views were amazing!! Overall, totally worth it. Highly recommend!

We took the K2 adventure and the green route around the park and lanes on a glacier.  While I enjoyed the Mendenhall glacier more this was still a bucket list adventure.  Second tallest mountain and the coldest in the world.  A must do, regardless of cost

Eric was the nest. Flying the plane was an experience in its own. we got to see all of Mauis five islands. We even got to see a bunch of humpback whales playing in the sea. Excellent. Would do again and again and again!!!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text:
I honestly don’t know where to start except if you’re considering booking or looking between other flights, look no further -Book K2! They were wonderful to work with, easy to set up and this was a once in a lifetime experience.

 I surprised my parents with this Grand Tour with Glacier Landing trip for their retirement and they said it was the best part of our trip. Chris was our pilot and wow! He’s a local Alaskan who’s been flying since he was 15. He knew all kinds of history, geography, made the flight fun and made sure everyone got the spectacular views! 

Our landing on the glacier was breathtaking! The trip was smooth and amazing! Please don’t miss out on this amazing crew and trip! You won’t regret it!

review_title: This is definitely the way to see Kauai!
review_text: We have done land tours and helicopter tours but this beats them flat!  Land is good, helicopter is better but this is the best!  It is an awesome way to see the island.  The ground staff and pilot were helpful and friendly.  Bruce, the pilot, is very knowledgeable and gave a great commentary as we flew over the various areas.  It is an amazing experience I would recommend to anyone.

We took an hour flight to get a birds eye view of Kauai. Our pilot, Harry, was awesome. He provided a great overview of the unique sites. The open cockpit was a real rush. All the staff were welcoming and made sure we were well taken care of. Good job Air Hawaii!

review_title: Spectacular, stunning air tour taking in all the beauty of Kauai !!!
review_text: Harry, our pilot, and the Air Ventures staff made our air tour the centerpiece of our week in Kauai.  From take-off to landing, Harry presented us with a grand view of all that Kauai has to offer.  Waterfall, waterfalls, waterfalls, beautiful beaches, Hanalei Bay, resort areas, Port Allen, coffee plantations, Waimea Canyon, Na Pali Coast and Princeville area.  Genle turns, skillful flying to avoid turbulence, detail narration, and great viewing from both sides of the aircraft made this one of those WOW Trips!  Mahalo to the Air Ventures [:-)
From online scheduling to in person service our family could not have asked for a better experience.  It was outstanding!
Fantastic flight and tour of the 5 islands of Maui! This has been the highlight of our trip. It was an amazing experience!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Nous avons passé un super moment au-dessus de Miami, merci à notre pilote pour sa gentillesse et ses explications très intéressantes sur l'histoire et la géographie de Miami. A recommander !

Due to weather reasons we were unable to make the trip to Hana, but the Maverick team kindly rescheduled us the next day to take the tour to northern Maui and Molokini. The wonderful views, like from another time, the spectacular guide, everything fantastic, I recommend Maverick helicopters, they are an excellent company.
The views were amazing and our pilot Nick did an excellent job giving us the highlights and adding his personal touch since he grew up in Kauai.

review_title: “Great example of what a great Moab Area Tour is”
review_text: My Flight to Needles and Canyonland's was second to none. The pilot was very friendly and knowledgable. The friendly lady in the gift shop was very knowledgeable also and has answers to all of our questions.The scenery was beyond what I can put into words. The Kodiak plane was very roomy and comfortable and there was not a bad seat anywhere. Every seat has a window. I was able to see certain arches that many people never get to see as they are in some cases a 25 mile hike. The Colorado river was also beautiful as is winds through the canyon. I can't say enough about the service that Red Tail provided. You will not be sorry with Red Tail Air tours.

After driving around the parks and hiking to numerous locations it was perfect to see Arches NP and Canyonlands NP from the sky. We had a great time with Desi our pilot and Preston our Co-Pilot. They were very friendly and knowledgeable of the parks. We loved that our tour took us over both parks. There were great views of the Green and Colorado Rivers, and the landscape is just awe inspiring from the air. It was just the two of us with Desi and Preston so we enjoyed a more personal tour. The plane was a bit tight for us, not a lot of wiggle room, but we did ok for the 45 minute ride. Doug had his Go-Pro videoing out his window and I had my camera pointed out my window, clicking pictures like crazy! It was fun! The tour is well worth it!

From pick up at the hotel to drop off at the train station, K2 provided outstanding and attentive service.  Pilot was most particular about the plane being in proper working order before take off.  Even though it was quite cloudy, it was a terrific flight and well worth it.  Highly recommend!

An awesome experience.  We happened to have a very windy day, however our pilot Paul guided the plane expertly with only slight turbulence. He told us all about each area we were viewing.  We took awesome photos and were able to see lots and lots of waterfalls.  From beginning to end everyone at Air Ventures was very friendly.  We would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Kauai.

What a great experience!  The pilot had great knowledge of the area and was so pleasant and helpful.  We had a fantastic flight, enjoyed it so much.  I would recommend Redtail helicopter tours to anyone who wants a birds eye view of the canyons and arches.  Thumbs UP!  Great flight.

Лучший вид развлечений и возможность увидеть всю южную Флориду с самолета. Владельцы компании, кто также являются пилотами, очень приятные и добро желательные люди. Очень рекомендую. Самый лучший вид отдыха в Майями :)
Our young great pilot showed us the fantastic island from above, which we discovered by car before.  Gorgeous impressions! To me no difference to a helicopter flight but much cheaper!

the owners were absolutely fan-fun-tastic!!! MUCH SAFER then copters and much MORE info -hx. ENVIRONMENTAL - and fun entertaining facts , the views were awesome!! VERY PERSONNAL !!! LOVED their dog in the office and the personal touches on board...drinks, etc... Can't wait to fly again!!! the picures and dvd of flight made it even more special

Highly recommend! We went on a windy afternoon- Marcus was a great pilot and kept the ride smooth and peaceful. Soaring above this beautiful island is a real treat. The hospitality from the time we arrived was top notch.

A wonderful flight to the Misty Fjords! We were able to fly with Chuck Perkins, who eased my sons fear of flying and provided us a very fun time! We live in SE Alaska and even living here we forget what an amazing place we have all around us! Thank you Office Manager, Danita Scott for recommending this flight tour as a gift for my family and Pilot Chuck Perkins for allowing my family to have a fun, safe and memorable trip!

We cannot wait to book our next flight on Taquan Air!!!!

The is singularly the most beautiful thing I have ever seen. Absolutely breathtaking. We were fortunate that we woke to a cloudless sky. The pilot said that it was one of the top 10 days of the year. Well worth the money...it was beyond beautiful.
Exceptional tour, with our pilot Doug being the absolute best! We had another tour the next day with a different company and that really made us appreciate Doug even more.
A buxket list worthy chance to see the island from a perspective that most dont get to see. Highly recommended, will be flying again!

review_title: Great Waterplane Flight to the Florida Keys
review_text: Great flight over the Florida Keys with stopover and lunch on 'Loreley' Island. The trip starts and ends in Miami, a short motorboat ride through Miami Harbour to and from the seaplane is included. Overall a great experience and highly recommended!
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_title: Absolument top '' ready for lift up''
review_text:
Top, super top.. surtout si vous êtes assis sur 1 des 3 sièges de devant: place 1,2 ou 3 mais..pas de négociation possible ces 3 places sont assignées aux plus légers des 7 passagers. Donc pour les plus lourds du groupe c'est le 2eme rang : places 4,5 6 et 7 et là,il faut dire que se voir attribuer une des 2 places centrales 5 et 6 est extrêmement frustrant puisqu'on ne voit RIEN du show. Ahhh vous aurez quand même le droit dans un casque high tech à la musique, bien choisie,  pour accompagner les plongées dans le canjon avec les commentaires en français. Une petite consolation. Bon vol.
Coolwet from the top.
Had a great time flying the beautiful island of Kauai with Captain Bruce and great coordination from Val and the rest of the team!

review_title: Memory of a lifetime - Float Plane Bear Adventure
review_text:
What a great experience this 2-3 hour trip was.  In mid-August 2012, my wife and I went on a float plane trip with Taquan Air Tours to Prince of Wales island about 30 minutes from Ketichan.  It was a beautiful clear and calm day.  We then took a short ride and hike to see bears hunting for salmon swimming up stream.  

It was great to experience this in person after seeing it on TV many times.  What an incredible time this was.  Got lots of great pictures to re-live the memories.

The company was very professional.  Pilot answered all the questions we had during flight over and back. The bear expert was also interesting and knowledgable.

This was the best activity we did on our two week trip to Alaska.

We were picked up by Brad who was very knowledgeable and friendly at the Sedona airport to the Grand Canyon Skywalk Adventure Tour  West Rim.  The view and scenery was unbelievable and walking on the glass skywalk was amazing.   We then boarded a helicopter for a 10 minute ride to the floor of the Grand Canyon then  boarded a pontoon boat for a 20 minute, ride on the Colorado River 6 hours in total and worth every penny.   The impact from the air is so different than been on the ground would recommend it to anyone.

We had a great time on our tour of Mt Denali and the area! Going in "shoulder season" allowed us to have a private tour, just the two of us and the pilot, which was great for a honeymooning couple! Our pilot was so knowledgeable and friendly! I did feel slightly motion sick while in the air but I'm very prone to that! Even still I would do it again! The views were amazing and everyone at the company was easy to talk to and work with to set up our flight!

We had a group of seven with 3 kids 12 and under. The kids got a bit scared (bumpier than they expected but certainly not bad). Kids are kids - it turns into a lot of crying. Our pilot Chris agreed to take us back after about 40 minutes of flying. The cool thing was, they only charged us half price and they fully refunded the poor couple who got stuck with us. Very customer friendly. I’m sure the flight would have been awesome but they knew how to treat a family.

The tour guide Eric was not only friendly, knowledgeable, and patient, but also a skillful pilot. With his incredible skill, we were able to witness the sea cliff from an impeccable perspective. With his patience, we were given multiple chances to take pictures, haha. Great experience, worth spending time with the ones you love.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: The greater bay area Seaplane tour enables its passengers to get a spectacular view from the air, to see the scale and beauty of San Francisco. My family members and I thoroughly enjoyed it! well worth the price in my humble opinion. I would highly recommend.
Bruce was our pilot and was very welcoming. It was a beautiful way to see the island.  Well worth it.  We saw the whole island.
First time in a small (6 seats) aircraft in a air tour of Kauai. Fun fun fun. The crew made it a plesant and wonderful adventure.

review_title: Great personal service - the only way to see NaPali Coast.
review_text: Family owned business with a personal touch. They have a general route but tailored it to fit our tastes so we saw whales from the air, circled Kilauea Point Lighthouse and we could take a picture of our condo from the air!  Flew over Tunnels Beach and decided we wanted to go and snorkeling there was our favorite thing we did.

Our experience completely exceeded our expectations....Bruce and Carter were very welcoming and informative, truly love their jobs, enjoy entertaining their guests, and teaching about the island they are very proud of.  The scenery was absolutely magnificent. Another bonus was the total cost is about half of what you might pay for a similar helicopter ride.  We are ready to do it again!

We really enjoyed this aerial tour!  Our pilot,  Bubbs, was personable and attentive and the views were amazing!  We also appreciate the reasonable cost from Air Ventures as compared with other companies.   It gets a li
Informative,exciting. Wonderful clear flying day with excellent views of glaciers and areas surrounding Talkeetna😁

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is a must do!!! Wonderful experience!
review_text: My wife and I flew around the island yesterday with our pilot Bruce in his Cessna airplane. Bruce is a terrific pilot and treated us like family. We saw so many beautiful sights of Kauai from up above with all of them being picture perfect. Fly with Wings Over Kauai you will not regret it. For those of you that might be nervous about flying in a small plane, don't be as you are in good hands with Bruce and his team. This was by far one of the best excursions we have ever been on and we look forward to doing it again when we come back to the island. Trust the reviews on Trip Advisor and take this trip, you will not regret it!
Outstanding tour led by Mel who was extremely knowledgeable about volcanoes and Hawaiian culture. Every part of the trip flowed smoothly and was informative and enjoyable.
tour_name: 15-Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Experience Departing from Oahu32_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: An incredible way to see the Canyon. Thoroughly enjoyed our flight, all staff friendly and helpful. Would recommend.

review_title: Biplane Over Kauai best best best
review_text: This is our 18th trip to Hawaii. The Biplane ride is the best of all of the adventures we have enjoyed on all of the islands. Every year we pick a big ticket adventure. This is by far the best. So put on your cap and goggles and let Kevin take you and your mate for an amazing open cockpit tour of the island!.
Very knowledgeable helicopter pilot! I got some great photos and learned a lot about the area.  I would highly recommend this group for a seaplane or helicopter tour.

review_title: ランディング出来なかったけど　レインボーがたくさん見えて素敵でした
review_text: タルキートナーからの飛行でした。はじめ人数がそろわないので、そろうまで時間待ち　なんとかラストで飛べることになって、乗ることができました。天候の関係でランディングができなかったので残念でしたが、かわりにレインボーがたくさん　2重に見えたときもあり、　とってもきれいな景色でした。ここにこないと絶対に見られない景色で、本当に夢のように素敵でした。ホテルまでの送迎もきっちりとあり、親切でした。

Our flight seeing trip was amazing! Incredible views of Denali and the Alaskan Range. Pilot was excellent, great narration and skill. The glacier landing was really cool too, no pun intended. You have to do this if you want the best view of the mountains. No comparison to seeing them from the ground.

review_title: Unbelievable helicopter trip over the Grand Canyon
review_text: We were first in the air the day we went - it was a beautifully sunny morning and the ride was so smooth.  Our pilot was great fun and pointed out all the sights to us.  The views are truly breathtaking.
The flightseeing experience was one of a kind. The most incredible, beautiful views that I couldn't imagine. The pilot was also incredibly talented and knowledgeable.

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: We had a great time on Wings Over Kauai.  The tour is very personal - it was just us and one other couple on the plane, and Bruce wrote down everyone's names and made a point of checking in with everyone individually during the ride.  His knowledge of the island is very strong so you could ask questions during the tour and he also had a good sense of humor.  Overall, felt this was very good value for the product offered and were very happy not to have paid twice the price for a helicopter which would probably have been quite similar (though haven't done a helicopter so can't say!).  Not Bruce's fault at all, but it is easy to get motion sickness in a small plane - so be prepared if you're prone to it!

We took an air tour of Kauai and it was absolutely gorgeous!  Eric was our pilot- he is very knowledgeable and fun to listen to.  This was a highlight of the trip with the exception of getting motion sick.  If you are prone to motion sickness, I would not recommend a plane tour.  Otherwise, get your camera ready!

We had a great time! They were very accommodating as we had to reschedule due to weather, and then we had to reschedule a 2nd time since we were running late. Despite all that we were able to have a lovely tour with pilot Matt Kass. He was very kind and did a good job of showing the island and giving a comfortably flying experience. Everyone here came off as very genuine, and if we comeback for flying tour will definitely do wings over kauai again!
Really enjoyed the flight and landing on the glacier. Expensive but really beautiful. Stunning scenery, Plan held 10 each person has their own window for photos.

review_title: An adverture that we will remember for a life time
review_text:
We diid the Quicksand Triangle Tour with Spencer, I don't know what else I can say about him, but will just echo what others have said. We had a great flight with awesome views, a great adventure indeed. I highly recomend Envi Adventures and will be back to do some of the other tours.

We all went as familly, no teens, but no other options to choose from : )
We have so much fun, Eric our pilot was very polite and knowledgeable. Me and my daughter had so much fun. The flight was very smooth and weather was just perfect.

A unique experience to discover the beauty of this dream island, its canyon and the Na Pali Coast. Around the island is slower than by helicopter and more comfortable. All passengers have a perfect view of the outside from their windows. The pilot is very reassuring and takes the time to explain what we find. He's a very good professional. I highly recommend this company.

My family of four and two friends we were traveling with had the very enjoyable experience of taking an airvan flight with Wings Over Kauai on Sunday April 3.  The weather was perfect (though Elaine offered to switch the date if we had to - glad it was not required), the check in experience was fun and the flight was wonderful.  Bruce is an excellent pilot/tour guide and we are very happy we did this tour early in our trip!  Thanks again for a lovely experience.

review_title: Flight Around Denali with Glacier Landing
review_text:
After having lived in Alaska for many years I finely experienced Talkeetna and K2 Aviations flight around The Great One. 
It is very difficult for me to describe how absolutely fantastic this flight was. My husband and I were lucky enough to be there when there wasn't a cloud in the sky and the mountain was out in all its glory. I have had the opportunity to fly over a lot of wilderness Alaska and see places that many life-long Alaskans haven't had the chance to see. This experience was almost overwhelming. The magnitude of Denali up close and personal is something every person that visits Alaska, or lives here, should save up pennies for. It is not inexpensive but 100% worth every penny. Our pilot Stan was excellent, personable, funny, informative and a very skilled aviator. If you want one adventure that will forever be one of the top experiences you have this is it. Office staff, pilots everyone very friendly and professional.

The flight was fantastic with truly amazing views of the island. Ray & Jill, the owners, could not have been better hosts. As Ray flew the airplane he explained what we were seeing and answered any questions we had. When the flight was over Jill gave us a ride back to the Marriott even though we had arranged a shuttle. Don’t miss this ride!

Really really loved this - definitely a highlight of our Hawaiian honeymoon! We had toyed with a helicopter tour but booked this as it was a lot cheaper, and because we were worried about being squashed in with other people in a helicopter. We are so glad we did. In a small private plane you get to see everything. I sat in the front as I get travel sick and my husband sat at the back. Doug was our pilot and he was excellent. He was very knowledgable, a lovely friendly man, told us lots about the scenery we were looking at, and did the most amazingly smooth landing! This is a really friendly company - Bruce met us at checkin and we really enjoyed chatting to him too and he let us look through his book on Kaui movie sights as well as giving us some island recommendations (it was our first day!). The tour itself was breath-taking... we saw the whole island and I got some incredible photos. Honestly indescribable. We even saw the famous Jurassic Falls (worth noting we saw from further away than a helicopter would have). I get travel sick really easily and this flight was no exception, even though it wasn't very bumpy, but if you sit in the front it is much better - take some water with you and do it anyway - it is so worth it! Many thanks Bruce and Doug for an experience of a lifetime - we will never forget it!

I would highly recommend taking a flight with this company. We decided to at the last minute and would do it again in a heartbeat. We decided on the Southside Explorer with a glacier landing. It was so incredible. A very smooth plane ride and fantastic pilot.
Surreal and fantastic! Great end to our anniversary trip. The pilot Steve was very calm and experienced.

Our pilot, Chris, gave us a thrilling 1.5 hour flight over Denali National Park. As we flew through steep canyons over sparkling glaciers, Chris beguiled us with interesting statistics and fascinating stories. We saw climbers below, snow caped mountains beside, and blue skies with puffy white clouds above us. Even Mt. Denali peeked out at us from time to time. We highly recommend this trip of a lifetime.

Booked day before, great communication and updates. Arrival at company’s terminal went very smoothly. Left on time and had a MAGNIFICENT 70 minute flight with great commentary by our pilot Mark. You could tell he had a love of the island. Got great pictures of everything and was an unforgettable adventure. Best value for your dollar on our whole trip!!

We paid for a ride but were upgraded to a glacier landing for free and were very pleased. The pilot was excellent and very helpful in helping us load and unload and assisted us getting out on a glacier.  Our pilot, Will, made us very comfortable and was very helpful in assisting us.

Very nice experience. There were only 4 people in the helicopter, so plenty of space and perfect visibility. Our pilot Ethan was great with lots of explanation along the way. A great experience for 45 minutes!!! We recommend it to everyone!

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the experience. We were greeted with a friendly shuttle driver when we were picked up at pier 39. The office was clean and well decorated. The plane was clean and appeared very well maintained. Pilot was friendly, skilled and well informed, offering us an overview of the sights as we flew overhead. Will be back to enjoy again!

My husband and I spent the weekend in San Francisco and took the seaplane ride. It did not disappoint. We were worried because it was a cloudy day we might not have the best views, but we did and it was breathtaking.

We took the "MistyFjords Flightseeing"on July 12,2024.  Thought it has been a while, we are still upset of the way we were taken care of for this tour.  Pilot, Clark, did not have a welcome word before the plane took off and either a thank you for us when we left.  He only had a few words during the flight and did not try to  make it a fun experience for us by letting us know of the areas we were flying over.  This  poor personality pilot should not be in that type of work to  deal with people on vacation.

Can’t rave enough about this organization.
From start to finish, top notch crew.
To Greg who was our pick up/drop off guide - Thank you
Our Pilot Doug - you are an amazing pilot/tour guide. 
So worth every penny for this experience.
You guys ROCK!

I surprised my husband with a Bay area tour by Seaplane Adventures.  We have been to San Francisco many times but have never done this before.  It was an absolute Awesome time.  Quite the surprise and the adventure was more fun than we could have even imagined.  The tour was great - throughout Marin county, over/thru the Golden Gate bridge spires and up and down the city coast line.  Highly recommend this adventure to anyone - whether it's your first visit to the wonderful city, you visit often or live there.  This is a must and worth all 5 Stars.

The ride was smooth taking off and landing.  There was slight turbulence over the valley - which is expected - and they warn you about slight air sickness, so I wasn't surprised I felt queasy.  However that is a SMALL price to pay for the sights that you see when compared to a helicopter.  Would do again.

Après avoir longuement comparé les différentes offres nous avons opté pour le Wind Dancer Tour proposé par Maverick Helicopters. Ce n'est pas l'offre la moins chère mais au moins vous êtes sur de décoller de l'aéroport Mac Carran de Las Vegas et les avis étaient plutôt bons.

Nous n'avons pas été déçus. Prise en charge  et décollage à l'heure. Départ en formation patrouille avec 3 autres hélicoptères. Survol du lac Mead, Hoover Dam, puis entrée dans le Grand Canyon, atterrissage, champagne.

Pilote professionnel et charmant.

3 places à l'avant à côté du pilote et 4 derrière.

Un conseil : faire le vol aller devant c'est plus impressionnant qu' au retour.

Alle sind wirklich freundlich.  Der Pilot war souverän. Erzählte während des Fluges einiges. 

Genial trotz der Kosten. Jederzeit wieder.

This is the best way to see all the beautiful sites of Kauai, as many of them are not accessible by car. Our pilot Nate narrated the tour and shared background and history for the sites along the way. It was a clear day with very little wind, so Nate was able to get us close to waterfalls and canyon views. This tour was the highlight of our trip to Kauai!
Pilot had a flight to do and was not very interested in us as a costumer. Look out the window and have a great time. I would recommend the Helicopter ride next door. A much better experience.

We did this tour years ago and it was so amazing we came back and did it again.  I got so many pictures I'm going to blow up and print as gallery wraps.   Kauai is so beautiful and you can't see so many of the best things, except for from the air.   Josh was such a great guide and so knowledgable.

There was "no" favorite part, the trip exceeded all expectations. Lindsey and her staff were very professional. Steve, our pilot, was informative with his narrations and provided answers to our questions when asked. Would highly recommend!

review_title: Air Ventures gave us a great flight
review_text: The flight was very good, information given by the pilot was great but we were led to believe we would be in the air for 70 minutes, but it was 55 minutes,best to clarify times before departure.
Professional start to finish.  The staff was friendly and the pilot was knowledgeable. Flight was smooth - felt 100% safe at all times.

review_title: Don't even consider another Denali flightseeing company!
review_text: Another couple was staying at the same B&B and had booked with another company for the same trip. Weather was "iffy" (cloudy). We got the go-ahead and enjoyed an excellent excursion on board an "Otter" aircraft with our pilot, Will Boardman. When we got back to the B&B, the other couple was still sitting waiting for their company to call w/ the OK! TAT had the right equipment and the experienced pilot to make this experience one of the highlights of our Alaska vacation.

Wow...hard to explain such a mind blowing experience. I am not a person with a lack of things to say, but this trip left me speechless.  The feeling of being so close to these majestic mountains that were so far away from our hotel is amazing.  Your mouth will hurt from smiling so much. Our pilot EO, was so fun and knowledgeable too. He answered all of our questions and even pointed out base camp so we could get a feel for how high we truly were.  WELL worth it....I can't wait to do it again!
Breathtakingly beautiful! Highly recommend. Our pilot took time and walked with us around the property and provided history in the culture and trees.

Our pilot was great. Too bad I forgot
His name as we have been to so many attractions. Views were so beautiful and it is definitely worth it
This was an experience to remember! Great ground crew, a wonderful pilot and guide, and a memorable flight! Thanks to you all.
Best float plane service to Friday Harbor.  Great company with friendly staff and knowledgeable pilots.  Planes are well maintained.

review_title: The BEST way to see Kauai
review_text: We have seen Kauai by driving around the entire island and by catamaran, but this was by far the BEST way to see the island.  We saw whales, sharks, porpoises, waterfalls, canyons that you cannot even hike too, Waimea Canyon, beaches and beaches, the Napoli coast and much, much more.  And on top of that our pilot was awesome and I loved his corny jokes.  The four of us loved it!!!

We opted for this small plane tour rather than a helicopter, partly because it was much more economical, and also because we didn't want to get stuck in a helicopter seat with a lousy view, which can happen.  We weren't disappointed. Bruce took us all around the island, offering interesting tidbits of history and trivia, and the views were fantastic. My husband had a little flying experience and got to help with the take off and fly a little bit too, which thrilled him.  We even got a short video included as a memento of the flight. We've never done the copter tour, so I can't compare, but I can't imagine that it would have been any better, just different, and much more expensive.

Our glacier landing flight was the highlight of our Alaskan adventure… The entire team at this facility, including our pilot, is top notch. Very friendly, accommodating, and passionate about the beauty of Alaska. Our pilot was awesome and gave us an extremely memorable experience. Worth every penny of the price.

Loved the tour! Kj was a great tour guide. He was very informative and patient. He made us feel conformable and was descriptive on what and where we were passing by. My friend and i love taking pictures, and he allowed us to take our time. We would definitely do this tour again!

It was such a great experience to have the flight seeing with Talkeetna Air Taxi. The pilot is nice, experienced and full of knowledge. I can feel the passion on him. Would definately recommend any people to have the flight seeing tour in Talkeetna!

Take your camera and make sure you have a head for heights. A really wonderful flight from people who know their business.  Landing on a glacier surrounded by peaks with a blue sky,  what more could you want? Flying over Denali was a once in a lifetime chance as far as I was concerned.  Strongly recommend the flightseeng trip.
