Of all the awesome things we did and saw in Maui, this by far was the best. The amazing views of the rainforest and incredible waterfalls was something words can’t explain. Our pilot, Jake, was not only knowledgeable of the island but was a fantastic pilot making us feel at ease - didn’t feel at all like we were going 120 mph. If you at all are questioning the cost, like we were, I can say you will have zero regrets.

review_title: Do not miss this if you’re in Talkeetna
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip. We almost skipped the glacier stop, and that would’ve been a big mistake. The flight was fun but the glacier stop was amazing. Our pilot Josh was the best. And by luck. we had the plane to just the two of us and the pilot. I do not skip this. if you are in Talkeetna. Worth every penny.
This was an amazing experience. We were warmly greeted by a sharply dressed kind pilot who whisked us to our tour without delay. Highly recommended;
Pretty humbling experience to see Denali up close from the air.    Amazing when we flew between some of the peeks!   Thanks for a great trip.

The flight was just the two of us and the pilot. It was a great hour, we saw a lot and took lots of photos. We would repeat the flight again and again. The whales we saw were particularly amazing when we flew over the sea in front of the island.

review_title: Stunning Views - easy trip from Phoenix
review_text: Our family did the West Rim tour - it was incredible! We flew with Noah from Phoenix to the West Rim and felt comfortable in his capable hands. Once there, Westwind made arrangements for us to enjoy one of the tours on site: we walked on the glass overhang, had lunch, stopped at an incredible spot with better views, and then flew on a helicopter to Colorado River and took a short boat ride. The views were incredible. I noticed a reviewer below complaining that they were waiting at the bottom in the canyon for a helicopter. We waited, too, as one of the helicopters was getting maintenance. And we enjoyed every breathtaking moment at the bottom of the canyon. It was a once-in-a-lifetime day...and we loved every second!
Flew out with Stan, back with Chris.  Outstanding flights, outstanding pilots, outstanding outfit.  Fly with confidence.

We did the Misty Fjords floatplane trip as part of a Princess cruise option package and it came with glowing recommendations. Conditions very wet with low cloud and storms but we did fly and pilot tried hard to get us some good views.
The worst part was my travelling companion and I were seated one seat behind pilot, the seats were high compared to the windows and you had to slide down on the seat to get any views (with your knees up around your ears).
We did land on a fjord but it was too wet to get out to enjoy the scenery and silence. I appreciate they have to arrange seating to balance the plane however they need to account for height when arranging this . Or change the plane or seating to at least see the views.
Very expensive for what we got. Disappointing compared to other similar fixed wing or helicopter flights taken around the world.
Fantastic experience, professional and friendly team and lots of fun. Totally recommend it to everyone. We had 2 years old child with us and would absolutely do it again with him.

review_title: Best part of our 2 week Hawaii tour for all 4 islands
review_text:
We were in Hawaii for 2 weeks splitting our time between 4 islands - Oahu, Big Island, Kauai and Maui. We took many tours including scenic flights and boats but this tour stands out as the best one overall. We took this on New years day this year and it is very memorable for many reasons. 

1. Scenery is breahtaking and you get to see upclose
2. Very thoughtful touches to tour - right from well planned route, superior customer service at check-in and in flight. We got a Hawaiian music CD and a nice follow-up email with our pic they took in start free of charge, that was a nice tough. 
3. Our Pilot Markus was awesome and made us feel tour was safe and pleasant. He took time to go through all nice landmarks, didn't miss a single spot, turned around the coast too, gave plenty of time for pics, and also lot of good information about Kauai as well. Take off and landing was very smooth. 
4. We didn't plan well in advance and luckily managed to get seats on this flight. Since weather was awesome during the day, we consider ourselves lucky that day. 
We felt there was no better way to start the new year ! this was a memorable trip for us and Kauai Deluxe Sightseeing Flight made it all happen for us. 

THANKS SO MUCH! Highly recommended.

Met het vliegtuig over de Grand Canyon vliegen is een unieke ervaring. Prachtig zicht op heel de Grand Canyon plus de mogelijkheid om mooie en leuke foto's te trekken.
Enkel het op en neer bewegen van het vliegtuig was net als op een rollercoaster maar dat heb ik er met plezier bijgenomen!

Our pilot Bill was the best! I would highly recommend this tour for anyone who is short on time or wants to see the Grand Canyon while staying in Sedona, but doesn't want to deal with the drive, a tour bus, or the crowds. We boarded a small plane from the Sedona airport and flew to the West Rim, landed in the Hualapai Indian Reservation and took a helicopter down to the floor of the canyon. We had took a short boat ride on the River and visited the Skywalk. We left at 8am and were back in Sedona by 3pm. There's no other way to see the Grand Canyon in my opinion!

review_title: No Better Way To See The Island
review_text: Great knowledgeable pilot. I believe his name was Marcus. He knew many facts, had a sense of humor, and answered all of the questions. The reception was very nice. They explained everything in detail, and showed us the route we would be taking. There were four of us on the plane, five including the pilot. We all had ear phones and mics so we could all talk to each other and ask questions about what we were seeing. I believe the pilot even deviated from the scheduled route to take us down close to a few whales he spotted. He shared his personal experiences from living on the island which was a nice perspective. I did not see their business adds anywhere in all of the tourist magazines, just from tripadvisor, so I was wondering how good of an outfit it was? It was excellent! You can also purchase a DVD of the flight, in which we did. It should be arriving any day.

review_title: K2 Aviation & Rick the pilot gave us an unforgettable flight around Mt. McKinley!
review_text:
We had the 1 hr flight around Mt McKinley even though the clouds moved in somewhat, the views of the glaciers and mountains were breath-taking. And our 1 hr didn't start until we were in the air. Rick our pilot was very informative and friendly, as were all the staff. From the shuttle driver to the staff in the office. Everyone must be weighed to balance out the plane, but it was done very discreetly so as not to embarass anyone.
And when the clouds did move in heavily you were given the option to reschedule or cancel your flight and get a refund! Excellent friendly service from start to finish!
Did a 15 day tour around Alaska, an incredible state.  But must say flying with K2 was the highlight of the trip.
I’m a big fan of planes, but have never been able to be in the front seat! Amazing experience! Incredible!

I echo what it has been repeatedly said in this forum: this is an exhilarating, amazing and fantastic experience. We end up doing the glacier landing at Denali's base camp, and enjoyed every minute of it. Thankfully we had great weather and we were able to enjoy the magnificent vistas from the sky and the glacier. Thanks to everyone at the check-in desk and to Paul our pilot and owner, for a great time. Also thanks to the young lady staying at base camp for 10 weeks helping climbers and coordinating comms. She was very informative and helpful to us. I can't say enough good things about these people.

Excellent Day......Reservations with Lindsay were easy to make.....Lindsay was so helpful and pleasant.....Our flight with pilot Seth was wonderful.....smooth and gorgeous....THANK YOU WESTWIND AIR SERVICE..... a fabulous day

Six members of our family took an airplane ride with Air Ventures over Kauai on our first day of our week long trip.  What a great way to start our vacation!  All through our trip, we could remember what that area looked like from the air.  It gave us a great overview of this beautiful island.  We were glad we took an airplane rather than a helicopter when we saw and heard all the helicopters around the island.  Air Ventures Hawaii was a wonderful experience!
一次精彩的空中体验飞行。阿拉斯加雪山，从塔基纳出发，乘坐观光小飞机飞越德纳里国家公园上空，可以俯瞰雪山冰原和冰川，阿拉斯加这遍神奇土地就在你的脚下，无限精彩在你眼前象一幅水墨画一样延伸展开。

review_title: Beautiful way to see the island
review_text:
Plane vs. Helicopter seems to be a matter of thrill vs. camera shots. In the plane, it seems you can get better camera shots because you are further away from everything, but we saw helicopters underneath us who could go quite close to the waterfalls and craters, etc. I imagine it would be awesome to experience but even more difficult to capture. If money were no issue, I might opt for the helicopter but I have no regrets on our plane experience. 
My friend and I booked the slightly larger plane because we wanted the bubble windows for better visibility. Unfortunately because there were not four of us, they called us to switch to the private jet, which I was a bit bummed about due to less window visibility (which they at least admitted) even though they didn't charge extra. Regardless, views were nicer on the side than I was worried we'd get (if you're short, it is hard to see out the front even as co-pilot). Doug was super calm and very friendly, which helps if you get altitude sickness (so do their ginger candies and water). Getting there 30min early seemed unnecessary since they didn't see us til 10 min before, yet again were very friendly. Overall would highly recommend seeing Kauai by air, whatever way it is that best works for you and your schedule/budget.

If you visit Talkeetna this trip is a must. The flight and glacier landing were breathtaking. Our pilot was an excellent guide as well as a very accomplished flyer. He gave stacks of interesting info throughout the flight.

My husband WANTED to take this flight around base camp, landing on the glacier again and he was not disappointed!!! It was a beautiful day up there and is bound to be the highlight of most trips to Alaska (seeing the bears is pretty exciting too).  They have a 25% off coupon in the Northern Lights coupon book also which helps a great deal on the cost. It helps if you are going to be in the area for a couple of days because weather interferes with your plans. The staff is helpful trying to accommodate your plans.
View was great! First experience for me and I enjoyed it. De pilot did a great job, although it would be nice if he would give us a bit more information about what we saw.

Our flight around the Denali mountain was awesome.  We were supposed to be able to land on the glacier but was not able to do that at no fault of Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Well worth the expense & the trip.
Thank you to our pilot.

review_title: Best way to see Kauai Island
review_text: After we took off we flew over Waimea Canyon and Mount Waialeale to enjoy the sights of towering waterfalls and lush valleys. Then we enjoyed the many views of the spectacular Na Pali Coast. This is the best way to see Kauai Island and I would do this again

Es war der perfekte Tag. Es war ein unvergessliches Erlebnis für uns. Muss mach gemacht haben. Es war ein riesen Spaß, cooler Pilot mit tollen Informationen über die Stadt. Viele Grüße an unsren Hamburger Jung :-).

This was one of the best things I have ever done!   Words cannot describe the beauty and magnificence of flying around the mountain in such an up close and personal way.    WOW.    Make sure you include this in your trip to Alaska!

The trip that I booked was rained out. The people at TALKEETNA AIR TAXI let my reservation slide until the following Saturday. I showed up early and they put me on the next flight. Jonathan was our pilot. Great guy. Extremely knowledgeable about the mountains, glaciers, rivers and Alaska. The trip from take off to landing was awesome! Denali is beautiful! And huge!  Jonathan told us about glacial movement and how big they really are. Perspective from a plane is different
Landing on the glacier is a rush. Walking in a foot of snow in August was fun.
There are no bad seats on the plane. The pilot flies by twice so both sides of the plane can see. Of course the view is spectacular out of either side. I am ready to do it again!
Plane ride over Denali was awesome!  The Talkeetna air taxi staff were knowledgeable and very friendly.  I would suggest this attraction.

Our ride provided spectacular views of the Waimea Canyon and Na Pali coast.  We also had a great view of a whale slapping it's tail off the Na Pali coast.  Pilot Harry was very skilled and provided great insight.  A great time was had by all.
The pilot was very professional and easy to listen to about facts on the island. The view was spectacular and we thought this was the best way to view the shore and mountains.

Took my father as a 70th birthday present.  We both had a incredible time. An easy day trip from Anchorage. Took the 8:30am flight and had amazing views of the North side of Denali.  They seem to adjust the flight to get the most out of the weather.  Extremely capable, friendly and informed pilot (thanks Clay).  Glacier landing is a must.  Staff at reception were great.  Had us checked in and ready in no time.  Would definitely recommend TAT for this.

review_title: the best part of our 11 nights in Alaska
review_text: We read all of the other reviews about SeaWind and all of the other flightseeing tours and are we ever glad that we went with SeaWind Aviation.  Steve (the owner) was our pilot,who was born and raised in Ketchikan.  He knows more about the Misty Fjords than anyone else, has a great sense of humor and and even greater sense of the seer beauty and majesty of the misty Fjords.  We laned on a glassy water inlet tha was so smooth, you would never know that you were landing on water (pr taking off). This trip was so much fun and very educational. A great, great trip.  Leslie runs the business part of the company has to be the nicest, most efficient and warming person on the face of the earth.  I had several encounters with her over the phone prior to our trip and she answered each questions professionally an sweetly and made me feel like their most welcome and important client.  I would recommend the in a heartbeat.  Everyone on the plane felt about the same way as I did,  You can not find nicer or happier people.anywhere.  This is a first class operation the whole way. ,

Great and amazing flight.pick up at pier very good.
Check in Quick 
Pilot very kind and professional.
I will recommand this activité.

Our family selected this flight as an option on our G Adventures tour. The experience in he helicopter was, literally, the experience of a lifetime. Absolutely breathtaking! Our pilot BJ was absolutely wonderful, getting us all involved and pointing out lots of interesting aspects. He even shared his favourite playlist with us. The experience on the ground was fantastic as well, with a great setup and very friendly and helpful staff. I could not fault the experience and would highly recommend to anyone visiting the Grand Canyon.

Loved my ride with Northwest Seaplanes! 

Check-in was easy, hangar staff was friendly and promptly answered any questions I had regarding the planes. Drinks along with merchandise items were available for purchase. Would love it if they carried tank tops for the hot summer months!

The seaplane base was easy to find and get to, as you don’t have to fight the fugly, steaming mess of traffic around Lake Union. 

The flight was absolutely gorgeous, smooth and afforded amazing views. The planes are smaller, and definitely loud, but you get a headset that allows you to both listen to the pilot talk to the tower and talk to the pilot. 

The landing in Friday Harbor is a treat and the entire town is fully walkable. I spent the day exploring the island with a moped (thanks Susie’s). Return was a similar, hassle-free affair. If and when I travel to the San Juans again, it’ll only be with NWS.

This was one of the most amazing excursions we've ever taken. We wanted to see Grand Canyon but the drive was 4-5 hours..We were picked up at our resort, boarded the plane with 2 other couples, stopped at Sedona to pick up another couple and off to the canyon..Entire trip was narrated..and the views were breathtaking. Once we landed, we boarded a helicopter which brought us to the base of the canyon... these views were amazing... then we were led to pontoon boats which brought us on a short ride along the Colorado river.. We felt like we were part of a movie scene...then back on the helicopter to bring us back to West rim..We then boarded a bus which brought us to the glass Skywalk and then onto Eagle Point for lunch!  All of this was so well organized...Westwind air is topnotch..We thank Karla (our pilot and tour guide) and the others at Westwind Air for making this the most amazing trip in our lives.

review_title: Our Crab Fest Flight was awesome!
review_text:
We (2 adults & 2 10 year old boys) did the crab feast on our Disney cruise last summer. We booked the crab fest flight through DCL for our excursion in Ketchikan.
So glad we did. We were picked up at the ship and taken to their "air port"/docks.
Our pilot (I REALLY wish I had written down his name Dave or Dan maybe) was just AWESOME!
The office staff was so friendly and helpful as well. 
My son still has the float planes he bought in the gift shop in his room.
We boarded our float plane and took off for the flight. Our son was even allowed to be the co-pilot!
Our pilot was so so knowledgeable during our flight and shared do much fantastic information on what we were seeing.
We arrived at George Inlet Lodge for our crab feast. (separate review)
If ever back in Alaska I would definitely book with these guys again for a tour!

user_location: I was in Omaha Nebraska I live in Arizona
review_title: I would highly recommend the red tour around Mt McKinley. Our pilot was very knowledgeable.
review_text: We had great weather I recommend you try to get a seat as far forward as possible. I sat in the 4th row and it was difficult to see over the wings.
user_city: I was in Omaha Nebraska I live in Arizona

review_text: Our airplane ride into Denali National Park was nothing short of amazing! Our pilot, Christopher, was skilled, friendly and very knowledgeable of the area, it’s weather and history. He brought our attention to many sites below, identifying main highways, the railway, glaciers, mountains rivers, structures and shared interesting facts about each. Besides the amazing views from above, we made a smooth landing on a glacier where we were able to deplane and snap some awesome photos! I’d like to thank Chris and K2 Aviation for one of the most memorable lifetime experiences and would highly recommend this for anyone’s bucket list!
Fabulous staff.  Fabulous vista.  Fabulous narration and circled around the Napali Coast a bit so we could enjoy it even more.  Seated everyone for maximum views.

review_title: Thanks for the great memories Bruce & Ellen!
review_text: What an awesome flight.  My wife, two kids and I spend a wonderful Sunday morning encircling the island of Kauai with probably one of the most knowledgeable and professional individuals on the island of Kauai.  A retired agronomist, Bruce the pilot provided us with information about the botany of the island that no one else could have.  I can see why people time and again have ranked the attraction as one of the number one activities to add to your itinerary while staying in Kauai.  Thanks for the free DVD, the family and I will remember this trip for a very long time while we are back in Wisconsin.  Dan, Julie, Kolton & Kiara Krolow.

user_location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
review_text:
K2 gave us an absolutely fantastic tour of Mt. McKinley and the surrounding area.  I was very nervous - but the flight was smooth as glass and our pilot Chip did a great job!  Experience and photos - PRICELESS!

Plus, they picked us up at the hotel and everyone had a great attitude!

We flew with AirVentures on our trip to Kauai. Check in was easy and our pilot JT was amazing. Not only was he a great pilot but he also was a great tour guide. I highly recommend this flight early in your visit to the Garden Isle. Aloha!

review_title: Don't miss this chance to see Kauai from the air
review_text: I am not in love with flying and I've never been in a small plane, so I was more than a little leery when I discovered that one of our party of four had booked us on a Air Ventures tour of Kauai. As it turned out, I loved the flight and had a fantastic time. The pilot, Paul, was very skilled and made sure that everyone had ample opportunity to see all the points of interest. His commentary was informative and quite humorous and the views of Kauai from the air were spectacular. I highly recommend this tour.

We recently returned from a land and sea vacation in Alaska. Our K2 flight to Mt. Denali with a landing on Pika Glacier was the highlight of our entire vacation! The views of the Alaskan Range as we flew between the mountain peaks, into the valleys, and over numerous glaciers was fantastic. Flying around the summit of Denali was breathtaking; unbelievable how awesome this mountain is. The weather cooperated and we were able to land on Pika Glacier and walk around on the snow covered glacier. What an experience! Chris, our pilot, was wonderful and gave us very informative commentary throughout our flight. Many, many thanks to K2 and to Chris for such a wonderful flight! Would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Alaska.

I had originally scheduled to take the Denali Grand Tour, but sadly the weather did not cooperate. Thankfully, K2 was able to reschedule me for a different tour to see several of the glaciers that were further south towards Wasilla and Anchorage. It was really beautiful!

review_title: Great experience across the SFO bay
review_text:
With the best Beaver pilot in the bay area we had an awesome trip around SFO bay area.
👍👍. 
Beautiful aircraft amazing scenery and great staff. Expensive.. yes but worth every penny

We flew over Denali the first of September, 2016.  Not a cloud in the royal blue sky, temperature in the 50's and a bit of wind that somewhat limited flight distance; however, the trip turned out to be an experience of a lifetime. I relate the following to show what an outstanding person our pilot Patrick Carter was, as well as the company K2 Aviation was in going above and beyond what is normally expected. While waiting in office area for flight takeoff, a very elderly gentleman with a cane walking extremely slowly and with carefully measured steps walked in alone.  He had great difficulty even stepping up on the scales to weigh in before takeoff.  I silently thought to myself that he would never have the ability to physically climb up the plane steps and certainly not into the plane.  We, along with the other passengers, were waiting to board the steps into the plane when Patrick started talking to the elderly gentleman.  Much to our surprise, the gentleman told us he was a WWII bomber pilot.  After helping him into the plane, Patrick asked him to sit in the seat beside him which he did. All the passengers had headphones and were able to hear him recount some of his WWII experiences as well as all his discussions about airplanes with Patrick. What an experience it was.  Not only were we viewing scenery that is almost beyond description, but we were transported back in time aboard that WWII bomber plane by listening to discussions between the elderly gentleman and Patrick.  When we arrived back to K2, some of the passengers took pictures of Patrick and the WWII pilot in front of the plane. The company even sent out a van to pick up the gentleman and drive him to his hotel.  These pictures will always remind me of our amazing pilot who was so well versed about Denali and the spectacular scenery, as well as the thoughtfulness and kindness exhibited not only by him, but also of this amazing company.  It truly turned out to be an experience of a lifetime.

review_title: Jolie balade mais coeur fragile s'abstenir.
review_text: Les ados ont adoré mais nous n'avons pas apprécié pleinement ce vol assez mouvementé. À priori les autres passagers se sont régalés... Nous avons tout de même pris de très jolies photos.

review_title: Super Duper Once in a Lifetime Experience!
review_text: After several days of rain, we were driving into Talkeetna to take the Hurricane Turn train, but as we topped the hill leading down into town, we were stunned to see clear skies over the mountain range, with clouds moving in but not there yet.  We detoured to K2 to see when the next "round the mountain" flight was leaving, and it was in just 30 minutes, and they had room for us, so we signed up immediately.  We left about 20 minutes late, but still managed to beat the clouds.  Our pilot (Robert?) did a great job, taking us on several tracks that I don't think were usually done, just so we could make the most of the north side where the clouds hadn't reached.  It was fantastic to see the cloud cover move in, so gorgeous!  The trip lasted much longer than I thought it would, went around many more peaks than I expected, got closer to the Wickersham wall, to the point where it almost seemed like you could reach out and touch it, saw so many glaciers I stopped counting, absolutely fantastic!  Worth every penny!

We flew with Bruce in August for the morning flight.  We loved every minute of it - from the personal check-in, the photos taken while boarding, and of course, the amazing view from the air!  Bruce is a wonderful pilot and I never felt unsafe while on the plane. Wings over Kauai was recommended by a good friend of mine, and I would highly recommend it to anyone reading this!

The flight over the canyon provided a great opportunity to see the canyon, rapids and various key attractions (horseshoe bend, etc.).  The trip to antelope canyon was awesome.  The Navajo guide (Patrick) was awesome.  The pictures here were amazing.  The trip ended with a rafting trip down the Colorado river.  My girlfriend and I enjoyed this the most.  Beautiful sights, good conversation with other participants.  I would definitely suggest this for people to do.

Had a wonderful flight with pilot, Harry.  Beautiful day for flying. Harry was very knowledgeable about the island and it’s history and pointed out many areas that one can only see from the air.  Great fun to fly in an open cockpit biplane. My friend had taken a helicopter tour in the past, but she said this was much better.  This is the ONLY way to tour the island from the air.

review_title: Amazing Birthday Present - Scenic View, Perfect Weather, Nice Pilot
review_text: We went on the waterfalls tour, and it was gorgeous. They canceled due to weather during our original date, and we were so glad they did, because we ended up coming in on a day with perfect weather instead. Devyn was our pilot and he was great at his pilot-ing as well as informing us of sites to keep in mind and where they would be, as well as personable and friendly in general. The takeoff and landing were smoother than a regular plane, and the whole ride was bump-free, shockingly. It was extremely beautiful and wonderful. I will go on more tours with Envi. 5 stars, well-earned.

Excellent experience. Beforehand, they were very upfront about the possibility of not landing due to weather and gave us opportunity for refund. However, we decided to go for it and were able to land on the glacier! Gorgeous views of greenery and snowy ice. Our pilot was so confident and comfortable we all felt very at ease. Spacious tour with only 5 other people in the plane. Highlight for sure!

It was absolutely amazing!!!!  Mike, our pilot, was awesome!   He was very knowledgeable and very personal!  What a wonderful young man!  The experience of flying around the mountains and landing on the Root Glacier at the base of Denali was magnificent!!!! Its hard to explain in words of how fantastic this trip was.  This trip will truly be a very special memory for me and my husband for the rest of our lives.

review_title: Cheaper than helicopters, and way better in my opinion!
review_text:
Their pitch is half the price, with a more personalised experience. You are also riding in a safer plane than a helicopter. The helicopter is rumbly, my friend threw up on it, but it does get in the nooks and crannies. However, to me, this was perfect enough. You get to see everything in a comfortable seating with your own window seating and audio gear. The views are amazing and totally worth the cost! Even if it's a little misty out.
The best part is the people. They are probably the nicest people I've ever met, haha. Also, they are incredibly knowledgeable about EVERYTHING on the island from history, people, agriculture, even politics I'd say. I learned more on this adventure than in my entire 4 years of high school history class.
You get free drinks on the plane, ladies get the free flower that Bruce grows himself, and a Hawaiian necklace made out of.... I'm not going to even try to spell it. Also with lots of opportunities for photos (and they don't try to charge you for them like all the other tours!)
Overall excellent experience!!

This was fantastic. Our pilot was fantastic. We had already done a boat tour so see the coast so this really was cool to see the same area from above. It really gives you a good look at the island and its beauty.

I also have taken a helicopter tour on the Big Island and the boat tour, both which I got sick on. I get motion sickness easily. However, I DID NOT GET SICK on this tour. I actually got to really enjoy it.

I did take my own pictures but decided to go ahead and purchase the video they offer for something like $50. Totally worth it. I just got it today and you can only image how much better it was than anything I took. Highly recommend to spend the $50, sit back and not take any pictures.

Take this tour with this company - excellent!

review_title: Great Views but couldnt do Glacier Landing
review_text: Booked a glacier landing trip but when we reached the weather was bad . Good customer care , even when the weather was not allowing they gave options to change the booking to another day or refund or fly without landing. We changed to another day but the weather didnt allow us next time as well , so we had to choose not to land on glacier. So missed the landing , but they refunded the difference in cost and we did get to see denali from above :)
Incredible! Once in a lifetime experience and totally worth the price. We flew over Haleakala and it was tremendous. My son got to co-fly the plane!
sadly our flight was cancelled because the weather was too bad (too bumpy to be comfortable). The cancellation was handled professionally and the refund of our deposit was prompt.

review_title: Amazing Views, Once in a lifetime experience
review_text: Friendly and very helpful staff. The pilot was also very friendly and explained in detail of what we were seeing during flight. The views are amazing. We took the Grand Denali tour and highly recommend it along with glacier landing.

I just received great service from Gary and Mike at Redtail Aviation.  While flying my P210 from Salt Lake City (KSLC) to Canyonlands Field (KCNY) the pilot's door latch let go and would not allow the door to latch.  Within minutes of landing my plane was in the shop and repaired.  Now when I leave for a return to CA I can fly in comfort pressurized.  Great guys and great service!

Thank you,

Joe Graziano
I was both terrified and excited when we went up to see the glacier. The pilot was very knowledgeable about all the places we flew! Very happy

review_title: Must-do flight-seeing over McKinley and its glorious glaciers
review_text: Although this was a pricey flight, it is a definite must-do. Try getting some local coupon books to save some money on the flights. The 10-seater plane itself was clean and well-maintained. The ride over the mountains and the Denali NP was spectacular. The pilot was friendly and very helpful. He gave us ample time on the glaciers to walk around and take pictures; we didn't feel rushed.
This was a great experience and fantastic way to view the island! Friendly folks greet you and make the flight fun. I would highly recommend!

review_title: A great way to see Kuaui.
review_text: This was an excellent flight tour of the island. The tour was professionally handled and very informative. Our pilot was great. The entire staff made the trip memorable. A great experience.  Go Hokies.

review_title: Great views of EVERYTHING in Kaua'i
review_text: The Air Ventures team did a very nice job. The pilot was funny, well-informed, and very skilled.  We saw everything interesting along the coasts-- historical landmarks, popular resorts, and beautiful windows into nature.

review_title: If your a pilot this is the tour for you
review_text: As a pilot a fantastic way to see the island and have some fun actually flying the plane : very good value for the money : we circumnavigated the whole island and we’re up for over an hour:

Absolutely loved it! Lived in the Bay Area my entire life and finally toured over it! My boyfriend and I did the “Sunset and Champagne” package which was nothing short of amazing. Champagne was DELICIOUS, plus 40 minutes in the sky admiring the beautiful Bay Area and listening to the pilot’s short history stories. Will definitely come back to do this again! Thank you Seaplane Adventures!

This was one of our favorite things that we did while we were in Kauai(and we did a lot!). The flight was beautiful! I can't even put into words how amazing this was. I was a little apprehensive about being in a plane versus the helicopter but I was happy with the decision we made. I saw helicopters along the tour and they do get a little closer to the waterfalls and mountains but there is something truly amazing about getting a zoomed out view of Kauai, I feel like I got to see more of the island this way. In addition to the scenery, the pilot was extremely nice and knowledgeable and made sure we were comfortable throughout the whole flight. Furthermore, the other staff at Wings over Kauai were AMAZING! They have a few surprises for their guests that I won't ruin here, but I will say that they are very generous! I HIGHLY recommend this activity to everyone!!!
I’m an outdoorsman, I’ve done some hang gliding, caving, rock climbing, rafting and kayaking. This was better than all of that especially landing on the glacier
It was such an awesome experience. My husband wanted to do this so we did the glacier landing and it was wonderful. He got to sit up with the pilot and so enjoyed that. I would highly recommend this.
We absolutely LOVED our K2 Aviation adventure!! It was pretty much Bucket List Perfect!! We would definitely recommend!!

We decided to take this tour based solely on the reviews we read from Tripadvisor and boy were the reviews right!

Like many of the reviewers and the reviews we read, we to have taken the helicopter tours and really enjoyed them as well.  This time, one of our group wasn't very comfortable with the helicopter idea so we decided we'd give the fixed wing tour a go.  We were met by Dori and she was great, her husband Josh was our pilot and he was absolutely outstanding.  Josh is a commercial pilot with American Airlines which goes a long way to relax you and he did a fantastic job making this tour one of the trips best experiences.  My parents went with us and even after spending many months on Kauai over the past 15 years, they both said they were able to see things they never new existed. It is saying something given the time they've spent on the island and that they've taken the helicopter tours before.  

Josh circled so we could watch a mother whale and her calf (who was really playfull), took his time on the Napali Coast to give us some fantastic pictures and really did a fantastic job giving us the grand tour and a bunch of the history about Kauai.

I'm not busting on the helicopter tours in anyway, they're great as well, but if you are looking for a very cool way to see Kauai that is just a little slower, this is the group to do it with!  This will be something that we will definately do again!

review_title: Excellent experience with a great team
review_text: Our experience with K2 Aviation was incredible, they were helpful and knowledgeable while providing us with an unbelievable experience. Our pilot Ryan was great at pointing out landmarks as we were in flight and made sure we were comfortable and enjoyed our trip. We will certainly fly with K2 again! Thank you for the unforgettable experience!

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: We had a fabulous time on this tour. Everyone was so friendly and informative. We wanted to see the whole island but didn't want to spend a whole day at sea...this was perfect. The tour is just over an hour and we didn't feel like we missed anything. We definitely recommend it!

I wasn't prepared to take this tour, but boy am I happy I did.  This was the only breathtaking view of Kauai, and Na Pali Coast.  This needs to be a must!  Our pilot was knowledgeable and pointed all the areas, and even circled around when we caught a glimpse of a whale so we could get a good view.  The island is simply magnificient and the Waimea canyon could only be viewed frkm all sides thru an aerial tour. Great Job Air Ventures!
Eric was amazing! The flight was amazing. Got to see views we would never have seen any other way. He even recommended a couple of places to go to in addition to this flight!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: We were on Kauai as part of Cruise of Islands.  Having done helicopter trip many times was very excited to give Air Ventures a shot.  It was great! Plenty of time to take pictures and see the things you can't see when zooming in and out of canyons.  Plenty of space inside and everyone had a great view.Would recommend to all ages.

Our Pilot, Desi, made our son's day. Our son hasDown Syndrome, and Desi made him, her co-pilot. He still talks about it & says it was his favorite thimg done on our vacation. For us, the tour was very informative, enjoyable, beautiful scenery & just plain fun. Not only would. we fly with Air Ventures again, we would ask for Desi again. Thanks, Desi, for making Bill's day & vacation.

My family traveled to Alaska so that I could visit my last National Park- Lake Clark. We also wanted to visit as many parks along the way as we possibly could in just 10 days. Our flight to the glacier in Denali National Park was a highlight on our trip. Our pilot, Chris, took my family of 9- including a 7 month old baby boy- on a flight we will remember the rest of our lives. Landing on the glacier in the Otter ski plane, seeing Denali close up and getting to stay and play on the glacier was absolutely awesome- and I do not use that phrase lightly. Thank  you Talkeetna Air Taxi for adding to the best trip my family will ever take!!!
This trip was more than I could ever dream of! The views were insanely beautiful and the experience was GREAT. It is a MUST!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text:
Paul was our pilot and was a wonderful tour guide as well as excellent pilot.  This was my first trip to Kauai and if I could only choose one of the several activities we did while there - this would be it!  The views were fantastic and the history and local education during the tour was extremely interesting.  This is a fantastic way to see the whole island and the variety of beauty Kauai has to offer.
I will say that if you have never flown in a small plane or are prone to motion sickness that taking something prior to the flight would be a very good idea.  Although I was with friends who have flown on many small planes and they commented that the pilot did an excellent job!
Thanks for helping make our vacation memorable :)
Diane F - Reno NV

review_title: Brilliant way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: We had a fantastic flight with Jack as the pilot. Incredible views of the  Grand Canyon and the surrounding National Park.  The seating in our aircraft was brilliant as everyone was sitting next to a window.  I don't know what the regulations are but it would have been nice to get a little lower.
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_title: An unforgettable way to see a new side of the islands
review_text: Flying with Eric was an amazing experience. We saw parts of the islands we could never reach by car. We also saw familiar places from new angles. Flying between the peaks of the big island was spectacular!

Le jour de ma réservation il faisait très mauvais. Nous sommes passé à l'agence et il m'ont tout de suite remboursé les 100$ que j'avais versé en acompte, sans poser de questions.Je regrette de ne pas l'avoir fait (le survol du Denali et glacierlanding), ça valait certainement le coup.

Our group did both the bear viewing and salmon fishing trip and also the heli-hiking. The pilots, equipment, and guides were all first class. Would highly recommend. The highlight of our Alaska vacation.

Amazing views! Incredible experience for our family 
The pilot was great and showed us the most beautiful scenery’s

Our flight was with Bruce, who was brilliant, Very friendly and reassuring (I was a bit afraid of flying but it was fine). Took us around the island on a very enjoyable flight - the views were amazing and Bruce was very experienced.

review_title: Can’t Leave Alaska without This Experience!
review_text: Words cannot fully express, but here’s to trying…The views are enormous and unlike any I’ve ever witnessed. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable. The experience of being in a plane landing and taking off in the snow is indescribable. We had previously booked the flight a day later, but the wonderful staff was able to change our date because of the clear weather and availability. Seeing the evening sun (4 pm flight) in our photos was simply gorgeous. I can’t give this crew enough stars! (Our flight was the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing.)

Absolute must do. Two days ago we were lucky enough to book a trip with Redtail Air. Craig was our pilot. Extremely knowledgeable. He learned to fly in this area. His knowledge both of the region in the geology of  the region helped with the enjoyment.  And absolutely wonderful experience that you should take it vantage of.

Me & my friends had booked this scenic 1hr Sunset tour for our Miami vacation this July. Though the cost was high we took a chance based upon the reviews read. We reached there on time & once our pilot arrived we didn't waste a minute. Our pilot was very friendly & made the 4 of us very comfortable within minutes of our introduction. As the weather was in our favour the whole tour was breathtakingly beautiful & our pilot entertained us by his non-stop knowledge about the places. We covered all of Miami & our pilot even took a chance of taking us towards the far most aerial border of Miami so that we can get a better snap of the sunset. All in all we didn't understand how the 1hr flew by but the whole tour was worth every $ spend. I am so happy with this experience that I have already recommended this to all my friends for their 
future tours.

There is so much of the beautiful island of Kaua’i that is inaccessible by road. So, you either have to take a boat trip or an airplane (or helicopter) ride.
The boat trip will reveal all the majestic beauty of the Na Pali Coast, but from the air you can see not only the craggy west coast, but also the beauty of the interior…the lush land, the waterfalls and Waimea Canyon (The Grand Canyon of the Pacific and so much more.
Air ventures is a great way to do this activity. The plane ride is much more keenly priced than the helicopters, and I venture (no pun intended) to suggest just as good.
On my trip, Pilot Nate was full of explanations of the history, the land and details of the rock formations. He skilfully guided over the many lovely waterfalls and after sn hour brought his charges safely back to Lihue.
I strongly recommend AirVentures to anyone eager to see and learn about Kaua’i.

Today my wife and I chartered a helicopter tour through Redtail Air Adventures. Our helicopter was piloted by a young man by the name of Jon, who was exceptionally talented in his profession!! Jon, took us to so many of the areas in the Canyonland park that we were obviously unable to access by vehicle.  He explained what each site was and gave many fun facts throughout the tour. If you are in the area and are interested,  I highly recommend taking this tour with Redtail Air Adventures. Jon made our last day here in Moab most memorable!! Thank you all at Redtail!!
Cheers,
Arthur

Eric had super aloha spirit and did a great job of explaining what we were seeing. Lots of cool highlights and a Molokini flyover! Would strongly recommend Maui Plane Rides for a uniques view of Maui County.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: Em grupo de nove pessoas fizrmos um voo espetacular no rosso K2. Emocionante e inesquecivel. Recomendo a todos. Vale a pena. O voo faz pouso na neve e se pode baixar e caminhar, fazer fotos, correr, rir, voltar a ser criança jogando neve uns nos outros. Fantasticos momentos. Não deixe de voar.... É um passeio imperdivel...
Flight over mountains and Glaciers--excellent Pilot. FABULOUS TOUR !!!   This was the Best tour of the trip and we come often -- have done them all😊

review_title: Highlight of our trip to AK
review_text: This is the first time I have flown in a small airplane so was a little hesitant.  I should not have been as the flight was excellent and I never once felt scared.  I thought the flight might be turbulent but it wasn't.  Our pilot was Alex and he was calm, cool and collect during our 1 1/2 hour flight with glacier landing.  He advised us what we were seeing every step of the way and his landing were terrific. My husband and I were so glad we took this flight and chose Talkeetna Air Taxi...Outstanding.

I didn't have a lot of time, still wanted to see nature's wonder called Grand Canyon.i booked this trip for 169USD and it was more than I expected. We were transported to boulder municipal airport from our hotel by the airline very comfortably. Our plane was a 17 seater Canada made vista liner with huge windows for full view.

Our pilots were friendly and expert on flying this sector. Plane has pre recorded commentary but you won't hear a lot foot due engine's noise.

This flight gives great view of Hoover dam and a small section of Grand Canyon. It's it for you if you want to spend time in or around Grand Canyon.

I strong recommendation for people short on time still wanting to have a flavor of Hoover dam, Colorado river and Grand Canyon.

This was our first flight. The pilot was friendly and very informative. 
He made the flight pleasant. He removed all anxiety we had.

K2 provided an amazing experience flying in Denali. Our pilot and guide, Daniel, was phenomenal! We flew around the many peaks of the Alaska range in comfort as Daniel pointed out many interesting features. The glacier landing tour is easily the highlight of any Alaska vacation and I am very happy that I chose to go with K2!
Alex was an outstanding pilot when we  circumnavigated Denali at  12,000 feet. Landing uphill on the glacier at base camp was exciting. This made my trip to Alaska more memorable than I expected.

Great trip, really informative pilot, he took us all over Miami including the port and beaches, great fun taking off and landing on the water, very enjoyable view of Miami, highly recommended and not expensive either.

The other reviewers have said it all but I am still compelled: You will like Bruce and Ellen (and their family) and entirely trust Bruce's professionalism. They will treat you well. Bruce will keep up the interesting observations even if you don't comment, and is well versed in any subject matter you might bring up. We've done helicopter tours on two other islands and I prefered this by far. The viewing was just as good, and comfort just as high (with the Bose noise cancellation headphones.) The only thing I noticed was that the helicopters would take you down into a coastal canyon, but having seen these from the ocean and the ridges, the (intrusive) flight in would have added nothing. 

(And the reviewer who just mentioned the tip was right. The Coulombes are without any hucksterism that the tourist industry thrives on. You could tell that Bruce really, really, tried to make an effort by way of a joke, but at the same time the concept was plainly abhorrent to him - it made me smile to myself. In fact I felt strange giving a "tip" to a consummate professional so I snuck it in to Ellen later. Remember - they really treat you right at a great value.)

review_title: Air Tour Page to Grand Canyon Tour with Westwind
review_text: To say that this splurge exceeded our expectations would be a huge understatement.  IT WAS WORTH EVERY PENNY!  Our pilot, Jordan, was professional, knowledgeable, and a great pilot.  There is no way we have ever seen so much splendor in such a short time if we had not taken this tour.  We got to see so much in a comfortable plane.  No crowds. No extreme heat (it was August). No lines.  Just a chance to absorb the beauty of this magical place.  We can’t recommend this enough.  You won’t be sorry.

The views from the helicopter were awe inspiring. Our guide Quincy was a capable pilot, however, as a guide, he spoke very rapidly and was therefore very hard to understand. Our only other objection was with the expectation that we tip the pilot. Charge more and do not put your customers in the awkward position of feeling obligated to pay out more money.

review_title: Amazing flight over the mountains this afternoon.
review_text:
Thanks for an outstanding flight this afternoon over the Denali national Park. What spectacular views, breathtaking. 

We went up in a Cessna with pilot Paul.  Smooth take off and landing.  Very informative as we traveled over the different areas.  

The plane was very comfortable with nice windows to easily see everything around us. 

Kimberly was wonderful to deal with when we booked our flight.  Offering many different options to suit our needs.  

Would recommend Talkeetna taxi air to anyone looking to do an aerial tour of the area.  

Thanks for a great flight.

We took an 8:30 AM private tour. The staff  communicated well with us on needed schedule changes based on their bookings and our schedule. Check-in and directions were clear and very smooth. Makao was our pilot and was the highlight of the tour (scenery excluded of course), he had a wealth of knowledge about the island and created a fun and relaxed atmosphere. We felt like we got a great feel for all aspects of the island and he made sure we got great views. We would highly recommend Air Ventures, the private tour and Makao.

Staff very courteous and professional. Had a very trustworthy experienced pilot. Weather was perfect so the sights were amazing. Landing and taking off from a high mountain lake just added even more to the experience. Would absolutely recommend based on weather.

review_title: Bus Tour from Las Vargas ,national Park parking
review_text: The Buses are available of A.c. coat he's of two By to to Take you to round tour from to.These buses halts at all visitor points to take you to nearest attraction of cannon beauty and attractions.You will get rest room and other needs like foods at subside rates.We took water and other beverages for summer heat.The tour was so attractive that other missed places of great nature thrust of visiting has been in mind.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai - A Cut Above
review_text: Knowing that my wife, Valerie, wouldn't consider a helicopter experience over the island, (neither would I) I researched WOK and talked her into the flight.  WOW!  We totally enjoyed the kindness and trust in Bruce and Ellen.  We were going to fly a day earlier, but the weather conditions weren't the best so they rescheduled us for the following day.  Val was the copilot and helped Bruce with the checklist.  After checking for birds, we were off.  At half the price of a chopper and so personalized, just the three of us, you couldn't ask for more.  Make sure Bruce demonstrates the Bose noise cancelling headset.  Incredible!This flight was the highlight of our week on Kauai.
A truly unreal experience.  I'm terrified of heights and the pilot went gentle.  Such an amazing view of entire island.  Highly highly recommend

Our guide was fantastic and the whole experience was incredible. The ride was comfortable and the views were breathtaking. A helicopter tour is a must-do while on Maui. Landing in the rainforest was a great experience. Our guide showed us and explained many of the plants which was very interesting.

My daughter and I took the Wildlife flight along with 2 others in the plane.  The pilot was very informative without feeling like he needed to continually talk. We both appreciated that.  We did the remote lake landing as well.  It was a nice addition. We didn't see too many animals, some bears mostly, and attribute that to it being a little later in the afternoon and hotter than normal, so most animals may have been waiting out the heat.  All in all, a great experience.  We definitely recommend Alaska Bush Float Plane Service.
We did the Red Baron tour with Harry.  it was absolutely worth the money (and we like to live cheaply)!
Loved the flight! The staff and pilot were amazing, and of course the views were incredible. I’m not usually one to pay for tourist activities, but this was definitely worth it!!

We had booked our flight over the Grand Canyon before we left Australia. On the morning of our flight there was thick fog and sleet falling so was quite hairy driving to the airport. Needless to say, helicopters could not fly because of no visibility. They asked us to come back at noon to see if the weather had improved.  Maverick offered a shortened flight so off we went. Our pilot was very experienced and we felt very safe.
It was a wonderful flight looking down into the canyon and seeing the Colorado River far below. 

Don't miss a flight with Maverick as they have excellent pilots and very new helicopters.

My bf and I did the airplane, antelope canyon and river rafting trip September 3rd.  I had an amazing time.  The flight was the best part. It was comfy and had a breathtaking view.  Seeing antelope canyon was awesome and it was beautiful but very a busy touristy area.  The river trip was awesome and beautiful as well however, it lasted a little longer than I care for and the captain kept stopping the raft.  My back was hurting by the end of the trip. But the captain Castro was amazing, knowledgeable, and kept the trip entertaining.

I am an Instrument rated Private Pilot (haven't flown since we started having kids) and decided to take my 10 and 12 year old boys on the Na Pali Mist tour last week.  I read many reviews and not only felt excited about the flight, but also very comfortable taking my kids.  They had never been in a light plane and never got nauseous on this flight.

The experience was great.  It started with a preflight discussion about where we were going to go, what we would see, as well as flight safety.  Then we were introduced to the Pilot who provided more in-plane information on safety and the flight.  The condition of the plane was excellent.  Very airworthy aircraft.  

We took off and headed toward the Southeast corner of the island.  He maintained an excellent viewing altitude and knew where to fly the airplane and how to bank it to allow all the passengers to see the many highlights of the island.  His knowledge of the agriculture, history, and geology of the land is amazing.

As we headed up the canyons, the pilot used care to avoid the clouds to maintain good visual contact with the ground and with other aircraft (many helicopters).  He allowed me to put the window in the up position (the wind around the wing keeps it up once it's opened) to take some amazing photographs of the Na Pali coast.

All in all, it was a great flight.  Couldn’t have asked for more. 
I hate to mention it because it I didn't go on it because of the reduced cost, but the flight for the three of us was a quarter of what a helicopter ride would have cost.

The pilot was very safe and knowledgeable.  The aircraft is well maintained and in great condition.  You won't regret it.  Below is a sample of a picture from our flight....

We wanted to do something special for our anniversary and decided to fly over Kauai.  We were on a cruise ship and were very limited in the time available to us.  Ellen picked us up close to the cruise ship terminal and explained the tour to us.  When we arrived at the airport the plane we were going to fly on had to have an adjustment and if we waited we would not have been able to get back to our ship in time.  Bruce made arrangements for my husband and I to fly in a Cessna for the tour and also gave us a DVD with some scenes from a fliht over Kauai and sent us a photo with the plane. Our pilot was very informative and you could tell he really love the island.  He explained history, a little about the geography and showed us were many films were shot.  It was an incredible tour and I am so glad that I was able to make the flight.  It was one of the highlights of our trip.

The flight was awesome, great pilot, professional customer service. It was the best experience I had in Talkeetna, the views were truly amazing. We were able to land on the glacier at base camp, so cool! We saw the mountain climbers and their camps. Denali was in full view and clear. Would highly recommend this company.

When we got there it was sort of confusing on where to go but we were able to find it eventually. We were excited for the tour but as we got in the plane, it was a bit small uncomfortable and you can tell the plane was older. Once we were in the air, the doors weren't very stable and i was afraid they would open at any moment. The worst part was probably the fact that there was no sort of A/C or at least a fan inside so it was HOT. The tour overall was nice but i think there should be some upgrades on some of these things.
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: This was an incredible experience that was safe, well organized, attentive staff, safe equipment and an excellent and thoughtful pilot. Highly recommend. Was the highlight of our two week trip to AK.

Awesome!! Family of 4.  Easy & on time pick-up at docks. Pilot Eric was great.  More than enough time on plane landing  in middle of mountain fjord. Totally worth every penny, wife’s highlight of Alaska cruise

Booked this in conjunction with a crab feast through Celebrity's website. Had a great but short flight. It was perfect despite the typical weather in Ketchikan. I would definitely recommend this excursion for anyone seeking a little adventure!

review_title: Awesome views, but I recommend afternoon or early morning (Cessna private tour)
review_text:
You will get very good views, the pilot is nice, everything is smooth. However, what we noticed when on Kauai is that there seem to be sunlight <10am, then 12pm-2pm, and then >6pm mostly, and clouds during the rest of the time. So I would recommend either do a tour before 10am, or one in the afternoon. In our case, we did a 10am-11am flight tour, and we could still see everything (we were lucky, Waimea Canyon was not under the clouds), but we didn't get that much of this nice sunlight-colored cliffs you would want to see on Kauai.

Also, I wish the pilot had talked a bit more about the history / geography of the landscape rather than touristy information. He mostly pointed out beaches and told us about cities. I would have preferred to hear about how the canyon formed, how old is the island, its climate... If you see what I mean :)
Once in a lifetime experience! Beautiful views and very pleasant flight! Its worth it and will definatelly do it again!

We had the most amazing trip seeing Kaua’i thanks to our wonderful guide Parker. We couldn’t have imagined a better view of this beautiful island. Parker not only shared the island visually but also so many wonderful stories, facts and recommendations about the island and ideas for enjoying our time here. Flying with Wings Over Kaua’i was the highlight of our trip!

Hi, 
We were absolutely pleased by this experience, which we booked in advance from Australia, Josh our pilot was personable and passionate about the fantastic sights and locations, we were so fortunate to see the highest wetland in the world when the normally clouded summit was on view, the interesting terrain in the valleys and the touching story of finding Millie in such a location made us feel like family.
We could have easily asked for another lap, hopefully on our return in the future.
We highly recommend Ellen and Bruce fine enterprise.
As a bonus, our plane is also Australian!
Was a really a great experience would recommend it to anyone me and my girlfriend really love our tour
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text:
I have flown in many small planes, but nothing compares to flying in an open cockpit biplane.  This is what real flying is all about.

Highlights included Poipu beach, Waimea Canyon and the Princeville area before flying cross country over the jungle back to Lihue Airport.  

The best part of the trip was flying out over the Niipali coast, and watching humpback whales breaching the surface and splashing back down.  The pilot, who was excellent through the whole trip, circled around three or four times to let us watch the whales play.

Everybody should do this trip.

My wife and I were in San Francisco visiting family over the Christmas holidays and were given a seaplane tour by our kids for our 35th wedding anniversary. Seaplane Adventures helped our kids pull this surprise off. It was am amazing experience. Their shuttle driver was prompt and courteous. The tour was expertly organized. And the flight over SF was a once in a life time experience. The weather cooperated that day, so we have some memorable pictures. 

We would highly recommend Seaplane Adventures for a magnificently organized, professional and uniquely memorable experience.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi - #1 Customer Service; #1 Great Experience
review_text: Talkeetna Air Taxi puts customers first.  We had a beautiful day - beautiful trip.  People in the office were fantastic.  Pilot was fantastic.  Worth every penny.  Best part of our two week trip to Alaska.

Was in Anchorage for a conference and took advantage of some downtime to take a scenic flight, which I'd never done before.  At first, I thought the cost was a little pricey, but once the trip was over I felt the experience was well worth what I paid for it.  The pilot was first-rate in his flying skills and very knowledgeable about the nature, geography, and geology of the area (I'm sorry I can't remember his name, but he was outstanding).  The views were incredible and I learned much about the Alaska Range and its surroundings that I never knew before.  Oh -- and the experience of landing on a glacier was thrilling.  I would certainly recommend using Talkeetna Air to anyone interested in such a trip.  If I find myself in Alaska again I will certainly try to put them on my schedule one more time.

review_title: If you have limited time for a tour, make it this one!
review_text: Stand up guys, knowledgeable about the area, a great way to see a lot of things in a very short period of time, and a ton of fun!

My husband and I chose Wings over Kauai based on their excellent TripAdvisor reviews and terrific price in comparison to a helicopter tour -- we were not disappointed! Not that we've done the flight, we can honestly say these reviews are true to the experience you get with Bruce and Ellen and their team. We flew with Bruce on a gorgeous December morning and loved every minute of it - just as others noted though, we too wished it would have lasted longer! The hour goes by so quickly and you are left wanting to circle and circle again -- it is THAT beautiful! We had contemplated choosing Maui as the island to see by air and decided at the last minute to stick with Kauai since we'd heard it is the best island to see by air because of its beauty and its inaccessibilty by car -- again, SO TRUE! If you are worried because you're scared of heights or bumps, don't be! I was concerned (I'm not even comfortable with turbulence on commercial flights) and was surprised to find the ride to be smooth and felt completely safe -- not normal for me. I would highly recommend booking this as a phenomenal part of your trip that you'll always remember -- it brings the island to life like you'll never believe! Thanks, Wings!
My daughter and I enjoyed the 9AM tour - it was the perfect amount of time and the pilot was informative and shared interesting info about the landscape of the canyon. The flight was comfortable.
We had a great trip with our pilot Dal. It was a great day to view all the falls of the island, and the coasts.

Absolutely wonderful experience - great customer service, amazing experience, personable and engaging pilot! So so so glad we took the opportunity to see Mt. Denali from the air and land on a glacier. Highly recommend K2!

review_title: Amazing tour, cruise and flight lesson too!
review_text: I am a student pilot with abouit 24 hours under the belt. I booked a tour/flight lesson with Capt. Bruce and was also able to bring my wife along in the Cessna 172. The tour aspect was wonderful and the views of the entire island were spectacular. I also enjoyed being able to fly the entire trip and appreciated Bruce's split between tour navigator and flight instructor. It was the best activity I've ever done on a vacation. Don't miss this tour and if you are a pilot or a student pilot, consider the trip in the 172 and you too can be the PIC! Aloha and Mahalo

We were so blessed to have a beautiful, clear day to fly up to Denali, see it in all its glory and land on Ruth glacier. K2 was wonderful to work with in every way and we would highly recommend this trip to others.

review_title: Page AZ departure for lake Powell and Grand Canyon
review_text:
We booked by phone and boarded at Page airport while visiting lake Powell. We did not want to drive all the way to the Grand Canyon so we flew a scenic tour. Well worth it! At first the price thru me off, seemed steep at $270 a person for a 1.5 hour tour but it was 2 hours and included the canyon and Lake Powell flyover. 

The views of the canyon were amazing and the time saved from driving was worth every penny. The first 20 minutes of flight are getting to the canyon, but it was worth the wait. The Grand Canyon tour does not claim to include lake Powell but we spent as much time over the lake as we did over the GC and it was as impressive maybe better. 

Highly recommend this company and this tour. There is a longer one that also includes monument valley that may be worth consideration. They do not fly every hour every day so look at weather and book according. We were in the executive plane, nice captains chairs that hold 9 passengers and only good seats. The best seats are the row righ in front of the back bench. Most legroom and best window placement and size. Next best is right behind the pilot. Worst seats are still good, but the small windows offset form the seats make it hard to do uninterrupted video. Make sure to clean the window before you shoot or you get ugly smudge on the video. Also, take time to watch the view live, put the camera down once in a while.

review_title: One of the Best Tours on our Alaskan Cruise
review_text: This was definitely a highlight of our Alaskan cruise....in fact, it was my wife's favorite excursion.  Our pilot Larry was a wonderful source of knowledge about the area and the de Havilland Beaver plane we were flying in.  He asked if anyone in our group had served in the military, and when he learned we had a veteran among us, he asked him to sit in the co-pilot's seat.  He immediately won my respect and admiration.  Tacquan Air does it right - they are friendly, organized, and safety-conscious.  DON'T MISS THIS OPPORTUNITY!

Got snowed out from K2 flight on July 18th, but woke up to clear blue skies on July 19th.  Had a tremendous flight up to Denali and landed upon Ruth Glacier.  The pilot also could play a banjo and played happy anniversary to a couple in our Group.
The flight, sights, and experience of landing upon Denali is a memory we will always cherish !!

My flight on Sunday was awesome. As a native of San Francisco, I was very impressed with Aaron's local knowledge. Also, being a commercially rated seaplane pilot myself, I was thoroughly impressed with the quality of the operation. Aaron's piloting skills are extremely impressive. Overall, Seaplane Adventures was "over the top" in terms of fun and safety!

My wife and I were a bit apprehensive on flight day due to high winds on the north shore of the island but we were assured it would be fine and the pilot would not go if it was not safe.  We were pleasently surprised, felt very safe and really enjoyed the flight.  The flight was on our last day of vacation on the island and it made it possible to see parts of the island such as the Napoli coast and the Waimea Canyon, that we were were not able to see during our entire visit.  The pilot did a very good narration of the various points on interest and was very informative.  The only regret I had was that I chose the wrong zoom lens to bring with my SLR camera, so if you are bringing a SLR camera, I suggest you a shorter lens such as an 18-70mm zoom for those great panaramoic shots.

We did the helicopter tour, catamaran tour, and finaly Wings over Kauai. By far if you have to choose take this tour. We saw everything we saw on the other tours and more. Bruce gives a great perspective of the island and wonderful photo opportunities. 
Ellen called to reschedule our day due to weather and wanted to give us the best tour possible.
They are great to work with, we would do it again.
Steve and Jean
Fond du Lac, WI

Wow talk about breath taking! Such an amazing experience and time we had with Jason. A true pro at navigating the mountains around Denali and being a subject matter expert on everything we asked! Group of 4 took the Mt McKinley tour with a water landing! Fantastic never forget type of adventure! Would love to go back and do it all over again! Don't forget your camera! Maybe even a GoPro Camera so you don't forget anything!

Denali only shows her face 30% of the time due to weather conditions. Flying around the peaks above clouds and landing on its famous glacier makes your denali experience unforgettable. Our pilot Joe took excellent photos of us. Thanks Joe!

We did the Air Van tour at 2:30 and had a wonderful experience. You could see everything really well through the big windows and it was unbelievable.  Our pilot provided great commentary on what we were seeing and answered all our questions.  He has a lot of years of experience and I felt safe with him.  The Na Pali coast was completely covered in clouds on the day of our flight and they offered us a full refund but we still went and ended up seeing everything else on the island and I would recommend this tour to anyone!

We loved the flightseeing tour of the Alaska Range with a landing on Ruth Glacier. It was an awesome experience!

We made our reservation through Alaska Tour and Travel, just because of some other stuff we were bundling, but you can go straight to the K2 site. They have a nice facility at the airport (soon to be even bigger and nicer with a new facility). Check-in was very organized, and you can enjoy some free coffee while looking at their gift items. They provide overboots for the glacier, so you can just wear your street shoes no problem. We were called by name, introduced to our pilot, and walked to the plane for a quick safety briefing. After takeoff, it is a short flight to get up to the mountains. Our pilot provided interesting information on the area over our headsets. Then you are in the mountains...

We were lucky to have a clear day, and it was specatcular! We flew up the Great Gorge, surrounded by peaks, then by Denali and the other large mountains in the range. Both sides of the airplane get the views. The glacier landing was very cool, and we spent 20 minutes walking around the plane in the huge Sheldon Ampitheater. It is just an incredlble place! The flight back included more awesome views as we zig-zagged down through the peaks (I was sitting up front with the pilot for this part). It was hard to believe we did all this in just 1 1/2 hours.

I highly recommend a flightseeing tour of the Alaska Range and the glacier landing.

review_title: Great experience, a must when in Vegas!
review_text: It's got to be done! We took the plane with Mavericks to the Grand Canyon. They did not disappoint! A very professional and fun tour. If you're in Vegas you must do this! I didn't think it would be possible to feel like a teenager again! But I really did! What fun we had! Highly recommended.
Incredible views and a very friendly pilot. It is a unique experience that leaves unforgettable memories.
One of the best ways to see this stunning island. All the staff are wonderful. Highly recommend to anyone!
Thanks to Michael for a great tour of SoBe! I was nervous but he made us feel right at ease even with the windy conditions! Would definitely book again and recommend to friends!

We looked at all the helicopter tour and airplane tour companies and decided on this company.  Number one, they are less than half the cost of the helicopter tours.  Number two, the tour was absolutely amazing.  The plane tours fly much higher than the helicopter tours, providing absolutely breath taking views of the entire island.  Well worth the time and money

review_title: Great way to see San Fran
review_text: Much better than helicopter ride because you have more minutes flying! Pilots was great too! We did the 45 minutes flight which covered an excellent area of San Francisco! Definitely recommend!

review_title: Westwind Signature Grand Canyon Tour Exceeds Expectations
review_text:
This was my anniversary gift for my wife and it exceeded every expectation. The staff, pilots and our tour guide on the ground (different company by Westwind coordinates for you) were all outstanding. 

The plane seats 10 (I think). You need to be comfortable in a small plane with minor turbulence. The narration was very informative. 

Make sure you order lunch beforehand. If you book through your hotel (like we did) make sure you tell them to order you lunch. Bring a lot of water. It isn’t a very physical tour but you will want to stay hydrated. If you go in the spring or fall don’t forget that it is noticeably cooler up at the Grand Canyon than it is in Phoenix. Caden our pilot and Gigi our tour guide did an outstanding job!
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_title: Talkeetna Air taxi is worth every cent!
review_text:
it was a trip of a lifetime. Expensive, and worth every cent. it was approx. 3-1/2 hours of amazing scenery. at times it looked as though we would crash into the mountains, it seemed we were that close. in reality, the air is crystal clear, and the scale of Alaska is hard to capture. it took three days before we could get up into the air, this company is tightly managed and very safe. 
  I would advise allowing several days, as the weather around Denali is unpredictable and picking one day to fly could easily lead to a disappointment. we allowed three days, and went on the last day. 
  we will do the summit tour when we return to Alaska, but will allow for weather delays. 
fantastic way to view summit views  usually reserved for only climbers.

Views from the air were absolutely breathtaking
 Glacier landing was such a unique and fun experience!

Mike, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and friendly. We felt safe flying with him. He provided explanations along the flight and while on the glacier. Landing and taking off from the glacier was an unforgettable experience. If needed, boots are provided for walking on the glacier. The check-in experience was efficient.
This was spectacular and everyone really needs to do it. You’ll want to come back for more. It’s great fun. Once in a lifetime.

The plane and facilities  were top notch and Harry the pilot was very informative professional  and safety  conscious. We picked what turned out to be a blue bird day with a smooth ride. I got many great photos of the entire island. Harry got in low to view the coast and mountian tops make sure to bring your camera and allow a couple of hours.

Kevin was our pilot and a wealth of knowledge about the different areas of Kauai. We enjoyed learning some history and seeing some beautiful sites during the trip.  We had a great time!!!  Thank you!!

One of the great travel adventures in a lifetime! Short, a bit costly, but a marvelous floatplane trip with 'landing' at Misty Fjords, even in drizzly weater. Magnificent scenery and info all the way there and back. Our pilot was Larry, who was extra helpful and knew all the answers.
Don't tour this part of Alaska and miss this!

We took the Denali Grand tour and we were just speechless the entire flight. The views were out of this world. The entire experience from check in to landing was top notch! Completely worth the money!

review_title: Amazing Helicopter Flight with Papillon Grand Canyon Helicopter Tours at Tusayan
review_text: We had a good experience. It could have been more informational and valuable if our pilot was more interactive.

I bought a Groupin for Seaplane ride & two night stay in Bimini and it was an amazing experience!! Captain Tony was very accommodating & professional. He has passion for his job and it shows!! Whether its a tour of Miami or charter to Bimini I highly recommend it!! An experience we will never forget!!

There is nothing to compare seeing Kauai by Air!  The trip was smooth due to the good piloting of Harry.  My friend and I took many pictures!  She was a bit afraid at first but after we took off she was so happy that I had convinced her to go.  The scenery was unbelievably beautiful!

The flightseeing experience is great and was the highlight of our 2 week trip to Alaska. The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable and gave us lots of information as we were flying. Arranging the trip was a challenge, however. Our summit flight was cancelled due to last minute routine maintenance to our plane.
