Then it was rescheduled due to a last minute change to the maintenance date. Then it was downgraded to the Flyer Tour due to weather conditions. Overall, though, we had a good flight.

review_title: This is the best way to see this beautiful island !!!
review_text:
When I booked a cruise from New Zealand to Vancouver  I started looking for small individual tours and activities rather than the Cruise company tours . One of our stops in April 2013 was Nawiliwili on the island of Kauai , Hawaii . Checking out Tripadvisor what the possibilities were on the top of the list was  " Wings over Kauwai " with an almost perfect record and feedbacks . I started emailing and asking questions about availabilityy and price , and got very fast and friendly responses from Ellen the owner together with Bruce . I placed my find on cruise critic and within a couple of days found five other passenger willing to share this flight . 
We were picked up by Ellen and processed at the airport by Captain Josh and his wife Dori , got our places on the plane after our weigh-in and soon took off after Josh had strapped us in and gave us our headsets so we could communicate with Josh , each other and it would dampen the sound of the engine . The flight was fantastic , what a way to see this beautiful island and go to places where no car could go for there are no roads in these most beautiful spots . Commentary by Josh was fantastic , he involved all of us in his talks and we were encouraged to asked questions . The weather was clear for the most part , we saw the coffee plantation flew through the Waimea Canyon , to the Na Pali Coast where we saw a few whales breaching the Ocean and Josh made a couple of circles around them so everybody was able to see this . The little more than an hour flight went so fast and once back at the airport we received each a picture with the plane and a DVD with the highlights of the flight . 
Compared to other flights at different locations in the world the price is extremely reasonable  and the little extras and personal touches by every one in this company were much appreciated by all . 

This is the BEST and ONLY way to see this beautiful place . We will long remember this . Thank you Josh , Dori and Ellen .

Five of us had a chopper to ourselves for our tour of the Grand Canyon - what an experience!!  This excursion was doubly exciting for us, as it was the first time we had been in a helicopter AND the first time we had seen the Grand Canyon.  We came straight to the airfield from Sedona, checked in quickly and were soon escorted to our copter by our pilot.  After a brief safety talk we were strapped in, put our headsets on and we were off!

The pilot was a lot of fun, making some good jokes along the way.  Of course the real star was the Canyon itself, which is beyond description.  Nothing can prepare you for its grandeur - and flying along at 200 feet off the ground en route makes for a staggering experience as the ground drops out from under you and you are over a mile above the Colorado River in a blink of an eye!  Lots of gasps from everyone!!

This trip comes highly recommended, and Maverick did a great job showing us the sights and making us all feel safe and secure.

This operation is first class all the way. Bose headphones for all passengers really made a difference.  

Our email contact with  Ellen was professional and she picked us up exactly as planned in Lihue.  The flight was super with Josh as pilot and total of 4 passengers.   We had a wonderfully clear day, so that made it more spectacular. Ellen took our picture and gave us a free (generic)DVD with our personalized photo as a cover.  This is a family run operation and they were all wonderful.

Great company I loved every moment of the tour and the weather was perfect…
Me and my family enjoyed a lot and the pilot was super friendly and professional.
Definitely recommending it to our friends.
Thank you Eagles Air Tours for this unforgettable experience.

When my parents and I decided we were going to visit Kauai, we decided we needed to take some sort of aerial tour so that we could see the Na Pali coast clearly. We quickly discovered that the helicopter tours were very expensive, but were still going to go that route. However, we also heard that the helicopter rides can be very choppy. This really concerned my mom, so we decided to try out Wings Over Kauai instead. I'm really glad that we did! Our tour guide/pilot, Doug gave us a great tour of the island, and his narration was really great. While we didn't get as close to a few things as the helicopters do, our tour was longer, smoother, and perfect for what we wanted. It's still a small plane, so don't expect it to feel like a jetliner, but Doug was very aware of my mom's aversion to turbulence and managed it like absolute pro. We also met the owners Bruce and Ellen and they were extremely kind and professional. I've got nothing bad to say about Wings Over Kauai and would absolutely recommend them.

This was a fabulous experience. Josh and Dori were welcoming and friendly and were focused on  meeting our needs. In the air, Josh was an informative and entertaining pilot. We learned a lot about the island while viewing the amazing scenery. We would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

With Clay as our pilot our family of 5 had an amazing tour of the Alaska Range!  Even got to see Denali! Felt very safe during flight. Clay was very knowledgeable!  Couldn’t land on glacier (which we hadn’t been told until checking in), but that turned out to be all right.

We were fortunate to have spectacular weather for our flight--sunny and warm with not a cloud in the sky. Our pilot Leanne said days like that are few and far between, so we really lucked out. Speaking of Leanne, she was friendly, knowledgeable, and would have made it a great experience even in less perfect weather conditions. Landing on the glacier was definitely a highlight and is highly recommended as an add-on. We are from Florida and our kids have rarely seen snow--a family snowball fight on the glacier, surrounded by the incredible backdrop of the mountains, was great fun for them (and us!). The folks at TAT were all professional and accommodating, we would definitely book with them again and recommend them to others.

Worked in AK for 6 months, scheduled a glacier landing for my birthday but had to reschedule 3x before it worked out. Everyone at K2 was great, friendly and helpful making suggetions. Finally got to fly in August which was lucky because it rained most of the month. Flying in to Denali was incredible but there are not enough adjectives to describe how amazing landing on the glacier was!! Getting out of the plane surrounded by snow covered mountains and sunshine was majestic!! Our pilot Chris was funny and family friendly, eager to answer questions the 3 kids on our flight had and teach them about Mt. McKinley. Great experience, worth the money and would definitely recommend it to anyone interested in flying while in AK. K2 was exceptional!!
We found the staff very professional and communicative.  The weather did not allow a landing but they kept us in the loop at all times.
This trip is a must do for anyone wanting to see Denali! The mountain and Talkeetna Air were STELLAR!  Knowledgeable and friendly team at Talkeetna Air.

Our pilot, Jonathan, was great! He gave us a thorough safety briefing before flight. His flying was great and he gave us an awesome tour around Mt Mckinley and landed on a glacier. We could get out and walk on the glacier. He told us all about the area, the mountain, the glaciers and its history. Very personable guy! It was our favorite parts of our trip! So glad we decided to go!
Awesome views. Flight was much calmer than expected due to the skill of our pilot. Barbara. Unforgettable

We booked a private flight around Kauai. Had trouble finding transportation and they were extremely accomodating and helpful. 
Marcus, our pilot, was great in explaining everything we saw and kept our fligh smooth (wife gets motion sickness very easy and did not have a problem with this experience).
Were not sure to book a helicopter or a plane. Do not regret at all having chosen the plane (price, everyone had a window, longer flight and smoother).
Would definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful experience with the Westwind Air Tour of the Grand Canyon.  Our pilot Duncan was nice,  everything ran on time,  we got a little fly by over Sedona on the way to the Grand Canyon and a nice 1/2 tour of the Grand Canyon before landing and getting a 3 hour Pink Jeep Tour on land..

Wonderful and beautiful trip!  Our pilot Mark took us on a very smooth and beautiful flight to Ruth Glacier.  This was the highlight of our trip.  We landed on the glacier after about a half hour flight from Talkeetna.  The scenery was just so beautiful.  We even got to play in the snow and do our ALS challenge for Facebook with snow being poured over us.  This Air Taxi service is very professional and also gave us a military discount as my husband is retired Navy.  You must do this if you are in this area!  Can't say enough good things about it!
The folks at K2 really care about showing you how profound Denali is! It was an amazing trip my husband and I will never forget!

De ervaring is waanzinnig, mindblowing!
Als je naar Vegas gaat met de auto, rij dan een dagje door naar hier en boek niet de Grand Canyon heli's van Vegas. Dit gebied is vele male mooier en je krijgt veeeeel meer waar voor je geld. Maverick zelf is een hele goede keuze. Althans ik heb geen andere geprobeerd. Het zijn aardige gasten, piloot was een van oorsprong Ierse man, heel veel uitleg. Echt een super ervaring!!

Fantastic flight.  It was a beautiful day so the views were tremendous.  The glacier landing was a memorable experience.  Our pilot (Chris - ?) was terrific - very personable and gave us good information along the way.

We were only spending 3 days on Kauai, so we wanted to see the most we could.
Air Ventures was just a fun, easy experience from start to finish.
We had mentioned some things to the pilot we were interested in, and he pointed them out when we were in the air!
This flight was amazing! Our flight was everything we could have asked for. Beautiful birds eye view accompanied with history. Highly recommend!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: Great Floadplane trip and wonderful couple
review_text: Took the Misty Fjords trip with my family in August 2011 from Ketchikan.  It was a beautiful sunny day and the trip was great.  Lesly and Steve(our pilot too) are a wonderful couple who are friendly and nice to deal with.  We got meet their kids too.   Highly recommend doing a trip with Seawind.

review_title: K2Aviation flight over and around Denali, Flightseeing, Glacier landing
review_text: Fabulous ride in comfortable and safe Otter, a ten passenger plane, which circled around Mt. Denali,  pilot gave wonderful monologue about area, geology, animal and plant life, history.  Had a 1/2 hour on top of the Ruth Glacier to play in the snow. A lucky clear bluy sky day, could even see climbers (looked like ants)

review_title: Enjoying the Majesty and Beauty of The Island of Kauai
review_text:
This is my second time taking the Island Air Tour; this time we brought friends with us.  To say that we had a memorable experience is an understatement.  The scenery from the air was breathtaking; everything from the Poipu Coast, Waimea Canyon, the amazing waterfalls, Hanalei Bay and the Islands beauty.  My favorite remains the Napali Coastline in all it's magnificent splendor; it truly is Bali Hai.

Ten years ago we flew with Ray Smith, a 34 year veteran flying Jumbo Jets for United Airlines.  Since then, Ray bought the company and still loves sharing this beautiful Island with all his guest.  Our pilot today was Nate who was not only friendly but very knowledgeable in sharing with us so much about Kauai that we had never heard on any other tour during our several visits to Kauai.  Nate also was  more than willing to fly back over parts of the Island that we wanted to see up close again.  Even though this is the middle of November with unpredictable weather we had beautiful sunshine and even the highest point on Kauai was fully visible.

The plane itself is unique, built in Australia to use by Bush pilots, the aircraft is steady and able to cruise much slower than the Helicopters that you can tour with on the Island.  The interior of the aircraft was comfortable even for me who is 6'1" and 230 lbs.  In fact I got to sit in the Co-Pilots seat!  Each seat however has a bubble window which gives excellent visibility and is perfect for your camera or I phone for picture taking.  Every guest has a headphone which keeps you in contact with the pilot and all the other guest.  The headphones also filter out excess engine noise which enables everyone to carry on a pleasant conversation and to ask any question they wish about the Island.

 Ray and his wife are truly customer oriented in answering questions and making this a great experience from beginning to end.  

We love coming to Kauai to go swimming on the amazing beaches; riding bicycles; go on Snorkeling and Dinner Cruises; tubing in the sugar cane canals; and of course the Luaus.  All of these are fun and have produced lasting memories with our children and now our grandchildren.  Having done all of this over the years I can honestly say, If there is only 1 tour that you must take on Kauai, Air Adventures is that tour.

If you are in talkeetna , you must do flight with glacier landing. You are surrounded by snow mountains all around. The view is out of this world. The pilot is skillful and definitely enjoy what he is doing. We landed at a based camp 7000 ft high. It was sunny with beautiful view but the weather up there can change in a couple of minutes. The snow shower came suddenly and it gave us a lot of time high up there. We were there more than 1.5 hour instead of the usual half an hour. No extra charge and we count yourself blessed. It is advised to check out the hotel before you take the flight because snow storm can come suddenly. The manager in the based camp was very kind to make hot chocolate drink for the visitors while waiting for the shower to pass. A very wonderful experience and a heart warming one.

The trip with air ventures was the high light of our vacation. We saw sites we could not access with a vehicle.

Weather was fine and the pilot very professional.
We would recommend the tour to our friends.
We were able to use a coupon which made the flight very reasonable.
Views were magnificent.  Standing on the glacier was so amazing its hard to describe.  Our pilot Jeff was really cool and had good knowledge of the area.
the trip was great the young lady piolet was very informative  and the people where we took off from was great! would recommend this outfit to anyone!
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_text:
Wanted to give a huge shout out to Charles at friday harbor seaplanes I was one of his last flights of the season and he was awesome had me laughing the whole time it was really a treat for my first experience in a seaplane plus I was the only passenger and got to sit co-pilot my return flight was great too 
So thank you very much when I return next year I will flying with you guys again

Not cheap, but if you can afford it do it. And opt for the glacier landing. It really is a once in a lifetime sort of experience, and the views from that small plane are unmatched. The opportunity to literally stand on a glacier in the shadow of Denali is something that few people get. It is difficult to adequately describe what you can see but the title really says it all - just awe inspiring. And don't be too concerned if the weather in Talkeetna is less than ideal. We had rain and thunder but after it blew through a bit we were able to launch and the flight was spectacular.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: The most incredible experience!  Take-offs and landings were as smooth as could be.  We loved landing on Ruth Glacier.  Michael, our pilot in the 5-seater explained geographical and historical facts about the region, the rivers and the Alaskan Range.  It was an awesome afternoon!

fully agree with others  excellent tour. My wife just couldn't get into the idea of helos so I talked her gently into Wings Over Kauai skyvan.  We lucked out w/ just us 2 passengers and she thoroughly enjoyed the flight.  We saw helos down in the depths of valleys etc but the sedate flight gave us a wonderful overview of the entire island, including all the helo whoopdidoo sights, just from higher up, slower and way less $$. 4 thumbs up from us.

review_title: Seaplane charter to Little Palm Island
review_text: We had originally booked a round trip charter flight with Key West Seaplanes, but they cancelled our trip with two days notice due to "legal problems" and did not offer any help with re-booking.  Thankfully we found Miami Seaplanes and they were great to deal with.  We flew with Capt. Tony both ways - Tony is an old salt, experienced seaplane pilot and also a great tour guide on the side.  I'd definitely recommend flying with him if possible.  We took a Cessna Seahawk on the way down and an old classic de Havilland Beaver back.  Incredible experience.

What an amazing experience! From correspondence with Envi before booking (super helpful!) through to the welcome on arrival and fantastic pilot skills of Davis we had an incredible time. Highly recommended to anyone with an interest in flying, volcanology, local history and sights. 
Davis made us feel so welcome and comfortable and gave us the smoothest ride, best local info, and very best of views of Mount St Helens which was simply AWESOME. 
Stop hesitating and just book it!

review_title: One of the BEST things we did in Alaska
review_text:
Highly recommend taking a flight to see Denali, the glaciers, and other mountain ranges.
Talkeetna Air employees are honest with you about the weather conditions and what to expect.
Spend some extra time in Talkeetna for lunch or dinner a neat little town.

Our scheduled flight time was 11am. When we got there they told us skies were cloudy and if we still want flight with glacier landing return at 3:30, Fine, we went for a hike, toured town and were back at 3:30. At that time they were sending up planes and the plane before us was great. All passengers loved it and they had glacier landing. So off we go at 4pm and wouldn't you know it, clouds rolled in again  and we had limited views of Mt Kinnely and no glacier landing. Everyone was bummed out on flight back.People at Talkeetna air were great.They only charged us 25% of the agreed on price due to our limited trip. They are really top flight honest people that were a pleasure to deal with, Would use them again if ever in area
This was an adventure in the sky! The views were spectacular.  Forever memories! Eric was  and knowledgeable. We would definitely do this again. The 5 island tour was a complete treat. Loved it!
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: This was the highlight of my trip. Fabulous scenery. Pilot was excellent and gave a great commentary, I felt totally safe the entire time. I plan on doing this again next year when I return.

The weather did not cooperate with the plans we made to have a glacier landing, but the staff worked with us to come up with another world class experience.  K2 is first class and provided my son and me with lifetime memories.

review_title: Awesome way to see Denali up close!
review_text: We had to adjust the tour a bit due to forest fire smoke - but was clear above 6000' and seemed we could have touched the mountains!  Glacier landing was not allowed due to low snowfall earlier in the year.  It still was a glorious view of the glaciers and mountains on such a clear day above the smoke. Pilot's explanation  of what we were seeing made the trip even more enjoyable.  Thanks for the great flight and experience!
Mac is the only native Hawaiian pilot that flies airplanes on the island. He was a great conversationalist and pointed out things that we would have missed without his expertise!

We just had an experience of a lifetime! Chuck is the only pilot you want! Over 20 years experience and he took us off the canned tour to awesome spots no one else sees. We landed in the middle of Walkers Cove (and not the usual dock) and got to see amazing waterfalls and snow capped mountains on the way. I was lucky enough to be his co-pilot to make the thrill even better. Chucks incredible knowledge made the tour much more interesting over a pre-recorded tape. He even flew us over an inlet where he knew orcas had been hanging and sure enough we saw 3 of them!! Definitely do this!! Ask for Chuck. Amazing bucket list adventure!! Thank you Chuck!! -Megan and TJ, Atlanta GA.

From start to finish, great experience! Our pilot was fun and extremely informative. The views were absolutely breathtaking. Landing on the glacier was a surreal experience. We had people of all ages in our group and everyone was able to participate and enjoy the ride!

We flew from Renton to Friday Harbor on Saturday 6/30.  The overcast weather meant we had to fly low and that gave us the opportunity to see a pair of Orcas from the sky. Our pilot was great and he circled around so everyone could see the whales.  

I wish every commercial jet landing was as smooth as with the seaplane, a perfect touchdown on both flights.

Highly recommended.

Allan P

I really hate flying - especially in such a small plane - But this was the best choice ever!!!!
It was super cool, not to mention the pilot - He was very calm and made the ride super comfortable!  We were VERY Happy & Would Highly recommend it!!!!
Amazing! Pilot was a young guy, did a great job. Took us by top of Mt Denali. Very safe. Walking on glacier was awesome. Best thing we have done in Alaska!

Took the Misty Fjords tour whilst in dock on a cruise. Loved it, loved it! The family run business has a great vibe about it. Friendly and professional. The flight was sensational and my husband and I still talk in wonder about the "infinity" lake high up in the mountains and the waterfall falling from it. Landing on the lake and taking in the beauty of the area was an experience we won't forget. In fact it's my dream now to come and stay in one those little remote cabins by the lake. I couldn't imagine a more unique holiday!

Bruce, the pilot, was very fun and nice! He told us so much about the Island and could answer every question we had. 
He also gives good advises how to be comfortable in the plane in case you are air sick.
It was absolutely fantastic, especially for this price! I paid 130 Dollar and did my flight at 1 pm. 
Would do it again!!
It's worth ist!
Fantastic facility, equipment and pilot!!!!! Great flight over the GC!!!!!!!! A must experience with Maverick!!!!!!!!!!

review_title: Personal and Educational experience with awesome views!
review_text: Thank you, Thank you, Bruce and Ellen from start to finish.  You welcomed us like family!  Since my husband is a pilot also this experience is one we will never forget!  The views were spectacular and it was interesting to learn of the dozens of famous and noteworthy films that were produced around the island. Na'Pali coastline is a definite favorite.  We would recommend Wings over Kauai  to anyone looking for a comfortable and personal experience.  We hope to visit again very soon.    Ron and Teri
Incredible morning! Eric and Steve were the perfect guides to all we saw. Still can’t believe all we were able to view — things we would never have seen if not from the air.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text:
After having said for years I would love to see the Grand Canyon, I was finally able to realise my dream and take my two teenage sons along for the ride. We decided on the sunset tour which meant we got a wonderful view of the lights on the strip on the way back in. We were shown a safety video before meeting our pilot and having photos taken, then boarding the helicopter.
I am not too good with heights and found myself seated in the front next to the pilot! Ryan was extremely competent and knowledgeable putting me at ease immediately. It was great to start In the front  but we were also happy to switch with the other party in the back when we made a quick stop to refuel. This was a bonus, as we didn't expect to be able to get out and stretch our legs and get photos on the ground. 
Ryan's commentary was informative and interesting and he was more than happy to answer any questions put to him. Not sure if the soundtrack/playlist was provided by the company or the pilot, but we all really enjoyed that too.
The trip back provided even more wonderful photographic opportunities, the landscape is just amazing. 
Well organised shuttle buses are provided by Maverick, so no problem getting to and from.
I would have got on that helicopter and gone out again and again! 
Definitely won't disappoint!!
我们是从拉斯维加斯直飞大峡谷的，第一次坐直升机飞行，因此整个直升机给我们很震撼的体验，其实直升机多少有些颠簸，但是我感觉驾驶员的技术很不错，因此整个旅程还是相对很完美的。在大峡谷只呆了半个小时，他们提供香槟和小食品，感觉是很好。只是全程没有厕所，最好不要喝太多水。。。

We took the flight to Mount McKinley early June during a record hot spell and included the glacier landing. The check in and seating was quick and efficient and the people very friendly. The flight and the scenery were simply amazing. The plot was well informed and skilled. Couldn't recommend this higher. Go take a stroll on a mountain glacier. Highlite of Alaska. Thanks Talkeetna air taxi!

Reallllllly enjoyed this air tour! Much more reasonably priced than a helicopter tour and all seats have a window. Eric was a fantastic pilot and tour guide! This was definitely the highlight of our time in Kauai!

Hovering over the Grand Canyon and experiencing the grandeur and splendor of its beauty is undefinable but our helicopter trip was great and gave us views that we couldn’t have experienced in any other method.  Highly recommend this experience.

review_title: Brothers meet for the first time in Alaska.
review_text:
Billy was our pilot on the1959 Bever, after explaining all the safety material we loaded up and were off on a glacier landing thanks to K2 Aviation.    This trip was absolutely beautiful, amazing and a once in a lifetime adventure for all of us.  Nothing compares to the beauty of Denali Park and this trip.   It was the best day of our two week trip and will be remembered forever.  Nate Ryan an EMT from Buffalo NY,  Senior Chief Nicholas Bradford from San Diego and Ian Bradford a laborer from Anchorage.    Snow ball fights and all, just the best of the best!!

Thank you K2 Aviation for making our trip so very special!!   Can’t wait to do this again with you’re company it’s just the best!!!

Susan Bradford 
Anchorage, Alaska
Amazing! The pilot was excellent. Perfect flight along with a wealth of information of Denali. Would recommend this trip to everyone.

Our family of four had a fabulous flight with Josh and it was definitely a highlight of our trip to Kauai.  I had struggled to decide whether we should try this or go with a helicopter flight and I clearly made the right choice.  The views far exceeded our expectations and I can't imagine what more we would have seen from a helicopter, at twice the price.  I also want to thank Wings Over Kauai for being so customer focused.  I had thought I'd booked the entire plane for our family but it turned out there were two other individuals who also had a reservation.  Because my husband and son had to sit on the left side of the plane which supposedly had less desirable views, they discounted our fare.  That being said, both my husband and son still saw 90% of what the rest of us did and the only downside is that they weren't in the best position to take photos.  My daughter and I took plenty of them so it wasn't an issue at all!  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!

I booked this excursion knowing I would be scared stiff and I was! BUT it was beautiful and  I enjoyed the trip so much...the scenery was breathtaking! I think I might even do it again! Thank you Steve!

review_title: Beautiful, Comfortable, Fun, We Would Do It Again!
review_text: My wife and I did this air tour and thoroughly enjoyed it.  In addition to the pilot, Randy, there were three others on the flight.  We flew in a very well maintained 1958 deHavilland Beaver which alone is worth the trip, but we also saw the beauty of Dinali and the glaciers from the air.  As described, each person has a headset so that they can hear the description offered by the pilot and so that they can ask questions.  K2 picked us up at our hotel at the designated time and returned us after the flight.  We had a fairly good day weather-wise and were able to take a lot of beautiful pictures; the flight itself was very relaxing with little to zero turbulence (this is weather dependent I suppose), and the pilot/guide was very informative.  We would certainly do this again in the future and recommend it to others.
It was great! Thank you for the amazing! The cliffs were incredible and so was seeing the true color of the water and beaches

review_title: A "must-do" for those who want to see the Misty Fjords
review_text: Steve and Lesly did everything to make this excursion easy to book and all that we hoped it would be. We appreciated their honesty with the weather and willingness to cancel if conditions weren't at their best. But the weather turned out to be perfect! Steve's familiarity with the area allowed for wonderful narration during our flight. The highlight was landing on a dock in the middle of the fjords and just enjoying the beauty! Skip the cruise booking and book directly through SeaWind--much better price and you're working directly with the company owners.

Our pilot, Doug, gave us a wonderful tour. He was very knowledgeable of the area and made sure we had a great experience.  I would recommend them highly.
KY family

The vast beauty of Denali park area is like no other.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable and experienced pilot.  The view was beyond words.  Seeing the back side of Denali was the greatest as a break in the clouds allowed us to look up to the top.  Would do it again and again  Cathedral Mountain was incredible.  I could have flown all day.

Great service.  Great ride.  What more can you ask for?  Outside of an awesome experience, the folks at Wings over Kauai made my vacation by allowing a reschedule due to bad weather.  I'm a photographer and this was to be a trip of a lifetime experience and my first aerial photography experience.  The day we were originally scheduled for, the visibility was practically non-existent for the majority of the island. I was so disappointed that I was going to be spending almost $300 on a flight where I'd get no decent photos.  You can imagine how overjoyed I was when they said yes to my request to reschedule as I know that's not done everywhere and can't possibly be done often because they'd go out of business if they do it too much. For that alone, they'd get a 10 star rating if I could give it to them.

I did a lot of research before booking, and found that many people recommended this over a helicopter flight. We decided on the Air Van flight as it has the bigger windows. It's a six-seater plane, and my husband got to sit in the co-pilot seat, which was cool!

On the day of our trip, the weather was cloudy and uncertain (Hurricane Lester was close to the islands at that point, bringing unusual conditions with it).  Because of this, the pilot was forced to take a different route than usual, but we still saw fabulous sights, including the Na Pali coast, and rainbows on the ocean. Tip: if you think there's even a chance you'll get motion sickness, take Dramamine or similar before the trip! It'll be worth it if the weather is a little 'off'.

Our pilot Marcus was superb, giving us a safe ride and plenty of interesting information.  Thanks as well to Val, Bruce & Ellen, who were all great.  This was a wonderful experience, so glad we did it.
Fantastic experience!  The fly-in/hiking was the best experience that we had during our Alaska vacation.

WOW! An experience of a lifetime. We were booked for the Denali Grand Tour however with limited visibility and weather moving into the area, we were offered the opportunity to do the Flyer Tour.  From the start to the end, I felt comfortable and confident I was flying with an experienced pilot and safety was their main concern. The flight and glacier landing was amazing!!! No words or photo can capture the beauty and grandeur of the area.
Beautiful flight in a beautiful Beaver.  It was windy when we flew and the pilot did an outstanding job.   I highly recommend it to anyone.   We did the North Coast tour a d even saw some whales.

review_title: Amazing 2 hours at close range with Denali
review_text: We did the Summit Tour on June 5, 2021 on the most clearest of days at the Summit, and what an amazing day.  Truly a trip highlight.  Our pilot did an awesome job of ensuring us the best views.  We were blessed to see climbers about to summit Denali - something I will never forget.  The glacier landing was terrific - in a new spot that I had not been to before.  This was truly one of the best parts of our trip to Alaska during our 3 week visit.  To see Denali this close up with incredible.  Kudos to Talkeetna Air Taxi and our amazing pilot.

review_title: The best way to see the Canyon
review_text: Mavericks tours were well organised, friendly, experienced and above all very knowledgeable! We flew with them in the morning and our pilot was fantastic. I was nervous about going up in a helicopter but he really put me at ease. You cannot describe how mind-blowing it is to fly over the Canyon in a helicopter, you just have to experience it for yourself and I can highly recommend Mavericks for this.

review_title: Put this on your Must Do list!!!
review_text: Our pilot Chris was fun and informative!!  This is a must do when visiting the Moab area!!!  It was an awesome experience!!

Fabulous!  Simply FABULOUS!

Nathan was a wonderful pilot/guide, pointing out all of the highlights of our tour!  Incredibly memorable and an excellent time!  Nate was extremely patient with our questions and provided a very safe and motion-sick-free ride!  Headphones had nice music. Thank you!

You may think the price is very high.
However, considering the professional of the whole team and the pilot, it's very worthy to spend $300+ flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi.
The best scenery I have ever seen.

The staff was friendly. Our pilot Chris was very knowledgeable about the area and provided some great insight on the Denali area. Although some freshly fallen snow had prevented us from landing on the glacier, we were grateful that they were aware of the weather conditions on the glacier and didn't want to risk our safety. Thank you for an amazing trip!

Beyond the majestic peaks of Denali, Hunter and Foraker are the winding rivers leading to the vast canyons and glaciers. Looking at the Alaskan range from a far has its beauty and then you get closer and you see that not only is this range absolutely enormous, it is full of peaceful hideaways around every corner. It is amazing that you can get so far away from civilization so quickly and yet still be so close. The pilot and staff were very knowledgeable and they are concerned about our safety more then anything.

Thanks for an amazing flight!

This was my fourth trip from the Deer Valley Airport in Phoenix to the Grand Canyon with Westwind tours.  We have taken children, grandchildren, parents and friends.  We have experienced a variety of trips to the Grand Canyon with this company.  The service and the staff are exceptional and all of our interactions have been positive.  They are friendly, knowledgeable, professional and fun.  I highly recommend this company for touring the Grand Canyon!
Voir Miami du ciel est un moment magique et c'est encore mieux quand le pilote est super sympathique. De bonnes explications sur Miami, un bon pilotage, je recommande, c'est un super moment.

We are a local family that has been watching the seaplanes fly by our home for years, and we wanted the chance to see the Bay Area from above.  This was an amazing experience and great for both locals and tourists!
Amazing experience! I absolutely recommend this to anyone visiting Maui. Steve was awesome and sights were unbelievable!! We will be returning 😁

Wonderful flight! The staff was friendly & professional. Safety is the first priority. The flight was very smooth, our pilot spoke with us through the provided headphones. He provided lots of information about Denali. Our plane touched down on Ruth glacier, it was beautiful. We were able to walk around the glacier and take in the breathtaking views. Then up again and back to the airstrip. Would highly recommend.

Just yesterday my wife and I enjoyed the spectacular beauty of Denali from the air with K2!  The pilot was excellent, explaining as we flew along and answering questions; the plane, an OTTER was perfect, the office folks were wonderful.  On a business trip 25 years ago I took this flight and have been looking for the occasion for my wife to share the experience with me - the occasion was our 50th anniversary vacation and she was appropriately delighted with the experience.
I could go on and on -- just do it!  You will forever be glad you did!

It's a memorable ride. I really appreciate the pilot, he was managed very well. I was amazed with scenic views.

Thank you.

Stunning views of all the coasts, mountains  & landscapes! Pilot Nic was great & made the trip more fun. Pointed out all the areas, waterfalls & gave us some local knowledge.  We each had a window seat as advertised  & was a very comfortable flight. The hour went by very quickly- lots to see including whales

This was the best way to view the Grand Canyon, particularly for the first time. We took off on time with a very knowledgable pilot and were treated to breathtaking views of the Canyon from the air. I would highly recommend this to any tourists visiting the Canyon.

The views were amazing. They are ever cooperative. We had to reschedule twice due to bad weather but they accommodative. Unfortunately, we were not able to get the tour we booked due to weather (we booked Grand Denali and ended up doing south side) but, they refunded the difference. 
Staff is very friendly, views are amazing and breathtaking. I seriously recommend to do it. 
Only reason i have 1 star less is because the headsets for my wife was not working during the flight. And she was not able to listen to any narration/music. 
Tip: book early in the day so even if the weather is bad, you can reschedule. 

If you want to sit on co-pilot seat, you can. Ask your pilot, 🤓. (We did not do it)
We had a beautiful sunny day for our flight which certainly helped as the scenery was absolutely stunning from the air.  Desi was delightful as our pilot and tour guide.
Gave this to our daughter for her birthday. She LOVED it!  Garrett was a great pilot!! Thank you Envi Adventures!

user_location: El Cardoso de la Sierra, Spain
review_text: A great scenic air tour around Canyonlands. The best family experience before starting our visits to the parks. The six of us really enjoyed. Dave, the pilot, explained every corner. Thanks Dave!

Great summit trip....with base camp glacier landing.  Visibility was amazing.  Most amazing experience and activity we did in Alaska.  Chris was our pilot, extremely knowledgeable and bvery generous making sure everyone got great views....this was not a quick up and down where you felt like you didn't get your moneys worth.....totally amazing

This may very well be the most beautiful place I have ever visited. We were in Oahu for one week and then Kauai.  Why did we not just go to Kauai for two weeks?
We had a small condo in Kapaa in the Coconut Beach area and that is where we will stay when we come again. I like the area and it is pretty easy to get everywhere from there.  There is a park nearby called Lydgate Park that would be great to take kids to or anyone leery of ocean swimming as it has 2 areas blocked off by big boulders so that there is no worry about getting in too deep or being knocked down by waves. It also has a huge playground.
We initially were holding a very expensive rental car but I kept checking and got it down to a reasonable amount. There is no charge to park anywhere we went.
Be prepared for bad roads if you go the scenic route.  Many of the scenic roads are rutted and have potholes the size of a VW bug.  When it rains on Kauai (it rains a lot), there are red mud puddles in areas that you will go to sightsee.  If you plan to hike, take it seriously.  Many of the hikes are considered to be for those more experienced hikers and you will need real hiking shoes. Also plan on slippery areas on the hike so a fall in the mud is possible. 
The rest of the island has good roads and no mud so you don’t have to engage with the mud if you don’t want to.
We paid for an app called the Shaka guide. They offer 4 GPS tours which covers the whole island and is definitely worth the money! 
This island has a slower pace than Oahu but you can still get into traffic in the morning and evening drive time if you are around Lihue.
The airport is adorable and very easy to get around.  Don’t be surprised to find chickens near the luggage carousel. i read that Kauai has about 75,000 people and 450,000 chickens.  Therefore don’t expect to sleep much past sunrise due to the roosters crowing. But then who would want to miss a sunrise in Kauai anyway?
我們兩人報了這團, 郵輪到達后打車到這里, 在柜檯chech in時才告知取消了這次行程,但沒有提前通知! 讓我無法及時補救, 我倆在島上無所事事, 沒有了觀光机會! 白白浪費了机票;船票;出租車費用, 這公司服務很差, 不負責任! 到現在等了一個多月,退款還沒收到.

My wife and I did the Grand Denali tour and loved it.  The views around the mountain are unlike anything else.  The pilot, as well as the staff on the ground, were friendly and helpful.  
The best views are from the front seat, but all views are awesome and the back seats have fewer obstructions for better pictures.
Espectacular!!! La vista increíble, Joel nuestro piloto nos explicó todo, muy amable. Súper recomendado :)
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_title: Forget the helicopters - this is great !
review_text: Really fun time.   Felt safe.  Professional.   Val on the ground and Captain Marcus made a great team.   You will enjoy it I promise !

THANK YOU to Ellen, Carter, Sophie and Joel for a truly amazing experience.  The service from my first email was warm and friendly.  The flight itself was spectacular - a gorgeous sunny day after some heavy rains so the waterfalls were really flowing.  I caught myself with an ear to ear grin several times.

I have already recommended Wings Over Kauai to a friend - they are phenomenal.

review_title: Air Ventures tour of Kauai was breathtakingly awesome
review_text: Amazing Aircraft, wonderful and knowledgeable pilot and of course seeing kauai from the air was fabulous.  i would recommend seeing Kauai from the air to get an overall view of the island. review_title: A must do when visiting Kauai
review_text:
My wife, little girl, and I went on a flight with Bruce (one of the owners) today and we had an extremely enjoyable time. I am a qualified pilot, so when the opportunity arose for me to do all of the flying Bruce was more than happy for me to do so as he is a qualified instructor. It goes without saying that the views are very different from the air, and although there are many different flying operators who offer this type of service I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. 

Not all of Kauai is accessible by vehicle, this was the best way to get up close and personal and see parts of the island, specifically the northern parts, that are largely untouched and extremely beautiful. Highly recommended, will definitely do again next time I come to Kauai.

review_title: Why would you want to take a helicopter???
review_text:
It appears that the key choice in chosing an air tour is to go by helicopter or by airplane.  The hotels always seem to recommend the helicopter tour, but why?  Could it be that they just recommend the most expensive option?  Take the airplane!  It's half the cost, and you see the same places.

Captain Bruce of Wings of Kauai has been flying for years, and his skill sets proved it to me.  As a commercial pilot myself, I notice things that most people don't.  I VALUE SAFETY ABOVE ALL ELSE.  Case in point.  There was another aircraft within sight that decided to fly up a canyon, one where the clouds were very low.  As I sat in the seat, I wondered if our captain was going to follow him.  My concern was that the clouds were too low to remain legally VFR (visual flight reference), a standard that tour planes must adhere to for safety sake because no IFR (Instrument Flight Rules) plan had been filed.  Flying into or too close to those clouds can spell trouble, after all, where are the sides of the canyon if you can't see them?  Draw your own conclusions.

Captain Bruce made a consciencous decision to take a different route, and we saw the same sights.  Later I asked him why he took that route, and he replied, "Safety comes first, and I did not want to risk my passengers".  There is a saying in aviation: There are old pilots and there are bold pilots, but there are no old, bold pilots.  I appreciated his decision and concern for safety rather than take a risk just we could see the same sight from a different perspective.

There are two rows of seats in the aircraft.  He only books the seats on the right hand side of the aircraft so everyone gets a window seat.  Great for visuals and great for photos.  Would you get that treatment in a crowded helicopter?  

We actually flew through a double rainbow that totally engulfed the aircraft.  I've never seen anything like it.  I totally encircled the aircraft.  It was above us, beside us and below us.  I've never experienced anything like it before.

In any case, I give Wings over Kauai a five star rating.  Great people.  Great trip.  Great memories. Great photos.

review_text: Our family. three generations ranging in age from 10 to 75, spent an amazing couple of hours with our pilot, Jim, flying over the Misty Fjords, seeing breathtaking sites and learning much about the creation of the fjords and their history.  Our pilot, Jim, was both knowledgeable and entertaining, interspersing his informative narratives with an outstanding music selection.  In fact, it is worth noting, that despite the unparalleled beauty of the Misty Fjords from aloft, Jim's selection of tunes runs a very, very close second and really added to the intensity of the excursion.  Many thanks to Jim for his expert flying, his knowledge of the history, geology, and geography of the fjords and choices of MUSIC.  A memorable experience it was, to say the least.

review_title: Spectacular, Friendly, Adaptive and Personal Experience,  The best part of our visit to Kawai!
review_text:
Jane and I had a wonderful experience with Wings Over Kauai, from the point of view of a visiting pilot and an amateur photographer. Before we flew, Bruce clarified the traffic patterns unique to the Island. We then did 1. familiarization / training session and  2. a photography session, both over 1 hour long. We did not want the flights to end.

Bruce kindly let me (the pilot) fly out of the left seat and guided me around the island traffic pattern, while we flew around the coast, the canyon and the mountains. Bruce pointed out interesting landmarks and locations where famous movies have been shot. We chatted about various issues related to mountain flying, strategies for monitoring traffic and bird avoidance. 

In the second flight Bruce kindly let us open the right window to get clear photo shots, free of reflections and distortions. He positioned the aircraft at an appropriate distance, and considered the direction of light for good shot opportunities. It is clear that he understands the needs of a photographer. He encouraged me to take control from the right seat (with which I did not have much experience) and all worked out well. 

Bruce is an excellent pilot and an excellent instructor and quickly finds the level at which his student functions, communicates and encourages at an appropriate level. Ellen runs the office professionally and in a personally attuned way. All aspects of the experience have been pleasant. We look forward to more flying with Wings Over Kauai in the future and highly recommend the experience as safe, educational and adaptive to individual likes, needs and skill levels (pilots).

Michael Krelina, M.D., Jane Barlow, M.D.
Canada

review_text: The views were fabulous. The pilot did a great job of personalizing locations with explanations of his own experiences at different spots. He also answered questions clearly and succinctly. Takeoff and landing were each well done.
Es war für uns ein einzigartiges Erlebnis, mit einem lustigen Piloten, der viele Informationen übermittelt hat. Auch der Pickup vom Pier hat einwandfrei funktioniert!

We flew with the mail run for 3 hours for a close-up, hands-on experience.  It was great, and the pilot was great.  We were lucky to get on a run with 5 take-offs and landings over on Prince of Wales Island.  I would highly recommend this if you have the extra time to spend.

review_title: A very safety oriented tour operator.
review_text: When I started researching Denali tour operators last fall I narrowed it down to two.  Talkeetna Air was my first choice, having lived in Alaska, both my choices have been operating in the state for many years.  Over the winter I spoke to many locals who confirmed my initial thoughts.  Our pilot was very patient with the preflight briefing making sure all our questions were satisfactorily answered before we boarded.  The trip over to the mountian range we had a very smooth flight.  The pilot's commentary across and working up the glacier was well balanced with geology, history and a little bit of lore.  We had a good landing at upper base camp.  Spent our fifteen minutes on the glacier.  He had to go to plan B and was very good about explaining what we would need to do and what he was going to need to do to get us back to the hanger.  Do not believe anyone in the group had any cause to question the pilot's decission and concern for our safty and that of the equipment.

review_title: You must do it! It really worth it
review_text: I had read a lot about different companies that offer this tour and i was not sure about to do an helicopter or this tour, at the end i decided to do it. I booked the trip at 4pm and my husband was all day telling me that maybe was not a good idea that we will see the same things that we already visit lile the canyon were we did a Beautiful trail. So we started the fligth withr other 2 people evryone hadba window seat so we could see very wells, my husband was in the copilot seat, we didnt speak during the flight, but as soon we landed he told me thay i was so right that is a must this tour, is totally different to see this wonderful island by air, its really amazing, there are not enought words to describe it, you should do it. And regarding this company i must sau thay they did a great job, markus the pilot, bruce and her daughter, they tool us a picture and send it to us and they even gave us a cd with pictures and a with christmas music in hawaiian, small details that are so important!

Professional, flexible, high-value, and talented. Redtail's entire team was wonderful and easy to work with from start to finish. Would highly recommend, and cannot wait to fly with them again. They're pilots are skilled, knowledgeable about the area, and very professional. They're shuttle and two are options are diverse and they are happy to be flexible to meet your travel needs. There is no better way to see Utah than from a redtail plane!

Nice trip 
Great views 
Educational and inspirational conversations with the pilot 
My wife and I really enjoyed our flight with Maverick

Went with my family -- travelled with kids ages from 12-23.   Loved the tour.   Our favorite part was when we landed on the water.   We were able to get out of the plane -- standing outside the plane and experiencing the quiet and beauty of nature.   It was fantastic.   This was one of our favorite excursions of our Alaskan cruise.

My husband & I decided to do the 1/2hr city tour with Miami Seaplanes. We had a great experience from start to finish! The take off & landing were very smooth. The views were amazing! The customer service was excellent! We saw a manatee, flew around south beach, by the city skyscrapers & around many of the rich & famous peoples houses!

review_title: Fantastic 1 hour air tour of the beautiful island of Kauai
review_text: I took this trip with my wife and 3 kids. We were met promptly by the friendly staff and taken to the airport for a safety briefing and weigh-in. We had the plane to ourselves, which meant there was one spare seat. One of my sons is a nervous flier, but he was totally relaxed by the calm confidence of our pilot, Marcus, who gave us a good commentary of everything we could see, which was a lot given that we all had great window seats. The views were stunning - no other word for it! Marcus explained everything through the headset system, and we could all use it to talk to each other which the kids loved. The hour passed very quickly, and I was surprised when we sighted the airport and were told it was time to land. All in all, a great trip and I would highly recommend it!!

review_title: Ruined One Day of Our Vacation
review_text: After spending $400 round trip to get to K2, we were told that our glacier walk / plane tour was cancelled when we got there. Why they could not tell us earlier was disappointing. There wasn't a lot to do in the town where they are located and we were stuck until our arranged transportation left. It was too late to book anything else. I get the weather can cancel flights; however, maybe be nicer about it and offer something more than a refund? To add insult to injury, while we were having dinner, we saw one of their planes that had the landing gear for ice pass over us.

My daughter and I had a 1pm flight. We were impressed with every aspect of our adventure. We loved the plane. The pilot was courteous, skilled and knowledgeable about the area we flew over.  I've lived here all of my life and have never experienced San Francisco, Marin and the Bay like this before. To any one who has thought about taking a seaplane ride I say...what are you waiting for? You won't regret it. It was a magic carpet ride over a beautiful place. Imagine soaring over the Golden Gate Bridge.

Well organized flight with an excellent overview of Kauai. The pilot gave good snippets of information about all the highlights and also personalized the tour to give an aerial view of a temple we were planning to visit.

We saved this for our last day and so happy we did.
Great way to cap off our vacation.  
Absolutely stunning views and pictures we have to last a lifetime
Tracey was our pilot and we had the plane to ourselves.
Husband was able to get great photos and I enjoyed the narrative
Was worth the price of admission!    lol

We took our tour on Memorial Day and it did not disappoint!  Bruce and and staff are friendly, accommodating and well versed in what they do.  The island is beautiful and we never could have seen all the gorgeous waterfalls, canyons, beaches and the lushness that Kauai has to offer if not for Wings over Kauai.  Highly recommend!  (And the price is right too!!)

review_title: Great experience and so much fun!
review_text: Great way to see the island and a wonderful experience to be on a buplane. Pilot Kevin was excellent - very knowledgeable, friendly and funny. Staff were excellent - welcoming and making sure we were informed of everything. Plus they take photos of you on and near the plane! The views were somewhat hampered by the struts but not enough to spoil the enjoyment of being in an open-air plane! You got a good sense of the island, what it looks like and where the population is located. Given roads only cover about 15% of the island, air and boat are a must. I've been a visitor to Kauai for many years and have seen the island by airplane, helicopter and boats but this time was with a first timer and so chose this means of transport. It was well worth the effort! And the Snoopy and Woodstock on the plane was just a bonus!

review_title: Absolutely the best - Great service and views
review_text: We experienced an awesome flight with Wings Over Kauai, a small family business, on February 24, 2010.  Customer service provided by Bruce and Ellen is second to none.  Ellen does an outstanding job of handling all the arrangements prior to the flight.  Bruce is an excellent pilot, who made us feel very safe and comfortable during the tour.  His comprehensive knowledge of Kauai made this a very informative and interesting tour.  Bruce pointed out some whales and seeing them from the air was a whole another view of these magnificent creatures.   We took this tour early in our visit to Kauai and this was a good decision.  It gave an excellent aerial perspective of the island together with background information prior to visiting the various scenic sites by car.  Finally, we had taken a helicopter tour on Maui the previous year.  Wings Over Kauai was superior in all respects but it especially eliminated the crowding inside the helicopter.   The complimentary DVD received at the end of the tour is such a nice touch and contains wonderful photography.  We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and the personable and friendly services.
Check in was easy!  Staff is friendly and helpful!  Our pilot was fabulous!  I am so glad we flew with you guys.  Our experience was perfect, start to finish.  Thanks TAT !!!!!!

take a ride in a hidroplane and see killer whales jumping, fiords in all their splendor, humpback whales breathing, and going around them many times just to enjoy this moment, priceless.  We booked this trip in advance, so as soon as the cruise arrived we were picked up and it was significantly cheaper than a similar excursion organized by the cruise. Strongly recommended.

review_title: Wow! Amazing trip and awesome staff
review_text: Booking was simple and the staff was very friendly. When we finally arrived a few months after we made the reservation, the staff treated us so well. Emily and the rest of the ladies at the check-in desk were fantastic. The flight was easy and smooth. Our pilot was very professional and made me feel confident in the ride, even though I was nervous about the flight. We did a glacier landing (strongly recommended) and it was unbelievable! Wear boots or they provide booties to keep your feet dry on the glacier. The only thing I would change would be to do a longer trip or do it again!

The folks at Wings over Kauai Tours could not have been nicer.  Our pilot Josh was a great guide, very knowledgeable about the island, and pointed out things as we flew over.  It was a much better experience than a helicopter.  Much better value, and more comfortable too.  Got great photos, and the dvd we were given, which we did not have to pay extra for, was really great.   Would definitely recommend taking this tour.
Great experience, truly one of a kind! Out Pilot Jon was friendly, skilled, enthusiastic and very professional… with a great sense of humor. Sensational part of out travels, and highly recommended!

My husband and I traveled to Maui for our 10 year anniversary. This plan trip was the best experience we have ever had. The flight was amazing and seeing the cliffs from this perspective was breathtaking. My husband even got to help fly the plane! I’m looking forward to another trip
We saw Miami from a different view - night view. Joel is an awesome pilot. I would definitely recommend it.

My husband and I did a flightseeing tour on April 6 and it really was one of the highlights of our short trip. The views were amazing and it was exciting to fly so close to the snowy jagged peaks. We landed on the Ruth Glacier and it was absolutely beautiful! My feet and hands were turning into popsicles even with several layers on, but it was still worth it. It's an experience you'll never forget! I would highly recommend this!

Had a great trip to Mt. Hood and back through the Columbia gorge.  I had my nine year old son got to sit in the front seat and help pilot the plane.  Guide was great.  seeing Mt. Hood up close was amazing.  Would definitely recommend using Envi Adventures.
Best experience! Great for whole family. Went with kids ages 10 & 12 - a day we will never forget. Space for RV parking & easy walk into town for lunch afterwards

review_title: incredible manner to enjoy the canyon!
review_text:
The tour was amazing and it left us breathless!

It is a great way to get the idea of how huge the Canyon is! 

The pilot was extremely nice and helpful and everything was explained to us! 

It is def. worth the money!

Magique, extraordinaire

Le pilote que nous avons eu (parmi 3) n’est pas commercial pour un sou, il est passionné tant par Miami que par la faune et la flore.  
Il nous a fait voir des lamantins, des requins et des raies. !!! Si si. Et il est revenu plusieurs fois à leur recherche en tournant. Pour nous permettre dès les voir 
Enfin. L’hydravion est vraiment  charmant.

After waiting 3 days for the weather clear weather we were able to make our glacial landing flight.  The company was excellent to work with helping us reschedule our flight and was very honest and up front regarding their estimate of success.  In the end we only got a glimpse of Mt. McKinley on our way to the mountains and the clouds came back in.  We flew through many deep canyons and were unable to make a landing on a glacier due to weather conditions.  Finally we had a break and our pilot, Bill, was able to make a very smooth landing.  Because weather conditions prevented the tour we had signed up for the company adjusted the cost.  1st rate and very honest company.  Our pilot was excellent and provided much information of the mountain and glaciers.  First rate company and great pilot.  Can not ask for more and are looking forward to our next trip.
Great experience!  The pilot was very informational and the entrie staff was friendly.  I have taken both a herlicopter tour and the airplane and this was a much better overall experience.

Absolutely fantastic experience and Michael did a superb job to show us Miami from a completely different perspective. I was at first considering a helicopter flight but found some reviews telling that some people have been seated in the back-middle which led to seeing less and uncomfortable flight. Definitely recommend this one!

They were there waiting for us.  We walked there from the train station. And when it was over they willingly took us to our hostel.  The pilot was great and the service was fantastic.  I have no complaints at all.  Awesome experience.
Amazing experience wonderful driver easy and accessible to come.  very friendly and warm invited I truly had so much fun

My husband and I had an amazing time on our air venture flight!  It was gorgeous and informative. However, I'm a highly sensitive person and passed out about halfway through the flight due to being airsick...was pretty scary and unfortunately ruined the last half of the trip (the most beautiful part, the Napali coast!). Other than that, we loved it!!!

Had the perfect time with our Pilot/Guide! Made us feel safe and welcome. The tour is essential if you want a good idea of what the total island looks like and where you would like to visit. Would highly recommend! I even attached my gopro on the side wing strut for amazing video!

review_title: K2 MCKINLEY EXPERIENCE FLIGHT!  OMG!  THIS IS AWESOME!!
review_text: 60 minute flight around Mt. McKinley.  Spectacular views and incredible learning experience with our pilot, Nick. (So much knowledge and expertise!)  Absolutely breathtaking flight!  Don't skip this!!

review_title: Safe and Fun, Even With Pandemic and Without the Sun
review_text: The weather was gray and wet but we were able to go up with Fred. We kept to the Bay and flew close to the GG Bridge and over the Bay Bridge. I was bummed that the weather kept us from going over the City, but Fred made the best of it, and we enjoyed our time in the sky. There's no better feeling than flying I can think of, besides my other favorite, being in water. It was my husband's first time in a small plane and he enjoyed the ride and views. Things were not so far away, especially since we were flying low because of the weather. A COVID note: Our temps were taken and the pilot disinfected the plane before we boarded, and all abroad wore masks. I could feel outside air moving through the cabin, too. I felt pretty comfortable and safe. Go flying and keep this awesome business afloat! (Get it?)
John was amazing! Simply Beautiful flight and sights! I highly recommend this tour. Envi Adventures are the best!

I'm fortunate to have taken this tour twice, including the glacier landing, both in the summer and in the winter.  I can't say that one was better than the other.  Both were breathtaking, but on the winter tour there were fewer tourists and I got to sit up next to the pilot in a smaller plane.  I am especially thankful that, on my last trip, they diplomatically put up with my fearful, hysterical sister, who initially refused to board the plane.  I was so embarassed, but they took it all in stride.  There was a little audio problem with one of the traveler's headset on my first flight, but I never had any audio issues myself.  The pilot's running commentary, while nice, is really not all that necessary anyway to enjoying the tour.  The views are so incredibly breathtaking that who care's what the name of this or that mountain is. A once (or in my case twice) in a lifetime adventure well worth the expense!

review_title: An Absolute Must When Traveling to Alaska
review_text: This is the best way to experience the Alaska Range of mountains and get a feel for what its like to be a mountaineer hiking around peaks 20,000 feet above sea level.  We flew around Mt. McKinley and did the glacier landing which is not to be missed!  A truly unique experience that should be on everyone's bucket list.

I have to say this was one of the best vacations I have ever taken! Going around and checking things out, the island is just gorgeous! Some of the places were so eye popping that I lost my breath a couple of times! I don't know what to say really, it was just amazing!

review_title: Amazing Experience from start to finish!
review_text: I have done the helicopter tours a couple times but I was on Kauai with my wife on this trip and she has a bit of a weak stomach so we chose the plane experience instead. Granted you cannot hover next to a waterfall but this experience is still worth it and it's more affordable.  This pilot Marcus was an outstanding guide and we had a beautiful clear day to fly around the island of Kauai.  It was an amazing flight and experience for the senses.  I challenge anyone to look out the window and not see a waterfall.  I would strongly recommend the airplane tours for families and couples with small children who can appreciate the views.  Unforgettable!

review_title: Hope I can do it again!
review_text: Spectacular experience of the islands and all their beauty.  Would highly recommend this tour and Eric was a great pilot and tour guide.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_text: We didn't have time to do the land and air tour of the Grand Canyon so we opted for Westwind's Grand Canyon Aerial Tour. The overall experience was spectacular as were the views. Our pilot was both personable and knowledgeable.

review_title: Extreme experience at low price, Kauai from the sky
review_text: There are many places in Kauai where ordinal transportation can not reach. See from the sky is one of the good way.

We were fortunate to be here during wonderful weather.  Our pilot Randy was just fabulous!  We truly enjoyed out Glacier landing and truly appreciated Randy's knowledge and expertise.  What an absolutely wonder tour.  High recommend it.

Je recommande cette sortie même si c’est un budget important car la découverte du grand canyon vue du ciel est époustouflante surtout que pour nous c’était une première nous avions réservés les places à l avant avec supplément mais aucun regret une version en français pour les explications genial

I wasn't sure at first if flying over Kauai was for me, but with encouragement from my friend Sheila I signed up. It turned out to be one of the best things I did on the Island...after hiking, and visiting much on the ground it was truly great to see it all from a different perspective in the air.  Bruce is a seasoned pilot that make you feel very safe, and does a great job in narrating the overall experience with his extensive knowledge. If I only had one word to describe the experience....awesome.

Dan
Huntsville, Alabama

review_title: Incredible way to experience the Grand Canyon
review_text: I’m so glad my husband and I took this tour as a honeymoon gift. What an amazing way to see the beauty of the Grand Canyon and its immediate surroundings. It was our first time in an helicopter and we were a bit nervous. The pilot made all guests very comfortable. We were 6 in total.  He also shared valuable information about the canyon. The flight was very stable and the views left me speechless. I would def do it again.

Remarkable plane ride around Denali.  Our pilot Will explained everything and pointed out our altitudes, each peak, glaciers, interesting facts about climbers...even showed us a plane landing on the glacier below.  Felt like we could reach over and touch the mountains!

How do you describe something that takes your words away and leaves you speechless?  This was meant to be a Floatplane and Alaskan Bear excursion.  We definitely saw the floatplane.  :)  If you ever read my reviews you know that heights aren't my favorite thing - so the idea of being in a small aircraft way up high in the sky was shall we say - intimidating.  However, the folks at Taquan seem on the ball when it comes to safety and preparing you for the experience.  Our pilot was fantastic - he has been flying since 1968!  It really gave you a boost of confidence that you were in good hands.  The views were breathtaking.  Sadly, our group didn't see a single bear.  I'm not sure if the location could have been better chosen and/or monitored and rerouted based on activity - but the floatplane views and experience alone were worth the time.  Here's what made this an Excellent! experience... when our pilot heard that we had not seen a single bear he made every effort to help us find one from the sky! And we did.  We saw a bear!!

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip!
review_text:
The tour was absolutely unbelievable.  My husband, 13-month old son, and I did the mountain voyager with glacier landing and were blown away.  The glacier landing is definitely worth the extra cost! 

I was also extremely impressed with this company's honesty and customer service.  We were called on the day of our tour to inform us that the planes were having to fly high above the cloud line and the altitude would be too much for our son.  They were quick to reschedule us to a tour the following day.  When we arrived the next day, it was still really overcast and the employees were up-front about what to expect from the weather.  We opted to continue and we are so glad that we did.  Overall, I just think that it's great that you have the option of choosing on the same day whether or not you want to take the tour.  With the weather being as unpredictable as it is in this area, I'm sure business can take a hit when the clouds are out.  I think it's great that this company is more concerned about their clients having a great experience than making money even if the weather isn't cooperating.
The flight was awesome and we got to see so much of the canyon!  They did a beautiful job showing us around!
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_text:
There is absolutly no better way to see the Canyonlands. It is such an awesome sight from the air. If you want to see the CanyonLands you have to do it from the air. Our pilot "Chip" was knowledgeable, helpful and friendly. I would recommend the flight to anybody.
Fred L. Minker

review_title: 1 of a kind in my life time that words can not describe!
review_text: My husband and I took this trip at 430 and timing was perfect, not too windy , our pilot was so knowledgable of the history of Kauai it is fascinating. He would fly over some of the special valleys or sites twice so both sides could get their pictures and repeat the history of that site again if you were filming. Very accommodating to the customer. Also before we took off it started to rain a shower they checked with the helicopters next door that just landed as to how weather was flying in addition to the radar and their own pilot that just lAnded as to weather coming in. I felt they had our safety in mind at all times. The airplane was very comfortable and the windows were hugh to take pictures. I liked how you got weighed that only the airlines saw your weight behind the counter and no one else . I can't say enough about the beauty of the flight and a once in a life time experience, one of the top 5 of my life time after my children , grandchildren and marriage!   Philly Patsy

We called them on 11/16/11 and Ellen said be there @ 1:00 she was busy so she said we could just pay when we arrived. Very easy to find Shane was great pilot very knowledgeable had a wonderful time. Two of us had the plane to ourselves because someone canceled

review_title: Just amazing, we ran out of words
review_text: I cannot recommend Air Ventures highly enough. We had such a great experience with their biplane tour of the island. Every staff member we interacted with was great, friendly and helpful. Our pilot Eric was excellent; both with the flying and with his commentary on the island and all its features. It's such a great way to experience Kauai and see all the amazing landscapes, we seriously ran out of superlative words about 10mins in.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the Napali Coast!
review_text: Josh was very knowledgeable about the island.  The entire staff was very friendly.  We are definitely glad that we booked this trip.  The ride was smooth and the views were amazing.  This should not be missed!

Wow, wow, and wow! My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our flight with our pilot, Marcus. Not only was he an excellent pilot, but also a superb tour guide. It was a beautiful and informative flight. We will be back to Kauai and we will fly with Wings Over Kauai again.

Vol en hydravion fantastique à San Francisco.
Très bon pilote francophone, un must aux US car très rare.

We took the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing Tour" through the peaks to Mt. Denali.  The entire experience was wonderful,,, from the customer service and preparation before the flight to the landing on the glacier and the landing back. Our pilot was Mike Gold.  He did an outstanding with the flight pointing out all the sights and history.  We HIGHLY recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi and the glacier landing.  If you get Mike as the pilot, then that makes it even better.  Go for it and enjoy!

review_title: A "must do" if you can but you don't need to go longer than one hour.
review_text: After reading several reviews on trip advisor about the different flight seeing companies I decided on Talkeetna Air Taxi. Since you will certainly see the same views of Mt. McKinley, Foraker and Hunter and price is a concern, look for a company who has a coupon going on. All of the companies have good ratings.  If you are also visiting Denali, make sure you do not pay the additional $10 entrance fee to the park (yes they will add it to the bill) Lastly, I agree that the flight seeing excursion is a "must do" if you can.  We did the hour and a half with the glacier landing and in truth, the one hour flight  is MORE than enough.  Your experience will be just as memorable, with the same breathtaking views.

High marks for this tour. The mountain was open ( no clouds ) we booked on the spot and where in the air within a half hour.  One of the best tours we went on. The price was 60% YES 60% lower than a air tour we booked through our cruise line. Call direct and book this one ,or stop by there booth in " Down town" Talkeetna.

review_title: A total must do while in Kauai
review_text: After spending a lot of time researching the islands' various airplane and helicopter flights, we chose Wings over Kauai because it seemed like it was going to be a more personalized experience than the other options. (It was cheaper to be on our own flight-2 people plus pilot- than the other places were charging for groups of 6 people to fly).  For less than $150 a person, we got an hour flight, personalized tour and a husband and wife team willing to make your experience as enjoyable as possible- they even offered an ice chest with drinks for the trip, a lei, and what looks like a dvd with our picture on the cover (we havent had a chance to look at it yet). We were able to see all of Kauai's breathtaking views (and get the most beautiful pics) while the pilot/ tour guide, Bruce, answered all of our questions and offered interesting facts about the island's history.  This experience was more than we expected from beginning to end.  Bruce and Ellen were awesome hosts and very fun people.  We will most definately do this again the next time we are on the island.  Many of Kaui's tourist activities are over-rated and over-priced but this was not the case here and it was worth every penny!  Definately the highlight of our trip and we are still talking about it!!  Thanks again Bruce and Ellen- You Rock!!
We did the grand denali with glacier landing and it was perfect. Our pilot chris was great,and what a smooth ride! It was perfect and we will definitely be doing it again.

We had booked a flight to celebrate my in-laws 50th wedding anniversary, and Ellen and John were very friendly from the get go. Josh, our pilot, was also congenial and offered an excellent narrative throughout our air tour. The views were remarkable, though Kauai is beautiful at any angle :) All that being said, be aware that the 6-seater plane is very cozy (read: I'm 5'3" and had no leg room) and could use a little sprucing up. Also, not all our headphones were in working order which made it difficult to ask questions of our guide as we flew over the various landscapes.

The view is glorious and the landing on the glacier is something we truly were amazed by  it. 
The pilot was very friendly and was able to tell you about the mountains with all their names.
Our first fight was cancelled but they were able to work us in an available one.
Everyone going that way should take one of these flights.

We did the McKinley Summit tour and glacier landing and it was absolutely one of the most amazing experiences!
