Our pilot was great and makes sure everyone gets an awesome view and also the rest of the staff at k2 were so friendly and helpful. We were very lucky to have a bluebird day and the view was just spectacular! Would definitely recommend the glacier landing for the full experience!

My husband and I were told to go on a helicopter ride by a concierge assistant, but I read the reviews for Wings over Kauai and decided to give them a try. I have to say I am glad that I did. Not only did we enjoy the ride but it was half the cost of what we would have paid. Not to mention it truly was a private flight. Bruce was our pilot and he was great!

review_title: One of the best tour companyies i have taken
review_text: I booked the tickets looking at reviews in Tripadvisor. Bruce was so good and showed us the island with all details and keeping the trip alive with funny jokes. He was so good and so polite. I havent gone on any helicopter ride but why to was 250$ when u acn enjoy the same views with half the price with a nice tour guide like bruce who shows all the best locations on the island. Loved the tour and the tour guide.

review_title: Denali Flight with Base Camp Glacier Landing
review_text: Talkeetna Air Taxi ROCKS!! Amazing flight with narrative. Breathtaking views. You will not be disappointed with Rick Olmstead as your pilot. I am sure the other pilots are outstanding as well. Rick flew our plane. Trip of a lifetime! You will be talking about it for years to come.

review_title: Gorgeous and unique. Dont let motion sickness stop you.
review_text: great trip. expensive but worth it; absolutely stunning view!! Buy some ginger gum there if you get motion sick. It works
We loved it! It was such a beautiful tour. The colors were lovely and our tour guide was the best. I’d definitely recommend.
This was an excellent way to see Oregon - the trails, waterfalls, gorge etc.  The plane ride was also a lot of fun.  Our pilot was “Kale” and he was fantastic and knowledgeable.
the whole experience was memorable beyond belief.. especially going over the rim.... if you can afford it DO IT

On a recent trip to Hawaii we were after a helicopter flight but they were all fully booked so instead we opted for a fixed wing flight which was fantastic, the pilot/ owner was an ex commercial pilot as well as a Vietnam vet, so we were put at ease right from the off in regard to our nerves etc, he also had a great sense of humour, which also made us feel at ease. We all had a great unrushed experience and it was one of the main highlights of our trip with Ray our pilot showing us some amazing scenery, so to anyone reading this I would fully recommend this company for a casual, unrushed, and safe adventure in the air, and I would certainly book again the next time I am in Hawaii.

review_title: Best thing we did while on our trip in the Fall!
review_text:
Our decision to spend the money for the flight over and around Denali was the best part of our trip!  The fall colors (just after Labor Day) were stunning purples, pinks, yellows, oranges, and red, on the lower part of Denali.  Seeing Denali from the snow capped peaks to the glaciers at her feet was much more memorable than when we saw her from a distance in the Denali Park (on the bus tour).  We highly recommend this service.  
Our female pilot was great.  We wore headphones to communicate and were told that if our ears got painful from the air pressure that we should tell her.  We were seated in the back of the small plane enjoying the views so much that when our ears hurt we never took the time to try to communicate, our fault.

The staff at Northwest Seaplanes was fantastic!  The ride over to Friday Harbor was amazing. Beautiful views, great pilots, everything went very turn key!  They even had a shuttle to the SeaTac airport, which was only about 15-20 minutes away.

Great experience!  Highly recomended!

Well after two cancelations due to weather and maintenance the tour was great I would like to thank my pilot he was very helpful on every question I had I definitely recommend this company I'm sorry I forgot my pilot's name bit he was great and on time which in miami time is everything because there is alot to see.If you are in miami definitely check this people out the views are amazing and I even flew the plane for a minute the pilot offer. Thanks and I would do it again.

In all our research for Alaska, what stood out the most was the encouragement to see Alaska from as many perspectives as we could - land, sea, air. When we figured out that flightseeing out of Talkeetna would not only work great for our schedule, but allow us to experience the Alaska Range and Mount Denali, it wasn't a hard choice to go with K2 Aviation. The reviews were overwhelmingly positive, and we really appreciated the transparency on their website for the different routes available. From booking, to arrival, and check-in, the staff was very kind and helpful. I tend to be a bit of a nervous flyer ever since experiencing a super bumpy ride many years ago in a small 2 seater plane, but Lauren in the office was so encouraging and genuine in putting my mind at ease. We had booked the Denali Grand Tour, but due to weather conditions up there, we weren't going to be able to fly that route. Instead, we were offered the Denali Flyer and a refund for the price difference. For anyone wondering if a certain time of day is best, there really isn't, and all the staff confirmed this. Whatever time works best for you, is the best time to go! We were there for a 6:30 PM and it was an absolutely beautiful, sunny and clear day - and yet we still had changes because the cloud and/or wind conditions are always going to be completely different higher up and around the mountains. We had an absolutely fantastic time, and I felt great throughout the flight! I do recommend being on Dramamine or Bonine if you're prone to motion sickness and/or have some anxiety with flying - take one dose the night before to metabolize in your system, and one prior to your activity. Being prepared is key! Our pilot Mitch was very friendly, professional, and knowledgeable about anything and everything we saw from the air. The views were breathtaking, and we learned so much! It was an almost out of this world experience to feel like you're floating above and among the mountains. We were prepared to do a glacier landing, but some last minute cloud cover interfered. It was still an awesome experience though, and one we won't soon forget!

We've flown with K2 in the past and loved the experience so much that we did it again! We are from AZ and decided to stay in Talkeetna one night during our stay. We popped in to K2 without a reservation to see if by chance we would be able to join a flight, same-day. The front desk was friendly and informative, our pilot (Stan) was engaging and also very friendly. The overall experience was absolutely positive. We'll continue to be returning customers with K2!

Highly recommend booking a flight with Eric as a way to kick off your trip to Maui.  We got a beautiful overview of the islands and even saw many whales.  Such a beautiful and unique perspective to see Maui from the air.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: Highlight of Our Trip to Alaska
review_text: Wow! This was an incredible experience. Our pilot was professional, informative, trustworthy, and fun. He provided interesting information along the route and checked in regularly. This was a highlight of our time in Alaska. The mountain peaks are brilliant and the glacier landing was definitely worth the extra money. I strongly recommend this adventure.
Eine wirklich wundervolle Erfahrung. Ein sehr netter Pilot, klasse Maschine, toller Flug über Miami Beach und Key Biscayne
Our pilot was very polite and a lot of fun! 10 out of 10 would do it again! Thank you for the great tour
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: Excellent service. Very experienced pilot.  It is worth every penny. We flew the Cessna 182 out of Lihue.  The flight took sixty minutes.  This is the best way to see the Island.  As a pilot, I appreciated the opportunity to fly in this location.

It was awesome experience, the view was breathe taking. We loved every bit of it. The captain was amazing and very patient with us and answered every question we had. It us a must  experience if you come to Miami.

review_title: What A Great Way to See Kauai!
review_text: We decided to do this because it circles the island and is much cheaper than a helicopter (which I did thirty years ago when I first came!)  Plus, everyone gets a window seat which does not always happen in a heli.  The pilot gave us a great narrative and made sure both sides got to see everything.  Of course, we had a beautiful day and that helps for a great tour experience!

What a great experience - and our pilot, Daniel, was so knowledgeable and made our trip very special!  He is an expert pilot! He gave us wonderful views of all the mountains for all who were aboard as well as great views of Denali!

We had an amazing experience with Scenic Airlines last week (November 2008).

We took the overnight tour - which included an early pick-up from the hotel (5am!!!), an amazing and incredibly smooth flight at 6:40am from Boulder City airport to the South Rim of the Grand Canyon), a drop off at a viewing point, a rather delicious buffet lunch at a hotel in Tusayan, a visit to an Imaxx theatre to see a film about the Grand Canyon, and then a further drop off at the Bright Angel viewing point (which was very close to out hotel - The Maswik Lodges). We were able to see the Sunset, and in the following morning we had an option to get up and see the Sunrise too (a bus picked us up at 6:30am to take us to a suitable viewing point). This whole trip was excellently organised and run by a group of exrtremely affable and interesting tour guides.

I can't reccommend this trip enough! It was one of the very few companies that offered flights to the South Rim of the Canyon, with an overnight stay in the park itself. Well worth the money! The tour was the right balance of laid back and very organised (none of that hassled 'herded' feeling - and you didn't feel that they were continuously pushing you into over priced gift shops). I felt that we were given the opportunity to get a real flavour of the area - and the guides were very informative (some passengers took a free shuttle bus to see yet more viewing points - and were given the information to do so by Rick, the guide).

We managed to book the tour via a travel agent in the Planet Hollywood hotel - a kiosk right in the Miracle Mile shopping centre (just as you go through from the casino into the shopping centre).

(p.s. We managed to see plenty of wildlife at the Canyon - deer, wild pigs and chipmunks, and there were some nice gift shopping opportunities - but this was in no way shoved down your throat). We also managed to get a very nice evening meal from the Arizona Lodge amd a delicious breakfast from the Bright Angel hotel. The beers in the Bright Angel hotel were also very good... we sampled a few "Fat Tires" during our evening stay ;-)

Took the Airtour over Canyonlands and Arches May 7th with Andy our Pilot. This flight is so amazing to see the Landscape from above is spectacular!Andy was so great, extremely knowledgeable and entertaining! I highly recommend anyone to treat them self to this awesome flight.Ask for Andy!He made it even better!

Let me preface this by stating that I am not a big fan of small planes.  I had a very uncomfortable close call experience while flightseeing over Angel Falls in Venezuela,  so I had some trepidation prior to our K2 tour to see the glaciers.  That trepidation was erased roughly 1 minute into the flight; once we were airborne, I got a sense for what a treat was in store.  The pre-flight safety precautions and impeccably maintained plane, coupled with our very knowledgeable and friendly pilot Scott put me at ease immediately.  Prior to our K2 flight, I thought I had already been awed by what AK had to offer, but Denali and surrounding areas are so much more breathtaking from the air.   The views were even more unforgettable thanks to Scott who answered all of our questions  and provided insightful information about the history, geology, and wildlife of the area.  
Thanks to K2 and our pilot Scott for an unforgettable experience!!!
Josh was super friendly. Kept the flight as smooth  as possible in a small plane. Knew his was around the island and knew where the interesting sights were.

I surprised my boyfriend for our anniversary with the Triangle flight and I've never seen him more excited! Our flight was absolutely incredible, perfectly timed during sunset over Mt Hood and back through the Gorge. We were able to capture amazing photos and memories. Ryan was an awesome pilot and gave us some random facts and pointed out every waterfall. Would 100% fly Envi again, and we plan to soon!

An experience not to be missed! Our very experienced and capable pilot Lou gave us an amazing flight over the Alaska Range and onto the Ruth Glacier - absolutely breath-taking! The highlight of our three-week tour!

Our flight was supposed to include Hoover Dam, Lake mead, and the sky walk n flight to private bluff in the canyon. Our pilot was busy adjusting his instrument and talking to other pilots because of heavy traffic I guess. No narrations. Hardly see Hoover Dam. The Grand Canyon was nice. We had flights in Kawaii and Maui in Hawaii before and this is nothing like those. We both fell asleep on the way back because it was so boring. If you never seen the desert then maybe it would be worth it to you. Again, this is about the flight and not about the Grand Canyon, we see other helicopters flying low between the canyon to get a better view, and this was how our flights were in Maui and Kawaii. I felt bad for the other couple because their trip did not include landing at the bluff which was way better. Not sure why our pilot did not fly low like other company. He certainly can do it because he took us down to the bluffs and certainly flew between the walls. We were told that our company was the only one that can land in the canyon. Other helicopters that we saw had Grand Canyon on their helicopters. The way they fly looks more fun. In my humble opinion, if you can see the canyon by flying low then you don't need to and and at extra money unless you want some pictures. This is the first time we took a ride in a helicopter tour without narration from a pilot whom I also consider a tour guide.  I guess we should be greatful for getting back in one piece. It kinds of sting paying over $569/ person and learn very little about our tour. Sorry, I am just comparing to my past flight experiences. Staffs were nice. Pilot was nice but not as informative as we would like. He was concentrating on his instrument and traffics because it was a new helicopter. Nice and funny guy. We did tip him even though we didn't enjoy as much. He was doing his job making sure that we are safe.

review_title: You just cannot fathom the scale!
review_text: Spent a month in AK- was the hi-lite of the trip! All the staff are extraordinary-very customer service oriented, great crews and grounds ops. Aircraft was top notch.  Narration was very good, and the scenery spectacular! You cannot imagine! Landing at base camp was silky smooth on new snow. Dave was great pilot. He made sure everyone got views and shots. Hard to keep your jaw from dropping!

review_title: I highly recommend this family-owned business for your next trip to Kauai
review_text:
This is a once in a lifetime experience to be able to see the beauty of the island from the air.
Bruce was a great pilot and a great teacher to understand how flying a Cessna works and to explain us everything about Kauai.

review_title: Denali flightseeing in all its glory!
review_text:
We arrived at K2 early.  The original 10:30 appointment time was not going to work, since the bus to the train to the cruise ship was leaving an hour earlier than scheduled.
Noel greeted us and was fantastic!  Yes we could go early, yes they had room and yes they would work it out.  Thank you K2!!  

Then off to fly with Billy the pilot.  There were 4 of us on the flight plus the pilot. Billy did a great job telling us all that we were seeing.  We flew out of Talkeetna and on to Denali to see the mountain up close and personal.  And boy did we see it!  Sunny, very few clouds and views for miles.  we flew around the mountain (no landing scheduled) and it was everything I could have hoped for.  

We landed, bought t-shirts and a video and made it back with plenty of time for the day.  Off to Talkeetna for lunch.  I would highly recommend K2.  They were personable and safe and we had a great flight.

One of the highlights of our visit to SF! Take off and landing were really smooth and the aerial views were amazing. Pilot was really knowledgeable and professional. My only complaint is that it was over too soon!

My husband and I had an amazing time on the Grand Denali Tour. The scenery was absolutely beautiful and the flight was calm and comfortable. We had a great time hanging out and taking pictures during the glacier landing. The weather was perfect and our pilot, Jonathon, was extremely knowledgeable.  It was definitely an experience of a lifetime!

Five + rating! Our two hour trip was spectacular! Our pilot, Paul, made sure that his 9 passengers saw everything whether you were sitting on the left or right hand side of his plane. I was in the second row and got great photos. With that said, the first row would have been better. Paul described what we saw through the headphones. The trip included a glacier landing which was just as thrilling!  Another opportunity for photos of which I took a total of 364!!!! 
We rented a car in Anchorage to drive a little over two hours for this adventure and are so happy that we did. Highlight of our vacation . . .  so far!  👍👍👍👍👍+

My wife and I took the Figure 8 flight that takes you on a tour into the Columbia River Gorge and then tracks back over the city of Portland. We were able to fly close by the Vista House, Multnomah Falls (as well as a bunch of others) and over Bonneville Dam. The view of all the mountains in the region was spectacular. We then circled back to Portland where we flew directly over the control tower at PDX and then over the the bridges and skyscrapers downtown. This is a fantastic tour of the area that you really need to do at least once! Our pilot, Garrett, was exceptional and helped make our trip very enjoyable.

If you do nothing else while visiting Alaska, make sure you do this. We did the 2.5 hour Grand Denali with Glacier Landing. It is absolutely worth every penny. We have been visiting Alaska for a month and this was the best thing we have done. Make sure you do this out of Talkeetna because if you fly out of Anchorage you will not see as much. A good part of your flying time is just getting there. We had a perfectly beautiful day and the time spent on the glacier taking pictures and playing in the snow was priceless. The plane is small (10 passengers),but it is not cramped and everyone has a window. We will remember this forever. Tnank you Talkeetna Air Taxi.
We had an awesome time!  Full view of Denali!  Riley, our pilot did an amazing job.  We had a perfect landing on Ruth Glacier.  Thank you, K2 Aviation!  Highly recommend the trip with the landing.

review_title: Amazing tour and great way to see the island!
review_text: We just got back from our trip to Kauai for our anniversary and son's 3rd birthday. We debated whether to do an aerial tour or not, and in the end decided to go for it! I AM SO GLAD WE DID! With the little ones it was hard to feel like I really saw the island and this was a great, relaxing activity everyone could enjoy. The day of the tour, we received a call that the Air Van needed a part and would not be flying that day. We were given a few options (basically whatever we wanted to do they would work with us). In the end, we were re-booked on the Cessna at a later time that day. Our guide Marcus was awesome, enjoyable, and very knowledgeable. Everyone at Wings Over Kauai was warm and welcoming, and went out of their way to make our day an enjoyable experience for all!
Best day in Alaska so far!! Whole experience was special from meeting the owners dog Charlie to our pilot Stan!! Highly recommend!!

If you ever travel to Alaska, I would put this on the top of the list of things to do while you are there.  It was by far the most amazing thing my wife and I have ever done on vacation.  The pilot was great.  We stayed on the glacier nearly twice as long as the brochure suggests.  The plane ride was super smooth for a smaller plane.  All the pictures in the world can't portray the beauty you will see.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Tour was highlight of vacation.  Counter, flight line, and pilot were knowledgeable, friendly, and very helpful in meeting all my needs.

I loved hearing the history and seeing all the turtles. We even got lucky and saw a couple monk seals and dolphins. Christian and Captain Dayton were wonderful and very knowledgeable. Definitely would go again!!

Went for the Glacier landing.  Was fantastic!  can be best summed up from the fact that a couple on the flight with us had flown the tour the previous day - was unable to land on the glacier - so decided to drive back the next day from Anchorage to do so -& they were happy they did!  Highly recommended for all ages

review_title: Great option for an aerial overview-Affordable and Great Service
review_text:
We were looking at Helicopter tours, but I read so many great reviews for Wings Over Kauai, that I preferred the plane. My husband wanted to do a doors off helicopter but there were weight limits and the potential of being crammed in a middle seat. I didn't want to pay a lot and be stuck in the middle. My husband, friend, and I decided to try this option. 

We did the airvan tour. Booking and check-in were smooth. There was plenty of parking near the office. The plane also had plenty of room. We went with one other nice couple. Customer service was excellent. The flights were pretty full but they squeezed us in for a 4:00 p.m. flight and it was perfect. The sun was out and the lighting was great for pictures. Bruce personalized the tour and gave us a good background of the island too. They also had drinks in the plane if anyone wanted them.
After the flight, they gave us a CD with music and our pictures in front of the plane at no extra charge, which was a nice gesture.

I also think you got more minutes in the air with the plane and less rocky motion so if anyone is subject to motion sickness, this would be a smoother ride and nice way to see the island.
In sum, we highly recommend this as it is a great value for an aerial tour and excellent customer service.

What an awesome day! This was such a special way to experience the Grand Canyon from the sky, land, and by water. The day was so well organized and the simplicity of transitioning from one event to the next was so nice. The cost for this trip was the only thing that caused us pause, but ultimately we found it to be worth the investment.

review_title: Best way to see the Canyon!
review_text:
While I was a little apprehensive, our pilot was very reassuring before we took off.  They take your picture before you take off that you can buy but the best part was that they created a DVD for your trip so you can hear the people that you travel with during the trip.  Our pilot created a fantastic soundtrack to go with the trip which is on the DVD. This is great so you don't have to watch the trip from your camera. 

I can't say enough about how great it is to see the canyon from this point of view.  It's so vast that seeing it from land is just not the same.  Our 45 minute trip felt like 15 minutes.  Highly recommend!!!!

Checked in at 8:15am for a 9:00am flight. They weighed us and gave us our seat assignments. 1 seat on the left side, 2 seats on the right side of the aircraft (Twin Otter). I asked about getting a seat on the left side (heard it was better). The agent said that because we had children, we needed to be seated next to them, thus, we'd be on the right side. I was disappointed, but hey, it sounds reasonable to me.

The crew offer a picture in front of the airplane before boarding. On board, we are given a quick safety brief and shown where the barf bags are. They have headset over which a guided tour is played during the flight.

The right side of the airplane is just fine for viewing the canyon and surrounding areas. I certainly didn't feel cheated. The windows are big and you can see out of either side. Note: if you are seat in row 4, the wing strut will be in the middle of your field of view. Not a deal breaker, but something to consider.

The canned tour was of poor quality and after about twenty minutes, I just took the headsets off so I could speak to my son.

Great flight and nice landing.

They try to sell you the photo at the end of the tour. It is a decent photo of your family surrounded by a collage of Grand Canyon images. Not my cup of tea, so we didn't spend the $20.

IMPORTANT: On your online reservation email, read the terms and conditions! You must call prior to showing up to RE-confirm that you will be there, otherwise you could be wait-listed! Our flight wasn't full, but I would have been pretty upset if it was! Luckily, I was rereading the driving directions when I saw that little gem.

We went for the morning flight in order to avoid some of the bumps. That went reasonably well, although the air conditioning did smell of exhaust that started to give us headaches after an :45.

All in all, we are really glad we did it.

Don't forget to tip your pilots! They are trained professionals working very hard for not a lot of money.

review_title: Lifelong Kauai resident gets first look at island from air -- just amazing!!
review_text: Flew in the Cessna 182 with pilot Eric for my wife's birthday.  In her whole life on the island, she'd never seen it from the air.  Eric was perfect -- polished, professional, reassuring, and very knowledgable.  Even had her put hands on controls late in the flight to get a sense of the beauty of flight.  Priceless experience, and so much better than a helicopter. Love this island anew...
My family really enjoyed flying over Denali and landing on the glacier was a super cool experience. I highly recommend it!

We took the Grand Denali Flight Seeing Tour with Glacier Landing. The tour provides awe-inspiring looks of the Denali mountain range and the glaciers. Thoroughly enjoyed the tour and took some great pics.

Highly recommend It.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Taquan Air was a great choice. This is a big operation. Very Professional.They have 5 or 6 planes, a big dock and check in/waiting room. The flight was beautiful. We went to the Misty Fjords where he landed in a cove, we got out on the pontoons, took pics, & flew back a different route. There are alot of choices of planes that do this and I chose Taquan because I could use my 2  for 1 coupon from my Toursaver Book.But after seeing all the others, I think they have the best planes & biggest operation. We felt very safe with a competent pilot.

review_title: It was absolutely amazing round trip flight. The pilot was very cordial and described all of the sites along the way there and b
review_text:
It was absolutelybperfect. The pilot was very informative and cordial.
The views were amazing. I would highly recommend Harbor Island flights.
tour_name: 41_9_3 Hours San Juan Island Seaplane Tour from Seattle_2025-03-06

review_text:
The air tour was a great. It was very informative.
I will say though that our narrator pilot needs to add a little live to his narration. It was as if he was tired of giving the same info over and over. A little flat.
Also want to say that if you do a combo tour, land and air and intend to tip on the combined price, the ground tour does not share with the air tour.

Words can't even begin to describe this experience of a lifetime! I had high expectations and they were surpassed! Our family of 9 felt very safe the whole time... except for the moments when we were so close to the mountains that we thought for sure that the pilot wasn't looking... but nope... we were supposed to be that close!

We lucked out on a beautiful, sunny day, so we got to see so much. The pilot was great about pointing out different things about the mountains and ice fields and plains and trees and glaciers and water and even the residence ON the mountain range! It was gorgeous!

I typically get motion-sickness so I took a dramamine before the ride and I did fine. It wasn't bumpy or anything - very smooth ride!

Was in the GC area for a few days on a cross country trip and obviously figured I had to do a helicopter ride. There are several tour companies that provide this, but Maverick came up consistently as the best. 

The views are spectacular and I'm glad I did it. The pilot did a great job and had good information about the canyon and areas we flew over which was nice. My enjoyment took a small hit due to the weather. The day of my ride was overcast and very windy. I was informed we may not even be able to fly. After a 10-15 minute wait they decided it was safe. I've never been on a helicopter so I do not know what the norm is, but it seemed pretty bumpy. 

Customer service at all points was friendly and solid. They made it very clear that safety was number one priority and kept everyone informed. They may be pricier than some of the other services, but personally I don't feel a helicopter ride into a massive, dangerous canyon is the time to be a penny pincher. Their helicopters are nicer and newer than most I saw at the other companies.

review_title: Once In A Lifetime Experience... Unbelievable!
review_text:
My wife and I had the trip of a lifetime with Wings Over Kaua'i on our recent trip to the island. We went to three different islands over the span of 12 days and saw many different things, however, this was the unquestionable highlight of our trip.

The company is a true family affair with Bruce, Ellen and their children, and they made us immediately feel welcome and a part of their extended family.

Bruce is an exceptional pilot and perhaps an even better tour guide. His knowledge of the island -- traditions, culture, geography, etc. -- is made even better by his knowledge of the climate and agriculture that you see during the flight.

We boarded his plane at the Lihu'e airport and took off on a route that followed the Eastern Coast south. We then turned West near Poi'pu and saw many things along the shore. During that part, and the entire trip, Bruce mixed in good conversation with fun facts and information about the island. It was as much of a learning experience as it was a sightseeing tour for us.

He then turned the plane northwest so that we could see the views of Waimea Canyon and eventually the dramatic Napili Coast. Words and photos do not do justice when describing these areas. It is truly an awesome sight and something that is hard to fathom. However, seeing it from the air adds an incredible dimension that you can't tell from land.

Bruce then took us along the Northern Coast of the island and inland to see Wailua Falls and other waterfalls. Again, an awe-inspiring experience.

When we booked the flight, Ellen warned us that the day we were going up could be a bit bumpy because of the tradewinds, but other than a few minor air pockets, it did not bother us at all. The entire flight was very comfortable for both of us.

Bruce also gave us the opportunity to open the window and take photos through that. We were amazed at the photo quality with the window both open and closed.

Overall, you cannot go wrong with booking this flight. It is unquestionable one of the best things I have experienced in our life. The price was very reasonable, and the quality of the experience was second-to-none.

This was a fabulous way to see Arizona! We truly felt like we were living like the 1% for the day, and the memories we made as a couple will be the stories we tell our grandchildren. This was probably our largest vacation splurge and it was absolutely worth every bit! The red rocks in the morning light were beautiful, the flight around the Canyon was stunning, and the history provided via the headphones during the flight was informative and helped calm nerves for those not accustomed to a small plane. If you are second-guessing the price, I assure you the adventure is worth it!

We went on our honeymoon and loved Wings Over Kauai. Not only was the price almost half of the helicopters - but we got to be in the air for a longer time and see the whole island.  They are the perfect size planes to feel like you are on an adventure ride - and the bubble windows are amazing!
The on site contact (Elaine?) was amazing and Josh the pilot was super informative and fun!

Thanks Wings over Kauai!
These folks are the best - from the initial pickup, the flight, the friendliness of everyone involved. If you're looking for a good tour to see the island, this is it.
Beautiful scenery. Friendly people who were very flexible to our schedule and weather. Highly recommend!

review_title: Simply, it's a must-do activity on Kauai.
review_text: When you live on Kauai, you have the ability to pick and choose. One of our best choices (other than making the decision to move here) was picking to take a Wings Over Kauai flight! Ellen was a great booking agent, very accommodating at the beginning of our check-in (our daughter was super stoked at receiving a stuffed animal to 'comfort/accompany' her on the flight was very thoughtful) and Ellen was amazing through the follow up e-mail and photo we received at the conclusion. The flight itself was awesome because we were able to fly over the Poipu area (not many helicopter tours do this) where we live, and we captured a lot of valuable photos that will always remain cherished by us! Our captain was amazing, he made us feel comfortable, reaffirmed our safety and took care of answering every question we had for him. A lot of people ask us ... airplane or helicopter tour of Kauai? ... my only answer is "Go do Wings over Kauai, it's a better feeling, better entertainment and better service." A+ experience, A+ tour, and an A+ company.

From the chopper you get views of the ocean, waterfalls, rain forest that are not possible from the road... Maverick is the best in the industry for safety, helicopters and level of pilots...we will always use them...

This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska. Not only was the flight smooth but the scenery was amazing. Steve narrated everything and filled us in on everything we were seeing! He made the flight very personable for us. He circled around whales that were spotted and took us to see a mama bear and her three cubs. I took dozens of pictures. My only regret was that it didn't last longer!!!

review_title: Awesome air tour at a great price
review_text: Pilot Ray did a great job showing the beauty of Kauai with many interesting points of narration along the way.  Made extra pass by some more significant sights.  Plane designed for touring, travels about 75 MPH, slower than the helicopters, giving a bit more time to appreciate the sights.  Much less money than the helicopter, and equal to or better than the copters!

We flew with Devyn in June and absolutely loved it! Unfortunately, we weren't able to go out to Mt. Hood due to the weather but we did get a peak at her while we were in the gorge! Such a stunning flight. Portland is a beautiful city and has so much beauty surrounding it. I'm an Oregon native and would recommend to anyone that's new to the city, visiting or locals!

We have lived in Miami and visited hundreds of times, but seeing the keys from the air with Tony from Miami Seaplane was a unique and memorable experience.  Easy to get to and arrange.  Tony was a knowledgable and warm guide who showed us a lot we didn't know about a city we know well.   Very safety conscious.  Strongly recommend this experience for visitors and natives alike.

Staff were very attentive and accommodating when weather conditions for my scheduled flight weren't optimal, but we were cleared for a flight later in the afternoon. Be flexible with your time as Denali weather is unpredictable and know that safety comes first with flights over mountains. Views were SPECTACULAR!!! Unlike anything I've ever seen before. Pilots demonstrated excellent flying techniques and were knowledgeable with the topography below.

review_title: Amazing a must do while in Kauai
review_text: Extremely memorable!!! Took this tour our first day on the island it was unbelievable!!! Absolutely magnificent. Our whole family did it which included our 4 and 9 year old children it was thoroughly enjoyed by the whole family. Bruce was amazing as well as all the office staff. Very personable and knowledgable about the island. They make you feel safe, comfortable, and welcome. I would recommend this tour without any reservation for all ages. Thank you wings over Kauai!!!

The flight went off without a hitch.  Spent about two hours flying over the Alaska Mountain Range and circling Denali.  Such breathtaking views!  The glacier landing was well worth the extra money.  We sat amount the mountains for about 30 minuets and it was amazing.

"Steve in town was great, offering to book us earlier given weather conditions. Great guy.
At the office, young blonde girl could not have been more accommodating, actually encouraging us to ask people who had just returned before deciding.
Brian the pilot was very informative, and personable.
You must do the glacier landing so book online and get a deal.
Yes its pricey. But its REAL and its Spectacular!
Great friendly staff! Wonderful scenery! Well worth the memories of a lifetime! Mr. JT gave us a smooth flight from beginning to end! Ray, Jill, and Kevin were superb!!!

Such beautiful scenery!  Such a wonderful company - full of people who seem to love their jobs and take really good and friendly care of their customers.  Went up over Misty Fjords with "Captain Dan" who was fabulous and very knowledgeable and put us all (five women!) at ease.  I had the distinct pleasure of riding in the co-pilot's seat which was a genuine thrill.  I will never forget this adventure or the people who made it possible.  As much as I enjoyed my trip and (amazingly) was not afraid, I couldn't help but remember the lives lost on a similar expedition (different company) a few weeks before.  My thoughts were certainly with their families and loved ones, and I appreciated even more our pilot's care of us.

review_title: This is the BEST air tour operator on Kauai
review_text: My wife and I took the custom flight on 8/23/08.  We were scheduled for an 1100 flight but the conditions were less the perfect so Captain Bruce suggested we come back later in the afternoon.  We arrived back at 1500 and went on a spectacular flight.  It lasted just over an hour and was the highlight of our seven days in Kauai.  This tour is much better then any of the air tour operators on the island and much more reasonable.

Awesome experience!  Lindsey was very helpful in working with us for booking.  Max was a great pilot to and from GC.  Helo, boat cruise, skywalk.  Can't tell you what was best because it all was amazing.

review_title: Beautiful Denali view and great service
review_text: What a great experience! My friend was hesitant and we ended up talking with one of the employees on the phone for quite a while before booking our flight—a shout out to Amy who eased my friend’s fears and gave us such personal attention! We took the 90-minute tour with a glacier landing, seeing both sides of Denali. It was a fabulous sunny day with an astounding view of Denali. Love that we had a female pilot with 18 years of experience! The takeoffs and landings were incredibly smooth, including the glacier landing. All around a fabulous experience, would highly recommend!

Everything about the tour exceeded our expectations. Josh was our pilot and he was very knowledgeable of the island history, the language, and the geography. He was very personable and a lot of fun to fly with. The weather was awesome and we got to see much more that most people do. I took lots of incredible pictures. The views were awesome and the ride was surprisingly smooth. Don't miss this!

review_title: Stuff Your Face & Fly With The Eagles
review_text:
My trip began with a bus ride from the dock to the lodge (perhaps a half hour trip), then the crab feed, then a flight back to Ketchikan.  Depending on when you go, the order may be reversed.

The trip up was on a comfortable bus, with a fun driver.  Plenty of local color and stories.

Then the feast.  As many dungeness crab legs as you want, with all the butter you want.  Delicious.  And messy.  Dessert is cheesecake, but you can skip that and have more crab if you prefer.

The flight back was on a 1950s vintage Dehavilland Beaver with up to date avionics.  Surprisingly short take off run.  Then over the island to Ketchikan and a smooth landing.  My first flight in such a small aircraft and it's a very different sort of experience.  The trip is short, but fun with great views.  And if you you are lucky, as I was on this trip, you can find yourself soaring with Bald Eagles over the forest.

review_title: Highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska
review_text: Amazing views of Denali- we were fortunate to have a clear day. Leighan, our pilot, was amazing. The flight was smooth, landing on the glacier was awe-inspiring, and her commentary was interesting and tailored to the group. She eased the young guest who was anxious, was personable and professional. This is a don’t miss experience.

One of the best views of Denali, Hunter, and Foraker! We bought the Groupon and took our parents (they are visiting from the lower 48) with us. We have seen the Alaska range from different angles and this is one of the best! Richard was our pilot and he definitely knew what he was doing. We'll do it again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Seaplane over the best part of America
review_text:
Booking was easy
Special time accommodation 
Military discount
Price -More affordable than i thought

Great Pilot

Interesting history tour guide during the trip

A nice family time

AnthonyG

review_title: Incredible: One of the highlights of our Alaska Trip!
review_text:
We did the Glacier Landing Tour with TAT in July 2015 during our Alaska Vacation.  Though we were delayed slightly due to weather related reasons,  TAT team were continuously updating us with the latest weather information and also ensured that the flight promptly took off as soon as the skies cleared up. 

The flight itself was simply amazing. We first viewed Denali from different directions and also saw the amphitheater and other interesting attractions such as Ruth Glacier before landing on the Glaciers. 

Important notes to consider: 
1) One must definitely take advantage of Northern Light coupon for TAT - this will provide 25% savings on all TAT tours
2) TAT can accommodate groups of up to 10 people in the same flight.  Based on the enquiries I did, other competitors could not do the same. This certainly is a plus for TAT

Conclusion: 
I would strongly recommend TAT to anyone considering a glacier landing flight in Alaska and also viewing Denali from close quarters.

I booked this tour for the sites and sunset and it did not disappoint!  First I want to mention I am scared of heights and to fly, but this flight was extremely comfortable and smooth.  Smoother and wayyy more comfortably than any commercial jet flights.  The tour is a must do. The views were spectacular and sunset is gorgeous. The experience of flying in a small plane is one not to miss.   Our pilot, Tracey, did a great job at pointing out the sites and shared some interesting history. We saw some much and got great aerial shots. This is definitely a tour I'd definitely recommend.   Thank you Redtail and Tracey for this amazing experience!

review_title: Scenic Canyon River Adventure vs Imperial Ecostar Helicopter Tour in Grand Canyon South Rim
review_text:
Both the tours left from Grand Canyon National Airport. Both I booked through Papillon, but Helicopter left from Papillon section of the airport whereas Scenic Canyon River Adventure left from the Grand Canyon Airlines section of the airport. 
Helicopter tour - lasts 45min, $294 (I would give two stars)
Grand Canyon River Adventure - lasts 15-16hours, $394 (I would give five stars)

Imperial Ecostar (Two stars out of five)- The first day I took a helicopter ride and booked "Imperial Star Helicopter Ride" by Papillon. The helicopter is well maintained and a smooth ride. It was advertised as 40-50minutes, but my tour lasted 35minutes and we spend approximately 10-13minutes seeing the Grand Canyon. My pilot was not friendly as she preferred not to talk much and didn't seem to know answers to simple questions about the Grand Canyon. I am not sure whether the pilot was interested to be there. I was disappointed that I wasted nearly $289 with limited time over the Canyons, so decided to do a different one the next day and I got it right the second time - the Scenic Canyon River Adventure.

Scenic Canyon River Adventure (Five out of five stars) - I booked it through Papillon website, but the tour left from Grand Canyon Airlines from Grand Canyon National Airport. I couldn't get enough of this tour as I enjoyed throughly every minute of it. It costed $394 for the whole day, breakfast and lunch included, it lasted 15 hours, we left at 6am. When we arrived at 6am in GC airport, our breakfast box was waiting.  We boarded on a small plane to fly over the Grand Canyon to Page Airport for an hour, our plane was an eight seater plane with brilliant views for everyone as all seats were window seats. We flew over Grand Canyon, saw Glen Canyon Dam and had beautiful views. In fact I enjoyed my views from this plane than the helicopter tour I did the previous day. We had a short break in Page airport where we could use toilets and was given a brief briefing on what the next tour would be - Antelope Canyon visit. We sat on back of trucks which were converted to be tour trucks with two rows of seats backing each other thereby all of us got good views of the town on the way to the Upper Antelope Canyon. It was an interesting unique rocky fun experience in this truck to the Antelope Canyon, I wouldn't want to trade it any other way. We spent some time visiting the Upper Antelope Canyon where our tour guide showed all the interesting views of Upper Antelope Canyon. I wish this tour had included the Lower Antelope Canyon also. We were then taken to Colorado River Discovery Office where we had 45 minutes to relax in the cafe and take a toilet break. We could fill up our water bottles in the cafe. Big buses came to pick us up to the Glen Canyon Dam site. We were given packed lunches when we boarded the bus.The long tunnel ride by bus was one of the most unique drives I have encountered - I would suggest to sit on the front seats as it has better view in the tunnel than the rear ones if you are interested in watching the dark tunnel drive. The tunnel was a two mile long dark tunnel dug through the canyon walls with small window of light dug out for ventilation. On the end of the tunnel was the base of Glen Canyon Dam and our motorized raft with our tour guide. Our guide Brian was knowledgable, interesting, interactive, fun and made our 4 1/2 hours ride as perfect as it could be! We had two toilet breaks, two brief swimming breaks, stopped at petroglyps, took several pictures, it was serene and beautiful in the Colorado river.  Interestingly, I couldn't picture the feel of Horseshoe bend while in the river as well as we could see it, since our view was limited by the Canyon walls. (So went the following day driving to see it from top of the Canyon). We had plenty of drinking water on board also. Our motorized raft ended in Historic Lees Ferry Port where buses were waiting to pick us up to drive back to Grand Canyon National Airport, it was a long drive for 3 1/2 hrs. We stopped at Cameron Trading Post where there were interesting Navajo Indian Reservation handicrafts, gifts, cafe, toilets and hotel. Our bus driver pointed out to the interesting tourist spots on the way back and stopped to drop some people off at the South Rim before getting back to Grand Canyon National Airport.

This was the best excursion my mom and I had taken during our cruise to Alaska!! I’m so happy that it all worked out perfectly. A few weeks before our cruise, I contacted Lesley to ask about their handicap accommodations as my mom had fallen a few years ago which left her with a broken shoulder and hurt foot so it’s a bit more difficult for her to get in and out of cars/planes/trains. Lesley assured me that they have ramps to the dock/onto the plane and was confident that my mom would be able to enjoy the flight. She also offered a great deal to my request of an AAA rate so I booked right away for our day in Ketchikan. When we arrived at the cruise port, Lesley picked us up in their van right by the port (no need to have to find our way to their dock). This excursion was a HUGE surprise for my mom’s birthday so I never actually let her know what I had planned for us until she saw the seaplane advertised on the side of the van. I knew she would never partake in such an adventurous excursion if I told her ahead of time. By looking at the shocked expression on my mom’s face, Lesley was so warm and comforting to my mom’s jitters of flying in a seaplane. Even the fellow passengers who would be flying along with us were so nice and friendly -- they tried their best to keep my mom’s mind off her nerves ☺ Once we got to the dock, we met our awesome pilot Peter who helped my mom into the seaplane with the use of the ramp. Easy peesy! We got to wear these great headsets where we could hear each other ask questions, the pilot provide feedback about what we’re seeing, and incredible music that fit the sights (ie. Jurassic Park soundtrack). It really made the entire flight enjoyable. BUT THE VIEWS! They were awe-inspiring and like nothing I’ve ever seen. We flew throughout a part of the Misty Fjords and even stopped at a lake dock for about 20 mins that had incredible views too. This flight was awesome and an once-in-a-lifetime experience! SO happy my mom got to experience this with me because by the time she got up in the air, her nerves settled and she loved every second of the flight. Big thank you to Lesley + team for a fabulous time in Ketchikan!
Had a nice trip me. Great greetings. Strawberry drink refresher at the end. Very, very, very very very very very very fun

review_title: Uno de mis mejores tours en avioneta
review_text:
La organización estupenda, se olvidaron de venirnos a buscar pero finalmente llegaron e hicimos el check-in con tiempo más que suficiente. Muy profesionales y amables, sin duda, avionetas pequeñas y el piloto genial. 
Lamentablemente y por razones que no vienen  al caso, no pudimos aterrizar en el glaciar como teníamos previsto pero el tour fue tan fantástico  que casi ni nos supo mal. Los glaciares y montañas estaban tan cerca que casi se podían tocar, fue una hora y media de vuelo tan repleta de paisajes y emociones que no se podía aprovechas más. No dejéis de hacerlo, además Talkeetna es el sitio ideal, como el objetivo principal es ver de cerca el monte Denali, nuestra primera idea fue hacer el vuelo desde Denali pero nos aconsejaron Talkeetna e hicimos caso, menos mal, por lo que pudimos observar la opción Denali es mucho peor por zona y recorrido. Animo a todo el mundo a hacer el tour, no es el primero ni el segundo que hago en avioneta sobre montañas y este fue soberbio
Awesome trip... our Pilot Rick was terrific. Along with the tutorial on the headset, Rick clued us in on the many landmarks. Absolutely worth every penny (Dollar)

My husband and I recently visited Talkeetna, AK and chose Talkeetna Air Taxi for a flight seeing tour.  Every aspect from reservationst, Heather, to our pilot and tour guide, Chris.  Chris explained all the sites including the history of the same.  The glacier landing was great as was the scenery.  You won't be disappointed with Talkeetna Air Taxi and its first class service.
We had a great time seeing the entire island in an hour long flight. I don’t like heights but the flight was totally enjoyable. I would highly recommend it.

My family had a great time and our pilot, Makoa, did a great job of showing us the island sites with plenty of humor thrown in.  As a 30 year full time professional pilot myself I highly recommend Air Ventures.

My wife’s first helicopter ride was a great delight for her. Michael gave us a smooth ride, and was very informative. Being in a helicopter we were able to get lower, and closer to the formations. Only regret it was only 20 minutes, but it was worth every penny.

review_title: Helicopter tour and touchdown on the grand canyon floor
review_text: For my sister's 30th, all she wanted to do was take a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon. We could not have had a better experience! Pilot Tyler flew us "first-timers" out into the canyon and we touched down a couple hundred feet above the riverside. We were able to get out, walk around, and take photos before flying back to the real world. Extra fees to touch down on Hualapai land were very much worth it. Safe, and very professional. Would definitely go again!

Steve is such a wonderful guy and a great pilot.  He has a great sense of humor and you can tell that he loves what he does!  He takes time to get to know the people on the flight and really makes the experience that much more enjoyable.  
We took the Misty Fjords tours and found Steve through a mutual friend.  The views are amazing and he does a great job explaining everything.  He is very knowledgeable.  Any of his tours are a MUST DO when in town!!
Awesome tour on a spectacular day by Talkeetna Air Taxi. The landing on the glacier was unforgettable.

I had a great time!  I would have regretted not taking this flight - sure glad I got to go!
Kevin, my pilot, was great about pointing out sights and explaining mountainous formations.  Quite knowledgeable!

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text:
Let me start by mentioning that I have a serious fear of heights. But it has never bothered me on airplanes where I am completely enclosed.

The night before the flight (which was my first helicopter flight), we stayed at the Kachina Lodge in Grand Canyon National Park. As much is possible, I tried to stay about 6 feet away from the wall at the edge of the walkway. When I got closer, my acrophobia started to kick in. But in the helicopter, like in a plane, it didn't bother me at all.

We had five passengers on our flight, and with a helicopter that seats eight, 3+ the pilot in the front row and four in the back row, the pilot put my wife and I on the outside seats in the back row, and the other passengers in the front row with him, so everyone had a window seat and a great view. The pilot was a young guy but seemed very knowledgeable about the Grand Canyon. It was both an informative and enjoyable experience. For me, it was the highlight of our trip, which included time at the Petrified Forest, Las Vegas, Zion National Park, Bryce Canyon National Park, and Arches National Park. The flight itself lasted about 40 to 45 minutes, of course with check-in (and possibly souvenir shopping) allow maybe twice that. I highly recommend it.

Great  flight adventure over Miami Beach and harbour in 4 seat seaplane . The arrangements were well planned and executed. The friendly pilot gave us a splendid commentary during the flight. We planned the trip en route to the airport after a cruise. The company kindly stored our luggage whilst we took our flight. A taxi rank is only 200 metres from their offices so you can easily make your own travel arrangements. We took the 30 minute sight seeing tour. I think that was just right.

review_title: Once in a lifetime view of Denali National Park!!
review_text: Very exciting and once in a lifetime experience! Our pilot was amazing! He circled around the peaks allowing both sides of the plane to see. This plane ride provides stunning views of the Denali Mountain and adjacent peaks! The glacier landing was really neat, we were surrounded by mountains, and even saw a small avalanche!! This is great if you want to see mountains up close!

Our recent trip with K2 was great. The week we were in the area there weather was not the greatest, lots of clouds and rain. K2 was sending us updates and advised they route we selected was not available due to the weather but they did have an alternate route we could take. Shuttle driver picked us up updated us to make sure we were still on board with the revised trip. Said we were since prior communication had informed us so well.

Got there, checked in and settled up paying only the amount for the new route, less deposits. Then we meet the pilot Mike. Will say Mike did a really great job. We had a pilot in the group and he said Mike was a very smooth flyer.

Anyway, got up in the air, managed to get above the clouds to see Denali. Then he dropped through an opening to below the clouds. Had some great glacier views and even sighted a mother grizzly and her cubs plus some moose. Mike flew around so both sides of the plane saw them.

Finished with a nice smooth landing.

We all agreed we would do it again.

Excellent tour to Neets Bay and salmon hatchery.  Saw bears, eagles, seals, and other wildlife in their natural habitat.  Beautiful scenery on flight and at tour location.  Knowledgeable friendly and professional staff, guides & pilot. Highly Recommend!

What a perfect way to see the glaciers of Denali with a wonderful glacier landing.  It could not been more perfect.  Sunshine and could see Mt Denali in all its glory.  Not every day I can play in the snow in August as I live in South Carolina.  The beauty will give you a lump in your throat.  I am a travel agent and this is a must for all my clients.  It turned out to be the best tour while in Talkeetna.  I will be looking at the picutres and videos for many years to come. Take my advise and bite the bullet and GO!!
The views were amazing and with Eric we had a wonderful experience. Our 10 year old had his first co-flying experience which is a wonderful memory.
tour_name: 31_745_aMaui -PRIVATE- Air Tour 5 Islands (2-5 people) SEE Even MORE!_2025-03-02

review_title: No mist on the Fjord on our flight!
review_text: A truly amazing day!  The skies cleared after our ship docked and we had a to-the-horizon view over the mountains and pristine lakes below as well as a completely smooth flight.  Steve was great - as was his wife, Lesley, when I called to reserve.  Besides saving money compared to the cruise ship excursion cost, we felt we couldn't have been in better hands or with a nicer person than Steve.  He tried his best to find grizzlies for us and although there were none to be seen that day he did circle a mountaintop to show us mountain goats grazing on the grass.  Our excursion set the standard pretty high right at the start of our trip!

I saw recommendations for this company everywhere which is why we chose them. Super friendly and accommodating family running this tour. It was a great way to get a birds eye view of the island. You won't get down as close as the helicopters do, but you will still see plenty in a safe, reasonably priced way.

Considering that we had 3 fifteen year old we definitely wanted to keep things exciting for them. We decided to book a helicopter ride but wanted something reasonably priced. The airplane was a good way to go. 9 people max capacity which still made it a private affair at a reasonable price. The full tour of 40-50 minutes was great. 

We got some great aerial shots and the teenagers were happy.

I thank Chris the Pilot for providing the most spectacular views and most entertaining history of formation of Denali National Park. From the description of size of some of the biggest glaciers we have seen in the park to how much the Mountains have moved, Chris was on point with the details. I now know and appreciate that the photos I took are one of a kind for every year this national park grows and moves around guaranteeing a unique sight and experience every time.  Bragging to all, spreading the word. Will  absiolutely choose to fly again with K2 Aviation.

Great way to see the area. We did the 1hr Canyonlands trip which was fantastic. Our pilot Chip was very good pointing out specific sights and features.
Redtail are very obliging and will tailor a flight to suit your requirements.
As well as taking loads of pictures we purchased a SD video of the flight which was very reasonable and a great keepsake.
Thanks again redtail and particularly Chip.

review_title: K2 is on top of the World experience
review_text:
Customer service was first rate.  The whole experience was perfect.  I will do this again!
Great views of the mountains and MckInley.  Glaciers were awesome!  Landing on the glacier was smooth and beautiful.  I am so glad we were given the option and chose yes,  Our pilot was an excellent guide.

Very nice and welcoming people on the phone, at the front desk and the pilot. We group of 8 people were on a small plane. Very smooth ride, I was afraid of bumpy flight and motion sickness. We had tour with landing, however bc of weather condition the landing wasn't safe that day. Instead pilot took us around fto see few unplanned spots. Unforgettable experience!

We took the air taxi from Talkeetna Lodge to the Denali Park entrance on our departure day.  We thought it would just be a straight shot out, but they actually take you on a great flight-see around Mt. Denali on the way.  The pilot, Dave, was super competent, knowledgeable, pleasant to be with, very tuned in to our needs and interests.  It turned out to be a highlight of our trip.
We had an excellent trip from check in to finish. Very friendly staff and professional. Very accommodatiing to our group of six as we had to change schedules due to weather. Trip of a lifetime

Denali was not an option the day we went because of bad weather so they offered us another tour.  We had a wonderful pilot and got to see a lot.  I was in the co-pilot seat which was amazing!  My girlfriend was in the back and was a bit disappointed that she was unable to see a lot of things that were being shown on the opposite side of the plane.  She was really underwhelmed when she got off the plane.  All in all though we felt it was cool to be able to see Alaska from that high though, despite not being able for her to see that much.

The day of our tour, we found out later, was the same day the plane crashed.  They left only a few hours after us.  I have no idea what the factors were that led to that, because there is not much information online still. I have to say that memory will live with us forever.  We are still in total shock that a few hours later the same tour we were on was never coming back.  Our hearts are heavy for everyone involved.  What an awful day.

review_title: Maui plane rides was the highlight of our maui vacation! 5 stars
review_text: This experience was top notch! Eric answered our call  (no voice mail or answering machine) and our 1 1/2 hour flight was booked exactly when we requested. Eric is an excellent pilot and had no problem letting my husband (who is also a pilot) take control of the plane. We saw 5 islands and Eric told us history and facts about each area. Some areas can only be seen from the air. We also had a surpise whale watch during the flight. We were able to see the whales clearly from the plane and even did a 360 degree turn for extra viewing! We took many pictures and Eric even took some while my husband was flying the plane. Eric was extremely easy to work with. I highly recommend mauiplanerides.com bring your vacation to new heights!

review_title: Surreal views - do the glacier landing
review_text: My wife and I went on the Denali flyer tour and it was incredible. Our pilot Randy was wonderful and very informative. We landed on Pika glacier which was a one-of-a-kind experience. Walking on it and being in the middle of such enormous mountains was unforgettable.

"What an awesome adventure," is the best way to describe the scenic Aerial Tour taken by my husband and I today.  The professionalism, friendliness of the office coupled with our pilot, Rose's navigational skills made our trip to Arizona complete!

Omg this was our best trip!! We loved it. After checking in and a short but necessary safety briefing we were given Wellington boots to walk to the plane. The tide was in a little so they saved our shoes getting wet. The pilot was very friendly and informative. We shared our flight with another couple. There are 6 seats including the pilot. You get a headset with microphone each. The flight was very smooth considering its a small aircraft. The views were amazing. The bay, city, woods, sea, coast, bridge. Lasted 45 mins as described. It was so exciting. I would definitely recommend doing it.

We were ambivalent about booking this flight, having taken small plane tours on other holidays in the past, but the reviews convinced us to commit.  Wow, wow, wow!!! It was so beyond our expectations.  Our pilot, Bill, gave us so many photo opportunities and was so interesting to listen to. We were blessed with a hot, sunny day, so our experience was really amazing, and much of it surprising, gifting us with new knowledge and an appreciation of how the glaciers and the landscape is changing in Alaska. Our glacier landing helped us to have a better perspective of the vastness of the area we were flying over and Bill took excellent photos of everyone in our group.
On our return flight, an unexpected thunderstorm blew in quickly and all of us were very impressed with the professionalism of the Talkeetna Air staff and our staff in getting us back down on the ground safely.  We will be talking about this trip for years to come.  If you are in Talkeetna, don't miss it!

review_title: A glimpse of the mountains and rivers of ice
review_text:
The tour was excellent and we had a great chance to see the mountains in their true glory.  And for the first time I could really understand how the glaciers are really a rivers of ice, you could really imagine them flowing from one place to the other.
Even though we were going to take the Grand Tour and try and land on the glacier, this was not feasible due to weather conditions, but the K2 people offered options which made the trip totally worth while.  Thanks it was great.
my moms first helicopter ride was amazing. our pilot was knowledgeable, professional, and the communication was great. i highly recommend and couldn’t be more happy with the experience, thank you!

I have traveled much of the world, and the experience of flying past Denali and the other peaks, then landing on the glacier is one of the top five I have had in my life.  The "laid back" approach of the pilot inspired confidence and allowed us to truly enjoy every moment of the trip.  I would highly recommend this to anyone.  As a side note, it was a bit anticlimactic visiting the national park on the ground after the experience in the air!

I've been to Kauai several times and have seen and done most things there. Told my wife I wanted to do something I hadn't done before. I saw the biplane flying one day and decided that would be it. The trip was simply incredible. The seating is a little snug for two, but the trip was smooth and relaxed. Even though I have driven and walked many areas of the island, the aerial view is visually stunning. Picture taking is a challenge due to the open air cockpit, wind, and just hanging on to the camera. But it is really the live views that are the attraction. Harry, our pilot, was friendly and informative. Seeing the things from the air that we had experienced on the ground brought a whole new appreciation and perspective. Next visit, I will be up there again!

Kim Ruble has been my flight instructor for the last 6 months (I took it slow) and yesterday, I passed my private pilot check-ride!  Kim has been a fabulous instructor, always patient, easy-going and taught me everything I needed to know to pass.  The day before my test, Nick Lamoureux sat down with me for over four hours and did an extensive review of required paperwork (POH, maintenance records, my logbook) and what I should focus on for the oral portion of my test.  Everyone who works for Redtail are extremely friendly, helpful and genuine.  I couldn't have asked for a better experience.
